title: Chhauna Chhadi Tu Jagat Ko Shyam Sumir Sukh Leh - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj
sanskrit_text: ‘Chhauna’ Chhandi Tu Jagat Ko, Shyam Sumir Sukh Leh.Kutumb Mitra Tere Nahin, Jaar Karenge Kheh.- Shri Guruchauna Ji MaharajGuru Chaunā says, give up worldly attachments and keep your mind fixed on Śyāmasundara (Krishna), for only through His remembrance will you find real happiness. Your relatives and friends cannot go with you after death, and in the end, they will burn your body to ashes, leaving you alone.

title: Mann Mein Basi Bas Chah Yahi - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Mann Mein Basi Bas Chah Yahi, Piya Naam Tumhara Uchara Karun. Bithla Ke Tumhe Man Mandir Mein, Man Mohini Roop Nihara Karun. [1]Bhar Ke Drig Patra Mein Prem Ka Jal, Pad Pankaj Nath Pakhara Karun.Ban Prem Pujari Tumhara Prabhu, Nit Aarti Bhavya Utara Karun. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa! Now my only desire is to chant Your holy name day and night. Enthroning You in the temple of my mind, may I always behold Your enticing form. [1]With eyes filled with tears, may I wash Your feet continuously. O Lord! Make me Your loving devotee, and I shall continuously perform Your ārtī. [2]

title: Nityam bhaktpradheena Ten Radha Biharini - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (21)
sanskrit_text: Nityam bhaktpradheena Ten Radha Biharini.Saamyam Bhajati Bhakten Rase Krishnen Leelya.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (21)Sri Radhika Maharani always remains under the loving control of Her devotees. Sri Krishna Himself is Her foremost devotee; thus, under the influence of His Bhakti, She performs divine pastimes in the same loving mood as Him. According to the bhāva of each devotee, Swāminījī reciprocates with that very rasa, worshipping them with the same tender feeling of love.

title: Hari Tero Bhajan Kiyo Na Jaay - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
sanskrit_text: Hari, Tero Bhajan Kiyo Na Jaye.Kah Karau, Teri Prabal Maya Deti Man Bharmai. [1]Javain Avau, Sadhu Sangati Kachhuk Man Thharai.Jyo Gayand Anhai Sarita, Bahuri Vahai Subhai. [2]Vesh Dhari Dhari Haryau Par Dhan, Sadhu-Sadhu Kahai.Jaise Natwa Lobh Karan, Karat Swang Banai. [3]Karau Jatan, Na Bhajau Tumkau, Kachhuk Man Upjai.Sur Prabhu Ki Sabal Maya, Deti Mohi Bhulai. [4]- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarO Lord Sri Hari! I find myself incapable of truly performing Your bhajan. What can I do? Your powerful Maya keeps deluding my mind again and again. [1]When I associate with saints, my mind becomes calm for a while due to their holy company, but soon that same old restlessness returns — just like an elephant that bathes in a river and then throws dust upon itself again. [2]Despite dressing like a saint, I remained only a pretender — outwardly pious but inwardly deceitful, looting other’s wealth like an acrobat who performs a prank only for money. [3]O Lord! Though I am determined to worship You, however, as soon as I begin, worldly thoughts arise within me. Shri Surdas says — O Lord! Your Maya is so powerful that it constantly keeps me lost in delusion. [4]

title: Shri Radharaman Adhar Rachi Biri - Shri Gunmanjari Das
sanskrit_text: Shri Radharaman Adhar Rachi Beeri. Napan Sakal Karle Huri Aali, Nirikhat Raho Chhabi Ri. [1]Shri Lalita Ju Ne Mukh Dini, Kaise Adhar Fabi Ri. Gun Manjari Pyari Beeri, Rang Barne Kaun Kavi Ri. [2]- Shri Gunmanjari DasThe redness of the betel leaf (pān﻿) glows upon the lips of Śrī Rādhāramaṇ, and the sakhīs stand entranced, gazing upon that enchanting vision. [1]Śrī Lalitājī has lovingly offered the pān into Rādhāramaṇ’s mouth, where it shines resplendent upon lips. Śrī Guṇmañjarī says—such an exquisite pān has been prepared that no poet could ever describe the beauty of its color.​ [2]

title: Yah Tan Yah Van Jamun Tat, Milyau Vanyau Hai Dau - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Aasha Tyag (42)
sanskrit_text: Yah Tan Yah Van Jamun Tat, Milyau Vanyau Hai Dau.Tatai Aasha Chhadikai, Jugal Kishorahi Gau.- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Aasha Tyag (42)To receive a human birth and the grace to reside at the bank of the Yamuna in Shri Dham Vrindavan is an extremely rare fortune. Therefore, one should abandon all worldly desires and engage constantly in the loving remembrance of the eternal Youthful divine couple, Shri Radha Krishna.

title: Shri Vrindavan Ki Dhuli - Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari
sanskrit_text: Shri Vrindavan Ki Dhuli, Param Sumangal Muli. [1]Jehi Munijan Dhyan Lagavai, Brahmadik Chhuvan Na Pavai. [2]Jo Alin Pad Aradhai, So Pavai Bina Upadhai. [3]Jo Apna Sheesh Chadhavai, Aru Vrindavan Jas Gavai. [4]Jab Kripa Karen Shri Radha, Sab Puren Man Ki Sadha. [5]Uddhavadhi Shiradhari, Shuk Muni Mukhahi Uchari. [6]Jehi Agam Nigam Pukarai, Sab Riddhi Siddhi Taapai Varai. [7]Kahlon Kahon Vakhani, Mahima Kou Na Jani. [8]Shri Ramsakhi Man Dinho, Nij Ang-Ang Bhushan Kinho. [9]- Sri Ramsakhiji, Shri Bhaktiras ManjariThe dust of Sri Vrindavan is the very root of all auspiciousness.​ [1]That sacred dust, upon which sages meditate, whose touch even Brahmā and other gods find supremely rare.​ [2]Only those sakhīs who worship the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhāraṇī can attain that dust without any obstacle.​ [3]One who completely surrenders himself to this dust and sings the glories of Vṛndāvan becomes truly blessed.​ [4]When Śrī Rādhā bestows Her grace, all the aspirations of the heart are fulfilled.​ [5]That dust which Uddhava and others place upon their heads, and whose virtues sages like Śukadeva sing aloud.​ [6]Its glory is praised by the scriptures and the Vedas—even all Siddhis (wealth) and Riddhis (mystic powers) could be sacrificed for it.​ [7]Who can ever describe the full greatness of that divine dust of Vrindavan? Its true glory remains beyond all comprehension.​ [8]Śrī Ramsakhi says—she has surrendered her heart completely to the dust of Vrindavan and adorned every limb of her being with it.​ [9]

title: Dou Kanan Lagi Kahe Chumban Dehi Ankor -Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji Ki Vani, AnanyaRasikabharan Granth 1 (16)
sanskrit_text: Dou Kanan Lagi Kahein, Chumban Dehin Ankor.Abkai Mohin Jitab Sakhi, Lehun Balaiyan Tor.- Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji Ki Vani, AnanyaRasikabharan Granth 1 (16)In the evergoing plays of love (Nitya-Vihāra), Śrī Bhagavat Ali Ji — absorbed in the loving service of Śyāmā–Śyām — narrates: In that state, when the Divine Couple had become impatient with longing, They drew close to my ears, touching Them gently, and bestowing tender kisses as loving offerings. While doing so, they said: “O beloved sakhi! I sacrifice myself to you. In whatever way, this time you must ensure my victory!”

title: Bhatakat Phirat Nahak Chit Chalu - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (827)
sanskrit_text: Bhatakat Phirat Nahak Chit Chalu Tu Braj Bhu Sakal Aram.Vrindavan Madhupuri Mahavan Barsane Nand Gram. [1]Radhakund Govardhan Yamuna Pulin Manohar Dham.‘Ali Sanket’ Sukhad Drig Lakhiye Biharan Shyamashyam. [2]- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (827)O mind! What is the use of wandering aimlessly? Come—let us go toward the sacred land of Braja, the abode of peace and divine bliss. Vrindavan, Mathura, Mahavan, Barsana, and Nandgaon—all are supremely holy places of divine pastimes. [1]Radhakund, Govardhan, and the banks of the Yamuna—all are enchanting abodes. Sanket Ali says—Behold these blissful līlā places, where the divine couple, Sri Śyāma-Śyāma, eternally wander together. [2]

title: Varam Vrrindavane Ramye Shrrrimgalatvam - Sanat Kumar Samhita
sanskrit_text: Varam Vrrindavane Ramye Shrrrimgalatvam Vrrinomyaham. Vaisheshikoktamokshattu Sukhalesha Vivarjitat.- Sanat Kumar SamhitaI would rather become even a jackal in the land of Śrī Dham Vrindavan than accept the mokṣa sought by the jñānī, for in the state of liberation there is not even a trace of the sweetness, the nectar-like rasa, that overflows in Vrindavan.

title: Shri Vrindavipinesvari Ras Sindhu Bihari - Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (77)
sanskrit_text: (Doha)Pyari Preetam Paraspar, Rachyo Ang Anurag.Adhar Sudha Ras Det Hain, Let Syam Badbhag.(Pad) [Iktal, Raag-Vihagarau]Shri Vrindavipinesvari Ras Sindhu Bihari.Rachyo Paraspar Prem Chem, Badhyo Ati Bhari. [1]Arpyo Piy Hiy Pay Cain, Nij Adhar Sudhari.Shribhat Badbhagi Gopal, Piyo Ruchikari. [2]- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (77)(Doha)Shri Priyā Ju and her beloved Shri Krishna are absorbed in the sweetness of divine conjugal love﻿. Their hearts overflow with the ocean of divine bliss. Blessed Shri Lālaji’s mind, like a bee, becomes intoxicated by drinking adharāmṛta﻿ (the nectar of the lips) of Shri Priya Ji.(Pada)Shri Bhatt Ji says — Queen of Vṛndāvan, Shri Rādhā, and Vṛndāvanvihārī Lāla are both the very ocean of rasa﻿. On the bower-bed, immersed in mutual love’s sweetness, waves of bliss surge through their hearts, and their entire beings overflow with divine bliss. [1]O Sakhi! When Shri Lālaji’s heart was filled with deep longing to taste adharāmṛta﻿, the supremely compassionate Shri Priyāji offered her own divine nectar in love. Shri Bhatt Ji says—Shri Gopāl Lāl, feeling supremely blessed, lovingly drank the nectar of Shri Priyāji. Thus, the divine couple joyfully engages in divine plays of love on the bed, granting bliss to all rasikas. [2]

title: Agra Alakas Jani Karo Hari Bhajibe Ke Het - Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali
sanskrit_text: Agra Alakas Jani Karo, Hari Bhajibe Ke Het. Bahut Gayi Thodi Rahi, Thode Mein Haun Chet. - Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali Shri Agradāsa says, “Do not be lazy in the devotion of Lord Hari. title: Bhajani Kyon Darihai Upahasahi - Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani
sanskrit_text: Bhajani Kyon Darihai Upahasahi. Apni Vastu Nauhari Kajai, Sahai Jagat Ke Trasahi. [1]Suhrid Sanehi Apni Apni, Aatam Maan Karahu Vas Vasahi. Beparvahi Vyas Suvan Kau, Bal Hai Nagaridasahi. [2]- Shri Neh Nagridas, Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki VaniAn aspirant of divine love should not fear the ridicule or criticism of the world. He endures everything for the sake of his true treasure, God realization. Even if he faces insults or hardships, he remains unconcerned and moves steadfastly toward his spiritual goal. [1]In this world, everyone, whether friend or relative, thinks according to their own viewpoint. Therefore, one should not worry about other’s opinions but focus on their own spiritual upliftment and seek residence in Śrī Dham Vṛndāvan. Śrī Nāgarīdās says that his true strength lies in the son of Śrī Vyāsji, Śrī Hit Harivansh Mahāprabhu, under whose shelter he lives forever fearlessly. [2]

title: Suni Man Madhukar Gyan Sikhau - Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (40)
sanskrit_text: Suni Man Madhukar Gyan Sikhau.Charan Kamal Rati Ruchi Upjau. [1]Tihi Path Chalau Ju Bahuri Na Aau.Janam Maran Bhai Bharm Bhulau. [2]Basi Vrindavan Uttam Thaun.Satsangati Paramarth Pau. [3]Nit Dampati Sampati Hi Dikhau.Shri Biharini Dasi Bhai Gun Gau. [4]- Shri Biharin Dev, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (40)O bee-like mind! You keep wandering from place to place—listen to me now. I will tell you something wise: if you somehow develop true love for the divine lotus feet of Śrī Śyāma-Śyām, you will experience unfathomable bliss.​ [1]By following this path, you will never have to come back to this material world. You will be freed forever from the cycle of birth and death, as well as from fear, confusion, and sorrow. [2]If the mind asks, “What is that secret?” then Śrī Bihārīndev gives the answer—reside forever in the holy land of Śrī Dhām Vṛndāvan. There, you will easily get the association of true rasika saints. [3]In Vṛndāvan, you will receive the divine vision of Śrī Bihārī Bījāriṇī Ju, the source of all bliss and spiritual treasures. You will keep drinking the beauty of their lotus feet and, in overflowing joy, will sing their divine glories again and again. [4]

title: Humpar Kab Kripalu Hari Huiho - Sri Roop Kunwari Ji
sanskrit_text: (Raag Bibhas – Titalā Tāla)Humpar Kab Kripalu Hari Huiho.Main Adhamin, Tum Adham-Udhaaran, Kaise Pran Na Nibaaiho.Kotin Khal Prabhu Tumne Taare, Deen Jaan Ka Mohi Lajaiho. [1]Main Sharanagat Naath Tihari, Daas Jaan Kin Aas Pujaiho.Kaa Kahihai Jag Lok Naath, Jab Roopkunwri Ki Sudh Bisaraiho. [2]- Sri Roop Kunwari JiO Hari! When will You show mercy upon me? I am extremely fallen, and You are the Savior of the fallen—so how can You not fulfill Your own vow?O Lord! You have delivered millions of wicked souls—then why hesitate to uplift someone destitute like me? [1]I have taken refuge in You, O Krishn, please consider me as Your servant and fulfill my hope. O Lord of the Universe, what will the world say if You forget Your own servant Rūpkunwarī? [2]

title: Viharat Kunj Kutir Dou - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (2)
sanskrit_text: Viharat Kunj Kutir Dou, Sri Jamuna Ras Teer.Nitya Vihar Gambhir Gati, Surati Judh Balvir.- Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (2)By the sacred, rasa-filled banks of Śrī Yamunā, in the charming bower-cottages, the divine couple Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa engage in Their eternal Nitya-vihāra. There, an unending, blissful play of love unfolds—a sweet battle where both are undefeated warriors, and the rasa of loving exchange never ends.

title: Taj Shesh Khagesh Ko Daudate Jo - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Taj Shesh Khagesh Ko Daudate Jo, Sunate Yadi Swapn Mein Aah Dukhi Ki.Chhilke Vidurani Ke Pyaare Lage, Mridu Meva Taji Kujraaj Sukhi Ki. [1]Hare Krishna! Ka Bhagya Na Cheta Abhi, Had Bhi Kuch Hoti Hai Berukhi Ki.Chaturanan Chaah Karen Jinki, Karte Vah Chaakari Chandramukhi Ki. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’Even if a sorrowful soul sighs and calls out to Him in a dream, He abandons even Śeṣanāga and Garuḍa and rushes toward that soul. He is pleased with Vidurāṇī’s simple banana peels, rejecting the royal delicacies of King Duryodhana. [1]Śrī Hare Kṛṣṇa Jī says, Has your inner wisdom still not awakened? How strange it is that you are still turned away from such a compassionate Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa! The One whom even Lord Brahmā longs to serve as a humble servant—that very Lord finds pleasure only in serving the moon-faced Śrī Rādhā Jū. [2]

title: Ravi Ko Bharoso Andh Meti Ko Udhot Kare - Taj Begam
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Ravi Ko Bharoso Andh Meti Ko Udhot Karai,Sasi Ko Bharoso Sheet Karat ‘Taaj’ Khyaal Ko. [1]Ees Ko Bharoso Sab Devan Ko Dichchha Det,Sukra Ko Bharoso Sarb Daitya Pratipal Ko. [2]Sani Ko Bharoso Drishti Raakhai Jo Kurur Buddhi,Mangal Ko Bharoso Sut Hone Bhuv-Paal Ko. [3]Rahu Ko Bharoso Sees, Ketu Ko Na Parse Kahoon,Moko To Bharoso Ek Preetam Gupaal Ko. [4]- Taj Begam (Taj Bibi)Some trust in the Sun, believing it will dispel darkness and bring light; others rely on the Moon, hoping it will bestow coolness and comfort. [1]Some place their faith in Jupiter (Guru), who imparts divine knowledge to the demigods, while others trust Venus (Śukra), the protector of demons. [2]Some believe in Saturn (Śani), who punishes the cruel‑hearted through his gaze, and some in Mars (Maṅgal), hoping to gain sons and kingdoms. [3]Some trust Rāhu and Ketu, the shadow planets; but as for me, I place my unwavering faith in the one and only — my beloved Śrī Gopāl (Lord Kṛṣṇa). [4]

title: Kahu Ki Manat Na Priy Lalan Chitt Udaas - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (657)
sanskrit_text: Kahu Ki Manat Na Priy, Lalan Chitt Udaas.Gaye Soch ‘Sanket Ali’, Sri Lalita Ke Paas.- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (657)When Śrī Rādhā, in Her loving māna (loving sulk), refused to be pacified by anyone, Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s heart became sorrowful. Thinking deeply—“How will this sulk come to an end now?”—He finally went to seek help from Śrī Lalitā Jī.

title: Janiju Ab Jaani Shrivan - Shri Lalit Madhuri
sanskrit_text: (Raag Jila)Jaaniju Ab Jaani Shrivan, Deho Vaas Vihaarni Rani.An Karni Jo Vani Daasi Son, So Karni Nij Hiye Na Aani. [1]Darasai Chhavi Lalit Kishori, Bhuj Gal Meli Shyaam Sukhdani.Aisi Kaun Kripaa Ki Saagar, Aisihu Patit Sukhad Ras Saani. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriNow I truly feel the need to go to Śrī Vṛndāvan. O Queen of Vṛndāvan, I know only You can grant me residence in Vṛndāvan. Please have mercy on me now and bless me with the dwelling in Shri Dham Vrindavan. If I, Your maidservant, have done anything not according to Your will, kindly do not hold it in Your heart. Who else can bestow such sweet nectar of bliss even upon the fallen like me? [2]

title: Param Prem Gun Roop Amit Kavi Ko Kahe - Shri Albeli Ali
sanskrit_text: Param Prem, Gun, Roop Amit Kavi Ko Kahe? Meen, Deen Jal-Leen, Su Kyon Antahin Lahe. [1]Lahe Ant Na Koti Kalpan, Sarada Mooku Rahe. Jeevan-Kripan Ki Ka Chalai, Binu Tav Kripa Jo Kachhu Kahe. [2]Charan-Rati Jo Dehu Swamini, Janm Ko Phal Paiye. Shri Vansi Ali ‘Albeli’, Jeevan Sujas Tumharo Gaiye. [3]- Sri Albeli AliO Supreme Queen Śrī Rādhe! Who among poets can truly describe the boundless love, virtues, and unmatched beauty that You possess? A lowly fish living in water can never know the depth of the infinite ocean. [1]Even after countless ages, no one can fully speak of Your glories—and so even Sarasvatī, the goddess of speech, remains silent. So what place do I, a powerless soul, have to say anything about You without Your grace? [2]O Swāminī Śrī Rādhā! If You give me pure, selfless devotion at Your lotus feet, only then will my life find its real meaning. Sri Albeli Ali says, You are the very breath of Śrī Vaṃśīalī, whose life is fulfilled only in singing Your divine glories. [3]

If You give me pure, selfless devotion at Your lotus fit, only then will my life find its real meaning. Sri Albeli Ali says, You are the very breath of Śrī Vaṃśīalī, whose life is fulfilled only in singing Your divine glories. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Soi Rasik Ananya Kahave - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
sanskrit_text: (Raag Maru)Soi Rasik Ananya Kahave.Jinko Jugal Charitra Bina Kachhu, Shravanan Naahin Aur Suhave. [1]Yaahi Rang Rangirahe Rangeele, Tinihi Ko Sang Bhaavai.Anudin Rahas Bhaavana Bheene, Nav-Nav Ruchihin Badhaavai. [2]Jo Kou Baadhak Ya Vatihan Mein, Tin Ko Sang Chhitakaavai.‘Rooprasik’ Anupam Chhabi Lakhi-Lakhi, Pulak Na Ang Samaavai. [1]He relishes only the association of those who are fully colored in the rasa of the divine couple. Every day, absorbed in deep inner sentiments, he cultivates his love in ever-new ways. title: Aadi Anta Vrindavipin Nirdoshik Kari Baas - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (440)
sanskrit_text: Aadi Anta Vrindavipin, Nirdoshik Kari Baas.Adbuta Sukhad Bihar Kon, Det Tinhein Haridas.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (440)Before creation began, and even after the universe dissolves, the one eternal and unchanging realm upon Earth remains Śrī Vṛndāvan Dham. Those who dwell there ceaselessly, without any offenses, are dearly loved by Śrī Swāmī Haridās Jī Mahārāj, who bestows upon them the supreme nectar of the eternal love-plays (nitya-vihāra-rasa) of Priyā Priyatama.

title: Ras Ki Nit Nav Uthat Tarang - Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani (41)
sanskrit_text: Ras Ki Nit Nav Uthat Tarang.Hansat Khilat Latika-Si Jhoomat, Kaam-Kusum Bhari Ang. [1]Tuv Tan Sravat Amit Amrit-Ras, Peebat Nain Kurang.Kaant Rasik Ke Praan Kishori, Shyam Kiye Rati-Rang. [2]- Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Pad (41)In Śrī Dham Vṛndāvan, ever-new waves of divine love (prema-rasa ) continuously rise and flow. There, the beloved Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, laugh, play, and sway like delicate creepers in the breeze. Their limbs are adorned with the blossoms of kāma-kusuma —the flowers of divine love. [1]From their divine forms, endless streams of nectar-like bliss flow, which the deer-like eyes constantly drink in. This radiant, dark, and fair-complexioned pair, the very life of Kānta Rāsika , forever showers the colors of divine love. [2]

title: Vrindavanam Tadgatavastujatam Sarva Namasyam - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.54)
sanskrit_text: Vrindavanam Tadgatavastujatam Sarva Namasyam Na Kadapi Nindyam. Ye Va Vinindantyaparadhibhistaih Svapneapi Sango Mama Naiva Bhuyat.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.54)Sri Dham Vrindavan and all the beings and objects that exist there are always worthy of reverence. Those who blaspheme or show disrespect to it are offenders. May I never, even in a dream, associate with those offenders who blaspheme them.

title: Kou Kahe Alakh Anant Puni Kou Kahe - Shri Vrindavan Das Ji
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kou Kahe Alakh Anant Puni Kou Kahe,Kou Kahe Brahm Kou Jyoti Kaun Bakhanat Hain. [1]Kou Kahe Gunateet Sagun Kahat Kou,Kou Kou Andh-Dhundh Aadi Hi Te Maanat Hain. [2]Kou Kahe Shesh Sir Paudhyau Sou,Kou Maha Tattvani Ginti Ur Aanat Hain. [3]Vrindavan Hit Roop Kunjani Mein Kridat,Hum Tau Ek Radhikai Vallabh Ko Janat Hain. [4]- Shri Vrindavan Das JiSome call Him “Alakh‑Anant” (the Unseen and Infinite), while others describe Him as Brahman (formless), and some as divine light. [1]Some say He is Nirguṇa (without attributes), others call Him Saguna (with attributes); there are some who, without reasoning or personal experience, simply accept and worship God as He has been traditionally believed since ancient times. [2]Some claim He rests upon the hoods of Śeṣanāga, while others try to understand Him through philosophical principles. [3]Śrī Hit Vṛndāvan Dās says—“For us, that Supreme Personality eternally plays in the enchanting bowers of Vṛndāvan; we know only that Supreme Beloved who is in the form of a divine couple and known by the name Śrī Rādhikā Vallabh”. [4]

title: Kare Bhakti Bhagwant Ki Kabhu Kare Nahin Chuk - Shri Maluka Das

title: Hum Balak Tum Maay Hamari - Sri Sahjobai
sanskrit_text: (Raag Bhairav)Hum Balak Tum Maay Hamari, Pal-Pal Maahim Karo Rakhwaari. [1]Nishidin Godi Hi Mein Rakho, Anvit Vachan Chitavan Bhaasho. [2]Vishay Or Jaane Na Devo, Dur-Dur Jaaun To Gahi Levo. [3]Main Ajaan Kachhuhoo Nahi Jaanun, Buri-Bhali Ko Na Pahichaanun. [4]Jaisi Taisi Tumhin Cheenho, Guru Hoy Dhyaan Khilauna Deenho. [5]Tumhari Raksha Hi Sun Jaaun, Naam Tumhaaro Amrit Paaun. [6]Drishti Tumhaari Upar Mere, Sadaa Rahun Main Sharanai Tere. [7]Maari Jhirkau Tau Nahi Jaaun, Sarki-Sarki Tumhi Pai Aauun. [8]Charandas Kahai ‘Sahjo’ Daasi, Ho Rakshak Pooran Avinaashi. [9]- Sri SahjobaiO Gurudev! I am your child, and you are my true divine Mother, protecting me every moment. [1]Keep me always in Your lap, guarding me with Your loving words and compassionate gaze. [2]Do not let me be drawn toward worldly desires; if I stray away, pull me gently back to You. [3]I am ignorant — I do not know what is right and wrong. [4]However, I am, only You truly know me; You have given me the bliss of contemplation. [5]I live because you protect me. I drink the nectar of your holy name. [6]May Your merciful eyes always rest upon me, and I remain forever in your refuge. [7]Even if You scold me or beat me, I will not leave; I will only humbly crawl and come closer to You again and again. [8]Sahjobai says to her Gurudev, Charandas — I am your servant and You are the all-protector, the complete and my eternal master. [9]

sanskrit_text: Gaur Shyam Ki Kripa Bin, Jaani Sakai Kou Naahin.Koti Janam Tap Hoy Kin, Parasi Sake Nahin Chhanhai.- Braj Ke DoheWithout the grace of this divine couple of fair and dark complexion (Shri Radha Krishna), no one can ever know the rasa (essence) of their eternal love-play (nitya-vihār). title: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Ki Lata Pyari - Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (01)
sanskrit_text: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Ki Lata Pyari.Phulele Kadam Madhuri Lapati, Koyal Bolat Kaari. [1]Chhahau Raag Chhattis Raagini, Kunj-Kunj Uchhari.‘Abhayram’ Raj Van Ki Mahima, Dekhat Hain Piyapyari. [2]- Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (01)Blessed, blessed are the charming creepers of Vrindavan, blossoming with sweetness as they lovingly wrap around the Kadamba trees, while the black cuckoo dwelling there sings its melodious tunes. [1]In every grove, one can hear the six rāgas and the thirty-six rāginīs. Sri Abhayarāma says that even the Divine Couple, Sri Radha Krishna, feels bliss upon beholding the glory of the sacred dust of Vrindavan. [2]

title: Dare Sada Chahe Na Kachu Sahe Sabe Ho Hoy - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (22)
sanskrit_text: Dare Sada Chahe Na Kacchu, Sahe Sabe Ho Hoy.Rahe Ek Ras Chaahi Ke, Prem Bakhano Soy.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (22)Raskhan says — That love alone is called pure love, in which the lover constantly fears that none of his actions should ever cause the Beloved even the slightest trouble. The one who seeks nothing in return from the Beloved, whose love continues to deepen even amidst all kinds of hardships, and who remains forever immersed in the nectar of love for the one and only Beloved — that is true, selfless love.

title: Baso Mere Nainani Mein Dou Lal - Sri Radha Prasad Dev Ju Ki Vani (26)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vihag)Baso Mere Nainani Mein Dou Lal.Syam Baran Shri Kunj Bihari, Gaur Biharini Bal. [1]Nainani Nirakhat Rup Madhuri, Upajat Sukh Ke Jal.Shri Radhaprasad Trn Torati, Parasat Prem Bisal. [2]- Shri Radha Prasad Dev Ju, Sri Radha Prasad Dev Ju Ki Vani (26)May the dark-complexioned Shri Krishna, the Kunj Bihari, and the fair-complexioned Shri Radha, the Kunj Biharini, my two beloveds, always reside in my eyes. [1]When the eyes behold the divine beauty of this couple, waves of infinite bliss arise all at once. Immersed deeply in this vast ocean of love, Shri Radhaprasad Ji is sacrificing Himself, moment by moment. Out of concern that an evil eye might fall upon them, he keeps plucking and scattering straws as a protective act. [2]

title: Prem Diwane Jo Bhaye Palti Gayo Sab Rupa - Sri Sahjobai
sanskrit_text: Prem Divaane Jo Bhaye, Palti Gayo Sab Roop.Sahjo Drishti Na Aavaee, Kahaa Rank Kahaa Bhoop.- Sri SahjobaiThose who are mad in divine love of God have their entire vision of the world transformed. They no longer see any distinction between a king and a beggar, for they behold their beloved Lord pervading all beings equally.

title: Jai Bolo Shri Radha Maharani Ju Ki - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
sanskrit_text: Jai Bolo Shri Radha Maharani Ju Ki.Ikchhat Raj Karati Vrindavan, Akhil Lok Rajdhani Ju Ki. [1]Roop-Gunanin Kau Dham Bhamini, Mohan Kau Sukhdani Ju Ki.Radha-Radha Japahu Sada, ‘Parmanand’ Madhuri Vani Ju Ki. [2]- Shri Hita Parmanand DasVictory to Shri Radha Maharani Ju! In Shri Dham Vrindavan, the capital of all realms, there is only one sovereign ruling authority—that is Sri Radha Ju. [1]She is the embodiment of beauty and virtues, always bringing joy to Sri Krishna, the enchanter Himself. Śrī Parmānanda Dās says that his tongue endlessly chants the sweet name “Radha-Radha” without pause. [2]

sanskrit_text: Shri Vrindavan Sahaj Ji, Lalit Madhuri Roop.Lalit Tribhangi Bhamini, Nitya Vihar Anoop. - Shri Lalit MadhuriSri Vrindavan is naturally the embodiment of beauty and sweetness, where the charming Śrī Lālajī, in his tribhaṅga (threefold-curved) form, remains immersed in the unparalleled rasa of nitya-vihāra (eternal love-play) with Bhāminī Sri Radha.

title: Ab Ka Samujhavti Ko Samujhe - Shri Thakur Ji
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Ab Ka Samujhavati Ko Samujhai, Badnami Ke Beej To Bo Chuki Ri. Tab Tau Itnao Na Bichar Kayo, Ihin Jal Pare Kahu Ko Chuki Ri. [1]Kahi Thakur, Ya Ras-Riti Range Kari Preeti, Pativrat Kho Chuki Ri. Sakhi, Neki-Badi Jo Badi Hoti, Bhal Pai Honi Hoti, So To Ho Chuki Ri. [2]- Shri ThakurjiOne sakhi (friend) says to another—Now what will you explain, and who will understand you? You have already sown the seeds of infamy. What’s the use of overthinking now? Since you yourself have fallen into the snare of love, whom can you blame? [1]Whoever once becomes immersed in the path of prema-rasa (divine love) for Banke Bihārī naturally gives up worldly pativratā. O friend! What was destined already unfolds according to fate—so give up your pointless worry. [2]

sanskrit_text: Utakantha Ati Hi Badhi, Tuv Darshan Ke Kaaj.Daya Drishti Mo Tan Karo, Sri Radhe Sirtaj.- Sri Kishori AliO Shri Radhe! The longing to behold Your divine form has become extremely intense in my heart. Please, O supreme Queen, cast Your merciful glance upon me now.

title: Nainan Ke Tare Dulare  - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (24)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Nainan Ke Taare Dulare Praan-Pyaare Mere,Dukh Ke Daran Sukh-Karan Visaal Hain. [1]Mero Dhyaan Mero Gyaan Mere Ved Au Puraan,Vividh Pramaan Mere Ek Nandalal Hain. [2]‘Harichand’ Aur Son Na Kaam Sapnehoon Mohin,Mere Sarvas Dhan Yasuda Ke Vaal Hain. [3]Meri Rati Meri Mati Mere Pati Mere Aan,Mere Jag Maahin Sabai Keval Gupaal Hain. [4]- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (24)Beloved Nandalāl (Kṛṣṇa), the apple of my eyes, dearer than life itself, fills me with joy and dispels all sorrows. [1]He alone is the essence of my meditation, my wisdom, my Vedas and Purāṇas — the very foundation of all scriptural knowledge. [2]Śrī Hariśchandra declares: Even in dreams, none other occupies my mind, for all my treasures reside in Yaśodā’s son, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [3]He is my love, my mind, my husband, my pride and honor — everything in this world means only Śrī Gopāl to me. [4]

title: Shri Guru Deen Dayal Ju Yah Abhilasha Mor - Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (86.1)
sanskrit_text: Shri Guru Deen Dayal Ju, Yah Abhilasha Mor. Yugal Chand Pad Kanj Chhabi, Man Malind Gat Chor. - Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (86.1)O Merciful Gurudev! My only wish is that the lotus feet of the Divine Couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa﻿, may steal away the restless movements of my bee-like mind with their sweetness, so that it may forever remain immersed in the bliss of those sacred feet.

title: Jamuna-Pulin Kunj Gahbar Ki - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (65)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Chaiti Gauri)Jamuna-Pulin Kunj Gahbar Ki, Kokil Hvai Drum Kuk Machaun.Pad-Pankaj Priy Laal-Madhup Hvai, Madhure-Madhure Gunj Sunaun. [1]Kookar Hvai Ban-Veethini Dolau, Bache Seeth Rasikan Ke Khaun.Lalitkishori Aas Yahi Mam, Brajraj Taji Chhin Anat Na Jaun. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (65)When will that blessed moment arrive when I become a cuckoo, sweetly singing from a tree in some secluded grove by the Yamunā﻿ in Vrindavan? Or, becoming a bumblebee at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, may I softly hum sweet melodies in Their loving service? [1]Or perhaps I may be like a dog, wandering the lanes of Vṛndāvan, surviving on the remnants of the rāsika saints. Śrī Lalitkiśorī expresses a single heartfelt desire: that never for a moment shall I leave the sacred dust of Braj. [2]

title: Vyas Kulinani Koti Mili, Pandit Laakh Pachis - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (16)
sanskrit_text: Vyas Kulinani Koti Mili, Pandit Laakh Pachees.Swapach Bhakt Ki Paanahi, Tulai Na Tinke Sees.- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Saakhi (16)Even if crores of high-born nobles and lakhs of learned Pandits were to gather, all their combined heads still cannot equal the dust of the feet of that low-born (so-called untouchable) devotee of Vrindavan, who, though born in a very low family, is a true servant of God.

title: Sadho Yah Vichar Man Jancha Hai - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (49)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Barwa Va Kalangda)Sadho Yah Vichaar Man Jaanchaa Hai. (Tek)Preet Nahin Unmein Bilkul Bhi, Jin Hari Se Kuch Yaancha Hai.Vishay Bhog Sab Feeke Laage, Jin Hari Se Man Rancha Hai. [1]Lok Laaj Kul Kaan Taje Soi, Daas Hari Ka Saancha Hai.‘Roopmaadhuri’ Ishq Hari Mein, Prem Magan Hoy Naancha Hai. [2]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (49)O seekers! I have thoroughly contemplated this truth within my heart — There is no trace of real love in those who ask anything from the Lord. Those who truly love Sri Hari find worldly pleasures tasteless. [1]One who renounces the sense of social modesty and family decorum is the true servant of Lord Hari. Sri Rūpamādhurī says — one who is immersed in the divine love for Hari, dances in divine ecstasy. [2]

title: Lalit Mohini Kunj Me Dayi Punj Darsay - Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (3)
sanskrit_text: Lalit Mohini Kunj Mein, Dayi Punj Darsay.Thakur Daasi Nit Sahchari, Sevat Hiy Hulasay.- Shri Thakur Das, Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (3)In the Lalit Mohinī Kunja (the charming and enchanting groves of Vrindavan), Śrī Thākur Dāsī is blessed with the privilege to behold the treasure of that divine beauty and rasa. He says that there, the Sahcarīs (female companions) are intoxicated with love and remain ever engaged in the selfless service of the Divine Couple, Śrī Śyāma Kunjbihārī.

title: Nit Bihar Vrindavan Radha Mohan - Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (637)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Alahiya Bilaval - Ikatala)Nit Bihar Vrindavan Radha Mohan Karat Rahain.Sahaj Rangeele Chhail Chhabeele Hit Chit Laah Lahain. [1]Nit Braj Nit Vyavhaar Nit Nae Tan Man Panani Bahain.Nit Hee Hit Jhoomain Anandghan Jamuna Teer Gahain. [2]-  Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghananand Granthawali, Padavali (637) Śrī Radha and Śrī Mohan (Śrī Krishna) eternally engage in their divine love-plays (nitya-vihāra) in the supremely divine land of Vṛndāvan. They are naturally playful and charming, always exchanging the rasa of pure love in their hearts. [1]Braj is ever-fresh; every sport here is ever-new. The body, mind, and very life flow continually in this stream of divine love. Śrī Anandghan beautifully describes how on the banks of the Yamunā﻿, the Divine Couple, along with their beloved companions (Sahcharis), sway joyfully every moment, immersed constantly in divine prema. [2]

sanskrit_text: Trailokye Prithvi Dhanya Yatra Vrindavanam Puri.Tatrapi Gopika Parth Tarta Radhavidha Mam.- Aadi PuranaSri Krishn says - In the three worlds, the Earth, where the sacred town of Vrindavan is present, is blessed. title: Det Sada Yamuna Sukh Raashi Ko - Shri Hita Damodar Das, Phutakar Vani (12)
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Det Sada Yamuna Sukh Raashi Kon, Naam Liye Yamuna Shram Na.Yamuna Hari Dhaam Kau Prapak, Kovid Shuddha Saroop Jahaan Tam Na. [1]Yamuna Hit Ras Mein Hit Daas Damodar Vaari Viloki Rahai Bhram Na.Bhaniye Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna Yamuna. [2]- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Phutakar Vani (12)Śrī Yamunā always bestows eternal bliss, and her name, “Yamunā”, is so effortless to chant that it requires no strain at all. Yamunā is the one who grants the way to Hari’s sacred abode. She is the embodiment of pure wisdom, dispelling all the darkness of illusion and ignorance. [1]Śrī Hit Dāmodar Dās declares that he offers himself entirely to Yamunā, who is forever immersed in the nectar of divine love and lifts others into that same blissful rasa. Whoever gazes upon Yamunā with a devoted heart finds all doubts vanish from within. So, chant again and again—“Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā, Yamunā!” [2]

title: Mangana Ho To Mango Seva Shyama Shyama - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (55)
sanskrit_text: Mangana Ho To Mango, Seva Shyama Shyama.Seva Hit Puni Mango, Prem Nishkama.- Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (55)If one must ask for something, then ask only for the service of the divine couple, Śrī Śyāma-Śyām. For that service, beg only for the pure, selfless love. Let no other desire or request arise within your heart—this alone is the true path of devotion.

title: Nitya Bihar Son Kari Priti - Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (61)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vibhas)Nitya Vihar Son Kari Priti.Sang Rasik Ananya Anusari, Bhaav Bhakti Prateeti. [1]Dhyaan Chit Chintaa Raho Nitya, Maani Rasik Ki Reeti.Laal Roop Viloki Dampati, Lakhi Jagat Bipareeti. [2]- Shri Roop Sakhi, Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (61)Develop love for the nitya-vihāra-rasa (the eternal love-plays of the Divine Couple), for that alone is the very essence of life for the ananya rāsika saints. By associating with such exalted rāsikas and walking in their footsteps, firm faith in this path of devotion naturally awakens within the heart. [1]Firmly grasp and adopt the mode of divine love followed in the rāsika tradition, and constantly engage your contemplation, mind, and heart in that rasa. Śrī Rūpa Sakhī declares—when the Divine Couple, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, appear vividly both in outward vision and inward meditation, then all worldly pursuits and pleasures seem utterly insignificant. [2]

title: Shri Vanraj Vilasini Mridu Hasini Sukh Punj - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Shri Vanraj Vilaasini, Mridu Haasini Sukh Punj.Shri Krishnavallabha Radhike, Jai Jai Sevakunj.- Braj Ke DoheO You who sport in the blissful forest of Vṛndāvan, O one with a most innocent smile, O embodiment of nectar, Sri Krishn's beloved  — Śrī Rādhikā, all glories to You! O Sovereign of Sevakunj, again and again, all glories to Sevākuñj — Your eternal abode!

title: Kou Chhatr Leenai Kou - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (23)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kou Chhatr Leenai Kou Chhahgir Keenai Kou,Beenai Le Prabeenai Ye Naveenen Sur Gaavati. [1]Kou Jari Jorai Kar Atar Gulab Borai,Lai Lai Alabeli Hathi Dhavan Tain Aavati. [2]Kou Chaur Dharai Kou Aarti Utarai Kou,Karti Salamen Kou Mujra Na Paavati. [3]Baithi Aan Takhat Pai Bakhat Biland Radhe,Bala Digpalan Ki Mala Pahiraavati. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (23)One sakhī stands holding a royal canopy above Her, another holds a mirror before Her, while yet another sings sweet melodies, playing the vīṇā to please Her divine heart. [1]One lovingly adorns Her with garments of gold, another sprinkles fragrant rose water and perfume, and yet another rushes forward in eagerness to serve the enchanting Sovereign Queen, Śrī Rādhā. [2]One waves a fly‑whisk, another performs Her āratī; one offers prostrations in reverence, while another greets Her with folded hands in deep devotion. [3]Śrī Rādhā sits gracefully upon Her jeweled throne, while celestial queens lovingly place garlands around Her neck. [4]

title: Shri Vallabh Var Ko Chhandi Ke - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (59)
sanskrit_text: Shri Vallabh Var Ko Chhandi Ke, Bhaje Jo Bhairav Bhoot.Anta Phajiti Hoygi, Jyon Ganika Ko Poot.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (59)A person who abandons devotion to the Supreme Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa and instead worships Bhairava-spirits meets a shameful end—just like the son of a courtesan, who never gains respect or honor in society.

title: Giridhar Piy Ke Hridyavasi  - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (163)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Nat Narayan)Giridhar Piy Ke Hridyavasi Tere Badan Ki Param Sudes Chhabi.Ek Ang Ke Roop Ke Aag Jat Sakhi, Kotisat Chandrama Davi. [1]Nain Ans Ki Sobha Varni Sakai Esau Kaun Kavi.‘Kumbhandas’ Swamini Radhika, Ihai Gati Tohi Kon Yon Aai Phavi. [2]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (163)O Sakhi! The beauty of Shri Radhika, who resides in the heart of beloved Giridhar (Shri Krishna), is supremely enchanting. The radiance of even one of her limbs surpasses that of millions of moons and suns. [1]Who among the rasik poets can truly describe the beauty of her eyes and arms? Shri Kumbhandas says — O Swamini Radhika! The sight of your divine beauty completely captivates the mind. [2]

title: Keet Patang Pipilika Markat Bhring Mayur - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (97)
sanskrit_text: Keet Patang Pipilika, Markat Bhring Mayur.Jugalvihari Kijiye, Vrindavan Ki Dhoor.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (97)Whether as an insect, a moth, an ant, a monkey, a bumblebee, or even a peacock — grant me any form that pleases You. O Divine Couple! Bless me to become one with the dust of Vṛndāvan, ever resting at Your holy lotus feet.

title: Aaj Jhulat Ladeti Jhulavat Lalit Tribhangi - Shri Kishoridas (of Gaudiya sect.)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Kaafi)Aaj Jhoolat Ladeeti Jhulaavat Lalit Tribhangi.Sahaj Shringaar Keshari Angiyan, Saadi Vani Pachhrangi. [1]Chahu Or Gopi Madhure Sur, Gaavat Taan Tarangi.Shri Vrajchandra Kishori Ju Ki, Vaanik Nav Nav Rangi. [2]- Shri Kishoridas (of Gaudiya sect.)Today, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose graceful form bends in three places, joyfully swings Śrī Rādhā upon a beautiful swing. Her limbs, naturally adorned with divine ornaments, glisten with saffron hues, and she is dressed in a radiant five-colored saree. [1]All around, the gopīs sing in soft, melodious voices. The enchanting scene of the Jhūlā-līlā of Śrī Vrajachandra and Kiśorī overflows with ever-fresh colors and blissful rasa. [2]

title: Shri Radha Pyari Sukumari - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
sanskrit_text: Shri Radha Pyari Sukumari, Chhabi Par Main Bali Jaun.Lekar Kamal Adhar Dhar Bansi, Tero Hi Gun Gaun. title: Kim Karishyanti No Veda - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (102)
sanskrit_text: Kim Karishyanti No Veda Kimva Deva Saheshvarah. Kushala Kushalamvapi Shriradha Bhajato Mamah.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (102)In the exclusive devotion of Shri Radha, I do not need to follow the injunctions of the Vedas and scriptures, nor do I need to please or fear any other deity or god. Whether they bring me good or bad results, I do not care. My only longing is to serve the lotus feet of Sri Radha, which is not attained through the grace of gods or scriptural rituals, but solely through the mercy of Shri Radha Maharani herself.

title: Jaake Pad Neti Neti - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (60)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jaake Pad Neti Neti Bandat Sures Sesh,Tere Pad Sees Naay Thaadhe Kar Jori Ri. [1]Jetau Nat Nagar Tu Naagari Chhabeeli Baal,Kahaa Pratipaal Bhayi Aisi Mat Bhori Ri. [2]Lal Balbeer Mil Dou Ras Rang Keejai,Deejai Sukh Nainan Kau Maani Binai Mori Ri. [3]Rahi Rain Thori Ab Sain Karau Gori,Kunj Preetam Ke Sang Mili Keerati Kisori Ri. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Shri Radha Shatak (60)The One whose feet are worshiped even by Indra and Śeṣanāga, who glorify Him as “beyond all description” — that Supreme Brahman, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, bows down with folded hands before Your lotus feet. [1]If He is the supreme master of divine play, then You are the supreme enchantress who captivates even Him, the most graceful and charming of all; tell me, O my tender‑hearted protectress, why do You behave so innocently today? [2]Śrī Lāl Balbir Jī humbly prays — O Rādhe! Please set aside Your loving pride and joyfully unite with Your Beloved, granting us, Your sahacarīs (companions), the bliss of witnessing that divine union. [3]O fair daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, beloved Rādhe! The night has nearly passed; the time has come — now lovingly repose with Your Beloved in the grove of divine pleasure. [4]

title: Shri Vrindavan Saghan Saras Sukh - Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri, Doha (4)
sanskrit_text: Shri-Vrindavan Saghan Saras-Sukh, Nit Chhavi Chhaajat. Nandan-Van Se Koti-Koti, Jihi Dekhat Laajat. - Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri (4)The divine land of Shri Vrindavan Dham is dense, blissful, and filled with the essence of transcendental rasa. Its beauty radiates in all directions, enchanting every heart. Even the countless celestial gardens like Indra’s Nandanvan feel shamed before its splendour — for Vrindavan’s glory far surpasses it in every way.

title: Shyama Sujhat Nahi Kachhu Mohe - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (17)

title: Hirani Ke Bore Nahin Hansan Ki Nahin Paant - Shri Biharin Dev, Rasopasna Tilak
sanskrit_text: Heerani Ke Bori Nahin, Hansani Ki Nahi Pant.Sheran Ke Nahin Revade, Rasikan Ki Na Jamaat.- Shri Biharin Dev, Rasopasna TilakDiamonds are not found in sacks, nor do swans walk in rows. title: Vrishabhanu Nandini Durant Ki Nikandini Hain - Braj Ke Kavitt
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Vrishabhanu Nandini Durant Ki Nikandini Hain, Nitya Nand Nandan Anandini Hain Radhika. [1]Roop Rang Ras Ki Sakal Chhavi Chandini Hain, Gandh Ki Madir Makarandini Hain Radhika. [2]Kalpana Srijan Ki Hain, Kamna Mithun Ki Hain, Sphurana Pranay Ki Hain, Spandini Hain Radhika. [3]Prerana Yajan Ki Hain, Bhavana Bhajan Ki Hain, Abhinandini Hain, Vishva Vandini Hain Radhika. [4]- Braj Ke KavittŚrī Rādhā, the enchanting daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, dispels all kinds of sorrow and delusion, and always bestows bliss upon Nand Nandan, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. [1]She is the very embodiment of beauty, color, and rasa — like the nectar of divine fragrance, she irresistibly captivates every heart. [2]She is the eternal inspiration behind creation itself, the yearning for divine union, the spontaneous pulse and radiance of love. [3]Rādhikā is the very foundation of worship, the very sentiment of devotion; she is the one who is honored and revered by the whole world. [4]

title: Mahali Ki Gati Mahli Jaane - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Mahali Ki Gati Mahli Jaane, Kaha Jane Bahar Varo.Nrip Ki Rahan-Sahan Kaha Jane, Bhedh Charavan Haro.- Braj Ke DoheThe most confidential love-plays of Shri Radha within Her personal palace with Krshn are known only to Her intimate sahacarīs (closest companions) who reside there. It is impossible to comprehend such secrets for those who are devoid of that rasa. It is just like a shepherd trying to understand the royal lifestyle of a king — how could that be possible?

title: Puran Prem Sudhanidhi Saar Ki - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Puran Prem Sudhaanidhi Saar Ki Moorati Manju Bani Ik Raajai.Keli Mahotsav Mein Hulsi Ras Ki Ghan Moorati Dooji Viraajai. [1]Radhika Ke Pad-Kanj Vilodat Morapakha Atihi Chhavi Chhaajai.Shri Barsane Sumandir Raajat Laadileelaal Ki Bolo Sadaajai. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaOn one side sits the beautiful Śrī Rādhā, who is the very source and essence of divine love; on the other, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is filled with the sweetness of rasa, is joyfully present in the keli-mahotsav (divine play festival). [1]Kṛṣṇa's peacock feather crown gently touches the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā, making Śrī Rādhā's form even more charming. Let us always sing the praises of Ladilī lāl (Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa), who dwells in the lovely temple of Barsāna. [2]
english_text: (Sawaiya)Puran Prem Sudhanidhi Sar Ki Murati Manju Bani Ik Rajai.Keli Mahotsav Mein Hulsi Ras Ki Ghan Murati Duji Virajai. title: Chari Badan Main Kah Kahyo - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar, Dasham Sakandh
sanskrit_text: Chari Badan Main Kah Kahau, Sahsanan Nahi Jaan.Gai Charavat Gwal Sang, Karat Nand Ki Aan.- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarBrahma Ji, humbly apologizing to Shri Krishna, says — “O Lord! You lovingly tend the cows in Braj and constantly remind everyone of Nand Baba’s oath. Even Sheshnag, with his thousand mouths, could not fully understand Your divine pastimes — how then can I, Brahma, with only four mouths, hope to sing Your glories?”

title: Raas Rachyo Vrindavan Banvari - Sri Purushottam Ji
sanskrit_text: Raas Rachyo Vrindavan Banwaari.Bansivat Kunjan Jamuna-Tat, Manmohan Piy Rasik Bihaari. [1]Nirat Karat Man Harat Sakhin Kau, Upjat Rang-Tarang Ati Bhaari.Purushottam Prabhu Ki Chhabi Nirakhat, Braj-Jan Baar-Baar Balihari. [2]- Sri Purushottam JiRasika Bihari, Lord Shri Krishna, performs the divine Rasa dance in the sacred groves of Bansivat, on the banks of the Yamuna in Vrindavan. [1]As he dances, he enchants the hearts of the sakhis, immersing them in the vibrant hues of divine love. Shri Purushottam Ji reveals that upon witnessing this captivating form of Krishna, the residents of Braj repeatedly offer themselves at His feet. [2]

title: Na Radha Na Radhapriyo - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.60)
sanskrit_text: Na Radha Na Radhapriyo Naapi Vrinda-Vanam Naiva Vrindani Tat PremabhajamSadaa Yasya Hrada-Gochare Vaatha Vaachaam Prachaare Katham Tasya Rasa-Shrih.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.60)One whose heart Shri Radha, Shri Krishna, Shri Vrindavan, and Their loving rasika devotees (sahacharis) do not ever manifest — and from whose speech they are never spoken — how can such a person ever taste the most wondrous Rasa-Shri (Vrindavan Rasa)?

title: Pyari Tohi Kaise Ke Maan Manaaun - Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (37)
sanskrit_text: Pyari! Tohi Kaise Ke Maan Manaaun.Sab Vidhi Vivas, Rajdhaani Vasi, Chhadam Kadam Bahu Baat Banaun.Gun-Aagar, Sagar Karuna Ki, Kaun Naveen Keli Jo Janaun.Shri Ramraay Tav Pad-Pankaj Navi, Nipat Deen Tan Haa-Haa Khaun.- Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (37)To please Shri Radha, Shri Krishna speaks in a voice full of compassion —O Pyārījū! I am trying every possible way to appease your sulking, but I am now completely helpless. Even while residing in your very own capital, Vrindavan, I keep devising new ways every moment to please You, but all My efforts end in vain. [1]O most merciful One, O ocean of divine virtues, Shri Radha! Tell me, what new playful pastime should I now perform so that a sweet smile once again graces your lips? Shri Ramray says — In the end, Shri Krishna humbly bows down and places His head at the lotus-feet of Shri Radha, pleading from the depths of His heart with utmost love and devotion. [2]

title: Ur Prakash Ho Rupa Ko - Sri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Sri Radha Naam Ank (21)
sanskrit_text: Ura Prakaash Ho Roop Ko, Naina Jhalakai Prem.Roop Maadhuri Priya Ko, Naam Japo Rakh Nem.- Shri Roop Madhuri, Sri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Sri Radha Naam Ank (21)If one sincerely takes a firm vow to constantly chant the holy name “Shri Radha,” then soon Shri Radha’s divine form reveals itself within the heart, and the radiance of love begins to shine through the eyes.

title: Jihi Jihi Angani Drishti Parat Ho - Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (35)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Devgandhar)Jihin-Jihin Angani Drishti Parat Ho Ladaiti, Tahan-Tahan Ataki Rahat Man Mero. Teri Saunhan Khaun Lakhan, Haun To Tero Cherau. [1]Teri Ye Aas Bihaar Karat Nit, Tum Upajeev Hero. Rasikan Shri Lalita-Sakhi Kripa Te, Mo Hiy Seban Tero. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (35)O Sri Radha! Wherever my eyes rest upon Your divine limbs, my mind becomes captivated and remains fixed there. I swear by you, I am your eternal servant. [1]It is only through the hope of You that I taste the sweetness of the nitya vihāra (eternal love-play) rasa. You alone are the highest refuge and the very support of my life. Shri Vamsi Ali says that, by the grace of the Rasika devotees and Lalita Sakhi, my heart is forever engaged in Your eternal service. [2]

title: Bahut Bhoomi It Ut Phirayo - Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani
sanskrit_text: Bahut Bhoomi It-Ut Phirayau, Maaya Bas Jhakhajor.Ab Kab Hvaihain Safal Page, Vrindavan Ki Or.- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh)I have wandered long through this world, entangled in the spell of Maya. Alas, when will that blessed day arrive — the day my feet find their true purpose, carrying me to Vrindavan at last, never to turn back again.

title: Jay Shri Radhika Ras Bhari - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (32)
sanskrit_text: (Doha)Puran Prem Prakas Ken, Pari Payodhini Puri.Jay Shri Radha Ras Bhari, Shyam Sajeevan Muri.(Pad)Jay Shri Radhika Ras Bhari.Rasik Sundar Sanware Ki Pran Jeevan Jari. [1]Gaur Ang Anang Adbhut Surati Rangani Rari.Sahaj Sang Abhang Jori Subhag Sanche Dhari. [2]Param Prem Prakas Puran Par Payodhini Pari.Hitu Shri Haripriya Nirakhati Nikat Nij Sahchari. [3]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (32)(Doha)All glories to the one and only, Shri Radha Maharani, who is filled with divine rasa and is the very source of life of Sri Krishn. By whose grace pure love became manifest, and who, after filling the ocean of love, submerged herself in it.(Pad)All glories to Shri Radha Maharani, overflowing with divine sweetness, the very source of life and bliss for Shyamasundara. [1]Her fair form is draped in divine love and the colors of amorous pastimes. She always performs eternal plays of love through her own Yugala form (Shri Radha and Sri Krishna together), never separated from His beloved Sri Krishna. Every limb of Her divine body radiates natural beauty, elegance, and auspiciousness. [2]The complete revelation of supreme love manifests only through Shri Radha Maharani, who is Herself immersed in that infinite ocean of love. Hari Priya Sakhi beholds Her intimately amidst the circle of Her beloved companions [3]

title: Koti Vishv Aishwarya Sukh - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer, Sohni Mahima (435.10)
sanskrit_text: Koti Vishv Aishwarya Sukh, Nahin Ju Ek Kan Tool.So Raj Tokon Khel Hai, Meri Jeevan Mool.- Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer, Sohni Mahima (435.10)Shri Hit Bhorisakhi Ji says — “O dear broom! The joy found in the splendor of countless universes cannot match even a single speck of this divine dust of Vrindavan. You may think that sweeping away this dust is mere play, but for me, this sacred dust is the very breath of my life.”

title: Avadhi Prem Ki Dou Pyare - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (101)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vihagarau)Avadhi Prem Ki Dou Pyare.Tan-Man-Nain Rahe Ekai Hai, Kabahoo Hot Na Nyaare. [1]Ruchi-Ruchi Saun Rachi Rahe Dou Jan, Jyaun Nainani Ke Taare.Hit Dhruv Reejhi Paraspar Chhavi Par, Tan-Man Det Hain Vaare. [2]- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (101)O Sakhi! Our divine youthful couple is the very embodiment of love. Their bodies, hearts, and glances have become one, inseparable in every way. [1]Immersed in the sweetness of each other’s love, they remain united like the very apple of each other’s eyes. Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji says that, captivated by one another's beauty, they constantly offer their body and mind in pure devotion to each other. [2]

title: Ratan-Khachit Vrindavipun Bhumi Lata Drum Rang - Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (22)
sanskrit_text: Ratan-Khachit Vrindavipun, Bhoomi Lata-Drum Rang.Shri Swami Ke Laadile, Rache Sukeli Anang.- Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (22)The divine land of Shri Dham Vrindavan, adorned with precious gems, is decorated with various creepers and trees of many colors. There, the beloveds of Shri Swami Haridas Ji, the divine couple Sri Śyāmā Kuṃjabihārī, are eternally engaged in love kelī, immersed in the rasa of nitya vihāra.

title: Hau Tere Varane Mand Gati - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (12)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vilabal)Haun Tere Vaarane Mand Gati Chali Piy Soin.Mere Pachhain Duri Muri Nilambar Odh Sakhi,Abhi Miluun Lalahin Gupat Ki Gaunhi. [1]Aatur Hwye Avainge Tab Na Banengi,Mero Kahyo Maan Pyari, Kahat Haun Tohi.Shri Beethal Vipul Vinod Bihari Saun Hil Mili,Kai Tero Jyon Janain Kai Haun Hi. [2]- Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (12)While thoughtfully arranging the loving meeting of Shri Radha with Her beloved Lalji (Krishna), the close companion (Vitthal Vipul) gently says to Sri Radha —O Sakhi! I sacrifice myself to you. Let us walk slowly toward the Beloved. I promise, this plan will bring such a divine rasa that its sweetness will be unmatched. If you wear a deep-blue veil and quietly follow me from behind, then meeting Lalji in this hidden way will awaken a new, special delight. [1]However, if you delay, and Shyamasundara meets you halfway in eager excitement, the rasa I am vividly conducting will not unfold in its intended fullness. So I kindly ask you — trust my words and come with me without delay. In this sudden meeting with Shyamasundara, a wondrous, playful ecstasy will manifest — either you alone will be able to relish it, or perhaps only I will truly comprehend its essence. [2]

title: Dhara Dhaam Mein Madhav Ne Itna - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Dhara Dhaam Mein Madhav Ne Itna, Kisi Gopika Ko Apnaya Nahin.Jise Lekar Saath Akele Gaye, Us Bhed Ko Ved Ne Paya Nahin. [1]“Hare Krishna”! Vishesh Rahasya Chhipa, Shiv Shesh Ke Dhyaan Mein Aaya Nahin.Samjha Sab Saaron Ka Saar Atah, Shuk Vyas Ne Naam Bataya Nahin. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’Śrī Kṛṣṇa never embraced any gopī as completely as He embraced that one gopī (Śrī Rādhā), whom He took alone with Him during the Rāsa pastimes. Even the Vedas could not grasp the mystery behind this. [1]Śrī Hare Kṛṣṇa Jī says—The subject of Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī is supremely mysterious, so subtle that even great jñānīs like Śiva and Śeṣa are unable to grasp Her in their deep meditation. Therefore, considering Her the essence of all essences, both Śukadeva and Ved Vyāsa did not explicitly mention Her name (Śrī Rādhā). [2]

title: Sarad Ujyari Raas Rachyo Piy Pyari - Shri Priyadas, Bhakti Ras Bodhini (371)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Sarad Ujyari, Ras Rachyo Piy Pyari,Tamai Rang Chadhyo Bhari, Kaisai Kahikai Sunaaiye. [1]Priya Ati Gati Lai, Bijuri Si Kaundh Gai,Chakchaudhi Bhai, Chhavi Mandal Mein Chhaiye. [2]Nupur So Tooti Parsayu, Man Arbarayo Bhayau,Tori Kai Janeu Bandhyo Vahi Bhanti Bhaiye. [3]Sakal Samaj Mein Youn Kahyo - Aaj Kaam Aayau,Dhoyau Hau Janam, Taaki Baat Jia Aaiye. [4]- Shri Priyadas, Bhakti Ras Bodhini (371)In the commentary of Bhaktamāl, Śrī Priyadās Jī narrates a unique incident from the life of Śrī Harirām Vyās Jī —On the full moon night of Śārad Pūrṇimā, when the Divine Couple (Śrī Rādhā‑Kṛṣṇa) performed the divine Rāsa, the entire atmosphere became immersed in the color of divine love, whose sweetness cannot be expressed in words. [1]During the Rāsa, Śrī Rādhā displayed such a wondrous movement, like a sudden flash of lightning; Her brilliance illuminated the entire Rāsa Maṇḍal, casting a glow in every direction. [2]Meanwhile, as the Rāsa continued, an anklet from Śrī Rādhājū’s foot fell off; upon witnessing this scene, Harirām Vyās Jī’s heart burst forth with intense, restless love, and instantly he broke his sacred thread (janeū) and tied it at Śrī Rādhā’s feet in place of the anklet. [3]Afterwards, in front of all the rasika saints, he said, “I wore this sacred thread all my life, but it never had real meaning; today, it became truly valuable by being used in Rādhā Jī’s service” — this touched everyone’s hearts and filled all the devotees with divine love. [4]

title: Agra Ubhay Taaki Bani, Hai Santan Ke Saath - Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali (1.45)
sanskrit_text: ‘Agra’ Ubhay Taaki Bani, Hai Santan Ke Saath.Ik Dvai Dvai Aru Chupri, Puni Laadoo Do Haath.- Shri Agradas, Agragranthawali (1.45)Shri Agraswami Ji says that those who associate with saints and strictly follow their guidance attain all kinds of welfare. As long as they live in this world, they experience bliss, and even in the afterlife, they remain forever immersed in spiritual rasa.  Such a person truly has sweets in both hands — meaning, he gains happiness in both worlds.

title: Brajraaj Son Naata Juda Ab Hai - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Brajraaj Son Naata Juda Ab Hai, Tab Jag Ki Kya Parvaah Karein.Bas Yaad Mein Rote Rahein Unki, Palkon Par Ashru Pravah Karein. [1]Jitni Veh Door Rahein Hum Son, Utni Hum Unki Chaah Karein,Sukh Adbhut Prem Ki Peer Mein Hai, Ham Aah Karein Vo Vaah Karein. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaNow that I belong to the Lord of Braj (Śrī Kṛṣṇa), why should I care about this selfish world anymore? I will keep shedding tears in loving remembrance of Him, and let my eyelids remain forever wet with love. [1]Even if Śyām Sundar ignores me endlessly, I will not retreat; rather, my love for Him will only grow. There is a unique rasa in the pangs of separation. My only hope is that when I sigh in love, those sighs become so dear to Him that He smiles joyfully and says, "Vāha!" (Wow). [2]

title: Niratat Raas Mein Piy-Pyari - Shri Vitthal Das
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vihagaro)Niratat Raas Mein Piy-Pyaari.Jamuna-Pulin Subhag Vrindavan, Sharad Chand Ujiyaari. [1]Bajat Taal Mridang Jhanjh Dhap, Sapt Suran Gati Nyaari.Urap-Tirap Gati Let Sulap Ati, Laadili-Laal Bihaari. [2]Jai-Jai Kahi Barasat Kusumaavali, Suran Sahit Suranaari.Shri Vitthal Giridharn Laal Par, Sarvas Daarat Vaari. [3]- Shri Vitthal DasUnder the full moonlight of Sharad Purnima, on the banks of the Yamuna in the sacred land of Shri Dham Vrindavan, the divine couple Shri Radha Krishna are immersed in the blissful Rāsa dance. [1]All around, the sweet and rhythmic sounds of mṛdaṃga, jhāṅjha, ḍhapa, and tāla resound rhythmically. The seven musical notes flow with unparalleled sweetness. Shri Lāḍlī Lāla dance together ecstatically in divine love, with swift, graceful movements of Urapa-Tirapa. [2]The gods and goddesses shower flowers while singing “Jai Jai.” Shri Vitthal Das Ji, overwhelmed in divine bliss, offers his entire being to the upholder of Govardhan, Shri Krishna. [3]

title: Ke Hve Rahu Drum Gulam Lata Beli Ban Mahi-  Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (67.1)
sanskrit_text: Kai Hvai Rahaun Drum Gulam Lata Beli Ban Maahin.Aavat Jaat Subhay Parai Mope Parchhayin.- Shri Nanddas, Nanddas Granthwali, Bhanwar Geet (67.1)The self-realized Uddhava says to Lord Shri Krishna — “O Lord! I now desire to become a tree, a vine, or a creeper in the holy land of Braj. Let me reside there forever, so that when the maidens of Braj wander here and there, their shadow may naturally fall upon me, and I may become truly fulfilled then.”

title: Shri Radhe Ju Ko Adhadhundh Darbar -  Shri Kripaluji, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha Madhuri (46)
sanskrit_text: Shri Radhe Ju Ko, Adhaadhundh Darbaar.Jin Vancharin Aacharan Kutsit, Jag Jehi Kah Vyabhichaar.Tin Kahun Nij Sahchari Kari Hari Son, Karavaavati Manuhaar.Jehi Raasahin Tarasati Kamala Si, Tap Kari-Kari Gai Haar. Tehi Vancharihīn Sakhin Kiy Raasahin, Ko As Saral Udaar.Kah ‘Kripalu’ Yah Jaani Gahahu Man! Sharan Gaur Sarkaar. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha-Madhuri (46)Grace is bestowed in absolute abundance in Shri Radha’s court. The conduct of the women of Braj is considered immoral in the eyes of the world, known as fornication (because they loved Shyamsundar with exclusive devotion, despite having husbands at home and not knowing He is the Supreme Lord). Yet Shri Radha accepted them as Her intimate companions. Not only that, She even compelled Supreme Lord Shri Krishna Himself to lovingly plead before them. In the Maharaas, even Mahalakshmi was denied entry despite performing penance for ages. Yet, in that very Rasa, Shri Radha lovingly included these women as Her dearest soul-companions. Who else could possess such a soft, generous, and love-filled heart? Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji says: “O mind! Realizing the limitless mercy of such a supremely compassionate Swaminiji, surrender at Her lotus feet without delay.”

title: Kim Krrishnasyaiva Rupam - Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (46)
sanskrit_text: Kim Krrishnasyaiva Rupam Tribhuvanamanaso Hari Kim Yuthapayah Premamurttah Kimishte Kimu Vijayate Kelirevanayo Rva. Ittham Yatraiva Radha Pranayasahachari Samchayamodavrrindad Vambhramyante Suramyam Pranamata Sarasim Tam Mahadbhih Sunamyam.- Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (46)Ah! How wondrous is the divine form of Shri Radhakund! Is it the form of Shri Krishna Himself, the Enchanter of the three worlds, manifest as a sacred pond? Or the personified love of ever-youthful Shri Radha, taking the form of a divine kund? Or perhaps the playful pastimes of both Radha and Krishna now appear in this form? Amid such divine wonder, Shri Radha’s intimate sakhis, lost in ecstatic rasa, wander in blissful bewilderment. Let us bow to that sacred and most enchanting Radhakund, revered by great souls.

title: Hamari Sudh Lije Ho Mohan Pyare - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj

title: Prem Punj Pragatai Jahan Tahan Pragat Hari Hoy - Shri Dayabai

title: Bade Bade Nayan Arun Ratnare - Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (68)
sanskrit_text: Bade Bade Nayan Arun Ratnare.Chhakani Chhake Rasmatt Uninde, Neendar Ghoom-Ghumare. title: Phool Kunj, Barsana
sanskrit_text: Phool Kunj (Flower Bower) is a peaceful place in Barsana. It is located at the foothill of Brahmanchal Parvat, in the lane opposite the Chitra Sakhi Temple on the Chiksauli Rupnagar road. A small pond called Bicchua Kunda is also found here, adding to the quiet and sacred atmosphere of the area.

title: Lochan Laalchi Mahaari - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
sanskrit_text: Lochan Laalchi Mahaari.Lokalaj Kulkaani Sabai Taji, Chitavat Laalvihaari. [1]Tan Baajaar Haat Ang Angani, Sauda Karat Na Haari.Bharat Aharnis Hriday Bhandaarani, Det Na Ek Lagaari. [2]Nafa Bahut Aavat Hai Tope, Adhik Adhik Adhikaari.Rooprasik Ras-Lobh Lapete, Ade Bade Byopaari. [3]- Shri Roop Rasik DevacharyaMy eyes have become extremely greedy! They have cast aside all concern for societal norms and family honor, wholly absorbed in beholding Shri Lal Vihari (Shri Krishna). [1]This body has become like a marketplace, where every limb is engaged in the trade of Shri Lalju’s beauty. In this sacred exchange, the heart’s treasury is constantly enriched, and there is never any loss. [2]Such is the boundless profit of this trade that it multiplies endlessly, beyond measure. Rooprasik says, this is a miraculous exchange of divine rasa (nectar), in which the rasik devotees stand firm—faithful merchants of love. [3]

title: Prem Khel Sabson Kathin Khelat Kou Sujan - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (151)
sanskrit_text: Prem Khel Sabson Kathin, Khelat Kou Sujaan.Narayan Bin Prem Ke, Kaha Prem Pahchan.- Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (151)The play of divine love is the most difficult of all games, and only the truly wise can play it. Sri Narayan Swami says, “Without engaging in this play of love of God, no one can understand what love truly is.”

title: Kahat Ju Baat Ari Suni Lalita - Shri Vrindavan Das Ji
sanskrit_text: Kahat Ju Baat Ari Suni Lalita.Piy Ke Sang Rang Ki Baaten, Kyon Tum Pragat Karat Hit-Salita. [1]Tumkau Kaaj Aur Kachu Nahi, Laaj Ki Aaj Majajahi Dalita.Vrindavan Rani Kar-Kamal Su, Kamalahi Dai Hansikai Van Chalita. [2]- Shri Vrindavan Das JiShri Radha says to Lalita — “O Lalita! Why do you reveal the private, intimate pastimes of love of my beloved, letting the stream of rasa overflow?” [1]You seem to have no other task — today you have completely cast aside all sense of modesty! Shri Vrindavan Das says — smiling sweetly, Shri Radha, the Queen of Vrindavan, placed a lotus flower in Lalita’s hands and gracefully walked off into the forest. [2]

title: Man Vach Kaik Ek Ras Dhare Maha Vrat Prem - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (28)
sanskrit_text: Man Vach Kaik Ek Ras, Dhare Maha Vrat Prem.Pran Priyahim Sevat Kunwar, Yahi Sukh Kau Nem.- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (28)With mind, speech, and body aligned in a single flow, and with complete concentration upon the supreme vow of divine love, Rasik Lalju (Shri Krishna) is wholly immersed in the loving service of Shri Radha. title: Ananya Vrat Khande Kisi Dhaar - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (175)
sanskrit_text: Ananya Vrat Khaande Keesi Dhaar.It-Ut Dagat Jagat Hit Tehari, Pheri Na Karat Samhaar. [1]Kaha Gyaasi Kul-Karmani Chhade, Jolagi Vishay Vikaar.Binu Premahi, Na Prasad Nem Tahan, Hari Na Grahat Jyaun Nar. [2]Kaun Kaam Keerati Binu Preetihi, Ganikaa Kaiso Jaar.Vyaasdas Ki Pati Gati Naasai, Gayein Paraaye Dwaar. [3]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (175)The vow of ‘Ananyta’ (exclusive devotion) is as subtle and sharp as the edge of a sword. If the mind wavers here and there and slips into worldly attachments, even though Hari is the well-wisher of all, He does not uphold such wavering devotion. [1]What use is it to abandon social or family norms if the mind remains trapped in sensual cravings? Without love, neither rituals nor offerings (prasada) hold meaning, for Hari accepts only devotion filled with heartfelt bhava. Just as a husband will not accept an unfaithful wife, Hari too rejects loveless worship or rituals. [2]Fame without love is empty, like lying in the arms of a prostitute, where no real love exists,  only selfish desire. Sri Hariram Vyas says: when a wife goes to another’s door, her fidelity perishes; likewise, devotion loses its essence when 'Ananyta' is broken. [3]

title: Hari Mohi Yon Apnay Liyo - Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (118)
sanskrit_text: Hari Mohin Yon Apnaay Liyau.Jahan Jahan Bighan Janyau Apne Kon, Tahan Tahan Jatan Kiyau. [1]Haun Tau Patit Aparadhi Atisai, Kripa Katakshi Jiyau.Shri Bihari Das Prabhu Ati Karunamay, Pragat Prasad Diyau. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (118)O Hari! You embraced me in such a way that wherever You saw obstacles in my life, You Yourself removed them time and again. [1]Though I am utterly fallen and sinful, still, through Your merciful gaze, You always protected and nurtured me. Shri Biharindev says — the ocean of compassion, Shri Banke Bihari Ji Maharaj, has bestowed upon me this manifest grace as a divine prasada. [2]

title: Achari Son Thakur Darein - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (113)
sanskrit_text: Achaari Son Thakur Darain, Dhing Nahi Avani Dehin.Premi Sadhu Kau Umangi Kai, Rijhi Ank Bhari Lehin.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (113)Thakurji (Shri Krishna) keeps His distance from those absorbed in injunctions, prohibitions, rituals, and outward formalities. But to a pure-hearted lover, He joyfully draws near — embracing them again and again with loving affection.

title: Sabso Sundar Hai Barsano - Braj Ke Lokgeet
sanskrit_text: Sabsau Sundar Hai Barsano Vraj Mein Radharani Kau.Jahaan Birajain Radharani, Jaaki Shyam Karai Agwani,Mahima Vedan Hoo Noy Jani, Parbat Ooni Mandir Chamkai,Sab Jag Jani Kau. [1] Sabsau Sundar….Khor Sankari Badi Raseeli, Dadhi Lai Chali Kunwari Garvili,Sakhi Sang Mein Vahut Hathili, Aage Mohan Gail Rok Diyo,Roop Lubhani Kau. [2] Sabsau Sundar….Dai Ja Daan Kunwari Rasiya Kau, Peet Pichhauri Kati Kasiya Kau,Kunwari Hansi Lakhi Man Wasiya Kau, Ghunghat Mein Te Chheen Liyo Man,Waa Manmani Kau. [3] Sabsau Sundar….- Braj Ke LokgeetIn Vraj Dham, the most beautiful place is Barsana Dham, for it is the divine abode of Shri Radharani Herself. Even Shri Krishna personally comes to welcome Her there, and such is its glory that even the Vedas cannot fully describe it. On the peak of Brahmachal hill in this sacred Barsana stands the magnificent temple of Shri Radha Rani, shining with unmatched divine splendor. [1]When Shri Radha, adorned with divine beauty and grace, walks with Her sakhis carrying yogurt through the narrow alley of Sankari Khor, Shri Krishna suddenly appears and blocks Her path. This enchanting lila is among the most divine pastimes that take place in Barsana Dham. [2]Dressed in yellow garments with a scarf tied around His waist, Shri Krishna sweetly demands a toll (daan) from Shri Radha. But just one gentle smile from Her instantly captures His heart. Even from behind Her veil, Her divine face steals the mind of the ever-playful Krishna. Such are the nectar-filled pastimes that make Barsana the true kingdom of Rasa. [3]

title: Tasmat Sarvatmanarudra Mat Priyansharanam - Sanat Kumar Samhita (36.172)
sanskrit_text: Tasmat Sarvatmanarudra Mat Priyansharanam Vrajet.Ya Ashu Mat Priya Bhootva Maa Vashikartu Michhati.Idam Rahasam Param Maya Te Parikirtitam.- Sanat Kumar Samhita (36.172)Shri Krishna said to Lord Shiva — “O Rudra, know this well: if you truly seek My favor, then take wholehearted refuge in My beloved Shri Radha. Whoever gains Her grace effortlessly brings me under His control. This is the highest secret I now reveal to you.”

title: Shvaan Kahu Ki Shrigal Kahu Ki - Shri Sundardas Ji
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Shvaan Kahu Ki Shrigal Kahu Ki,Vidal Kahu Man Ki Matti Taisi. [1]Dhed Kahu Kidhao Doom Kahun Kidhao,Bhaad Kahu Ki Bhadāi De Jaisi. [2]Chaur Kahu, Batmaar Kahu,Thag Jai Kahu, Upma Kahu Kaisi. [3]Sundar Aur Kaha Kahiye Ab,Ya Man Ki Gati Dostat Aisi. [4]- Shri Sundardas JiWhat can I say about the strange nature of this mind? At times, it seems like a dog—always restless with greed and hunger; sometimes like a jackal—filled with deceit and trickery; and sometimes like a cat—outwardly calm but inwardly cunning. [1]Sometimes, this mind behaves like a Ḍheḍha (untouchable)—immersed in impure, inappropriate thoughts; sometimes like a Ḍoma (one who performs cremations)—always inclined towards death and destruction; and sometimes like a clown—treating everything as a joke and creating chaos. [2]At times, it acts like a thief, hiding its corrupt desires; sometimes, like a bandit, it becomes violent; and at times, like a conman, it deceives others with clever tricks. What analogy can truly capture this mind that defies all boundaries? [3]Śrī Sundara Dās says—truly, the nature of this mind is horrifying and wicked. It is the very root of all our problems. [4]

title: Lakhi Augun Tan Aapne Bhul Sabe Sudhi Jai - Shri Rasnidhi
sanskrit_text: Lakhi Augun Tan Aapne, Bhula Sabe Sudhi Jaai.Adham-Udharan-Virad Tuva, ‘Rasnidhi’ Sumir Suhai.- Shri RasnidhiWhen I look at my own faults, my mind becomes restless with fear, losing all awareness of myself. But, O Lord! The moment I contemplate Your glorious titles such as Patita-Pāvana (Savior of the fallen), Adhama-Udhārana (Redeemer of the wretched), I am filled with great peace, trusting that surely, the Lord will also deliver someone fallen like me.

title: Jaat Rupa Takhat Pe Baithi Roop Rasi Radhe - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (25)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jaat Roop Takhat Pai Baithi Roop Raasi Radhe,Angan Ki Prabha Prabhakar Ko Lajavati. [1]Cheer Chaaru Heer Haar Hiy Pehiraay Kar,Bhushan Bnaay Baal Saajan Sajaavati. [2]Atar Gulaab Lai Sugandhan Lagaavai Sabai,Chandan Chadhaay Bhaal Bhauran Bhagaavati. [3]Jori Jori Paani Devtaan Hoon Ki Rani Hathi,Koti Koti Kornis Jhuki Kai Bajaavati. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (25)When Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī, the infinite mine of beauty, sits gracefully upon Her golden throne, the radiance of Her divine limbs shames even the brilliance of the sun. [1]Her intimate sakhīs lovingly adorn Her with beautiful garments, garlands of diamonds and pearls, and precious ornaments with their delicate hands. [2]They anoint Her with rose‑scented oils and fragrant essences, apply sandal paste to Her forehead, and gently wave away the bees drawn to Her divine fragrance. [3]Śrī Hathi Jī says — even the queens of the celestial gods come with folded hands, bowing countless times, playing kornish (a melodious ceremonial instrument), and offering reverent obeisance at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī. [4]

title: Banshivat Yamuna Nikat Jahan Saghan Ghan Chhaah - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Vanshivat Yamuna Nikat, Jahan Saghan Ghan Chhaah.Pyari Mukh Bihasat Bhayi, Daari Gale Piy Baah.- Braj Ke DoheShri Lalita Sakhi says — On the banks of the Yamuna, at Vamshivata, where the dense trees provide their cooling shade, Shri Radha stands with a sweet smile on her face, and her beloved Shri Krishna has lovingly placed his arm around her neck.

title: Man Re Shyam Son Kar Het - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vihaag)Man Re Shyam Son Kar Het.Krishn Naam Ki Vaar Karle To Vache Tero Khet. [1]Man Sua Tan Peenjra Ho Tasu Baandhyo Tero Het.Kaal Roopi Majhaar Dole Ab Ghadi Tohai Let. [2]Vishay Vish Ras Chhand De Re Utar Sagar Set.‘Soor’ Shri Gopal Bhajle Guru Bataye Det. [3]- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraBind yourself, O mind, in the bond of love with Shyamsundar. Encircle your life with the protective boundary of the holy name “Krishna” to safeguard the field of your very life. [1]This parrot-like mind is trapped in the cage-like body, entangled in attachments. Meanwhile, Yamraj, the God of death, like a prowling cat, circles all around, ready to eat you at any moment! [2]Therefore, abandon these poisonous sensual desires and cross the bridge over this ocean of worldly illusion. Shri Surdas says — the Guru instructs us to perform exclusive devotion to Shri Gopal. [3]

title: Jehi Binu Jane Kachhhi Nahin - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (18)
sanskrit_text: Jehi Binu Jaane Kachhuhi Nahin, Jaatyau Jaat Bisesh.Soi Prem Jehi Jaanikai, Rahi Na Jaat Kachhu Sesh.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (18)Without which nothing can be understood, through which divine knowledge arises, and after knowing which nothing remains to be known, that very essence of all essences is Prema (love).

title: Pyariju Kaun Tihari Khot - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (68)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Bhairavi)Pyariju Kaun Tihari Khot.Moso Vani Na Kachu Vai Swamini, Hon Augunki Mot. [1]Shrivan Daras Dikhayke Radhe, Meto Jiyaki Chot.Lalit Kishori Ko Apanavahun, Gahi Tihari Ot.  [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (68)O Pyārījū! There is no fault in You — Your grace is boundless. The fault lies entirely within me, for I am nothing but a massive bundle of sins. [1]O Queen of Shri Vrindavan! Please grant me the vision of Your eternal divine abode, Shri Vrindavan, and relieve the deep pain of my heart. Shri Lalit Kishori humbly prays — Accept me as Your maidservant, for I have no shelter except your lotus feet! [2]

There is no fault in You — Your grace is boundless. The fault lies entirely within me, for I am nothing but a massive bundle of sins. [1]O Quin of Shri Vrindavan! Please grant me the vision of Your eternal divine abode, Shri Vrindavan, and relieve the dip pain of my heart. Shri Lalit Kishori humbly prays — Accept me as Your maidservant, for I have no shelter except your lotus fit! [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Banki Rasik Viharini Radhe - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
sanskrit_text: Banki Rasik Viharini Radhe, Banke Rasik Bihari. [1]Banki Mukut Chandrika Banki, Banki Chitvan Pyari. [2]Banki Chalan Chaaru Gati Chanchal, Pag Nupur Jhunkari. [3]Saras Maadhuri Banki Jhanki, Jivan Praan Humari. [4]- Shri Saras MadhuriRasika’s beloved Queen, Shri Radha, who eternally engages in Nitya-Vihāra, and Rasik Bihari Shri Krishna, are both mischievous. [1]Their crown and moon-shaped forehead ornament (chandrika) are tilted, and their sidelong glances are playful. [2]Their enchanting walking style and movements are enchanting, and even the anklets on their feet jingle in rhythm with that graceful, mischievous gait. [3]Shri Saras Madhuri says — These bāṅkī (tilted/mischievous) glimpses of the Divine Couple are the very life-breath of my soul. [4]

title: Vrindavan Sabson Bado, Yatha Dudh Mein Gheev - Shri Charandas
sanskrit_text: Vrindavan Sabson Bado, Yatha Dudh Mein Gheev.Sab Dharman Hari Bhakt Jyaon, Yatha Pind Mein Jeev.- Shri CharandasAs ghee is the pure essence extracted from milk, so is Vrindavan the supreme essence among all abodes. title: Hum To Yonhi Bhakt Kahaye - Shri Kishori Ali
sanskrit_text: Hum To Yonhi Bhakt Kahaye. Rasik-Janan Ki Sangati Tajikai, Bimukhan Sanmukh Dhaye. [1]Svaang Sinh Kau Dhari, Swaan Sam Man Nai Chal Chalay. Bishayan Ke Bas Karikai Indrin, Kapi Laun Naach Nachaye. [2]Kahani Si Karni Na Kari Kachhu, Jag-Jan Bahut Hansaye. Param Kripalu Kishori Ju Ne, Aise Hoo Apnaye. [3]- Shri Kishori AliI call myself a devotee, but in truth, I have not yet lived up to that sacred name. Instead of seeking the company of Rasik saints, I kept running after the world and those who turned away from God. [1]Outwardly, I disguised myself like a lion, but my inner nature was like that of a dog. I failed to control my mind; under the sway of desires, my senses kept dancing like monkeys. [2]I did not practice what I preached—my conduct was limited to mere words, and because of this, the world mocked me. Yet even in such a fallen state, the most compassionate Shri Kishori Ji (Radha) accepted me. Who else but Shri Radha could bestow such causeless grace? [3]

sanskrit_text: Gahi Gahi Radha Kar Kamal, Jhoomak Nachon Naach.Radha Ke Pad Kamal Gahi, Akhiyan Laun Saanch.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Hriday Sarvasv (37)Holding Shri Radha’s soft, lotus-like hands again and again, I wish to dance in joyful ecstasy, and with a pure heart, I long to place her lotus feet upon my eyes.
