title: Jyon Jyon It Dekhiyat Murakh - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Tirthanand (01)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jyon Jyon It Dekhiyat Moorakh Vimukh Log,Tyon Tyon Sukharashi Vrajvasi Jiya Bhavain Hain. [1]Khare Jal Chheelar Dukhare Andh Koop Chitai,Kalindi Ke Kaj Maha Man Lalchavain Hain. [2]Jaisi Ab Beetat Su Kahat Na Avain Bain,Nagar Na Chain Parain Pran Akulavain Hain. [3]Thohar Pharas Dekhi Dekhi Kain Bambur Bure,Hay Hare Hare Ve Tamal Sudhi Avain Hain. [4]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Tirthanand (1)Once, Śrī Nāgarīdās Jī had to go to a desert for some personal reason; while living in that desolate land, a deep remembrance of Braj arose in his heart. He says —As my eyes fall upon these love‑deprived beings, the pure devotion and sweetness of the Brajvāsīs come to my mind with even greater intensity. [1]Seeing the salty‑water wells here, my heart becomes restless, and the memory of Yamunā Jī’s sweet waters surges with even more force. [2]I cannot express how the days are passing; without Braj, my heart finds no peace even for a moment — a deep yearning keeps rising within. [3]Śrī Nāgarīdās says — seeing the dry cactus (thuhar), thorny feras, and lifeless babool trees here, I am struck with intense remembrance of Braj’s lush, beautiful, dark tamal trees and their cooling shade. [4]

title: Kaun Bhagya Bhari Nain Niharao - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (267)
sanskrit_text: Kaun Bhagya Bhari Nain Niharao.Binu Nakh Chandra Chandika Dekhe, Tribhuvan Sab Andhiyarao. [1]Sahaj Chhabili Chhabi Ke Upar, Tribhuvan Sobha Warao.Bhori Chhin Ik Darshan Karan, Koti Pran Taji Darao. [2]- Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (267)When will that blessed moment arrive, O Pyari Ju, when I may behold Your divine beauty with my own eyes? Without the radiance of Your moon-like toenails, this entire world appears to me as shrouded in darkness. [1]Even the beauty of all three worlds pales in comparison to Your naturally graceful form. Shri Hit Bhorisakhi Ji declares — for a single glimpse of You, I would gladly sacrifice my millions upon millions of lives. [2]

title: Vasiye Shri Vrindavan Dham - Rasik Vani
sanskrit_text: Vasiye Shri Vrindavan Dham.Ang Pulaki Nishi Divas Boliye Shri Radhe Radhe Nam. [1]Lalit Priya Jehi Tyagi Parampad, Payahun Nahi Vishram.Bhag Bado Tab Yah Vraj Raj Mein, Pavat Man Abhiram. [2]- Rasik VaniReside in Shri Vrindavan Dham — in such a manner that every time you chant “Shri Radhe Radhe,” a wave of divine ecstasy runs through every pore of your body. [1]Those who forsake Shri Radha-Krishna in pursuit of so-called supreme accomplishments can never experience true peace. Blessed indeed is the soul who receives the dust of Vraj, for that sacred dust alone grants the highest bliss to the mind. [2]

title: Paande Maati Mein Sane - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (320)
sanskrit_text: Paande Maati Mein Sanain, Karmath Nipat Nikor.Prem Padarath Kyon Gahein, Arujhe Lahai Na Chhor.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (320)Just like dry clay, the pandits remain deeply entangled in endless rituals and external formalities, with no real spiritual depth. title: Maya Ko Sab Jag Bhaje - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Uttarardh (28)
sanskrit_text: (Kundaliyaa)Maya Kon Sab Jag Bhajai, Madhau Bhajai Na Koi.Jo Kadaapi Madhau Bhajai, Maya Cheri Hoi. [1]Maaya Cheri Hoi, Rahai Charanan Lapataani.Jyon Malayaj Ke Sang, Sahaj Saurabh Sukhdaani. [2]Bhagavat Rasik Ananya, Hoy Satguru Ki Daaya.Maadhau Saun Man Lagai, Moh Mad Chhootai Maaya. [3]- Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Uttarardh (28)The entire world, knowingly or unknowingly, is devoted to Maya — attachment to wealth, relationships, possessions, and even Ashrams has become the norm. But only a rare soul offers single-pointed devotion to Shri Krishna, the Lord of Maya. [1]For such a soul, Maya no longer binds; rather, she becomes an obedient servant — not just any ordinary servant, but one who clings to the devotee’s feet like fragrance to sandalwood. [2]He who constantly and selflessly remembers the Lord with exclusive devotion receives the special grace of the  Guru. Such a devotee effortlessly becomes immersed in divine love, and the knots of illusion, ego, and attachment naturally fall away. [3]

title: Vrindaranya Lata Grriheshu Vasatam - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.65)
sanskrit_text: Vrindaranyalatagrriheshu Vasatam Govindalilasudha-Mapiyashru Vimu~nchatam Sumadhuram Radheti Samgayatam.Ardhonmilitalochanairvicharatam VrrindatavivithisuKutrapi Skhalatam Kvachichcha Patatam Yajjivanam Jivanam.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.65)Those great souls who reside in the vine groves of Shri Vrindavan, drink the nectar of Shri Govind’s pastimes, shed tears of love, always chant Shri Radha’s sweet name with devotion, and wander the alleys of Vrindavan with half-closed eyes—unaware of their own bodies, sometimes stumbling, sometimes falling in divine ecstasy—their life alone is truly blessed!

title: Suniye Nath Gareeb Nivaj - Shri Yugal Priya
sanskrit_text: (Raga Jhanjhoti Taal Charchari)Suniye Nath Gareeb Nivaaj,Aayi Sharan Tumhe Sab Laaj. [1]Adham Udhaaran Birad Samhaaran, Tribhuvan Ke Sirtaaj.Kunjdwaar Haun Khadi Kabai Ki, Traahi Traahi Maharaj. [2]Karunaakar Ab Boli Lijiye, Kariye Bilam Na Aaj.Jugalpriya Ko Abhay Kijiye, Yah Nahin Kachhu Bad Kaaj. [3]- Sri Yugal PriyaO Lord, Protector of the humble! I am in your shelter—now my honor lies solely in Your hands. [1]You are the Redeemer of the fallen, the Master of all three worlds, renowned for this very glory! I have been standing long at the gate of Nikunja, repeatedly crying out — “Save me! Save me!” [2]O Ocean of Compassion! Please bestow Your mercy upon me — delay not today. Shri Yugal Priya Ji pleads: grant this maidservant the shelter of fearlessness — surely this is no great task for You. [3]

sanskrit_text: Agradev Aagya Deyi, Bhaktan Ko Jas Gaau.Bhavsagar Ke Taran Ko, Naahin Aur Upaau.- Shri NabhadasMy revered Gurudev, Sri Agradev, has instructed me to sing the glories of the devotees, for there is no greater means than this to cross the ocean of worldly existence.

title: Ankhiyan Dukhiya Nit Hi Tarasein - Shri Rashid Ji
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Ankhiyan Dukhiya Nit Hi Tarasein, Tum Aan Se Neh Lagate Raho.Bisrate Raho Mohi Jaan Ayog, Viyog Ki Jwaal Jalate Raho. [1]Yahu Nyav Kahaan Ka Gopal Bhala, Kal Paake Mujhe Kalpaate Raho.Viniti Hai Vineet ‘Rashid’ Yahi, Braj Mein Ghanshyam Bulaate Raho. [2]- Shri Rashid JiMy tearful eyes constantly yearn for You, while You continue to shower Your love on others. Counting me unworthy, You keep forgetting me and burning me in the fire of separation. [1]O beloved Gopāla! What kind of justice is this—that You remain peaceful, while You leave me to suffer in Your separation? Śrī Rāshīd Jī humbly prays only this—O Ghaṇśyām! Kindly keep calling me to Braj again and again. [2]

title: Jyon Din Jat Ashadh Ke Tyon Tyon Ghate Meri Bhukh - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Jyon Din Jaat Ashaadh Ke, Tyon Tyon Ghatai Meri Bhookh.Bidhi Na Kab Darsaihau, Barsane Ke Rookh.- Braj Ke DoheAs the days of Ashadh (monsoon month) pass, my hunger keeps diminishing. O Creator! When will you let me see the trees of Barsana?

title: Are Man Shri Vallabh Gun Gaay - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
sanskrit_text: Are Man Shri Vallabh Gun Gaay.Vritha Kaal Kahe Ko Khonvat, Ved Puraan Padhay. [1]Shri Girirajdharan Pevai Ko, Naahin Aur Upaay.“Rasik” Sadaa Ananya Hoy Ke, Chitt It Ut Na Dulay. [2]- Goswami Shri Hariray JiO mind! Sing the glories of Shri Vallabh (Shri Vallabhacharya / Shri Krishna) lovingly. Why are you wasting your time reading the Vedas and Puranas? [1]There is no other way to attain Shri Krishna, the lifter of Govardhan. Goswami Shri Hariray Ji says that a true rasika always performs exclusive, single-minded devotion to his Lord; he does not allow his mind to wander here and there. [2]

sanskrit_text: Pyari Preetam Son Likhyaun, Mat Pariyau Mau Dhyan.Tum Mose Hvai Jauge, Karihon Ka Pain Maan.- Shri Dayaram JiPyariju writes, “Beloved, do not meditate upon me too much — otherwise you become like me. Then, to whom shall I display my loving sulk?”

title: Ham Vasi Barsane Ke - Shri Lalit Madhuri
sanskrit_text: (Raah Laavni Iman)Ham Vaasi Barsane Ke.Shri Chaitanya Upaasi Khaasi, Radha Govind Vaane Ke. [1]Lalit Kishori Garv Bhare Ham, Anyason Kyon Chit Laaneke.‘Lalit Madhuri’ Nit Avaloken, An Tan Man Bhatkaaneke. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriWe are residents of Barsana and intimate devotees in the tradition of Shri Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, belonging to none other than “Radha-Govind.” [1]Proudly belonging to enchanting Kishoriji (Sri Radha), why would we fix our mind on anyone else? Shri Lalitmadhuri says — we behold Her eternally and never let our body or mind wander elsewhere. [2]

title: Vrindavan Ki Chuhari Chali Mukti Thukray - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Vrindavan Ki Choohari, Chali Mukti Thukray.Vyas Kahai Acharaj Kahan, Yah Radha Mahal Khvay.- Braj Ke DoheEven the sweeper woman of Vrindavan kicks away mukti (liberation) with her feet and walks on with no desire to accept it. What is surprising in that? After all, this is the palace of Shri Radha Herself, whom she serves as a maid.

title: Shri Swami Haridas Ji Rasik Maha Hari-Vyas - Shri Charan Das
sanskrit_text: Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Rasik Maha Hari-Vyas. Krishnadas Aru Hit Ali, In Marag Sukha-Ras. [1]Soi Mero Marg Hai, Maha Mod Ki Khaan. Unnat Param Nikunj-Ras, Tin Baanin Parmaan. [2]- Shri CharandasIn this verse, Śrī Caraṇdās Jī declares that the path of the exclusive rasikas who worship the nitya-vihāra (eternal loving pastimes) is indeed his own path. He says—Śrī Svāmī Haridās Jī, Śrī Harivyās Jī, Śrī Kṛṣṇadās, and Śrī Hit Alī (Harivaṃś Mahāprabhu)—all these are great rasika ācāryas. The path shown by them is truly an ocean of bliss. [1]  That very path is also mine—it is a mine of supreme divine happiness, directly leading to the gateway of nikuṃja (the confidential inner forest of divine love). The realization and perfection of that highest rasa is clearly expressed and confirmed in the divine vāṇīs (words) of these great saints. [2]

title: Jag Mein Milan Anup Hai Bhagwadian Ko Sang - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (26)
sanskrit_text: Jag Mein Milan Anoop Hai, Bhagwadian Ko Sang.Tinke Sang Pratap Ten, Hot Shyam So Rang. - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (26)Among all associations, the most rare and sacred is the association of Premī saints (God realized), for in their presence, the heart effortlessly immerses in the rasa of Shri Krishna’s love.

title: Chalu Man Shri Vrindavan Or - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata
sanskrit_text: Chalu Man Shri Vrindavan Or.Anupam Dhaam Kamna Pooran, Viharat Yugal Kishor. [1]Shat Ritu Rahat Pratyaksh Swachh Jal, Yamuna Let Hilor.Praphulit Lata Pata Mridu Phal Yut, Khag Dhvani Naachat Mor. [2]- Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket LataCome, O mind, let us go toward that divine Vrindavan, the unparalleled abode where all loving desires are fulfilled and where the youthful Divine Couple, Sri Radha Krishn, eternally engages in Nitya Vihara rasa. [1]All six seasons are present there at once. The pure waters of the Yamuna flow in gentle waves. The vines and leaves remain ever-blossoming, adorned with colorful fruits. Birds fill the atmosphere with melodious songs, and peacocks dance joyfully in bliss. [2]

title: Pashu Pakshi Pashan Hon - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (91)
sanskrit_text: Pashu Pakshi Paashaan Hon, Trin Anu Raj Braj Gail.Koop Baavari Keejiye, Lalit Kishori Chhail.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (91)O Lalit Kishori (Shri Radha), please grant me the grace to become anything in the pathways of Braj — a bird, animal, stone, a blade of grass, or even a speck of dust. Even as a well, a stepwell, or a lifeless object, my only prayer is to never be born or dwell outside the dust of Braj-dham.

title: Rakhi Dridh Bharoso Toko Poshaegi Jai ShriRadha - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Vinayavali (141)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Dhanashri)Rakhi Dridh Bharoso Toko, Poshaegi Jai ShriRadha. (Tek). [1]Shyamvihari Agyakari, Tan-Man Ki Sab Maite Badha. Sundar Shyama, Shyam Manohar, Pranatan Ke Poshan-Sukh Saadha. [2]Daya-Udadhi Karuna Ke Sagar, Kripa-Sindhu, Sadgunan Agadha. Ali Madhuri Ke Sarvas-Dhan, Dampati Sarvopari Aaradha. [3]- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Vinayavali (141)Place unshakable faith in Shri Radha, and firmly believe that Shri Radha Herself will take care of you and protect you always. [1]Even Lord Shri Krishna Himself moves under Her command. She, the supreme Swamini, is the remover of all obstacles of body and mind. This incomparable couple, Shyama-Shyam, bestows happiness and shelter upon those who take refuge in Them. [2]Shri Radha is the boundless ocean of compassion, the unbroken stream of mercy, and adorned with countless divine virtues. Shri Ali Madhuri Ji says — the entire treasure of my life is this divine couple, whom I always worship. [3]

title: Jaavak Charan Det Choom Ur Dhar Let - Shri Hita Chaturbhujdas
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jaavak Charan Det Choom Ur Dhar Let, Romaanchit Bhaye Het, Vahai Jyon Banaari Hain. [1]Charanan Madhilaal Prem Hiy Ko Vishaal, Aadi Hai Na Ant, Kaal Bharyo Bharain Bhaari Hain. [2]Pad Aanguri Je Laal, Evai Laal Ki Hi Laal,Aise Laal Par Baal Lalitaadi Vaari Hain. [3]“Chaturbhujdas” Prabhu-Bhaar Saun Virad Padhai, Naachi Kai Ja Aage—Soi Swamini Hamaari Hain. [4]- Shri Hita ChaturbhujdasŚrī Kṛṣṇa applies jāvak (red alta‑like dye) to Śrī Rādhā’s lotus feet; as He kisses those tender feet and holds them to His heart, He becomes thrilled, completely intoxicated in divine love’s ecstasy, and sheds tears out of love. [1]In the midst of those divine feet resides Lal Jī (Kṛṣṇa), whose heart holds such deep and boundless love for them that it has neither beginning nor end. [2]The redness of Her toe‑fingers is such that it seems as though the redness of Śrī Kṛṣṇa (Lal Himself) has entered into them; upon that incomparable crimson hue, Lalitā and the other sakhīs offer themselves completely. [3]Śrī Chaturbhujdās declares — the one before whom even the Lord (Kṛṣṇa) bows and dances, She alone is our eternal Svāminī, Śrī Rādhā. [4]

title: Kahu Lakut Kahu Muralika  Pitambar Sudh Nahin - Shri Brajnidhi Granthawali, Preeti Lata (63)
sanskrit_text: Kahun Lakut Kahun Muralika, Pitambar Sudh Nahin. Mor Chandrika Jhuki Rahi, Priya Dhyan Man Mahin. - Shri Brajnidhi Ji, Shri Brajnidhi Granthawali, Preeti Lata (63)Shri Krishna is so deeply immersed in the meditation of Shri Radha that He is unaware of His stick, forgetful of His flute, and even has no awareness of His yellow garment. Even the peacock-feathered crown upon His head bends down in absorption, as if it too has merged into that same mood of devotion.

title: Aaju Badhai Vrindavan Sukh Sindhu Hilor -  Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Ras Ke Pad (62)
sanskrit_text: Aaju Badhai Vrindavan, Sukh Sindhu Hilor.Priyalal Tan Man Hulasane, Manasij Meghani Ghor. [1]Sab Sakhi Umangi Umangi Gun Gawai, Naachat Mor Chakor.Shrilalitamohini Ke Ur Biharata, Nain Kamal Chit Chor. [2]- Shri Lalit Mohini Dev, Lalit Mohini Dev Ju Ki Vaani, Ras Ke Pad (62)An auspicious celebration fills the divine land of Vrindavan today, where the ocean of bliss constantly rises in waves. The divine couple, Priyālāla, remain ever ecstatic in body and mind, while the cloud-like cupid roars with great thunder. [1]The sakhis, filled with joy and delight, sing the songs of the nitya-vihāra (eternal love-play). Peacocks and chakors are dancing. In the heart of Sri Lalit Mohini, the lotus-eyed heart-stealers, the divine couple ceaselessly sport in divine play. [2]

title: Brajvasi Nahin Sab Devta Hain - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Brajvasi Nahin Sab Devta Hain, Yah Bhavana Chitt Mein La Rahe Hain.Chir-Kal Pratiksha Ke Baad Aha! Mam Swami Samip Mein Aa Rahe Hain. [1]Hare Krishna! Chalo, Der Mat Karo, Drig Darshan Ko Lalcha Rahe Hain.Jinhen Dekho Wahi Kuch Bhent Liye, Bas Nand Ke Dwar Ko Ja Rahe Hain. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’The residents of Braj are not ordinary people; they are all divine beings—let this feeling fill my heart. After a long wait—aha! my Lord is coming near to me. [1]O Kṛṣṇa! Delay no longer, my eyes have become restless for Your darśana. Everyone you see carries an offering and heads toward Nanda’s door. [2]

title: Bain Wahi Unko Gun Gai - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Bain Wahi Unko Gun Gai, Au Kaan Wahi Un Bain Son Sani. Haath Wahi Un Gaat Sarai, Aru Pai Wahi Ju Wahi Anujani. [1]Gyaan Wahi Un Aan Ke Sang, Au Maan Wahi Ju Karai Manmani.Tyon Raskhan Wahi Raskhani Ju, Hai Raskhani Son Hai Raskhani. [2]- Shri Raskhan, Raskhan RatnawaliOnly that speech is meaningful which sings the glories of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and only those ears are truly blessed which listen to His nectar-like praises. Only those hands are meaningful which serve the limbs of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and those feet are truly blessed which always follow in His footsteps. [1]Only that knowledge is meaningful which prevents the mind from attaching to anyone other than Śrī Kṛṣṇa and His devotees. And only that sulking is worthy which, driven by self-willed love, melts the heart of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Raskhān says—he alone is truly ‘Raskhān’ who is a genuine connoisseur of the nectar of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the mine of rasa, and remains forever immersed in His divine rasa. [2]

sanskrit_text: Makka Madina Dwarika, Badri Aur Kedaar. Bina Daya Sab Jhooth Hain, Kahai Malook Vichar. - Shri Malook DasEven if one undertakes pilgrimages to Mecca, Medina, Dwarka, Badrinath, Kedarnath, or any sacred land, it bears no fruit if the heart is devoid of compassion.

title: Nandalal Mo Tan Dukh Hero - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (16)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Iman)Nandalal Mo Tan Dukh Hero.Shri Vraj-Raj Paavan Darasabahu, Jaason Sahajen Hoy Nivero. [1]Uk-Chook Sab Kshamo Sanware, Ha-Ha, Ab Na Karo Avasero.Lalit Ladaiti Dehu Kripa Kari, Shri Vrindavan Kunj Basero. [2]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (16)O Nandalal, please look towards me and see the pain of my body. Show me the vision of the supremely holy dust of Vraj, through which my distress will be easily removed. [1]O Shyamasundar, forgive all my mistakes and faults — delay no longer. Shri Lalit Ladaiti humbly prays: please grant me residence in the bowers of Shri Vrindavan. [2]

title: Vrindavan Vraj Ko Mahat Kape Varni Jaai Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar, Dasham Sakandh
sanskrit_text: Vrindavan Vraj Ko Mahata, Kape Varni Jaai.Chaturanan Pag Parasikai, Lok Gayo Sukh Paai.- Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar, Dasham SakandhThe significance of Shri Vrindavan and the entire land of Vraj is immeasurable. No one can describe it completely. When four-headed Brahma admitted his offense in Braj, he bowed down and placed his head at Shri Krishna’s lotus feet, and then returned to his own abode immersed in endless bliss.

title: Main To Tere Darshan Ki Hun Bhikhari - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (125)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Desh and Sorath)Main To Tere Darshan Ki Hun Bhikhari,Arji Suniye Bhan Dulari. (Tek). [1]Jeevan Dhan Sarveshwari Shyama, Sab Gun Aagar Ati Abhirama,Dhyan Dharun Tumko Athyama, Kirat Raj Kumari. [2]Naam Ratun Nit Tumro Mukh Se, Jeevan Bite Yaasun Sukh Se,Jag Mein Khoye Bahut Din Dukh Se, Aai Sharan Tumhari. [3]Karunanidhi Jai Jai Shri Radha, Shobha Sindhu Roop Agadha,Haro Virah Ki Begahi Badha, “Roopmadhari” Vari. [4]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (125)I am but a humble beggar, yearning for just one glance of Yours, O Bhanu’s charming daughter, Shri Radha! Please hear my prayer. [1]O Shyama, Sovereign of all! You are my life’s treasure, the mine of all virtues, and supremely enchanting. O daughter of Kirti! Show such mercy upon me that day and night (all eight quarters), I may keep my mind fixed on You. [2]May I constantly remember Your name, so that in every breath only Your name resounds. Then alone will I attain true and supreme bliss. I have wandered much in this material world and gained nothing but sorrow; now I have come to seek Your shelter. [3]O ocean of compassion, O Shri Radha, glories be Yours! You are the boundless ocean of beauty! Kindly relieve me from the pain of Your separation quickly, for Roopmadhari sacrifices herself at Your lotus feet, again and again. [4]
english_text: (Rag Desh and Sorath)Main To Tere Darshan Ki Hun Bhikhari,Arji Suniye Bhan Dulari. (Tek). [1]Jivan Dhan Sarveshwari Shyama, Sab Gun Aagar Ati Abhirama,Dhyan Dharun Tumko Athyama, Kirat Raj Kumari. [2]Nam Ratun Nit Tumro Mukh Se, Jivan Bite Yasun Sukh Se,Jag Mein Khoye Bahut Din Dukh Se, Aai Sharan Tumhari. [3]Karunanidhi Jai Jai Shri Radha, Shobha Sindhu Rup Agadha,Haro Virah Ki Begahi Badha, “Rupmadhari” Vari. [4]- Shri Rup Madhuri, Shri Rup Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (125)I am but a humble beggar, yearning for just one glance of Yours, O Bhanu’s charming daughter, Shri Radha! Please hear my prayer. [1]O Shyama, Sovereign of all! You are my life’s treasure, the mine of all virtues, and supremely enchanting. O daughter of Kirti! Show such mercy upon me that day and night (all eight quarters), I may kip my mind fixed on You. [2]May I constantly remember Your name, so that in every breath only Your name resounds. Then alone will I attain true and supreme bliss. I have wandered much in this material world and gained nothing but sorrow; now I have come to sik Your shelter. [3]O ocean of compassion, O Shri Radha, glories be Yours! You are the boundless ocean of beauty! Kindly relieve me from the pain of Your separation quickly, for Rupmadhari sacrifices herself at Your lotus fit, again and again. [4]

title: Radhanantaparadhat‌ Patatam - Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.100)
sanskrit_text: Radhanantaparadhat‌ Patatam Vadhambudhavanuddhara.Vrrindavanamapi Mandayata Iha Karunardradrrik‌ Prasare.- Shri Prabodhanand Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (14.100)The one who commits an offense against Shri Radha Maharani, because of those endless offenses, falls into the ocean of worldly obstacles and is deprived of deliverance. Even Shri Vrindavan itself does not show compassion to such an offender and keeps him deprived of its merciful glance.

title: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Mein Vase Kumhaar - Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (98)
sanskrit_text: Dhan Dhan Vrindavan Mein Vasain Kumhaar,Bhaawai Chaak Banaawai Baasan, Karuye Kulra Karain Apaar.Saadhu Sant Kau Paani Pyaawai, Inke Kul Ko Yahi Vichaar,Abhayaraam Ehuh Badbhaagi Sab Kaun Aawai Inke Dwaar.- Shri Abhay Ram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (98)The potters of Vrindavan are truly blessed. Their hands turn the wheel to create beautiful vessels, creating karūvā (water pots) and kulahaḍ (earthen cups) from the soil of Vraja. [1]They serve the saints and sages by offering them water — this is the noble service tradition of their lineage. Shri Abhayram says, they are greatly fortunate, for everyone comes to their door. [2]

title: Kabhu Hakdhak Ho Rahe Uthe Prem Hit Gaay - Sri Sahjobai
sanskrit_text: Kabhun Hakdhak Ho Rahai, Uthai Prem Hit Gaay. Sahjo Aankh Mundi Rahai, Kabhoon Sudhi Ho Jay. - Sri SahjobaiWhile describing the signs of a true premi bhakta, Sahajo Bai says that sometimes he stands motionless, deeply absorbed in bhava-samadhi (ecstasy) and loses all outer awareness. At other times, the force of divine love lifts him into spontaneous singing. Sometimes he closes his eyes and sinks into deep contemplation, and at other times he returns to his external consciousness.

title: Radhe Aan Pado Tere Dwaar - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (33)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Durga Tritaal)Radhe Aan Pado Tere Dwaar.Tumhein Chhod Vrishbhaan Dulaari, Kaason Karu Pukaar. [1]Bhavsagar Mein Doob Rahi Hoon, Veg Lagaabo Paar.Sharan Tihaari Aan Padi Hoon, Ab Na Maano Bhaar. [2]Jeevan Praan Adhaar Tumhi Ho, Ye Man Leeno Dhaar.Shri Gopal Hit Hari Swaamini, Tum Bin Hon Bekaar. [3]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (33)O Radhe! I have come to your doorstep. Other than You, O daughter of Vrishbhanu, who else can I turn to? [1]I am drowning in the ocean of worldly existence, please take me across with the force of Your grace. I have come into Your shelter, please do not consider me a burden now. [2]You alone are the support of my life and breath; my mind has firmly resolved to remain absorbed in you. Sri Hita Gopaldas says, O Swamini of Shri Hari! Without You, I am nothing. [3]

[2]Jivan Pran Adhar Tumhi Ho, Ye Man Lino Dhar.Shri Gopal Hit Hari Swamini, Tum Bin Hon Bekar. [3]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (33)O Radhe! I have come to your durstep. title: Krishna-guru Dyuti Para Bahu Gayamana - Shri Kishori Ali, Radhashtak (01)
sanskrit_text: Krishna-guru Dyuti Para Bahu Gayamana Krrishnatate ViharatanvitaKrishnasara. Krishnanena Kamthamanushamjita DirghabahuhKrishnapriya Vasatu Me Hrridaye Sadaiva.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radhashtak (1)May Shri Radha, who is the guru of Krishn, supremely radiant, glorified in countless ways, who performs Vihāra (love-plays) along the banks of Yamunā, who embodies the very essence of Krishn, whose long arms embrace His neck, who is His dearest beloved, always dwell in my heart.

title: Tere Charanan Mein Bali Jaaun - Sri Bholi Gopi
sanskrit_text: Tere Charanan Mein Bali Jaaun. He Manmohan Shri Banwari, Darshan Se Sukh Paun. [1]Makhan Mishri Modak Meva, Prem Se Tohe Khilaun. Rom Rom Mein Teri Soorat, Ik Pal Bhool Na Paun. [2]Nand Gaon Gokul Govardhan, Braj Taj Anat Na Jaaun. ‘Bholi-Gopi’ Charanan Daasi, Jag Mein Teri Kahaun. [3]- Sri Bholi GopiI lay my life at your feet, O enchantingly sweet Lord Krishn; your darshana fills my heart with joy. [1]With love, I offer you butter, sugar candies, sweets, and dry fruits. Your form dwells in every pore of me; I cannot forget you for even a moment. [2]I will never leave Nand Gaun, Gokul, Govardhan, or the sacred land of Braj. Says Bholi-Gopi, I wish to be known in this world only as a humble servant at Your feet. [3]

title: Gun Gaavai Gopal Ke Bhari Laavai Drig Neer - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (171)
sanskrit_text: Gun Gaavai Gopal Ke, Bhari Laavai Drig Neer.Narayan Nahi Kal Parai, Bin Dekhe Balbeer. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (171)Sing the glories of Gopal, and let your eyes overflow with tears. Shri Narayan Swami says that until he beholds Shri Krishna, the brother of Balram, his heart cannot find peace even for a single moment.

title: Koi Kahai Baikuntha - Shri Lalitkishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhaant Ki Saakhi (346)
sanskrit_text: Koi Kahai Baikuntha, Koi Kahai Brahma Hai.Koi Kahai Iha Rama, Koi Kahai Krishna Hai. [1]Koi Kahai Yaha Kunjani-Kunjani, Raas Kiyau Niradhara Hai.Hari Haan, Sabai Tajau Janjala, Bhajau Haridasa Kahyau Sukhasara Hai. [2]- Shri Lalitkishori Dev, Shri Lalitkishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhaant Ki Saakhi (346)Some describe Lord’s form as Vaikunthanath, some despicable Him as ‘Brahma’ (impersonal). Others describe Him as Lord of Ayodhya, Shri Ram, while some proclaim Him as Lord Shri Krishna. [1]Some describe Him as the One who performs Rāsa-vilās in the groves (kuṃjas). Shri Lalit Kishori Dev says — cast away all these confusions, and worship that Nitya Vihāra (eternal love-play) of the divine couple, which is the very essence of all nectars, worshipped by the crest-jewel of all, Swami Sri Haridas Ji Maharaj. [2]

title: Yah Sukh Samujhan Ko Kachhu - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (49)
sanskrit_text: Yah Sukh Samujhan Kaun Kachhu, Nahin Aan Upai.Prem Dareechi Jau Kabhun, Sahaj Kripa Khuli Jaai.- Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Premavali (49)The experience of this rasa of Vrindavan cannot be attained by any practice or method; it opens only through the causeless grace of Shri Radha. When, by Her mercy, the window of divine love opens, only then does the direct experience of this rasa become possible.

title: Barsane Vrishabhana Gopa Ghar - Shri Kalyan Das
sanskrit_text: Barsane Vrishabhana Gopa Ghar, Sobha Ki Nidhi Ai Ri.Dhani-Dhani Kukha Mahari Kirati Ki, Jina Yaha Kanya Jai Ri. [1]Akhila Loka Bhuva Naga Loka Mein, Dekhi Suni Na Nikai Ri.Sindhusuta Girisuta Sachi Rati, Nahin Samana Kou Pai Ri. [2]Anamda Mudita Jasoda Rani, Kanhara Ki Karaum Sagai Ri.Prabhu Kalyana Giradhara Ki Jori, Vidhana Yahai Banai Ri. [3]- Shri Kalyan DasIn Barsana, at the house of King Vrishbhanu, the treasure of beauty, Sri Radha, has appeared. Blessed is the womb of Queen Kirti, who has given birth to such a daughter. [1]In all three worlds, no one has ever seen or heard of such beauty. Not even Lakshmi, Parvati, Indrani, or Rati (the wife of Kamadeva) can compare to this daughter. [2]On hearing the news of this girl’s birth, Yashoda Rani became overjoyed and thought to herself, “I will arrange the engagement of my Krishna with this daughter.” Kalyan Prabhu says that Brahma himself has destined Giridhar for this very match. [3]

title: Ab Kou Kaho Koor Kutil Yah - Sri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (16)
sanskrit_text: Ab Kou Kaho Koor Kutil Yah, Kaami Kripan Kaho Kou Mauni.Yaun Kautik Kripa Nirakhai Nitya, Shrinagridasi Liyein Ras Thauni.- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (16)O brother! Let people call us cruel, miserly, cunning, lustful, or even mute — we no longer concern ourselves with such worldly opinions. By the divine grace of Shri Swami Haridas Ji, we remain absorbed in lovingly beholding the eternal Nitya-Vihār (love-plays) of the divine couple uninterruptedly, like one who drinks milk straight from the udder of a cow with undivided focus.

sanskrit_text: Aaj Barsane Mangal Gai. Kunwar Lali Ko Janm Bhayo Hai, Ghar Ghar Bajat Badhai. [1]Motin Chauk Puraavo, Gaavo Dehu Aasis Suhai. Rasik Bihari Ki Yah Jeevani, Pragat Bhai Sukhdai. title: Aaju Badhai Hai Barsane -  Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (355)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Jayatishri / Devgandhar)Aaju Badhai Hai Barsanain. Kunwari Kisori Janam Layo, Sab Lok Baje Sahdanain. [1]Kahat Nand Vrishbhanaray Saun, Aur Baat Ko Janain. Aaju Bhaiya Ham Sab Vrajvasi, Tere Hi Haath Bikanain. [2]Ya Kanya Ke Aage Kotic, Betanin Kau Ab Maanain. Tere Bhalain, Bhalau Sabhi Kau, Anand Kaun Bakhanain. [3]Chhail Chhabile Gwal Rangeele, Harad, Dahi Laptaanain. Bhushan Vasan Vividh Pahire, Tan Ganat Na Raja Raanain. [4]Naachat Gaavat Pramudit Hvai Nar, Narin Ko Pehichanain. Vyas Rasik Sab Tan Man Poole, Neeras Sabai Khisanain. [5]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Uttarardh (355)Today, the town of Barsana is filled with joy and celebration, for in the house of Vrishbhanu Ji, Kishori Shri Radha has descended, and auspicious blessings are resounding throughout all the worlds. [1]Nand Ji says to Vrishbhanu Maharaj — “Apart from Shri Radha, nothing else remains worthy of discussion. Today, all of us Vrajvasis are completely surrendered into your hands.” [2]In front of this divine daughter, even the honor of millions of sons appears insignificant. Truly, she is not only your blessing, but the very redeemer of the world. Who can put this transcendental happiness into words? [3]The charming cowherd boys have anointed their bodies with turmeric and curd. They have adorned themselves with various ornaments and beautiful garments — and in their splendor, even kings and queens appear dim. [4]All of Braj, male and female alike, are absorbed in the ecstatic bliss, lost in dance and song. Shri Hariram Vyas says that on Radhashtami, all Rasikas are overjoyed as their bodies and minds are immersed in nectar, while monotonous jivas (without rasa) have fled into the corners in embarrassment. [5]

title: Striyo Maclechhasca Pasava - Padmapuran, Patalkhand
sanskrit_text: Striyo Mlechchascha Pashavah Pakshino Mrrigah. Mathurayam Mrrita Ye Cha Te Yanti Paramam Gatim.- Padma Purana, PatalakhandWomen, outcasts, animals, birds, and deer—whoever dies in Braj, they all attain the supreme destination.

title: Chirjivao Vrishbhanu Dulari - Sri Ladili Lal
sanskrit_text: Chirjeevau Vrishbhanu Dulari. [1]Agam Nigam Puran Kahat Hain, Vidhi Ki Srishtin Ten Yah Nyari. [2]Keerti Kookh Kalpataruvar Bhai, Manvanchhit Phal Det Hain Pyari. [3]‘Ladili-Lal’ Janm Radhe Kau, Sab Braj Baji Hai Vadhai Mairi. [4]- Sri Ladili LalMay Sri Radha, the darling daughter of King Vrishbhanu, live forever — this is the auspicious prayer. The Vedas and scriptures declare that she is unparalleled beyond Brahma’s ordinary creation. [1]Born from Mother Kirti’s womb, she is like the supreme wish-fulfilling tree, granting everyone their heart’s desire. Shri Ladili Lala Ji says that on the birth festival of Shri Radha, the whole of Braj reverberated with celebration, saying, “Congratulations, O Sakhi!” [2]

title: Ham Janma Tasu Sikatasu - Sri Kuresh Swami (c. 1010 CE,  disciple of Sri Ramanujacharya)
sanskrit_text: Ham Janma Tasu Sikatasu Maya Na Labdham, Rase Tvaya Virahita Kila Gopa Kanya.Yastavaki Na Padapanaktijusho Jushantu, Nikshipya Tatra Nijama~ngamanataptama.- Sri Kuresh Swami (c. 1010 CE,  disciple of Sri Ramanujacharya)O Śyāmasundara! Alas! I was not even blessed to be born as a single dust-grain of Vṛndāvana’s sacred soil. What disfavor of Yours is this? When, during the Rāsa dance, the gopīs were burned by the fire of separation from You, they found relief by touching that very dust— dust sanctified by the traces of Your lotus footprints. O Lord, by the touch of those particles alone, the torment of longing is soothed, and the burning heart finds peace.

title: Kirati Kisori Vrishabhan Ki Dulari Radha - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (99)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kirati Kisori Vrishabhan Ki Dulaari Radha,Sahaj Sakhin Lai Nikunjan Ko Dagari. [1]Charan Ki Chauki Ki Chamak Chaaru Angan Ki,Kayo Rang Rangan Ki Jyoti Braj Bagari. [2]Dekhai Pag Dwarei Varei Tan Man Pran Hathi,Roop Chak Chaundha Rahi Chauk Sab Nagari. [3]Kaidhau Sukhma Hai Kai Dama Hai Ke Tama Hai Kai,Uma Hai Induma Hai Kai Rama Hai Roop Aagari. [4]- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (99)Śrī Vṛṣabhānu’s charming daughter Rādhā, along with Her sakhīs, is walking gracefully toward the path of the Nikunj (divine grove). [1]The divine presence of Her footprints has illuminated the land, casting a radiant glow that fills the entire Braj region with a fresh charm and spiritual splendor. [2]Whoever catches a glimpse of Śrī Rādhā’s sacred footprints at their threshold becomes overwhelmed, surrendering their body, mind, and soul at Her feet; Her beauty stuns the entire town. [3]People are amazed and wonder — what exactly is this beauty? Is it the embodiment of bliss? The essence of peace? Or the aura that dispels darkness (tam‑harinī ābhā)? Some say, “She is Pārvatī”; others say, “She is Indumā (the moon goddess)”; some believe, “She is Lakṣmī”; but in truth, She is none other than the ultimate pinnacle of beauty — Śrī Rādhā Mahārānī. [4]

title: Vrindavan Ki Bhakti Ko Marm Na Jane Koy - Shri Tulsidas Ji Maharaj
sanskrit_text: Vrindavan Ki Bhakti Ko, Maram Na Jane Koy.Daar-Daar Paat-Paat Pe, Radhey Radhey Hoy.- Goswami Shri TulsidasUpon arriving in the divine land of Vrindavan, Goswami Shri Tulsidas was astonished to see the rasopāsanā bhakti (rasa worship) here. He said that no one can fully understand the secret of this rasopasana bhakti of Vrindavan. In Vrindavan, on every tree, every branch, and every leaf, the divine name “Radhey-Radhey” resounds constantly.

title: Dampati Dou Rajat Kunj Bhavan - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (385)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Hameer).Dampati Dou Rajat Kunj Bhavan.Peet Kulhai Sir, Kati Piyarau Pat, Kundal Lalit Shravan. [1]Vijna-Biyar Dhorati Sakhi Niyare, Sheetal Lagat Pavan.Kumbhandas Govardhan-Dhar, Rijhavat Pyari Radha Ravan. [2]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (385)In the fragrant bower-palace, the Divine Couple, Shri Radha Krishna, sit gracefully. Krishna wears a golden pagaḍī (turban) upon His head, a yellow cloth around His waist, and dazzling earrings swing from His ears. [1]Nearby, a sakhi lovingly waves a fan, and its gentle breeze offers comfort to Prītama Pyārī. Shri Kumbhandas says: Shri Krishna, the lifter of the Govardhana Mountain, is delighting Radha Pyari with His sweet pastimes. [2]

Shri Kumbhandas says: Shri Krishna, the lifter of the Govardhana Mountain, is delighting Radha Pyari with His swit pastimes. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Sabhin Bhumi Gopal Ki Ya Mein Atak Kahan - Taj Begam
sanskrit_text: Sabhin Bhoomi Gopal Ki, Ya Mein Atak Kaha.Ja Ke Mann Mein Atak Hai, Soi Atak Raha.- Taj Begam (Taj Bibi)The entire land belongs to Lord Shri Krishna, who dwells in every particle. The world itself holds no obstacle—it’s the soul’s mind, entangled in attachment and hatred, that binds. When the mind is absorbed in the Lord’s bhajana, all entanglements vanish, and supreme fearlessness is attained.

title: Bhajaum To Gupala Hi Kaum - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (21)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitta)Bhajaum To Gupala Hi Kaum Sevaum To Gupalai Eka,Mero Mana Lagyo Saba Bha.nti Namdalala Som. [1]Mere Deva Devi Guru Mata Pita Bamdhu Ishta, Mitra Sakha Hari Nato Eka Gopabala Som. [2]'Harichamda' Aura Som Na Mero Sambamdha Kachu, Asaro Sadaiva Eka Lochana Visala Som. [3]Mangom To Gupala Som Na Ma.ngom To Gupala Hi Som, Rijhaum To Gupala Pai Au Khijhaum To Gupala Som. [4]- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali, Vinay Prem Pachasa (21)If I worship, it is only Gopāl; if I serve, it is Gopāl alone — my mind is wholly attached to Nandalāl. [1]My god, goddess, guru, mother, father, kinsmen, worshipful deity, or friend — every relation is with that cowherd boy, Lord Krishn. [2]Harichand declares, I know no other; my eternal shelter lies with that Lotus‑eyed Lord. [3]If I ask, it is from Gopāl; if I don’t ask, still I will love Gopāl; if pleased, it is with Gopāl, and even when I am annoyed, it is with Him alone — everything begins and ends with Him. [4]

title: Madana Nada Taramgai - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (96)
sanskrit_text: Madana Nada Taramgairullasangopanari Hrridayachilachimanamamisham Samjihirshu.Brajapatitanayaravyo Dhivara Praudha Vamshi Kara Hita Mapi Vadityanta Tatrastu Vasa.- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (96)May I reside in the very Govardhan where Shri Krishna, the son of Nand, held His flute in His lotus hands and played its sweet melody, captivating the hearts of the beautiful cowherd maidens, overwhelmed with ecstatic waves of divine love.

title: Shri Radharaman Nukile Nain - Shri Gunmanjari Das
sanskrit_text: Shri Radharaman Nukile Nain.Vedhe Braj Yuvatin Man Manik, Kahat Bane Nahi Bain. [1]Kal Na Parat Pal Meri Sajni, Kaha Divas Kaha Rain. Gun Manjari Bade Chanchal Hain, Anchal Son Karen Sain. [2]- Shri Gunmanjari DasThe eyes of Shri Radharaman are extremely sharp, piercing the gem-like hearts of the young maidens of Braj. Such is the power of His gaze that words fail to describe it. [1]O dear sakhi! Ever since His eyes struck me, I have found no peace, not even for a moment—the distinction between day and night has vanished. Shri Gunmanjari Das says: His large, restless eyes are constantly making gestures of divine love-bliss with their unique expressions. [2]

title: Sadhu Sang Mein Sukh Bado Jo Kari Janai Koy - Shri Dayabai
sanskrit_text: Sadhu Sang Mein Sukh Bado, Jo Kari Janai Koy. Aadho Cheen Satsang Ko, Kalamakh Darai Khoy. - Shri DayabaiOnly one who truly engages in the association of saints knows the immense bliss it bestows. It is so precious that even half a moment spent in their association is enough to destroy all sins.

title: Sharan Shri Vrindavan Ki Jaiye - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
sanskrit_text: (Raag Gaud Saarang)Sharan Shri Vrindavan Ki Jaiye.Yugal Bihari Charan Kamal Son, Nish Din Neh Lagaiye. [1]Seva Kunj Sameep Baithke, Dampati Dhyaan Samaiye.Hoy Bhaavna Siddh Sahaj Hi, Nirakhi Nayan Hulasaiye. [2]Lele Seet Rasik Santan Ki, Baadha Bhookh Bhagaiye.Sheetal Sundar Jal Yamuna Ko, Pee Pee Pyaas Mitaiye. [3]Radhe Shyaam Naam Rat Rasna, Aansoo Drigan Bahaiye.Sarasamadhuri Piy Pyari Ke, Prem Pulak Gun Gaiye. [4]- Shri Saras MadhuriSeek refuge in Shri Vrindavan. Day and night, love the lotus feet of the Yugala Bihari (Shri Radha-Krishna). [1] Sit near Seva Kunj and meditate upon the divine couple, where bhāva is naturally accomplished, and the eyes become joyous upon beholding their form. [2] Satisfy the hunger by accepting the leftovers of rasik saints, and quench your thirst by drinking the cool waters of Shri Yamuna. [3] While chanting the names of “Radhe Shyam”, shed tears of love from your eyes. Shri Saras Madhuri says — be immersed in the nectar of the divine couple and sing their glories, filled with pure love. [4]

title: Na Lokachcha Bhayam Kimchita Na - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (99)
sanskrit_text: Na Lokachcha Bhayam Kimchita Na Cha Nigamatah Kimchita. Na Sprriha Samprada‌yadervayam Radhapadepsava.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (99)The devotion to Shri Radha’s feet is so miraculous that there remains no fear of the world, nor of the bindings of the Vedas and scriptures. Moreover, the exclusive devotee of Her lotus feet holds no desire to adopt any particular sampradāya (sect); he has only one longing — to selflessly serve the lotus feet of Shri Radha with exclusive loving sentiment.

title: Daas Kain To Raavari Ye - Shri Ratan Ali
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Daas Kain To Raavari Ye Aas Bisvaas Driddh,Kaun Ke Bharosain Tum Hai Udaas Rahe Maun.Aeho Shyaam Bhaarat Pukaarat Hūn Baar-Baar,Tārat Sune Ho Aage Kari, Kahi Dūr Gaun.Biradain Vichaar Nirday Na Hou Hirdai Mein,Dardai Pichhaanin Amain Baradain Na Hou Toin.Hansi Kī Na Baat Ab To Hūn Dūbiyo Jaat,Thāre Dekhat Kahaa Meri Naav Paar Karo Kyoon Na?- Shri Ratan AliO Śyāmsundara! This servant has firm hope and trust only in You; I have no refuge except Yours. Then why do You remain silent and upset? [1]O Lord! I am repeatedly calling out to You with deep anguish. You have always rescued the distressed the moment they cried to You — then why have You turned Your face away from me? [2]O Lord! The Vedas, scriptures, and all saints declare that You are the shelter of the shelterless and an ocean of compassion. Please remember these divine titles of Yours and don’t be so harsh with me. Recognize my pain — no one grants blessings greater than You. [3]This is no longer a laughing matter — I am drowning! Why do You simply stand there watching? Why don’t You help my boat cross to the shore? [4]

title: Maan Badaai Irsha - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Karunavali (3)
sanskrit_text: Maan Badaai Irsha, Harsh Shok Dukh-Day.Chatur Shiromani Laadili, In So Leu Bachaay.- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Karunavali (3)O Laḍilī Shri Rādhe, the crown jewel of all chaturtā (wisdom)! Pride, praise, jealousy and worldly joy and sorrow — all these ultimately bring suffering. Please be kind and protect me from all of these, and keep me forever engaged in devotion of Your lotus feet.

title: Nek Viloki Ri Ik Vaar - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
sanskrit_text: Nek Viloki Ri! Ik Vaar,Jo Toon Preeti Karan Ki Gaahak, Mohan Hain Rijhwaar. [1]Maha Roop Ki Raasi Naagari, Naagar Nandkumar,Haav Bhaav Leela Lalchohin, Laalan Naval Vihaar. [2]Mohi Bharoso ShyamSundar Kau, Kari Raakhyo Niradhaar,Nek Ek Pal Jo Abhilaasen, Rooprasik Balihaar. [3]- Shri Roop Rasik DevacharyaO friend, look closely just once; if you truly seek love, know that Sri Krishn is the one who charms every heart. [1]Shri Radha is the treasury of supreme beauty, and Nanda’s son is a connoisseur of love; their gestures, moods, and pastimes awaken desire - the Beloved’s sports are ever fresh. [2]I place all my trust in Shyamasundar, for He is the true shelter of shelterless like me. Whoever yearns sincerely even for a single moment—on such a one, says “Ruparasik,” I am wholly sacrificed. [3]

title: Basathi Vrindavipin Mein -  Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.49)
sanskrit_text: Basathi Vrindavipin Mein, Antar Karai Ju Koi.Tinkaun Ripu Badha Janiuaun, Takau Mukh Jin Joi.- Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.49)One who creates an obstacle in residing in Shri Vrindavan Dham should be considered one’s greatest enemy, and one should not even glance at the face of such a wretched being.

title: Main Kahan Janun Kunjbihari- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Sambhram-Manalila (10)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Kalingada)Main Kahaan Jaanoon Kunjbihari.Kihi Kaaran Roothi Hai Tum Son, Chandramukhi Vrishabhaankumaari. [1]Jab Te Uthi Priya Sovat Ten, Tabhi Son Man Mein Ris Bhaari.Na Jaanoon Kachhu Sapne Mein Un, Dekhi Hai Kartooti Tihaari. [2]Thaade Rahau Bheetar Mati Jaavau, Preetam Maano Kahi Hamaari.Naaraayan Jo Bhuj Gahi Rookoon, Phir Kahaan Baat Rahe Giridhaari. [3]- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Sambhram-Manalila (10)A Sakhi says to Krishna -O Kunja-Bihari! I don’t know for what reason the moon-faced daughter of King Vrishabhanu, Shri Radha, is upset with You. [1]Ever since she woke up from sleep, she has been visibly annoyed. Perhaps she saw something in a dream, maybe one of Your mischiefs, or if something else is the matter, I am not very sure. [2]Now, stay right here; do not go inside. O Beloved! Please listen to me. If you try to step in, I will hold your arm and stop you, and remember that won’t go well for you, O Giridhari! [3]
english_text: (Rag Kalingada)Main Kahan Janun Kunjbihari.Kihi Karan Ruthi Hai Tum Son, Chandramukhi Vrishabhankumari. [1]Jab Te Uthi Priya Sovat Ten, Tabhi Son Man Mein Ris Bhari.Na Janun Kachhu Sapne Mein Un, Dekhi Hai Kartuti Tihari. [2]Thade Rahau Bhitar Mati Javau, Pritam Mano Kahi Hamari.Narayan Jo Bhuj Gahi Rukun, Phir Kahan Bat Rahe Giridhari. [3]- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Sambhram-Manalila (10)A Sakhi says to Krishna -O Kunja-Bihari! I don’t know for what reason the mun-faced daughter of King Vrishabhanu, Shri Radha, is upset with You. [1]Ever since she woke up from slip, she has bin visibly annoyed. Perhaps she saw something in a dream, maybe one of Your mischiefs, or if something else is the matter, I am not very sure. [2]Now, stay right here; do not go inside. O Beloved! Please listen to me. If you try to step in, I will hold your arm and stop you, and remember that won’t go well for you, O Giridhari! [3]

title: Pyari-Mukh-Mayank Nishi-Bhor - Shri Kalyan Pujari Ji, Shri Hita Kalyan Pujari Ji Ki Vani (58)
sanskrit_text: Pyari-Mukh-Mayank Nishi-Bhor,Shodash Kala Roop-Gun Sevat, Eeshad Haas Kiran Sab Or. [1]Adhar-Sudha-Maadhuri Manohar, Peewat Piya Anuraag Chakor.Tripit Na ‘Kali Ali’ Din Dekhat, Sukh-Saagar Naagari-Kishor. [2]- Shri Kalyan Pujari Ji, Shri Hita Kalyan Pujari Ji Ki Vani (58)Shri Radhaju’s face glows like the full moon, resplendent with all sixteen divine qualities (kalās) of beauty and virtue. The gentle radiance of her subtle smile spreads divine bliss in all directions. [1]The sweetness of the nectar of her lips is so enchanting that Shri Krishna, like a love-filled chakor bird, constantly drinks it lovingly.  The sakhis gaze at her ever-blissful face all day long, yet their eyes remain unsatisfied and yearn ever more. [2]

title: Rasasvarupah Shrikrrishnah - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (6)
sanskrit_text: Rasasvarupah Shrikrrishnah Rasikastu Yaya KrritahReme Taya Chatmaratah Atma Ramopyakhanditah.Taveti Trritiya Hetau-budhairsaya ShukoktitahBhaktamshcha Premadanena Karoti Rasabhoginah. - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (6)The Śrutis (Vedas) describe the Supreme Lord as Ānanda-svarūpa (embodiment of bliss), not as rasa-bhoktā (enjoyer of rasa). It is Shri Radha who makes Him a rasika, a connoisseur of divine love. In Bhāgavatam, Shri Shukadeva calls Krishna ātmārāma (self-satisfied) and ātmarata (rejoicing in the Self), yet Radha engages Him in loving pastimes, making Him Rādhā-Ramaṇa. The word “tayā” in the verse, in instrumental case, is interpreted as “by her,” i.e., by Radha. Similarly, Radha grants divine love to devotees, making them Rasikas, capable of relishing the bliss of love.

title: Meri Swamini Prasann Badan - Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Ras Ke Pada (20)
sanskrit_text: Meri Swamini Prasann Badan, Sanvarau Sukha-Raasi.Inhin Ladaau Anudin Chhin-Chhin, Lahon Syaabasi. [1]Phooli Phooli Tahal Karon, Man Ke Manan Hulaasi.Ananya Shri Haridaas, Bipul Bali-Bali Biharinidaasi. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Ras Ke Pada (20)My Swamini, Shri Radha Ju, has a joyful and blooming face, and My Shri Krishna is the embodiment of all happiness. May I forever, night and day, lovingly fondle and playfully adore this Divine Couple, always receiving their affection. [1]May I joyfully, with a heart overflowing in divine love, be absorbed in their personal service (mahala-ṭahala). Shri Biharindev Ji says — adopting the path of exclusive devotion (ananyatā) shown by my Gurudev, Shri Haridas Ji, and Shri Vitthalvipul Dev Ji, I offer myself again and again, in total surrender. [2]

title: Shyam Rang Shyama Rangi Shyama Ke Rang Shyam - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Shyam Rang Shyama Rangi, Shyama Ke Rang Shyam.Ek Praan Tan Man Sahaj, Kahive Ko Dou Naam.- Braj Ke DoheShri Radha is imbued with the hue of dark-complexioned Shri Krishna, and Shri Krishna is imbued with the hue of fair-complexioned Shri Radha. Their bodies, minds, and very source of life are one. For the sake of loving pastimes, they are referred to as two — Radha and Krishna — but in truth, they are eternally inseparable and non-different.

title: Aho Doun Ke Mukh Chand Lasai - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Aho! Doun Ke Mukh Chand Lasai,Aru Doun Ke Drig Chaaru Chakori.Pat Shyaamal Shyaam Lakhau Pahine,Patpeet Kase Kati Radhika Gori. [1]Aji Preeti Ki Reeti Ki Kaun Kahai?Vipareet Bani Ati Adbhut Jori!Sakhi! Sundar Kaun Kahau Inmein,Vrishbhanu Dulare Ki Nand Kishori. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO dear sakhi! Both Śrī Rādhā and Śrī Kṛṣṇa have faces radiant like the full moon, and each is the cakōrī (moon-lover bird) to the other’s moon-like face. Śyāmasundara, with His dark complexion, is adorned in dark-colored garments, while fair-complexioned Rādhikā is adorned in golden-yellow attire tied gracefully around Her waist. [1]What a wondrous play of love this is, difficult to understand, for today this Divine Couple seems to be appearing in contrast to each other’s usual forms. So, O sakhi, now you tell me—who appears more beautiful today: Rādhā, the darling daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, or Kṛṣṇa, the lovely son of Nanda? [2]

title: Uddho Sudho Hai Gayo Suni Gopin Ke Bol - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Uddho Sudho Hai Gayau, Suni Gopin Ke Bol.Gyan Bajayi Dugdugi, Prem Bajayo Dhol.- Braj Ke DoheUddhav stepped into Braj with the intention of teaching jñāna (knowledge) to the gopīs, but he ended up being transformed in the path of love by hearing their love-filled conversations. He had arrived beating the ‘ḍugḍugī’ (a small handheld drum) of jñāna, but in Braj, the ‘ḍhol’ (the grand drum) of prema (divine love) was being played everywhere.

title: Braj Mein Hot Kulahal Bhaari - Shri Parmanand Das Ji
sanskrit_text: (Raag Maaru)Braj Mein Hot Kulahal Bhaari,Aanand Magan Gwaal Sab Naachat,Det Paraspar Taari. [1]Nandaray Ke Bhavan Mein Aavat,Aanandit Brajnaari.Putra Janam Suni Harash Bhayo Hai,‘Parmanand’ Balihaari. [2]- Shri Parmanand Das JiThere is a great celebration in the land of Braj due to the birth of Lord Krishn. The cowherd boys, immersed in joy, are dancing and clapping to congratulate each other. [1]The women of Braj are joyfully arriving at Nanda ji’s home. Overjoyed by the auspicious news of Shri Krishna’s birth, they are offering themselves in adoration, says Sri Parmanand Das. [2]

title: Jake Aganit Gunan Ko Gavat Ved Richan - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (94)
sanskrit_text: Jaake Aganit Gunan Ko, Gaavat Ved Richan.Daari Ke, Gaari Sunan, Soi Chhedat Sakhiyan.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (94)Lord Shri Krishna, whose countless divine virtues are sung tirelessly by the four Vedas, that same supreme personality, in the land of Braj, considers it his highest fortune to mischievously tease the gopis and then be scolded by them with playful taunts like “Dārī ke!”.

title: Jayati Jay Jayati Lalitadi Var Bhamini - Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari
sanskrit_text: Jayati Jay Jayati Lalitaadi Var Bhaamini,Traahi Bali Kripaa Kari Khabari Kari Deejie,Dharo Pad Kamal Mam Sheesh Mein Swaamini. [1]Tumahi Taji Kaun Soon Karoon Vinati Aho Milai,Kachhu Tahal Mohi Gunan Abhiraamini. [2]Sujasvar Aapko Sakal Lokan Vidit,Karati Tum Kaho Shri Radhika Bhaamini. [3]Raamsakhi Deen Jalahin Jyon Meen Hai,Vegikarunaa Karo Karunaaras Gaamini. [4]- Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras ManjariGlory to Shri Radharani, the crown jewel among all the all-skillful sakhis like Lalita. O my Swamini! Please show your mercy and pay me heed — kindly place your lotus feet upon my head. [1]O my most merciful Swaminiju! Who else can I turn to with my heartfelt cries, if not you? Please bless me with the fortune of contributing even a small service in your divine palace. [2]Your divine glories spread through all the worlds. Please tell me — what service can I perform for you, O Radhika Bhāmini? [3]Your humble maidservant, Rāmsakhi, is restless like a fish without water. Kindly shower your mercy upon me without delay. [4]

title: Kaik Swang Banaike Nacho Bahu Vidhi Naach - Shri Rasnidhi
sanskrit_text: Kaik Swang Banaike, Nacho Bahu Vidhi Naach.Reejhat Nahin Rijhwar Vah, Bina Hiye Ke Saanch.- Shri RasnidhiSri Rasanidhi says — No matter how many disguises or outward dances one performs, unless the heart is pure and honest, Lord Shri Krishna will not be pleased. External displays like wearing saffron robes, shaving the head, or growing matted locks are all meaningless without sincere, loving devotion free from deceit and hypocrisy.

title: Preetam Kunwari Charan Binu Ko Hai - Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (24)
sanskrit_text: Preetam Kunwari Charan Binu Ko Hai.Ap Apne Swārath Jag Atakyo, Tāsōn Ko Sukh To Hai. [1]Eho Param Udār Kripānidhi, Swāmin Bhajat Sakal Sukh Yo Hai.Jayashree Bansi Ali An Raj Nis Nahin, Taj Bhajan Nit Sohai. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (24)An intimate Sahchari, firmly absorbed in the supreme exclusivity (ananyatā) of Shri Radha, declares—Who else can be my beloved (worthy of my love and affection), apart from Kishori Ji’s lotus feet? The entire world is busy fulfilling its own selfish motives. There is not even a trace of true love here, nor does this false world contain the real happiness that one finds at the feet of Shri Radha. [1]My Swamini, Shri Radha, is immensely generous and the very embodiment of compassion. Whoever worships her attains all kinds of happiness with ease. The one who, day and night, holds the dust of Shri Radha’s lotus feet in the highest reverence— that devotee forever shines on the path of eternal loving service (nitya-vihār), on the ever-blissful path of divine bhajan. [2]

title: Do Man Ik Hote Sunyo - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (34)
sanskrit_text: Do Man Ik Hote Sunyo, Pai Vah Prem Na Aahi.Hoi Jabai Dvai Tanahu Ik, Soi Prem Kahahi.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (34)True love is not merely the union of two minds. Only when both the minds and the bodies unite completely, can it be truly called the highest form of love.

title: Shriradhe Ab Beg Samharau - Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (97)
sanskrit_text: Shriradhe Ab Beg Samharau.Aho Naagri Jher Na Keejai, Apani Cheri Jaan Niharau. [1]Sanshay Harau Dharau Nij Parikar, Yah Abhilakh Hamarau. Premsakhi Ki Aho Swamini, Yah Sandeh Nivarau. [2]- Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (97)O Shri Radha! Please bestow Your grace upon me. O Most Skillful One! delay no longer, considering as Your own maidservant. [1]Dispelling all my doubts, kindly include me among Your close-knit circle of sakhis. This alone is my heart’s sole longing. O beloved Swamini of all rasika maidens! Kindly dispel this hesitation once and for all. [2]

title: Shrivrindavan Raj Paras - Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (78)
sanskrit_text: Shrivrindavan Raj Paras, Saras Haras Sukhmool.Shrivrindavan Vaas Kari, Shriyamuna Ke Kool.- Shri Ramray, Geet Govind Braj Bhasha, Doha (78)Just the touch of Vrindavan’s sacred dust brings sweetness, fills the heart with joy, and is the very source of all happiness. Thus, residing on the Yamuna’s banks in Vrindavan is the highest fulfillment of life.

title: Tarani Tanaiya Teer Santani Ki Rahai Bheer - Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha Ji
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Tarani Tanaiya Teer, Santani Ki Rahai Bheer,Keki Keer Aisi, Radha Ju Kau Dham Hai. [1]Kunjan Ke Kaune Baithe, Rahain Anurag Chhake,Aracha Aur Charcha Mein, Bitein Sab Jaam Hain. [2]Hiye Prem Rahai Suchi, Maansik Sewa Ruchi,Piye Ju Alaukik, Khilauna Shyamashyam Hai. [3]Bali Hitaroop Aise, Rasikan Sang Sada,Vrindavan Hita Bhayi, Mati Abhiram Hai. [4]- Shri Vrindavan Das Chacha JiOn the sacred banks of Śrī Yamunā within the realm of Śrī Dham Vṛndāvan, the group of saints forever remains present; peacocks dance, and parrots with their melodious voice fill the air with rasa. This is the most intimate personal abode of Śrī Rādhājū. [1]Saints, seated in the secluded bowers of Vṛndāvan, remain immersed in the loving devotion of the divine couple, Śyāma Śyām; they dedicate their entire time to devotion, listening, and singing their rasa‑filled pastimes, thereby making their lives truly meaningful. [2]The hearts of rasika saints overflow with divine love, and they remain engaged in ‘mānasī sevā’ (serving Śrī Śyāma Śyām through the mind). The divine couple, like wondrous toys of love, always keep their hearts soaked in the nectar of rasa. [3]Śrī Hit Vṛndāvandās Jī says, I offer myself at the lotus feet of such rasika saints, for through their association, the mind becomes forever immersed in the divine ocean of Vṛndāvan’s prema‑ānanda (bliss of divine love). [4]

title: Shat Mukti Ki Chaha Taji - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj
sanskrit_text: Shat Mukti Ki Chaha Taji, Sahaja Bhae Nirvaas.Janachauna Nija Bhava Rata, Nirakhai Yugala Vilaas.- Shri Guruchauna Ji MaharajDevotees of Yugala Rasa renounce not only worldly pleasures but also the six types of liberation (Sālokya, Sāmīpya, Sārūpya, Sāyujya, Sārṣṭi, and Kaivalya). Immersed in selfless love for the Divine Couple, they become free from the cycle of birth and death effortlessly, gaining the supreme fortune of serving Them in Their eternal realm. Such devotees behold the love plays of the divine couple, with their eyes filled with devotion.

title: Syama Chalahu  Ladaiti Priya - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (11)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Bilaval)Syama Chalahu, Ladaiti Priya,Kunjani Karahu, Keli.Syam-Tamal-Lal Naval Kisori Bal Tum,Ju Naval Nav Kanak-Beli. [1]Bividh Kusum-Ghan-Rachit Shree Vrindavan,Bolat Suhaye Pik-Madhup Rahe Jheli.Shree Beethal Vipul Ras Bihari Tihare Bas,Jamuna Ke Teer Sukh Bisad Bilas Kheli. [2]- Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (11)Shrivipul Biharini Dasi Ji, revealing her heart’s desire, prays to her beloved soul-friend, Shri Radha:O dear Śyāmā Jū ! Please come to the Nikunj bower and be immersed in the colors of Keli love-plays. My body, mind, and very life are restless to fondly serve you in this rasa. O youthful maiden! Embrace dark Shyamasundara as a golden vine entwines the dark Tamal tree. [1]Shri Vrindavan is adorned with flowers rich in varied fragrances, where cuckoos sing melodiously and bumblebees hum in delight. On the banks of Shri Yamuna, shower your intimate play of love with your beloved Kunj Bihari, for He is entirely under your control. [2]

title: अक्रूर घाट - वृन्दावन
sanskrit_text:
श्रीमद्भागवत के अनुसार, जब कंस के आदेशानुसार अक्रूर जी श्री कृष्ण एवं श्री बलराम जी को रथ में बिठाकर वृन्दावन से मथुरा ला रहे थे, तब उन्होंने अपने रथ को यमुना जी की किनारे रोक दिया। श्री कृष्ण-बलराम जी को रथ पर छोड़ कर उन्होंने स्नान, संध्या आदि करने के लिए यमुना जी में प्रवेश किया। तो अक्रूर जी ने स्नान करते समय श्री यमुना जी में श्री कृष्ण बलराम जी के दर्शन भगवान विष्णु शेषसैयां पर विरजमानित रूप में किए। बाद में यही स्थान श्री अक्रूर घाट के नाम से जाने जाना लगा। इसी स्थान पर वृन्दावन वासियों ने वैकुण्ठ के ग्रहों का दर्शन किया था।
इसी स्थान पर, जब श्री चैतन्य महाप्रभु वाराणसी से वृन्दावन आए तो उन्होंने इसे ही अपना रात्रि विश्राम का स्थान बनाया। दिन में वे इमलीतला पर बैठ कर हरिनाम करते थे। तब वृन्दावन में चारो तरफ केवल वन ही वन थे। अक्रूर घाट के सामने सुरभि गाय के दर्शन है तथा उसी के पास श्री चैतन्य महप्रभु के चरण कमल चिन्ह हैं। निकट ही एक बरगद का वृक्ष (पेड़) है, जिसके बारे में कहा जाता है कि श्री चैतन्य महाप्रभु ने वहां विश्राम किया था। 
वर्तमान में अक्रूर घाट पर कृष्ण और बलराम के साथ अक्रूर जी का मंदिर है।
english_text: shrimadbhagavat ke anusar, jab kns ke adeshanusar akrur ji shri krishn evn shri balaram ji ko rath men bithakar vrindavan se mathura la rahe the, tab unhonne apane rath ko yamuna ji ki kinare rok diya. shri krishna-balaram ji ko rath par chhoड़ kar unhonne snan, sndhya adi karane ke lie yamuna ji men pravesh kiya. to akrur ji ne snan karate samay shri yamuna ji men shri krishn balaram ji ke darshan bhagavan vishnu sheshasaiyan par virajamanit rup men kie. bad men yahi sthan shri akrur ghat ke nam se jane jana laga. isi sthan par vrindavan vasiyon ne vaikunth ke grahon ka darshan kiya tha. isi sthan par, jab shri chaitany mahaprabhu varanasi se vrindavan ae to unhonne ise hi apana ratri vishram ka sthan banaya. din men ve imalitala par baith kar harinam karate the. tab vrindavan men charo taraf keval van hi van the. akrur ghat ke samane surabhi gay ke darshan hai tatha usi ke pas shri chaitany mahaprabhu ke charan kamal chinh hain. nikat hi ek baragad ka vriksh (peड़) hai, jisake bare men kaha jata hai ki shri chaitany mahaprabhu ne vahan vishram kiya tha. vartaman men akrur ghat par krishn aur balaram ke sath akrur ji ka mndir hai.

title: Komalta Kanj Te Gulab Te Sugandh Laiken - Shri Thakur Ji
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Komalta Kanj Te, Gulab Te Sugandh Laiken, Chandr Saun Prakash Laiken, Udit Ujerau Hai. [1]Roop Rati Aanan Saun, Chaaturi Sujaanan Saun, Neer Nirvanan Son, Kautuk Niberau Hai. [2]Thakur Vichari Kai, Banayau Vidhi Karigar, Rachna Nihaari Kaanh, Hot Chir Cherau Hai. [3]Saune Sau Surang Le, Sabad Lai Sudha Kau, Vasudha-Sukh Looti Kain, Banaayau Mukh Terau Hai. [4]- Shri Thakur JiWith the tenderness of the lotus, the fragrance of the rose, and the cool radiance of the moon, O Śrī Rādhā, Your unparalleled form has emerged. [1]Your face is as charming as the goddess of love, Your wisdom as exalted as the nobles, and Your purity is as spotless as crystal water — all woven into a wondrous beauty. [2]Thākurjī says — as a master craftsman fashions a matchless creation with delicate care, so has the Creator formed Your divine form, upon which Śrī Kṛṣṇa gazes with unending love. [3]With a glow like molten gold, as sweet as nectar, and the bliss of all the worlds combined, O Śrī Rādhā, Your face stands unmatched. [4]

title: Braj-Vasi-Patatar Kou Naahin - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
sanskrit_text: Braj-Vasi-Patatar Kou Naahin.Brahm, Sanak, Siv, Dhyan Na Paavat,Inaki Joothan Lai Lai Khaahin. [1]Haldhar Kahyo, Chhaak Jaivat Sang,Meethau Lagat Saraahat Jaahin.'Surdas' Prabhu Jo Visvambhar,So Gvalanke Kaur Aghaahin. [2]- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraNo one can be compared to the residents of Braj. Supreme Lord Shri Krishna whom Brahma, Shiva, the Sanaka sages, and others cannot attain even in deep meditation, that same Krishna, out of love, eats from the leftover plates of the Brajvasis. [1]Balram says that when He drinks buttermilk with them, it tastes as sweet as nectar, and He praises it. Shri Surdas Ji says — He who sustains the entire universe, the all-nourishing Vishwambhar, longs to eat the remnants of the Braj cowherd boys. [2]

title: Shribiharidas Braj Mein Basat Mile Saprasi Shyam- Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (365)
sanskrit_text: Shribiharidas Braj Mein Basat, Mile Saparasi Shyam.Paras Na Pavai Prem Binu, Aparas Dukhi Sakam.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (365)By residing in the abode of love, Vraja Mandal, we have attained such Shri Banke Bihari Ji Maharaj, who embraces only those premi devotees that love Him selflessly. Those devoid of pure love, entangled in external saparasa and aparasa, remain forever distant from Him and thus dwell in constant sorrow.

title: He Swamini Shri Kunj Viharini - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (122)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Khammach)He Swamini Shri Kunj Viharini, Vegi Khavari Meri Leejai.Seva Reet Kachu Nahi Jaanau, Chook Chhima Kari Deejai. [1]Ati Adheen Deen Rati Tero, Chitt Dai Yah Suni Leejai.Lalit Kishori Kunj Nikunjan, Raj Adhikari Keejai. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (122)O Swamini, Shri Kunj Viharini (Sri Radha)! Kindly take heed of me quickly. I know nothing of the mode of your service, so please forgive my faults. [1]In utter surrender and humility, I call upon your name — please hear the cry of my heart. O charming Kishori! Bestow such grace that I may also become worthy of serving the dust of the bowers and groves of Shri Dham Vrindavan. [2]

title: Jagadbharturvisvasamohanasya Sri Krishnasya - Atharva Veda, Sri Radhika Tapani Upnishad (6)
sanskrit_text: Jagadbharturvisvasamohanasya Sri Krishnasya pranato Adhikamapi,vrindaranye sveshta deveencha nityam tam Radhikam vanadhatrim namamah.- Atharva Veda, Sri Radhika Tapani Upnishad (6)To that Śrī Radhika, the beloved goddess of Vrindavan, the sustainer of the Vrindavan forest, who is dearer even than life to Sri Krishna, the maintainer of the universe and enchanter of the worlds, we offer our salutations.

title: Roop Hu Ke Roop Tai Anoop Roop Pyari Ko - Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (8)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Gaud)Roop Hu Ke Roop Tai Anoop Roop Pyari Ko.Jag Ujiyaari Jag Jeevan Ki Maharani, Anand Na Bhaavai Ang Lochan Nihari Ko. [1]Paavak Prakash Chand Damini Ki Kaha Chami, Ghata Duri Jaat Aiso Neelo Rang Saari Ko.Kishori Swamini Hiye Mein Basau, Achal Suhag Thakurain Hamari Ko. [2]- Shri Kishori Ali Ji, Vinay Ke Pad (8)Shri Radha’s divine beauty is such that even personified beauty itself appears pale in comparison to her matchless form. She is the one who illuminates the entire world and is the queen of the life of the universe, Lord Shri Krishna Himself. Her beauty increases every moment, and the eyes can never be satisfied gazing upon her limbs. [1]The light of fire, the radiance of the moon, and the flash of lightning — none can describe the fair glow of her form adorned in a blue sari. Shri Kishori Ali says — O Swamini! Reside in my heart forever, for you alone have the eternal wedded fortune, you alone are my Thakurani. [2]

sanskrit_text: Lok Laaj Kul Ved, Chhoote Sabe Vivek Bal.Pare Hriday Jab Chhed, Dusah Prem Ke Banako.- Shri Dayaram JiWhen the unbearable arrows of divine love pierce the heart, all boundaries—such as social shame, family honor, scriptural bindings, Vedic rules, and rational thoughts are left behind.

title: Sunihun Na Dekhi Aisi Jori Jugal Kisor Kisori - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (56)
sanskrit_text: (Doha)Ang Ang Sobha Ju Par, Varaun Kaam Karori. Suni Na Hun Dekhi Kahun, Aisi Adbhut Jori. (Pad)Sunihun Na Dekhi Aisi Jori Jugal Kisor Kisori. Ang Ang Sobha Par Sajani Varaun Kaam Karori. [1]Nahin Upama Patatar Deebe Kon Dekhi Thaki Mati Mori.Shriharipriya Adbhut Kalavali Maanahu Kaadhi Kori. [2]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (56)(Doha)Millions of Cupids should be offered to the unparalleled beauty residing in the limbs of this divine couple. Such a divine couple (Shri Radha Krishn) is neither heard nor seen anywhere else.(Pada)An ever-youthful couple like this ‘Yugala Kishor’ (Shri Radha-Krishna) has neither ever been seen nor even heard of anywhere. The beauty of each of their limbs is so astonishing that even millions of Cupids could be sacrificed upon it. [1]Despite my best efforts to find a worthy comparison for them, even my intellect gave up in exhaustion. I surrender myself to them completely — the divine arts of love in Shri Hari and Shri Radha are absolutely astonishing. In awe, I wonder who could possibly have created such divine artistry. [2]

sanskrit_text: Hit Ahlaad Swaroopini, Mohani-Mohan Vaam.Nit Araadhan Karat Hari, Yaatai Radha Naam.- Braj Ke DoheShe brings delight to every heart, the enchantress who captivates even the enchanter, Shri Krishna Himself, and forever resides on His left side. title: Garjani Ghan Aru Damini - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (68)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Malar)Garjani Ghan Aru Damini, Chaatik Pik Suk Bolati Morani.Syam Ghata Kaajar Hoon Ten Kaari, Umadi-Umadi Aayi Chahun Orani. [1]Naanhi-Naanhi Bundani Barshani Laagyo, Taisiyai Rochak Pavan Jhakorani.'Hita Dhruv' Pyari Pyar Saun Jhoolat, Piyhi Jhulaavati Nainani Korani. [2]- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (68)With the arrival of the rainy season, the rumble of clouds, flashes of lightning, and the sweet melodies of the chataka bird, cuckoo, parrots, and peacocks bring immense pleasure. Clouds darker than kohl gather all around. [1]Gentle raindrops begin to fall as cool breezes blow through, filling the air with serenity. Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji says—upon beholding this enchanting scene, Shri Radha sways on the swing of love and, with the tender corners of Her eyes, swings Her beloved Krishna in love-bliss. [2]

title: Ratan Khachit Kanchan Maha - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (80)
sanskrit_text: Ratan Khachit Kanchan Maha, Shri Vridavan Ki Bhoomi.Kalpavriksh Se Drum Rahe, Phal Phoolan Kari Jhoomi.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (80)The glorious land of Shri Vrindavan is golden, studded with gems, where every tree is a wish-fulfilling Kalpavriksha, and branches laden with fruits and flowers sway gracefully.

title: Pyari Tu Gunani Rai Sirmaur - Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (65)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Sarang)Pyari Tu Gunani Rai Sirmaur.Gati Mein Gati Upjati Nana Raag Raagini, Taar Mandar Sur Ghor. [1]Kahu Kachu Liyau Rekh Chhaya, Tau Kaha Bhayo Jhoothi Daur.Kahin Shri Haridas Let Pyari Joo Ke, Tirap Lagni Mein Kisore. [2]- Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (65)O Kunja-biharini Shri Radhe! You are the crest jewel among the kings of fine arts. In dance and music, You are unmatched. From You, countless ragas and raginis spring forth, their sweet notes resonating in both high and low tones. [1]If anyone claims to have mastered even a slight portion of the shadow of Your artistry, such words are hollow and false. Swami Shri Haridas Ji declares that ever-youthful Shyamsundara, following your hand gestures, dances in the same rhythm in divine love-bliss. [2]

title: Dhanya Dhanya Vrindavani - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Shri Hari Leela (55)

Blessed is the enchanting form of the divine couple, Sri Radha Madhav, and their love-play in this sacred grove.

title: Apne Vash Mein Vrajaraj Kiye - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Apne Vash Mein Vrajaraj Kiye, Kahke Vachanamrit Aadhe Ki Jai Jai.Sur Kinnar Karaj Sadhe Ki Jai, Vrajjeevan Prem Samadhe Ki Jai Jai. [1]Ras Raseshwari Ki Sada Jai Ho, Harekrishn! Sada Bhavvaadhe Ki Jai Jai.Ati Sundar Roop Agaadhe Ki Jai, Vrishbhanu Kishori Shri Radhe Ki Jai Jai. [2]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’Glory to Śrī Rādhā, who, with the nectar of just half of Her words, has brought Vrajarāja Śrī Kṛṣṇa under Her control. Glory to Her, the embodiment of divine love, the very life of Braj, by whose grace even the endeavours of gods and celestial beings are fulfilled! [1]Repeated salutations to Śrī Rādhā, the presiding deity of the rāsa pastimes, the ocean of compassion, and the destroyer of all worldly obstacles. Glory, glory to the enchanting daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, Śrī Rādhikā, whose charm is matchless and unfathomable. [2]

title: Sukh Ki Dampati Rashihain - Shri Saras Madhuri
sanskrit_text: Sukh Ki Dampati Rashihain, Tinso Prem Badhav. ‘Sarasmadhuri’ Tahal Ko, Nit Prati Rakh Chitchav.- Shri Saras MadhuriThe Divine Couple, Shri Radha Krishna, are an endless treasure of bliss; therefore, keep increasing your love for them. Shri Saras Madhuri says, always maintain your eagerness and desire to serve them selflessly.

title: Pavitra Shobhit Paat Puneet - Shri Hit Kishori Lal
sanskrit_text: Pavitra Shobhit Paat Puneet.Pyari Ur Lasai Arun Sosani, Mohan Ur Lasai Peet. [1]Sahchari Been Mridang Bajaavat, Gaavat Mangal Geet. Jay Shri Kishorilal Hita Roop Hindore, Jhoolat Badhat Sameet. [2]- Shri Hit Kishori LalA pure silk pavitra (sacred thread) adorns the neck of the divine couple, Shri Shyama-Shyam. Upon Shri Radha’s chest lies a pavitra of red and blue, while on Shri Krishna’s chest gleams a yellow pavitra. [1]The sakhis play the veena and mridanga, singing songs of auspicious joy. Shri Kishori Lal Ji says — the divine Couple swings upon the jhoola, their love growing ever deeper with every moment. [2]

title: Parmanand Swarupini Manharni Sukh Raas - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (23)
sanskrit_text: Parmanand Swarupini, Manharni Sukh Raas.Piy Hiy Ur Kullolini, Preetam Hiye Nivas.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (23)Shri Radha is the embodiment of supreme bliss, the stealer of the heart, and the abode of divine happiness. She creates surging waves of rasa in the heart of her beloved Lord Krishn and forever dwells within His heart.

title: Nandnandan Hindore Jhoolen Mayi Ri - Shri Chaturbhuj Das
sanskrit_text: (Raag Kaanarau)Nandnandan Hindore Jhoolen Mayi Ri.Sang Vrishbhanu-Suta Ati Sohai, Rimjhim Rimjhim Boond Suhayi Ri. [1]Gaavati Savan Geet Baanik Bani, Vraj Vanita Piy Jiy Bhayi Ri. 'Chatrubhuj' Prabhu Nab Chhabili Chhabi Nirkhein, Reejhi Reejhi Sab Ur Layi Ri. [2]- Shri Chaturbhuj DasNandalal Shri Krishna swings on a beautiful swing, and beside Him, Vrishabhanu’s beloved daughter, Shri Radha, sits with unparalleled charm. The monsoon rain falls gently in the forest all around. [1]The maidens of Braj are immersed in love, lovingly singing the songs of Sāvana. Shri Chaturbhujdas Ji says — beholding the ever-fresh, enchanting beauty of the Lord, all the sakhis are spellbound, keeping that darśana forever in their hearts. [2]

title: Jo Kreeda Vrindavan Kini Radhe Sundarshyam - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (33)
sanskrit_text: Jo Kreeda Vrindavan Kini, Radhe Sundarshyam.Rooprasik’ Rasikan Ki Jeevan, Ek Vastu Dvai Naam.- Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (33)The lilas of the Divine Couple in Vrindavan are the very source of life for the Rasikas. Though they appear as two, “Radha” and “Shyam”, their soul, their essence, is one — the eternal stream of rasa born of their love-play, known as “Nitya Vihara Rasa.”

title: Jhoolat Ye Dou Roop Apaar - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Van Kunjan Jhoolan Leela (25)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Malhar Va Kinnari)Jhoolat Ye Dou Roop Apaar.Bhanu Kishori Gori Bhori, Chhavi Nidhi Nand Kumar. [1]Ghan Damini Deenen Galbaahin, Chhin-Chhin Baadhat Pyar.Lalit Ladaiti Ya Sukh Oopar, Sarbas Deejai Vaar. [2]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Van Kunjan Jhoolan Leela (25)The abode of all beauty, the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam, swing together on a charming swing. Vrisabhanu’s daughter, Shri Radha, is fair and supremely innocent, while Nand’s son, Sri Krishn, is the very treasure of incomparable charm. [1]Shri Krishna is dark like a raincloud, and Shri Radha shines like lightning. With arms entwined around each other, their love grows deeper with every passing moment. Shri Lalit Ladaiti Ji says — this swing pastime is so wondrously sweet that one should offer everything upon it. [2]

title: Lakshmya Yasch Na Gocharibhavati Yannapuh - Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (239)
sanskrit_text: Lakshmya Yasch Na Gocharibhavati Yannapuh Sakhayah Prabhoh. Sambhavyopi Viranchinaradashivswayambhuvadyairn Yah.Yo Vrindavannagaripashupatistribhavalabhyah Katham Radhamadhavyormamastu Sa Raho Dasyadhikarotsavah.- Shri Hita Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (239)That intimate service, unattainable even by Lakṣmī, denied to the Lord’s closest companions like Sridama, and far beyond the reach of great personalities like Brahmā, Nārada, Śiva, and the Sanaka sages, the treasure which only the gopīs of Vṛndāvana like Lalitā attains through the mood of a sakhi — how shall I ever attain that most confidential festival of serving Śrī Rādhā Mādhava in their secret pastimes?

title: Bansari Bajaavai Nand Ju Kau Lal - Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj, Raas Mahotsav Ke Pada (103)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Shyam Kalyan)Bansari Bajaavai Nand Ju Kau Lal.Jamana Tat Bansivat Thaadau, Sundar Rooprasaal. [1]Mor Mukut Peetambar Sohai, Chanchal Nain Vishal.Kaanan Kundal Gal Bich Mala, Shritilak Diye Bhaal. [2]Vrindavan Mein Raas Rachyau Hai, Radha Phirat Khushaal.Guruchauna Ke Hiye Base Nita, Darasan Karat Nihal. [3]- Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj, Raas Mahotsav Ke Pada (103)The charming son of Nanda, Shri Krishna plays His sweet flute on the banks of the Yamuna, beneath the shade of Vanshivat. His form is overflowing with rasa and supremely enchanting. [1]A peacock feather crown adorns His head, and a yellow garment graces His divine form. His eyes are playful and large, earrings sway upon His ears, a garland of flowers graces His neck, and a tilak glows upon His forehead. [2]In Vrindavan, during the grand festival of Maha-Rasa, Shri Radha dances in bliss, immersed in love-bliss. Shri Guru Chhauna declares — Shyama-Shyam dwell forever in my heart, and their vision alone completes my life. [3]

title: Bipul Biharinidasi Tain Ab Chhin Chhin Man Anand - Sri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (19)
sanskrit_text: Bipul Biharinidasi Tain, Ab Chhin Chhin Man Anand.Yaun Nirkhat Nagridas Nit, Dulahu Dulahini Makarand.- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (19)Through the company of Shri Beethalvipuldev Ji and Shri Biharindev Ji, my heart remains drenched in streams of rasa. title: Hamaari Brindavan Rajdhani - Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Muktavali (9)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Sarang, Titala)Hamaari Brindavan Rajdhani.Nidhi Ban Maharaj Brajraj Laadilo, Shriradha Patarani. [1]Nidhi Ban Seva Kunj Pulin, Bansivat Sukh-Dhani.Brajnidhi Brajras Saun Man Atkyau, Nidhi Payi Manmaani. [2]- Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Nidhi Muktavali (9)Shri Vrindavan is the crown jewel of all holy places, the capital of the rasikas, where the Lord of Nidhivan, the beloved Prince of Braj, Shri Krishna, eternally resides, and where Queen Shri Radharani, His supremely loving consort, forever remains in her divine form beside Him. [1]Within Vrindavan, sacred leela sites such as Nidhivan, Seva Kunja, the banks of the Yamuna, and Vanshivat grant unparalleled bliss to all beings. Shri Brajanidhi Ji says: “My mind is captivated by the nectar of Braj, and I have thus attained the treasure I longed for.” [2]

title: Vrindavane Sthiracharaatmak Keet-Durva - Sri Kuresh Swami
sanskrit_text: Vrindavane Sthiracharaatmak Keet-Durva-Paryant Jantu Nichayebataetadaanim.Naivalabhaamahijanimahatkaastaete, Papa Padam Tab Kada Punarashrayamah.- Sri Kuresh SwamiNot even as a tree, a blade of grass, or the tiniest insect in Vrindavan did we take birth. Alas! Such great sinners we are! O Lord, when shall we again take shelter in Your holy abode?
