title: Radhe Albeli Sarkar - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (115)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Bhupali, Trital)Radhe Albeli Sarkar.Vanrani Rasikan Ki Pyari, Ati Udar Sukamar. [1]Jaake Pag Nupur Rav Son Hi, Koti Brahm Avatar.Raas Viharin Kunj Viharin, Mahima Amit Apaar. [2]Nav-Nikunj Ki Nav Nidhi Radhe, Karati Nitt Bihar.Shrigopalhita Naval Priya Pai, Bar-Bar Balihar. [3]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (115)Shri Radharani is the enchanting sovereign — the supreme queen of Vrindavan, the very life and soul of the rasikas, endlessly generous and extremely tender. [1]From the sweet jingling of the anklets on her lotus feet, countless Brahmas arise; she is that very Shri Radha, the one who delights in the rasa dance within the bowers of Vrindavan, whose glory is beyond measure. [2]Shri Radha is the ever-fresh treasure of the eternal nikunjas, always absorbed in ‘Nitya Vihara’ rasa. Shri Hit Gopal Ji says — upon such Shri Radha, I sacrifice myself again and again. [3]

title: Kou Chaahai Sir Kamalkar - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Kou Chaahai Sir Kamalkar, Kou Nirkhai Mukh Math.Haun To Radha Pad Kamal, Sirdhari Hou Sanath.- Braj Ke DoheSome long to place upon their heads the lotus hands of their worshipful Lord; others yearn to behold the lotus face of their deity. But I desire only this — to rest the lotus feet of Shri Radha upon my head and find my eternal refuge there.

title: Shrikunjbiharini Lalit Ladili - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (4)
sanskrit_text: Shrikunjbiharini Lalit Ladili,Adbhut Roop Rasala. [1]Hansani Lasani Musakani Ras Barasat,Lalai Karati Nihala. [2]Umangi Umangi Dou Madan Ladaavat,Dou Doun Urmala. [3]Shrilalitkisori Ke Hita Viharat,Jaani Maha Niju Hala. [4]- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (4)The forest-bower queen, Kuñjabihāriṇī (Śrī Rādhā), is a treasure house of divine beauty and rasa. [1]Her gentle smile is full of nectar of love, which continually enchants Kuṃjabihārī (Śrī Kṛṣṇa).  [2]Both, immersed in the ecstasy of love, are entwined with each other as if each were the garland of the other. [3] Shri Lalita Kishori says that to fulfill the innermost feelings of her intimate sakhis, Shri Radha always showers Nitya Vihara rasa with Kunja Bihari. [4]

title: Kaam Hi Na Krodh Jaakai - Shri Sundardas Ji
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kaam Hi Na Krodh Jaakai, Lobh Hi Na Moh Taakai, Mad Hi Na Machhar Na, Kou Na Vikaarau. [1]Dukh Hi Na Sukh Manai, Paap Hi Na Puny Jaanai, Harash Na Shok Aanai, Deh Hi Tai Nyarau Hai. [2]Ninda Na Prashansa Kar, Raag Hi Na Dosh Dharai, Len Hi Na Den Jaakai, Kachhu Na Pasaarau Hai. [3]Sundar Kahat Taaki, Agam Agadh Gati, Aisau Kou Sadhu Su To, Ramji Ko Pyarau Hai. [4]- Shri Sundardas JiOne who harbors neither lust nor anger, neither greed nor attachment, neither pride nor envy, and remains untouched by every stain of impurity. [1]One who makes no distinction between joy and sorrow, nor between sin and virtue; who neither rejoices nor grieves, and is free from bodily awareness. [2]One who is beyond both praise and blame, free from attachment and aversion; who seeks no give‑and‑take and accumulates nothing in this material world. [3]Sundar Dās says, the state of such a saint is immeasurable and unfathomable; such a rare saint is dearer than life to Lord Śrī Rām Himself. [4]

title: Shyama Pag Lavleen Ho Unhi Ke Hath Vikaay - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (236.2)
sanskrit_text: Shyama Pag Lavleen Ho, Unhi Ke Hath Vikaay.Tohi Kar Mein Ye Bhattu, Mohan Vikihai Aay.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (236.2)Shri Krishna sells Himself only to those who are completely absorbed in the loving devotion of Sri Radha’s lotus feet. To such premi-bhaktas, out of pure love, He willingly offers Himself, becoming as if a sold servant—without expecting any price in return.

title: Muskan Se Kaam Tamaam Hua - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Muskan Se Kaam Tamaam Hua,Tirchhe Drig Kyon Ab Taanta Hai.Ati Sundar Gol Kapol Tere,Bhrikuti-Lakuti Pehichanta Hai. [1]Parinaam Mein Dukhko Jaanta Hai,Par Haay Nahin Hath Thaanata Hai.Bahutera Kaha Par Tere Bina,Man Mera Na Mohan! Maanta Hai. [2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaYour smile has conquered me—why wound me now with arrows from Your restless eyes? Your round cheeks, Your mischievous brows—their charm is carved deep in my heart. [1]Though I know this love will end in pain, still my mind refuses to surrender its stubborn longing.  O Mohana! I have tried to counsel myself countless times, yet without You, my heart bows to nothing. [2]

[2]- Braj Ke SawaiyaYour smile has conquered me—why wound me now with arrows from Your restless eyes? Your round chiks, Your mischievous brows—their charm is carved dip in my heart. [1]Though I know this love will end in pain, still my mind refuses to surrender its stubborn longing.  O Mohana! I have tried to counsel myself countless times, yet without You, my heart bows to nothing. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Mai Ri! Nand-Nandan Merau Man Ju Haryau - Shri Chhit Swami
sanskrit_text: (Rag Kalyan)Mai Ri! Nand-Nandan Merau Man Ju Haryau.Kharik Duhavan Jaat Rahi Haun, Mo Tan Musikani Na Jaanaun Kaha Karyau. [1]Ta Chhinu Ten Mohi Kachhu Na Suhai Ree? Hiy Mein Aai Paryau.“Chhit-Swami” Giridhar Mili, Tumhen Hridayi Maanjh Dharyau. [2]- Shri Chhit SwamiA sakhi says to another — O friend! The enchanting son of Nanda has stolen my very heart. As I went to milk the cow, Krishna glanced at me and smiled, casting some unknown spell upon me. [1]Since that moment, my mind cannot settle on any task, for Krishna’s form has taken full residence in my heart. Shri Chhitswami says — this restless mind will find peace only when Giridhar Lal, Shri Krishna Himself, stands before me; otherwise, never. [2]

title: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayai - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)
sanskrit_text: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayai Radhabhidhayai Nikhilashrayayai.Sakridgrinantastavanamaye Vai Te Twam Gatim Yantibhavpramuktah.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)I bow again and again to the one who is supreme among all, beyond whom nothing exists, whose name is Radha, and who is the shelter of all beings. Whoever remembers Her name even once surely becomes free from the bonds of worldly existence and attains Her supreme abode.

title: Shri Radhika Madhav Chhavi Apaar - Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Hari Leela (18)
sanskrit_text: (Doha)Chhavi Apaar Shringar Ki, Arati Jay Jay Kaar.Karat Prem Parivar Mil, Bar Bar Balihar.(Pad)Shri Radhika Madhav Chhavi Apaar. Karat Prem Parivar Milin, Ali Arati Rati Shringar. [1]Veenavenu Vaadyavar Vilasit, Gaavat Jay Jay Kaar.Shri Priyasakhi Trintor Jor Kar, Bar Bar Balihaar. [2]- Shri Priya Sakhi (Sri Brahm Gopal Goswami), Hari Leela (18)(Doha)The beauty of Shri Radha Krishna’s adorned, enchanting forms is truly breathtaking; the sakhis perform their aarti while joyfully singing their glories. All the sakhis, together as a loving family, repeatedly offer themselves in complete surrender.(Pada)The beauty of Shri Radhika Madhava is unparalleled. The sakhis lovingly adorn them and perform their aarti with deep devotion. [1]Some play veena, some flute, and some various other instruments; overwhelmed with love, they joyously chant “Jai Ho”. Shri Priya Sakhi, absorbed in ecstatic love, sacrifices herself completely to the divine couple, Sri Radha Krishn. [2]

title: Karuna Sab Dukh Churana - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Utsah Sukh (117)
sanskrit_text: Karuna Sab Dukh Churana, Mam Sarana Sukunvari.Shri Radhe Pranadhike, Jayati Krishna Sukhakari.- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Utsah Sukh (117)All glory to ever-new Shri Radhika — She who removes all sorrows, bestows supreme joy to Shri Krishna, protects those who surrender to Her, and is the very source of my life.

title: Aashik Hokar Ishq Kamave - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Aashik Hokar Ishq Kamave,So Preetam Man Bhaata Hai.Lok Ved Ki Kaid Door Kar,Prem Dev Ko Dhyaata Hai. [1]Rove Hanse Maun Ho Baithe,Pyaare Ke Rang Raata Hai.Saras Madhuri Ka Ras Peekar,Dilwar Ke Gun Gaata Hai. [2]- Shri Saras MadhuriOnly the one who truly becomes a lover and gathers the treasure of love can please the heart of the Beloved, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. He who casts aside worldly customs and even scriptural bindings to worship only the god of love is the true premī devotee. [1]Sometimes he sheds tears, sometimes he laughs, sometimes he sits silent—these are the signs of a heart immersed in the bliss of divine love, fully colored in the Beloved’s hue. Saras Madhurī says—tasting the sweet nectar of love, he remains absorbed in lovingly singing the glories of his Beloved. [2]

title: Nakh-Sikh Mohani Sohani - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Rang Hulas (19)
sanskrit_text: Nakh-Sikh Mohani Sohani, Baari Rati Shri Koti.Jaddapi Piy Mohan Hute, Rahe Charan Tar Loti.- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Rang Hulas (19)Ever-new and rapturous, Shri Radha is supremely enchanting and charming from head to toe. Even countless Ratis and Mahalakshmis can be offered in sacrifice at Her lotus feet. Though the Beloved Lord Krishna is known as ‘Mohan’, the enchanter of all, yet He remains mesmerized by Shri Radha’s beauty, constantly bowing at Her lotus foot-soles in deep adoration.

title: Aur Jaaki Vanshi Sunibe Kaun Tarasat - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Vraj Saar (19)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Aur Jaaki Vanshi Sunibe Kaun Tarasat,Sob Radha Bainn Sunibe Kaun Hiyai Sarasat Hain. [1]Taaki Sab Kripa Chahain Chahain Kripa Radha Ki So,Iktak Rahain Nain Nahi Arasat Hain. [2]Jaake Paay Pankajni Raakhain Kuch Beech Kiti, "Nagariya" Paayan Saun Nain Parasat Hain. [3]Jaake Dekhibe Kaun Sab Tarasat Soi Hari,Radha Mukh Dekhibe Kaun Nity Tarasat Hain. [4]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Vraj Saar (19)The flute of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose melody everyone longs to hear — that same Kṛṣṇa yearns to hear the sweet, nectar‑like words spoken by Śrī Rādhā. [1]He whose grace all beings crave — that same Lord Kṛṣṇa constantly gazes at Śrī Rādhā to receive Her grace, and never tires in doing so. [2]The lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which all beings desire to serve, which even Goddess Lakṣmī keeps close to her heart — that very Kṛṣṇa remains a humble servant at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā, touching them lovingly with His eyes. [3]Śrī Nāgrīdās says, “Though everyone longs for Bhagavān Kṛṣṇa’s darśan — that very Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself lives in eternal longing for a glimpse of His Svāminī, Śrī Rādhā’s darśan”. [4]

title: Shri Swami Haridas Ke Charan Kamal Chit Lau - Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (1)
sanskrit_text: Shri Swami Haridas Ke, Charan Kamal Chit Lau.Kant Rasik Ras-Madhuri, Lakhai Na Aur Upau.- Shri Kant Kishor, Kant Rasik Ji Ki Vani, Doha (1)Shri Kant Rasik says, I place my mind at the supremely sacred lotus feet of Shri Swami Haridas Ji, for there is no greater means to behold and experience the sweetness of the rasa leelas of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam.

title: Shriradhavallabh Tum Mere Hita - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (288)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Kanharo)Shriradhavallabh Tum Mere Hita.Aur Sabai Svarath Ke Sangi, Gur Chopari Dai Poshat Pitu. [1]Yah Main Jaani Sabani Saun Tori, Tumsaun Jori Dai Charnan Chitu.Itani Aas Vyas Ki Pujavahu, Jyaun Chaatik Poshat Paavas-Ritu. [2]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (288)O divine couple, Shri Radhavallabh! You alone are my true well-wisher. All worldly relationships last only as long as they serve their own self-interest. [1]Knowing the selfish nature of this world, I’ve cast aside all attachments and united my heart solely with You, offering my mind at your lotus feet. Shri Hariram Vyas says — please fulfill this one hope of mine: just as the chataka bird is satisfied only by a raindrop from the monsoon, rejecting all else, so too may my heart be forever content with the nectar of Your love alone. [2]

title: Re Chitta Ma Tyaja Vanam Vrrishabhanujayah - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.61)
sanskrit_text: Re Chitta Ma Tyaja Vanam Vrrishabhanujayah Nanyatra Gachcha Mama Yachilametadeva. Vrrindavane Tvamiha Ashvapachan Sadaiva Yachatva Bhakshaya Tadiyasubhuktamuktam.- Shri Vagish Shastriji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.61)O mind! I have only one heartfelt prayer — never leave this Shri Vrindavan Dham, which belongs solely to Shri Radha. Even if it requires begging from the highest caste to the lowest and surviving on their leftovers — let it be so. But never, ever step outside the sacred bounds of Shri Vrindavan.

title: Naval Laal Aru Naval Kisori - Shri Radha Prasad Dev Ju
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vihag)Naval Laal Aru Naval Kisori,Paudhe Naval Nikunj-Mahal Mein Hansat, Lasat, Vilasat Sukh Sori. [1]Sheetal-Mand-Sukhad Malayanil, Vasanani Chandanadi Charachori.Shri Radhaprasad Piy-Pyaari, Sada Rahau Avichal Yah Jori. [2]- Shri Radha Prasad Dev JuIn their ever-fresh bride and groom forms, the divine couple, Shri Shyama Shyam rest upon the blissful bed in the Nikunja Mahal. O sakhi! They delight each other through playful laughter and loving exchanges. [1]Cool, gentle, fragrant breezes flow, filled with the scent of sandalwood, and even their garments are imbued with its sweet aroma. title: Rasna Ras Ki Khani Tu Saras Madhur Priye Toy - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Rasna Ras Ki Khani Tu, Saras Madhur Priy Toya.Tau Pi Radha Prem Ras, Ya Sam Madhur Na Koya.- Braj Ke DoheO tongue! title: Ham Bhukhe Braj Ki Gaari Ke - Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Siddhant Madhuri (132)
sanskrit_text: Ham Bhukhe Braj Ki Gaari Ke,Vaarat Nij Baikunth Lok-Sukh, Suni Suni Gaari ‘Daari Ke’. [1]Bhaav Na Mo Kaham Nekahun Astuti, Maha Vakya Shruti Chaari Ke.Hot Vibhor Sunat Braj Narin, Vakyan Chori Jaari Ke. [2]Bhaav Na Mo Kaham Charan Samarchan, Padma Si Gharvaari Ke.Mohin ‘Kripalu’ To Charan Palotan, Bhaavat Bhaanudulari Ke. [3]- Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Siddhant Madhuri (132)Lord Shri Krishna says — I am hungry for the loving scoldings of Braj. Whenever I listen to the abuse “dārī ke” from their lips, I gladly give up even the bliss of Vaikuntha. [1]The reverent praises offered to me through the four Vedas do not please me, but hearing the sweet, playful words of “chorī jārī ke” (a thief or a flirt) from the Braj gopis fills me with bliss. [2]Even the worship of My feet offered by my consort Mahalakshmi doesn’t delight Me. However, I consider it my greatest fortune to massage the lotus feet of Vrishabhanu-nandini, Shri Radha, says Jagadguru Sri Kripaluji Maharaj. [3]

sanskrit_text: Ati Adbhut Lavanya Nidhi, Shri Vrindavan Chand.Nigam Neti Kimi Varaniye, Rasik Naval Nandanand.- Shri Brajavasidas, Braj VilasShri Vrindavan Dham is an unparalleled treasure of beauty and sweetness, beyond the comprehension of even the Vedas, where ever youthful Rasika Shyamsundar engages in eternal love-filled pastimes.

title: Shri Radhe Rani De Daro Banshi Mori - Shri Mirabai
sanskrit_text: Shri Radhe Rani De Daro Banshi Mori.Ja Bansi Mein Meri Pran Basat Hai, So Bansi Gayi Chori. [1]Kahe Se Gaun Pyari Kahe Se Bajau, Kahe Se Laun Gaiyan Pheri.Mukh Se Gavo Kanha Hathon Se Bajao, Lakuti Se Lao Gaiyan Gheri. [2]Ha Ha Karat Tere Paiyan Parat Hun, Taras Khao Pyari Mori.Meera Ke Prabhu Giridhar Nagar, Bansi Lekar Chhori. [3]- Shri MirabaiO Radharani! Please return my flute, my very soul rests in it, and now it has been stolen. [1]How shall I sing, how shall I play, and how will I call back the cows now? Shri Radha replies: O Beloved, sing with your voice, clap with your hands, and gather the cows with your stick. [2]I beg You, I fall at Your feet — have mercy on me, my Beloved. Mira’s Lord, Giridhar Nagar, found no peace until He got His flute back. [3]

title: Anya Dev Puja Tajai - Shri Priyadas Ji, Ananya Modini (14)
sanskrit_text: Anya Dev Puja Tajai, Bhajai Yugal Drida Heta.Bhakti Badhe Jun Lavake, Kartal Halhat Kheta.- Shri Priyadas Ji, Ananya Modini (14)One who renounces the worship of other deities and devotes himself solely to the devotion of Shri Radha-Krishna, witnesses his devotion flourish — like a farmer who carefully digs the field, sows the seeds, nurtures them with his own hands, and sees his field turn lush and green.

title: Giri-Pati Laagi Meru Meru - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (96)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Giri-Pati Laagi Meru Meru-Pati Laagi Bhoomi,Bhoomi-Pati Ses-Kol Kachh Neer Chaari Saun.Dig-Pati Laagi Dig-Palan Ke Haath Hathi,Sur-Pati Laagi Sur-Paal Chatradhaari Saun.Daan-Pati Karan Karan Pati Laagi Bali,Bali-Pati Laagi Kailaas Ke Vihaari Saun.Teenon Lok-Pati Braj-Pati Sau Laagi Hai,Braj-Pati Pati Laagi Vrishabhan Ki Dulaari Saun.- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (96)Mighty Himalaya bows to Mount Meru, which rests humbly upon the Earth; Earth itself stands upheld by Śeṣanāga, Varāha, Kūrma, and the oceanic depths — none stands alone. [1]The ten directions are ruled by guardians like Indra, Yama, and Varuṇa — even Indra, King of heaven, bows to higher powers beyond. [2]Even the generous Karṇa and noble King Bali serve under the lordship of Mahādev, Lord Śiva. [3]Yet Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva — the triad of creation, preservation, and destruction — are under the authority of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa of Vraja; and Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself is under the command of Vṛṣabhānu‑nandinī, Śrī Rādhāraṇī. [4]

title: Prem Diwane Jo Bhaye Pritam Ke Rang Mahin - Sri Sahjobai
sanskrit_text: Prem Diwane Jo Bhaye, Preetam Ke Rang Mahin.Sahajo Sudhi Budhi Sab Gayi, Tan Ki Sodhi Nahin.- Sri SahjobaiThe one who is intoxicated in the love of the Beloved Lord Shri Krishna forgets all sense of physical presence. He desires neither worldly pleasures, nor Vaikuntha, nor even liberation. Lost in divine love, he becomes unaware even of his own body.

title: Gunj Garen Sir Morpakha - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Gunj Garen Sir MorpakhaAru Chaal Gayand Ki Mo Man Bhavai. [1]Saavro Nand Kumar SabaiBrajmandal Mein Brajraj Kahavai. [2]Saaj Samaaj Sabai SirataajAu Laaj Ki Baat Nahin Kahi Aavai. [3]Taahi Aheer Ki ChhohariyanChachiya Bhari Chaach Pai Naach Nachavai. [4]- Shri Raskhan, Raskhan RatnawaliWith a garland of guñjā beads and a peacock crown atop His head, and His elephant-like, intoxicated walk, Śrī Kṛṣṇa captivates my mind. [1]This Dark Son of Nanda is lovingly revered as the Prince of Vraja. [2]He is the incomparable crown jewel of Braj, beyond the reach of words. [3]Yet the playful gopīs make Him dance for just a drop of buttermilk from the palm of their hand. [4]

title: Gram-Sinh Bhunsyau Bipin - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Purvardh (26)
sanskrit_text: Gram-Sinh Bhunsyau Bipin, Dekhi Sinh Kau Roop.Sun-Suni Bhunsain Galin Mein, Sabai Svaan Bekup.- Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Purvardh (26)Near a village, a dog strolled into a forest and barked at a lion. Other village dogs, without knowing why, began barking too. Bhagwat Rasik says people mindlessly repeat the words of God-realized saints without true experience, remaining far from the deeper essence behind it.

title: Vegi Kripakar Kunwari Swamini - Shri Lalit Madhuri
sanskrit_text: (Raag Kaafi)Vegi Kripakar Kunwari Swamini, Vrindavipin Basavo. Radhakund Nikunj Manohar, Tahan Dou Sachupavo. [1]Preeti Vivas Rasreeti So Pooran, Nootan Neh Upavo. Nek Adhar Muskay Madhuri, Mohan Chitahi Churavo. [2]Lai Veeri Priya Karahi Apne, Lalan Mukhahi Khavavo. Do Bhuj Meli Mukur Niharo, Lol Kapol Milavo. [3]Aras Paras Adharamrit Peevat, Hasvilas Badhavo. ‘Lalitmadhuri’ Karat Khavasi, Yah Chhavi Drig Darasavo. [4]- Shri Lalit MadhuriO Queen of Vrindavan, Sri Radhai! Please grant me residence in Vrindavan soon.  In the enchanting groves near Radha Kund, sweet rasa showers endlessly, delighting you both. [1]Kindly awaken the ever-new, rasa-filled mode of love in my heart.  Just one sweet smile of yours is enough to steal the heart of Shyamsundar. [2]With your tender hands, offer betel leaf to Shyamsundara, and as you embrace Him, gaze into the mirror, cheek-to-cheek, admiring each other. [3]May you both forever relish each other’s Adharāmṛta (nectar of lips), immersed in laughter and playful joy. Lalita Madhuri prays, may I eternally serve You both, forever beholding Your divine, sweet leelas. [4]

title: Sur-Nar-Kinnar-Urag Hu - Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Shringar (6)

title: Ras Bas Surat Bhayi Ab Mori - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (135)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Tilak Kamaod or Malkosh)Ras Bas Surat Bhayi Ab Mori.Jugal Roop Chhavi Nain Samaai, Bandhi Prem Ki Dori. The beautiful Yugal form rests within my eyes, for my heart is bound by the thread of their love. [1]Rasa pervades my every pore — how can I ever describe this bliss? Sri Roop Madhuri is absorbed in loving contemplation, having attained the rapturous divine couple. [2]

title: Teen Lok Kau Raaj Sukh -  Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.45)
sanskrit_text: Teen Lok Kau Raaj Sukh, Sampati Sab Parivaar.Chhaandhi Sabai Basi Vipin Mein, Jahan Ras Sindhu Apaar.- Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.45)Renouncing the royal luxuries of the three worlds, material wealth, and family joys, one should reside in Shri Vrindavan Dham, which is the endless ocean of divine love and rasa.

title: Sri Vrindavan Rani Sahibani - Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (14)
sanskrit_text: Sri Vrindavan Rani Sahibani.Swamini Charan Kamal Ki Seva, Hum Ko Bhali Thani. [1]Lalitadik Sakhiyan Son Mitrata, Hounhun To Ya Paat Gani.Jugal Rasik Ras Jay Shri Bansiali, Janat Kynhu Na Mukh Jaat Bhani. [2]- Shri Vanshi Ali, Siddhant Ke Pad (14)Shri Radha reigns as the sovereign Queen of Sri Vrindavan Dham. The loving service of Her lotus feet has settled deeply in our hearts. [1]And if, in addition, one receives the affectionate company of sakhis like Lalita, there is truly nothing greater. Shri Vanshi Ali says — the rasa of Yugal Vihār, held within the hearts of ananya rasika saints, is supremely rare and beyond the grasp of words. [2]

title: Chaatik Chuhal Chahu Aur Chaahai  - Ghananand Granthawali, Sujan Hita (187)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Chaatik Chuhal Chahu Aur Chaahai Swati Hi Kon,Soore Pan-Poore Jinhen Bish Sam Amee Hai.Praphulit Hot Bhaan Ke Udot Kanj-Punj,Taa Bin Bichaarani Hi Jyoti-Jaal Tamee Hai.Chaahau Anchaahau Jaan Pyaare Pai ‘Anandghan’,Preeti-Reeti Bisham Su Rom Rom Rami Hai.Mohin Tum Ek, Tumhen Mo Sam Anek Aahin,Kahaa Kachhoo Chandhin Chakoran Ki Kami Hai.- Shri Ghananand Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Sujan Hita (187)The playful chātaka bird longs only for the raindrops of the Svāti star; even nectar seems like poison to it — such is its vow‑bound commitment. [1]Lotuses bloom only at sunrise; without it, even heaps of light seem like night to them. [2]Śrī Ghanānand says — O dear Beloved (Śrī Krishn)! Love me or don’t, but every pore of my being is drenched in the wild madness of Your exclusive love. [3]To me, You’re the only one; but for You, I may be just among many, like the moon with its countless moon‑longing chakora birds. [4]

title: Ved Puraan Sumriti Sabai Sur Nar Sebat Jaahi - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
sanskrit_text: Ved Puraan Sumriti Sabai, Sur Nar Sebat Jaahi.Maha Moodh Agyan Mati, Kyon Na Sanbhaarat Taahi.- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraAll the Vedas, Puranas, and scriptures glorify that Supreme Lord, whom all divine beings, humans, and sages serve. title: Pritam Mohi Pranan Hun Tein Pyaro - Shri Hita Kamal Nain, Shri Hita Kamal Nain Ji Ki Vani, Ashtayami Padavali (110)
sanskrit_text: Preetam Mohi Praanan Hoon Ten Pyaaro.Nisidin Ur Lagaaye Rahoon Hit Saun,Naink Na Karihaun Nyaaro. [1]Dekhat Jaay Param Sukh Upajat,Roop Rang Gun Gaarau.Jai Shri Kamalnainan Hit Suni Priya Bainani,Tan Man Dhan Sab Vaarau. [2]- Shri Hita Kamal Nain, Shri Hita Kamal Nain Ji Ki Vani, Ashtayami Padavali (110)Shri Radha says — “My Beloved is more precious to me than life; day and night I lovingly embrace Him to my heart, never letting Him go.” [1]Just a glimpse of Him brings supreme happiness, for He is the embodiment of beauty, bliss, and divine virtues. Goswami Shri Kamalnayan Ji Maharaj says — upon hearing such sweet words, one should offer body, mind, and wealth completely. [2]

title: Kshir Saaramapahrittya Shankaya - Sri Krishn Sukati
sanskrit_text: Kshir Saaramapahrittya Shankaya Sweekritam Yadi Palaayanam Tvaya.Maanase Mam Nitantataamase Nandanandan Katham Na Leeyase.- Sri Krishn SukatiO Shri Krishn! If You wish to escape in fear after stealing butter, then why not hide inside my heart? It is so dark inside that no one could ever find you there.

title: Mero Lal Shyama Rang Bhino - Shri Thakurdas Ji
sanskrit_text: Merau Laal Shyama Rang Bheenaun.Bolat Naahin Priya Tu Mukh Tein, Kai Kaahu Kachhu Keenaun. [1]Main Pyari Tere Charanani Lotun, Tihin Mol Mohin Leenaun.Thakur Sakhi Reejhi Hansi Priya, Shyam Ank Bhari Leenaun. [2]- Shri Thakur Das, Sri Thakur Das Ju Ki Vani, Pad (2)O Shyama Ju (Shri Radha), my Lalji (Shri Krishna) is completely colored in Your divine love. Why then do You say nothing? Has he done something wrong? [1]Shyamsundar says, “O Beloved, I’m at Your feet and You’ve bought me with Your love.” Thakur Sakhi says, Priyaji now smiles sweetly, her heart pleased, and embraces Him to her heart.” [2]

title: Bas Gaye Nainan Maahi Bihari - Sri Roop Kunwari Ji
sanskrit_text: (Raag Hamir Taal Titala)Bas Gaye Nainan Maahi Bihari.Dekhi Jabse Shyamali Moorti, Tarat Na Chhabi Drig Taari.Mor Mukut Makarakrit Kundal, Baam Ang Shri Pyaari. Since the moment I first beheld His dark-complexioned form, He has never vanished from my sight. His forehead is decorated with a peacock feather crown. His ears are decorated with crocodile-shaped earrings and seated lovingly by His left side is His eternal consort, Shri Radha. [1]O my Lord, please cast Your merciful glance upon me and bless me with the priceless treasure of prema-bhakti. Sri Rupa Kunwari declares: Shri Banke Bihari is the true well-wisher of His devotees—He who lovingly fulfills all their needs. [2]

title: Jab Daant Na The Tab Doodh Diyo - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Jab Daant Na The Tab Doodh Diyo,Daant Diye To Kon Ann Hoo Dehai. [1]Jal Mein Thal Mein Pashu Pakshin Mein,Sabki Sudhi Let Wo Teri Hoo Laihai. [2]Jaan Ko Det Ajaan Ko Det,Jahaan Ko Det Ve Tokon Bhi Daihai. [3]Re Manmoorakh Soch Karai Kyun,Soch Kare Kachhoo Haath Na Aihai. [4]- Braj Ke SawaiyaWhen You were a child, the Lord gave you milk; as you grew and gained teeth, He provided food as well. [1]That very God nourishes all creatures—on land and in water, animals and birds in the sky—surely He will care for you too. [2]He provides for those who know Him, and even for those who don't. He sustains the entire world. Will He forget you? [3]O foolish mind! Abandon your fears—nothing ever came through worry. [4]

[2]Jan Ko Det Ajan Ko Det,Jahan Ko Det Ve Tokon Bhi Daihai. [3]Re Manmurakh Soch Karai Kyun,Soch Kare Kachhu Hath Na Aihai. [4]- Braj Ke SawaiyaWhen You were a child, the Lord gave you milk; as you grew and gained tith, He provided fud as well. title: Narayan Ghaati Kathin Jahan Neh Ko Dham - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (137)
sanskrit_text: Narayan Ghaati Kathin, Jahan Neh Ko Dham.Bikal Moorchha Siskibo, Yah Mag Mein Vishram.- Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (137)The narrow path that leads to the supreme abode of divine love is exceedingly difficult. title: Lalit Latan Par Nanhi Nanhi Bunda Paren - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
sanskrit_text: Lalit Lataan Par Nanhi Nanhi Boond ParenBheejat Rangeele Dou Pritam Pyari. [1]Hansi Hansi Baat Karen Bhuj Mool DharenLagyo Peet Pat Tan Surang Kasoobhi Saari. [2]Bimb Badan Par Rahi Kachu Fuhin FabiUpma Na Jaat Kachu Jiyame Bichari. [3]‘Rasik’ Ubhay Udaar Gaavat Raag MalhaarHit De Suni Taan Det Pran Vaari. [4]- Goswami Shri Harirai JiTiny raindrops are falling upon the charming forest vines, and Shri Radha and Shri Krishna are both soaked in divine love and rain. [1]They laugh and speak joyfully, arms around each other. Shri Krishna’s rain-soaked yellow garment and Shri Radha’s bright crimson sari cling to their graceful forms. [2]A raindrop on their bimba-like faces appears so beautiful that no comparison can truly capture it. [3]Rasika Goswami Hariray Ji says: Both Shri Radha and Shri Krishna overflow with love, singing Raag Malhar in such a state of grace that, upon hearing their sweet melody, He willingly offers his very life in love. [4]

title: Vyashi Baman Jin Gano Haribhaktan Ko Das - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (14)
sanskrit_text: Vyashi Baman Jini Ganaun, Haribhaktan Kau Das.(Sri) Radhavallabh Karnain, Sahyau Jagat Uphas.- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Saakhi (14)Sri Hariram Vyas says — “Do not count me among the Brahmins; I am but a humble servant of the devotees of Lord Hari.” Immersed in the love of Shri Radhavallabh Lal Ji, I have joyfully embraced all ridicule from the world.

title: Kamal Se Loin Lalit Ati Shobha Det - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (273)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kamal Se Loin Lalit Ati Shobha Det,Kunwar Ke Sang Tau Viraje Koti Kamini.Apne Apne Kar Jor Juri Thadi Bhai,Chahu Or Mano Ghan Ghero Aay Damini.Roop Gun Gaan Ras Ek Ek Te Saras,Nirtan Sakal Nana Bhain Son Bhamini.Ras Seem Raas Seem Param Vilas Seem,Raje Raas Mandal Mein Madhuri Ki Swamini.- Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (273)Śrī Rādhā, with lotus‑like eyes and radiant beauty, adorns with Śrī Kṛṣṇa; even millions of celestial maidens pale before Her divine charm. [1]Around the Divine Couple, the sakhīs stand with folded hands in a circle, like flashes of lightning amidst rain‑filled clouds. [2]Each sakhī overflows with streams of rasa, beauty, melody, and virtues, and dances in her own style, drenched in devotion. [3]Śrī Madhurī Dās says: My Svāminī, Śrī Rādhā, the embodiment of rasa, rās, and vilās, shines with unmatched brilliance in the Rasa Maṇḍal of Vāṁśīvaṭa. [4]

title: Jeto Antar Vaas Mein Teto Jaan Upaas- Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (603)
sanskrit_text: Jeto Antar Baas Mein, Teto Jaani Upaas.Shri Bihari Das Kachhu Saanch Hai, Kachhu Kachhu Lobh Libaas.- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ki Saakhi (603)Attaining Shri Vrindavan Dham is equivalent to attaining the worshipful Lord Himself. Separation from Vrindavan is separation from the Lord. Yet if someone claims, “I have lived in Vrindavan and felt nothing,” Shri Biharini Dev replies: ‘O brother! Your residence in Vrindavan is only partially genuine. The rest of your mind is still filled with desires and greed, and that is why you are not experiencing the true essence of Vrindavan. Otherwise, the attainment of Vrindavan is indeed the direct attainment of the Beloved Deity.’

title: Aho Navalal Piy Vinay Sun Lijiye - Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras Manjari
sanskrit_text: Aho Navalal Piy Vinay Sun Lijiye.Vaas Vrindavipin Tahal Shrikunj Ki Sohni,Aadi Mohi Kripa Kari Dijiye. [1]Aur Kachhu Na Chahau Mukti Baikunth Laun,Roopras Madhuri Paan Kari Jijiye. [2]Pari Bhav Jaladhi Mein Paar Paavat Nahin,Dhunat Shirnath Balidaya Tuka Kijiye. [3]Ramsakhi Sharan Pai Drishti Karuna Karo,Bhai Ati Vikal Sab Gayo Bal Chhijiye. [4]- Sri Ramsakhiji Maharaj, Shri Bhaktiras ManjariO ever-youthful divine couple, Sri Ladli Lal, please hear my humble plea. Grant me residence in Shri Vrindavan, and the blessing of sweeping the bowers of Your forest. [1]I seek neither liberation nor Vaikuntha. I yearn only for the sweetness of Your divine beauty and service. [2]O Lord, I am drowning in the ocean of worldly existence. In helplessness, I bow with folded hands—please bestow Your little mercy. [3]Shri Ramsakhi says — I have taken refuge at Your feet. Please cast a glance of grace upon me, for I am restless and without strength. [4]

title: Kuru Bho Kuru Bho Vasam Mathuriyam  - Skanda Purana
sanskrit_text: Kuru Bho! Kuru Bho! Vasam Mathuriyam.Yatra Gopyasthach Govind Strailokyasya Prakashak.- Skanda PuranaO souls! Reside, reside in that sacred land of Mathura (Braj Mandal), where Lord Govinda and the gopis, the illuminators of all three worlds, eternally reside!

title: Meri Swamini Lalit Kisori - Shri Kishori Ali
sanskrit_text: (Raag Malar)Meri Swamini Lalit Kisori.Pritam-Sang Kunj Ke Aangan, Biharat Bahan Jori. [1]Hiy Harakhat Nirakhat Ban-Sobha, Paavas Ritu Piy-Gori.Adbhut Chhabi Dampatti-Sampatti Ki, Lakhi Aligan Trin Tori. [2]- Shri Kishori AliMy guardian is none other than the most enchanting Shri Radha, wandering joyfully in the bowers of Vrindavan, arm in arm with Her beloved Shri Krishna. [1]As they behold the beauty of the forest and the charm of the rainy season, the hearts of the dark and fair couple overflow with joy. Witnessing the unmatched splendor of this divine pair, the sakhis offer themselves entirely in love. [2]

title: Gahvar Van Aru Sankari Galiyan Lila Hoy - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Gahvar Van Aru Saankari, Galiyan Leela Hoy.Tab Hi Anubhav Hota Jab, Bhaav Saras Hiy Poy. - Braj Ke DoheThe divine pastimes of Sri Radha Krishna in sacred places like Gahvar Van and Sankari Khor can be truly realized only by a heart free of deceit and filled with pure devotion; to one without bhāva, they appear as mere ordinary sites.

title: Pyari Ju Tihare Pad Pankaj Ki Balihari - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (9)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Pyari Ju Tihare Pad Pankaj Ki Balihari,Sadaan Hi Bihari Lal Man Te Na Taarai Hain. [1] Ve Harat Kusum Parag Tabai Laagain Jabai Her,Alabele Peet Pat Ki Son Jhaarai Hain. [2]Jaavak Banaay Chitr Sukhma Vichitr Her,Lootat Mayur Pichchh Pran Dhan Vaarai Hain. [3]Hita Dhruv Ras Yah Saban Ten Durlabh Hai,Rasik Su ‘Balbir’ Dasi Ur Dhaarai Hain. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (9)O Rādhājū! I bow again and again at Your lotus feet; Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s heart eternally rests there, never forgetting them for even a moment. [1]As You walk through Vṛndāvan and flower‑pollen graces Your feet, Kṛṣṇa gently wipes it away with the edge of His yellow garment. [2]With loving hands, He paints Your feet with red jāvak, then stares in wonder, heart surrendered; His peacock‑feather crown bends naturally toward Your feet as He offers His very life at them. [3]Rasikā Lāl Balabirā, Śrī Rādhā’s maidservant, says — these lotus feet forever dwell in my heart too, whose rasa even Śrī Hit Dhruvdās has declared supremely rare. [4]

title: Jakau Gati Chahat Diyau Leta Agati Tain Raakhi - Shri Rasnidhi
sanskrit_text: Jakau Gati Chahat Diyau, Leta Agati Tain Raakhi.Rasnidhi Hain Ya Baat Ke, Bhakt Bhagwat Saakhi.- Shri RasnidhiWhomsoever the Lord Himself chooses to uplift, no matter how fallen or unworthy they may appear, He protects them from every obstacle. title: Jinke Shri Harivansh Sahayak - Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani
sanskrit_text: Jinke Shri Harivansh Sahayak.Tei Sajan Bhajan AdhikariVrindavan Ghan Basive Layak. [1]Alak Lade Anand Bhare DolenSir Par Vyas Suvan Sukhdayak.Kunwari Kunwar Jahi Sulabh NagaridasRasik Shiromani Ke Gungayak. [2]- Shri Neh Nagridas, Sri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki VaniThose blessed by Shri Harivansh Mahaprabhu are truly qualified for the divine bhajan of Vrindavan rasa, and only they are worthy of residing in the sacred groves of Shri Vrindavan. sanskrit_text: Sri Yamunaji So Neh Kari, Yah Nemi Tu Leh.Shri Vallabh Ke Das Binu, Auran So Taji Sneh.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (76)If you truly wish to adopt a vow, then let it be this — Love Shri Yamuna Ji with unwavering devotion, and offer your affection only to the servants of Shri Krishna, renouncing all other attachments.

title: Naina Pragat Karat Piya Preme- Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (24)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Sarang)Naina Pragat Karat Piya Premain.Jhoothe Heen Utar Kat Thaanati,Chhaand Maan Ke Nemai. [1]Kop Kapat Kau Adhar Kamp Sakhi,Ati Hulaas Hiradai Mai.Shri Beethal Vipul Bihari Nag Bar,Jatit Su Tuv Tan Hemai. [2]- Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (24)Sri Vitthalvipul Biharinidasi says, O Radha! Your eyes speak the truth of love. Why then do you try to mislead us with false replies and playful denials? Let go of this mock sulk. [1]This lovely anger — it’s all illusion! Though your lips tremble in fury, but your heart shines with love’s ecstasy. You and our Beloved look so resplendent together, like a brilliant red gem set perfectly in golden ornamentation. Tell us — are you two ever truly separate? [2]

title: Kal Kundal Keki Kirit Lasai - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Kal Kundal Keki Kirit Lasai,Kal Kunjit Kesh Sanwari Ki Jai-Jai. [1]Mukh Dekhat Hi Dukh Door Bhaye,Musikaan Manohar Dhaari Ki Jai-Jai. [2]Jai Ho Kamala-Kuch Kunkum Ki,Jai Keshav Kunj Bihari Ki Jai-Jai. [3]Jag Pooshan Krishna Murari Ki Jai,Braj Bhooshan Banke Bihari Ki Jai-Jai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’With earrings that dazzle and a radiant peacock-feather crown upon His head. All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose curly, graceful locks are lovingly arranged. [1]Just a glimpse of His divine face dispels all sorrows. Glory to the Lord who carries an enchanting smile. [2]Glory to the sacred kuṃkuma that graces His chest. Glory to Keśava, who sports joyfully in the secret bowers of Vṛndāvana. [3]Glory to Kṛṣṇa Murāri, the nurturer of the world; all glories to Baṅke Bihārī, who adorns the land of Braj with His beauty. [4]

title: Vrindavan Nij Dham Mein Eik Ras Yugal Vilas - Sri Begamdas (of Shuka sect.)
sanskrit_text: Vrindavan Nij Dham Mein, Eik Ras Yugal Vilas.Sakhibhav Bin Kaahun Ki, Gam Nahin ‘Begamdas’.- Sri Begamdas (of Shuka sect.)Sri Vrindavan Dham, the personal abode of Priya-Priyatam (Sri Radha-Krishna), forever showers only the bliss of Yugal rasa. Begamdas says, without attaining sakhi-bhav (the mood of a confidential companion of Sri Radha), no one can enter that sacred rasa.

title: Aaju Bani Ati Saarang Naini - Shri Govind Swami Ji Ki Vani (461)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Iman)Aaju Bani Ati Saarang Naini.Madanmohan Piya Rachi Pachi Kar, Goothi Banai Beni. [1]Mrig Mad Tilak, Likhat Bhaal Sakal, Kalagunnidhaan Roop Ki Eni.‘Govind’ Prabhu Ras Bas Keene Sahaag Ten Madanmohan Sukh Deni. [2]- Shri Govind Swami, Shri Govind Swami Ji Ki Vani (461)Shri Radha, whose eyes resemble the gentle gaze of a graceful deer, is magnificently adorned today. Even Madanamohan (Sri Krishna), the enchanter of Cupid himself, is completely lost in Her beauty and lovingly engaged in braiding Her hair. [1]With tender love, Krishna applies a tilak of deer musk (kasturi) on Sri Radha’s radiant forehead, who is the very embodiment of beauty, grace, and divine art. Shri Govind Das says, Sri Radha has drawn Krishna entirely under the spell of Her rasa, and through their love-filled union, She bestows upon Him the highest bliss. [2]

title: Ati Albeli Bhanti Son Lai Muralika Haath - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (5)
sanskrit_text: Ati Albeli Bhanti Son, Lai Muralika Haath.Thir Cha Sab Vrinda Vipin, Kiye Sabani Mann Sath.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (5)When Shri Radha, with supreme enchantment, picked up the flute with Her lotus hands and played it upon Her lips, the sweetness of Her melody cast a divine spell over all of Vrindavan. Both movable and immovable beings became ecstatic, as if Sri Radha Herself had stolen every heart.

title: Swamini Houn Patitan Shirataj - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (81)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Jangla)Swamini Houn Patitan Shirataaj,Teri Jagat Kahaay Bimukh Jyon, Dolat Lagat Na Laaj. [1]Shreevan Begi Basaay Ubaaro, Naahin Param Akaaj.Lalita Kishori Bise Sindhu Mahin, Boodat Vais Jahaaj. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (81)O Swamini, I am truly the crown among the fallen. Though the world calls me Yours, still, like the ungrateful, I wander aimlessly, without even a trace of shame. [1]O Radhe! Kindly bestow me refuge in Shri Vrindavan and grant me deliverance. Your mercy will not go in vain — it will bring the highest good. Sri Lalita Kishori says, “O Kishoriji! I am sinking in the ocean of sensual poison, just as a helpless ship sinks deep into the sea.” [2]

title: Piya Pyari Ko Viharivo Rakhi Hiy Duray - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (298)
sanskrit_text: Piya Pyari Ko Viharivo, Raakhi Heey Duray.Chhin Chhin Rokat Adhik Taun, Nikasi Nikasi Mukh Jaay.- Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (298)Though the Vihāra (love plays) of the divine couple, Sri Priyā Priyatama, are meant to be kept hidden deep within the heart, but no matter how much I try to conceal them, the more effortlessly they manifest upon my lips.

title: Durlabh Ya Sansar Mein Rasbhajani Rativaan - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (62)
sanskrit_text: Durlabh Ya Sansar Mein, Rasabhajani Rativaan.‘Rooprasik’ Aise Bahut, Neeras Rees Nivaan.- Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Vishisht Doha (62)Meeting a genuine rasika, immersed exclusively in the rasa, is extremely rare in this world. Most people only talk about rasa, but they remain entangled in mere external formalities. Outwardly, they may present themselves as rasikas, but inwardly, they are monotonous, entangled only in nonsensical customs and ritualistic practices.

title: Latkat Aavat Baah Jori - Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (186)
sanskrit_text: Latkat Aavat Baah Jori.Phule Phoole Dou Jan Sundar, Dekhat Ban Ghan Khori. [1]Phoolan Ki Maala Ur Pahirein, Naval Syaam Nav Gori.Albeli Ali Pranaravan Din, Avichal Bhutal Jori. Hand in hand, they roam the dense groves, exchanging joyful glances. [1]Shri Abeli Ali says, this ever-youthful, dark and fair couple, the very source of my life, adorned with garlands of flowers, dwell eternally in Vrindavan in their most splendid form. [2]

sanskrit_text: Rain Radhaun Paani Piyau, Paatar Seetha Chugaun.Shri Vrindavan Chhandi Kai, Anat Na Kit Hun Jaun.- Shri Hita Damodar Das, Nem Battisi (4)Even if I sleep on the bare ground, drink only water, and survive on the thinnest morsels of food, still, I will never, ever leave Shri Vrindavan and go elsewhere.

title: Ab Man Yugal Charan Mein Atakyo - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri
sanskrit_text: Ab Man Yugal Charan Mein Atakyo.Janm Anek Bhaye Ya Jag Mein, Dharm Karm Mein Bhatakyo. [1]Kripa Kari Shri Nitya Kishori, Vipin Raaj Mein Thatakyo.Rasikan Ke Sang Rahas Keli Suni, Hiy Aanand Mein Latakyo. [2]Paayo Maarag Prem Preeti Ko, Chit Kau Sanshay Satakyo.Ali Madhuri Bhayi Nacheeta, Door Bhayo Bhav Khatakyo. [3]- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli MadhuriMy mind is now bound at the lotus feet of the Divine Couple. I have wasted countless lives entangled in the webs of karma and dharma. [1]By the grace of the ever-youthful Goddess, Shri Radha, I have now been granted shelter in Her forest of Vrindavan. Through the association of Rasika saints, my heart sways in bliss upon hearing the secret love pastimes (keli leelas) of Shri Radha-Krishna. [2]I have now found the path of true love and devotion, and all doubts of the mind have vanished. Shri Ali Madhuri now dances in rasa, for the cycle of worldly existence has been dispelled. [3]

title: Maat Taat Jaake Nahin - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (686)
sanskrit_text: Maat Taat Jaake Nahin, Vrishbhanu Suta Nahin Naam.Kunjbihari Naam Niju, Kunj Biharini Baam.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (686)In the ‘Akhand Nitya Vihara’ worship of Swami Shri Haridas Ji, Shri Radha and Shri Krishna are always perceived as eternally youthful and entirely beyond the scope of their manifest birth pastimes. Even names like “Vrishabhanu Dulari” hold no relevance here, for in this devotion, Shri Radha has no parents. She eternally resides in the Nikunj, absorbed in divine love-play. Here, Krishna is worshipped as Kunjbihari and Radha as Kunjbiharini. This path excludes Braj-based leelas such as those involving cowherds, gopis, cows, and parental figures, focusing solely on the pure, uninterrupted rasa of Nitya Vihara.

title: Suni Ahankar Bhalau Na Bhiya- Shri Biharin Dev, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (88)
sanskrit_text: Suni Ahankar Bhalau Na Bhiya.Kahe Kaun Dukh Sukh Maanat Man, Paiyat Na Bina Diya. [1]Budhi Vivek Bhajan Bhari Raakhat, Mohan Heri Hiya.Shri Bihaari Daas Prabhu Kiyau Su Maanyau, Yon Jan Jaani-Jiya. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev, Shri Biharin Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (88)O brother! heed this truth — pride in anything is never good. Without the Lord’s will, no one can attain anything. So why let your heart feel sorrow or joy over gains or losses, whether yours or another’s? [1]Keep your intellect and wisdom always immersed in devotion to the divine couple, Shri Shyama Kunj Bihari, and constantly behold Their enchanting form within your heart. True servants of Shri Bihari Ji accept everything as His will and live with simplicity and graceful surrender. [2]

title: Ra Dane Dharane Dha Cha - Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (10)
sanskrit_text: Ra Daane Dhaarane Dhaa Cha Iti DhaatudvayaadapiRadhaanaamno’sti Nishpattir Vijneyaa Bhakta-Sattamaih- Shri Vagish Shastriji, Sri Radha Naam Sudha (10)The name ‘Rādhā’ consists of syllables — ‘Ra’, meaning to give or bestow, and ‘Dha’, meaning to hold, sustain, or protect. Thus, exalted devotees understand Her name as: She who lovingly bestows rasa, love, or grace, and lovingly protects it.

title: Dol Jhooliye Dou Pyare - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
sanskrit_text: Dol Jhooliye Dou Pyaare,Kunjmahal Mein Phoolan-Rachna, Phoolan Phool Sanvaare. sanskrit_text: Dhan Dhan Vrindavipin Bhayi Panihari.Praat Hoy Jamuna Jal Nhaavai, Sab Hi Gop Kumari. title: Kabahoo Tau Laadili Aisi Kripa Karau Ri - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (348)
sanskrit_text: Kabahoo Tau Laadili Aisi Kripa Karau Ri,Haun Tau Loti Rahau Kunjan Mag, Tum Hiy Aai Kai Paav Dharau Ri. [1]Haun Tau Laagi Rahau Charanan Saug, Tum Jhuki Vihansi Bhuja Pakarau Ri,Haun Tau Naink Uthau Na Uthaae, Tum Bal Kar Hath Bhujan Bharau Ri. [2]Haun Tau Sab Vidhi Adham Apaavan, Tum Tau Aapni Dharani Dharau Ri,Bhori Neech Sabai Neechan Mein, Kripa Aas Nit Dwaar Rarau Ri. [3]- Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (348)O Shri Radha! Bestow Your grace upon me — When You walk from one bower to another, let me lie on that very path, So that Your sacred feet may rest upon my heart. [1]Let me cling to Your feet, and may You try to lift me up in Your loving arms gently; If I fall and cannot rise, may You, with full strength, lift me up and embrace me. [2]Shri Hit Bhorisakhi says, Though I am deeply fallen and burdened with sins, You vowed to uplift the lowliest of beings. I lie here at your doorstep, begging daily for just a drop of your grace, shedding tears in your devotion. [3]

title: Pyari Teri Chhabi Par Ravi Sasi Vaarau - Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (251)
sanskrit_text: Pyari Teri Chhabi Par Ravi Sasi Vaarau,Mahal-Nikunja Sej Pritam Sang, Ikatak Nitya Niharau. [1]Lata Tamal Sughan Damini Duti, Ratipati Ki Gati Taarau,Shri Vrindavan Nitya Biharini, Roop Drigani Main Dhaarau. [2]- Shri Roop Sakhi, Shri Roop Sakhi Ji Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (251)O beloved ‘Pyārī Jū’ (Shri Radha), I would willingly offer even the sun and moon for your unparalleled beauty. My sole desire is to gaze day and night, unwaveringly, upon the form of you and your beloved resting upon the lovely bed in the Nikunj Palace. [1]Beside Shyamsundar, your form appears like vines entwining a dark tamala tree, or like lightning flashing amidst dark clouds, so resplendent that even Kamadeva’s beauty fades before it. Shri Roop Sakhi says, O Nitya Viharini Jū! May your eternal love-play (‘Nitya Vihar’) of Vrindavan be the sole object of my eyes. [2]

title: Shri Vrishabhanu Se Raja Jahan Aru - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Shri Vrishabhanu Se Raja Jahan Aru, Kirti Si Mahishi Sukh Dani.Shri Vrishabhanu Pur Hun Kahen, Barsane Si Rajati Hain Rajdhani.Mandir Manjul Madhya Birajati, Bhrajati Uchh Dhwaja Phairani.Pranan Pyari Shyam Sujan Ki, Sebya Hamari Shri Radhika Rani.- Braj Ke SawaiyaWhere Śrī Vṛṣabhānu himself is king, and Queen Kīrti reigns, a true benefactor of happiness. [1]This town is called the city of Vṛṣabhānu, with Barsānā as its splendid capital. [2]At its heart stands a beautiful temple situated on a hill, its banner proudly fluttering in the breeze. [3]She who is dearest to Śyāmasundar’s heart, that very Śrī Rādhikā Rāṇī, is our revered and worshipful Queen. [4]

title: Rasik Raseeli Rang Bhari Ramani Kamni Naari - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (14)
sanskrit_text: Rasik Raseeli Rang Bhari, Ramani Kamni Naari.Ras Salita Ras Roopini, Ras Krida Ki Saari.- Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (14)Rasīlī Shri Rādhā, full of nectar, is the very source of life for the Rasikas. title: Meri Sudhi Lijo Ho, Brajraj - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
sanskrit_text: (Raag Multani Dhanashree Titala)Meri Sudhi Lijo Ho, Brajraj,Aur Nahi Jag Main Kou Mero, Tumhin Sudharan Kaj.Ganika, Geedh, Ajamill Taare, Sabari Au Gajraj,Soor Patit Pāvan Kari Kije, Bahan Gahe Ki Laaj.- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraO Lord of Vraja, Shri Krishna! Please heed my plea—I have no one else in this world.You alone can rectify my misfortune. [1]You have redeemed many—be it Ganika, Jatayu, Ajamil, Shabari, or Gajraj.Please redeem this fallen Surdas as well, uphold his honor by taking his hand and guiding him. [2]

title: Shyam Batayo Nain Mein - ShriBhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (30)
sanskrit_text: Syam Batayo Nain Mein, Rahi Samujhi Sukunwari.Charan Lagyo Jab Kahayou Tab, Harshi Laal Nihari.- Shri Bhatt Devacharya, Yugal Shatak (30)Shri Krishna pleaded to the sulking Shri Radha through His longing eyes, and She silently acknowledged His plea. But when He placed His head at Her lotus feet in deep humility, Her heart melted, and She was fully pleased.

title: Uraj Utang Ati Bharit Bhare Se Ang -  Shri Vallabh Rasik Ji Ki Vani
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Uraj Utang Ati Bharit Bhare Se Ang,Adhar Surang Son Rangi Si Mati Jati Hain. [1]Unchi Gunthi Veni Son Taneni Bhaunh Bhai Bhari,Aai Bhari Chhavi Hansi Lasi Itarati Hain. [2]Vallabh Rasik Dooau, Sanmukh Mukh Sane,Chakit Thakit Kit Divas Kit Rati Hain. [3]Nainani Sihani Lalchani Muskani,Tarasani Sarasani Aani-Aani Darasati Hain. [4]- Shri Vallabh Rasik, Shri Vallabh Rasik Ji Ki VaniŚrī Rādhā’s bosom, full and majestic, is so captivating that it bewilders the mind. Her lips are painted red, making Śrī Kṛṣṇa lose all sense. [1]Her high‑braided hair and perfectly arched brows add to Her beauty as She smiles and sways, radiating elegance. [2]The blissful lovers, Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, stand face to face; Kṛṣṇa, entranced, forgets both dawn and dusk as He gazes at Her form. [3]Her eyes, filled with love and passion, Her subtle smiles, and playful glances fill Kṛṣṇa with love‑bliss as He beholds them with longing eyes. [4]

title: Hita May Shrivrindavipin Hita May Shyama Shyam - Shri Magan Ali
sanskrit_text: Hita May Shrivrindavipin, Hita May Shyama Shyam.Hita May Shri Lalitadi Sakhi, Hita May Kunj Sutham.- Shri Magan AliSri Vrindavan Dham is completely filled with divine love — so are the divine couple, Shri Shyama Shyam; so are Lalita and the other sakhis. Even the beautiful bowers are pervaded with this divine love.

title: Mukut Latak Atki Manmaahin - Sri Sahjobai
sanskrit_text: Mukut Latak Atki Manmaahin.Nrityat Natvar Madan Manohar, Kundal Jhalak Palak Bithuraai. [1]Naak Bulak Hulak Muktahal, Honth Matak Gati Bhaunh Chalaai.Thumuk-Thumuk Pag Dharat Dharani Par, Baah Uthaay Karat Chaturaaai. [2]Jhunak-Jhunak Noopur Jhankaarat, Taa-Taa Thei-Thei Reejh Rijhaai.Charandas ‘Sahajo’ Hiy Antar, Bhavan Karau Jit Rahau Sadaai. [3]- Shri SahjobaiThe tilted, swaying crown of Sri Krishn steals the heart. The charming ‘Natwar’ (the supreme dancer) enchants even Cupid with his dancing. His earrings gleam, and his eyelids flutter with gentle playfulness. [1]His pearl nose-ring swings; his lips pout with grace, and his eyebrows move rhythmically. He stamps the earth with each graceful step, arms raised in an artful dance. [2]The anklets jingle rhythmically, “tā‑tā theī‑theī” enticing and enchanting all. Says Shri Sahajobāī to her Gurudev Shri Charandas: “May this form of Shri Krishna dwell forever in the palace of my heart.” [3]

title: Ravani Rasayani Parihari Saah Na Maanat Kaun - Shri Lal Swami
sanskrit_text: Ravani Rasayani Parihari Saah Na Maanat Kaun.Aasu Ke Haridas Ki Lagai Lal Pag Paun.- Shri Lal SwamiSwami Shri Haridas Ji, was an unparalleled rasika saint, who effortlessly renounced all worldly pleasures and luxuries. He acknowledged no other sovereignty apart from that of Shri Shyama-Kunjbihari, and offered every thought, every breath, and the entirety of his life solely at Their lotus feet.

title: Jaaki Kripa Son Nity Divy Brajmandal Maanhi - Shri Giriraj Goswami 'Anant' (Gokul)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jaaki Kripa Son Nity Divy Brajmandal Maanhi,Lalit Vilas Khas Raman Vihari Ke. [1]Vani Aru Veenapani Riddhi Siddhi Rama Uma,Gayatri Savitri Roop Barsane Vari Ke. [2]Bhav Bharpoor Chitt Choor Shyam Chintan Mein,Narad Shuk Vyas Haridas Das Pyari Ke. [3]Bandaun Manmohanki Madhuri Dhuri Jag Ki,Bandaun Pad Kanj Manju Keerati Kumari Ke. [4]- Shri Giriraj Goswami 'Anant' (Gokul)By the grace of whose sacred lotus feet, one eternally resides in the divine land of Braj and beholds the intimate līlās of the divine couple, Rāmaṇ‑Bihārī and Bihārīṇī. [1]She, the Queen of Barsaṇā, is the very voice of Sarasvatī, the veena‑bearing goddess. She is the origin of Riddhi, Siddhi, Lakṣmī, Pārvatī, Gāyatrī, and Savitri. [2]Nārad, Śukadev, Vedavyās, and other exalted sages remain deeply immersed in Kṛṣṇa’s remembrance, and such Kṛṣṇa is the devoted servant of Śrī Rādhā’s lotus feet. [3]I bow down to one who brings sweetness in Maṇmohan Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is the very source of all; I bow repeatedly at the lotus feet of Śrī Rādhā. [4]

title: Yatha Bhagavatam Shrestham - Sri Narayan Bhattji (16th century), Braj Bhakti Vilas (1.92)
sanskrit_text: Yatha Bhagavatam Shrestham, Shastre Krishna Kalevaram.Tathaiv Prithvi Loke, Sabnam Braj Mandalah.- Sri Narayan Bhattji (16th century), Vraja Bhakti Vilas (1.92)Just as the crown jewel of all scriptures, Śrīmad Bhāgavatam, is a non-different form of Sri Krishna, the very embodiment of Shri Krishna Himself, so too is the sacred land of Braj none other than the form of the Lord Krishna Himself.

title: Bhajo Keerati Nandini Shrishyama - Shri Vanshi Ali
sanskrit_text: Bhajo Keerati Nandini Shrishyama.Bhanubaba Ki Ati Hi Ladili, Lad-Ladaavai Bhaiya Shridama. [1]Lalita Vishakha Ki Pran Jeevandhan, Mohan Gaavai Yaakau Gungrama.‘Banshiali’ Ki Aash Kishori, Barsano Yaakau Nij Dhama. [2]- Shri Vanshi AliDevote yourself exclusively to Shri Radha, the beloved daughter of Kirti Devi, the treasured darling daughter of Vrishbhanu Baba, and tenderly adored by her brother Shridama. [1]She is the source of life of Lalita and Vishakha; Lord Krishna joyfully sings her praises without end. Sri Vanshi Ali says, “My every hope rests solely in Shri Radha, whose eternal abode is Barsana.” [2]

title: Tum Mere They Rahoge Yah Shruti Vachan Tihar - Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (81)
sanskrit_text: Tum Mere They Rahoge, Yah Shruti Vachan Tihar.Adham Udharan Naath Puni, Kaahe Mohin Bisar.- Jagadguru Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (81)O Shri Krishna! Though I am fallen, still You have declared in the Vedas: “Since eternity, you were Mine, and you will remain Mine forever.” Then why, O Uplifter of the fallen, have You forgotten me?

title: Dekho Sundarta Ki Sivaan - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya
sanskrit_text: Dekho Sundarta Ki Sivaan.Jamuna-Teer Kadam Ki Chhahiyan Dai Thaadhe Bhuj Grivaan. [1]Vah Bansi Vah Madhur-Madhur Sur Gaavat Raag Uchaari.Vah Mohan Sab Braj Ko Sajni Vah Mohani Mahaari. [2]Duri Kunj Dai Ot Lakhori ! Dhany Prahar Pal Ghari.'Rooprasik' Vah Syamsundar Vah Radhe Roop Bhari. [3]- Shri Roop Rasik DevacharyaO dear friend, just behold, this sight is the very essence of beauty. By the Yamuna’s banks, under the cool shade of a kadamba tree, the divine couple Shri Shyama Shyam stand, their arms entwined. [1]Shri Krishna plays sweet melodies on his flute, and Shri Radha, with a gentle voice, sings the ragas. Shyamsundar is the very breath of Braj, and Sri Radha reigns as the supreme queen. [2]Shri Ruprasikji says: “O friend, hide behind the bushes and see this moment, this hour, this time—it is truly blessed. Shri Radha and Shyamsundar are entirely immersed in each other’s divine beauty and nectar.” [3]

sanskrit_text: Tanak Sohago Daarikein, Jadh Kanchan Pighlay.Sada Suhagini Radhika, Kyon Na Krishn Lalchay.- Shri Parmanand Das JiEven solid gold melts at the mere touch of borax, so why would Shri Krishna not be drawn and melted in love upon beholding the divine form of Shri Radha, the eternal Bride?

title: Aiso Aura Sanehi Kaun - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (97)
sanskrit_text: (Raga Kanharo)Aiso Aura Sanehi Kaun.Range Ekahi Ramga Rangilau, Taji Kaim Vibhau Chaturadasa Bhaumna. [1]China-China Charana-Kamala Saharavata, Kabahun Karata Pata-Pita Saum Pauna. Aisau Prema Kaha Kou Baranai, Jahan Sakala Sukha Gaumna. [2]Adbhuta Rupa Madhuri Nirakhata, Bhari-bhari Loini Daumna. 'Hita Dhruva' Taji Marjada Badaai, Hai Rahe Sabai Bata Mem Mauna. [3]- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (97)Who else could be such a devoted lover than Lalji (Shri Krishna) who renounces all grandeur and the kingship of the fourteen worlds, and drenched Himself completely in Shri Radha’s love? [1]Rvery moment, He massages Shri Radha’s lotus feet, sometimes fanning them gently with His own yellow garment. What words can describe such love, where even the greatest worldly and spiritual pleasures become utterly insignificant? [2]He gazes constantly upon Shri Radha’s divine beauty, drinking it deeply with His large, longing eyes. Shri Dhruvdas Ji declares, Sri Krishn has cast aside every rule of society, all scriptural bounds, and even His reputation, immersing Himself entirely in Priyaji’s love. [3]

title: Nij Subhay Chhodat Nahin Kar Dekhau Hiy Gaur - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Nij Subhay Chhodat Nahin, Kar Dekhau Hiy Gaur.Adham-Udhaaran Naam Tuv, Haun Adhaman-Siramaur.- Braj Ke DoheNo one ever abandons their true nature. O Shri Krishna, kindly ponder this truth in your heart. If you are known as the ‘Adham-Uddharan’ (savior of the fallen), then surely I am the greatest sinner. I have full faith that, staying true to your nature, you will also uplift me, the lowest of all.

title: Parmesvar Parteeti Nahin - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Uttarardh (22)
sanskrit_text: (Kundaliya)Parmesvar Parteeti Nahin, Paisan Ki Parteeti.Binu Bhagavat Bhavnidhi Pare, Gehi Kaha Ateet. [1]Gehi Kaha Ateet, Syam Sarbasu Dhan Bhoole.Kanak-Kamini Dekhi, Rahain Nisi-Baasar Phoole. [2]Din Das Prabhuta Pai, Kahain Ham Hi Sarvesvar.Maha Moh-Mad Piyen, Jiyen Kaise Parmesvar. [3] - Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyanishchayatmak Granth, Uttarardh (22)Those who have no faith in the Lord and place their trust only in wealth and material possessions, whether they are householders or renunciates, remain immersed in the ocean of worldly illusion. [1]They have forgotten that the only true and supreme wealth for every living being is the divine couple, Sri Shyama-Kunj Bihari. Alas, misled by fate, they wander aimlessly, clinging to wealth and pleasure. Their lives revolve around comforts, sensual indulgence, and the fleeting beauty of women. [2]Shri Bhagavat Rasik Ji says—if such people gain even a moment’s glory, their pride swells, and they boast, “We are the masters; all bow to us.” But how long can ego’s intoxication endure? What lasting fruit can delusion bear? [3]

title: Khan-Paan-Paridhan Mein Jeevan Gayau Sab Biti - Shri Surdas, Sura Sagara
sanskrit_text: Khan-Paan-Paridhan Mein, Jeevan Gayau Sab Biti.Jyaun Bit Par-Tiy-Sang Basyau, Bhor Bhaye Bhayi Bhiti.- Shri Surdas, Sura SagaraThe whole life is wasted in eating, drinking, and worldly pleasures — all went in vain. Just like a sinner who spends the night with another’s wife, and trembles in fear at the break of dawn, so too does the soul, entangled in Maya (illusory world) like an illicit lover, begin to shiver with fear when the dawn of death approaches.

title: Morkuti Aur Daan Maan Gadh - Rasik Vani
sanskrit_text: Morkuti Aur Daan Maan Gadh, Gadh Vilas Sukh Paiye.Gahvar Van Ki Baith Latan Mein, Shriradha - Radha Kahiye. [1]Sada-Sarvada Parvat Upar, Nit-Prati Chadhkar Jaiye.Ladililal Ke Darshan Paakar, Tan-Man-Nayan Siraiye.Kahe Das Bas Barsano, Bade Bhagy Tein Paiye. [2]- Rasik VaniOne should lovingly wander through the divine places of Barsana, such as Mor Kuti, Dangarh, Mangarh, and Vilasgarh, immersing oneself in divine love-bliss. Rest beneath the shade of the creepers in Gehvar Van, chanting “Shri Radha Radha” with devotion. [1]Daily, one should ascend Brahmachal hill to behold the divine couple, Shri Ladli Lal, thereby quenching the thirst of body, mind, and eyes. To dwell in Barsana Dham is an exceptionally rare blessing, attained only by divine grace. [2]

title: Prabhuta Dasi Hvain Rahe - Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (14)
sanskrit_text: Prabhuta Dasi Hvain Rahe, Khoje Milain Na Mool.Jab Atakyau Ya Dham Son, Hot Sabai Anukool.- Shri Priyadas Ji, Rasik Mohini (14)Even the Lordship itself resides in Vrindavan, dwelling like a humble servant, its source unknowable. When a soul resides here in exclusive surrender, all of creation aligns in their favor.

title: Jaati Paanti Nana Bhanti Kul Abhiman Taji - Shri Chanda Lal Goswami, Abhilash Battisi
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jaati Paanti Nana Bhanti Kul Abhiman Taji,Nishidin Sheesh Kaun Navaoon Rasikan Mein. [1]Sewakunj Mandal Pulin Vanshivat,Nidhivan Au Sameer Dheer Vicharaun Magan Mein. [2]Lata Drum Heraun Radhakrishn Kahi Teraun,Raj Laptaoon Tan Mein Aur Sukh Paoon Man Mein. [3]Eho Radhavallabh Ju Tumahi Son Vinati Hai,Jaisen Banai Taisen Mohi Raakho Vrindavan Mein. [4]- Shri Chanda Lal Goswami, Abhilash BattisiCasting aside all pride of caste, creed, and lineage, I will daily bow before the lotus feet of the Rasika saints humbly. [1]I’ll wander lovingly through Seva Kuñj, Rās Maṇḍal, along the banks of Yamunā, Vāṁśī Vāṭ, Nidhivan, and Dheer Sameer. [2]While gazing at the holy trees and vines, I will cry out the names of Rādhā Kṛṣṇa, and as Vṛndāvan’s holy dust embraces my body, it shall awaken waves of bliss within me. [3]O Śrī Rādhāvallabh! With folded hands, I beg of You — please, by any means, always keep me in Vṛndāvan. [4]

title: Sahjo Sumiran Kijiye Hirday Maahin Duray - Sri Sahjobai
sanskrit_text: Sahjo Sumiran Kijiye, Hirday Maahin Duray.Hoth Hoth Sun Na Hile, Sake Nahin Koi Paay.- Sri SahjobaiOne should perform devotion to God silently and secretly through the mind. Neither the tongue nor the lips should move. It must be done in such a way that only the one remembering and the One being remembered (the Lord) are aware of it. If done to gain attention or display before the world, it loses its essence and sacredness.

title: Shri Vrishabhan Se Rane Jahaan - Shri Kishori Ali
sanskrit_text: Jo Pai Karama Hi Mere Bhari. Tau Radhe Sahivani Meri, Sahivi Kaha Tihari. Sharanagata Vapu Hota Alaukika, Kahata Purana Pukari. [1]Bara-bara Meri Vinati Suniye, Shrivrrishabhanu Dulari.Ali Kishori Kaum Kije Aba, Shrivana-raja Adhikari. [2]- Shri Kishori AliO my Queen, Shri Radhe! If ever I choose my will over Yours, then truly it would be my downfall — what greater foolishness could there be than abandoning Your command and following my mind’s dictate? The Purāṇas declare again and again: only the one who fully surrenders is eligible for your divine grace and becomes truly divine — no one else. [1]O Daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, Śrī Rādhe! Time and again, I offer this humble plea — kindly make me worthy of receiving the raja (dust) of Vṛndāvan. If it be Your will, grant me the fortune of residing in the holy land of Vrindavan, says Ali Kishori. [2]

title: Kirti Tapah Sthali, Khelan Van, Padar Van, Barsana
sanskrit_text: Kirti Mata Tapas Sthali, located in Barsana, is a highly sacred and divine place, where it is believed that Queen Kirti (mother of Shri Radha) performed intense penance to attain Shri Radha.This entire region is situated within Padar Van, where Shri Radharani arrives daily along with Her eight principal sakhis to engage in divine pastimes. This forest was abundant with padar (lotus) flowers, which Shri Radha would personally pick with her sakhis. Due to the abundance of these lotus flowers, the forest was named Padar Van, and it is counted among the 24 principal forests of Braj.There is a special tradition of the Sanjhi festival here. Shri Radharani Herself would create Sanjhi (rangoli made of flowers) and worship Shri Krishna through it. Once, Shri Krishna arrived here disguised as a Pandit, and Shri Radha worshipped Him by making a Sanjhi in His honor.The area adjacent to the temple is called Khelan Van because it is here that Shri Radharani, along with Her sakhis, used to play. Hence, it came to be known as Khelan Van. Even today, a swing remains in this forest, where Shri Radha and Shri Krishna swing together.Near the Tapasthali, there is a beautiful kund (pond), in front of which stands a temple of Mata Kirti, where She is seated with baby Shri Radha in Her lap. In the same area, there is also an ancient Shiva temple and a nearby Hanuman temple. According to the temple attendants, even today, during the night, the soft tinkling of anklets and the melodious sound of Krishna’s flute can be heard here.The entire region is covered with dense and enchanting trees. It is believed that these trees are from the era of Sri Radha and Krishna, embracing one another as if they are Shyama-Shyam themselves. Nearby, there is a cave where toys of baby Radha are preserved. Devotees joyfully offer their affection to the child form of Radha there.The atmosphere of this place is extremely peaceful and gentle. Various colorful birds and dancing peacocks enhance the charming spiritual ambiance of Braj. At the center of the Tapasthali is the Raas Sthali, where even today, devotees experience the divine Raas Leela of Shri Shyama Shyam during the night.Within Padar Van lies a beautiful water body called Kamal Kund, filled with blooming lotus flowers that are offered in the service of Shri Radharani. In ancient times, this area was known as Pavadi, from which the name Padar Van was derived.Location:Kirti Mata Tapas Sthali is situated in Padar Van in Barsana.

title: Radhabhaktapadambhoja - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (17)
sanskrit_text: Radhabhaktapadambhoja Dhulirdhaarya Svamauleena. Kimanyaih Sadhanaih Kimva Vairagyena Japaadibhih.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radha Siddhant (17)One should place the dust of the lotus feet of Shri Radharani’s exclusive devotees upon one’s head. What further need remains for disciplines like yama, niyama, renunciation, or even japa? The foot-dust of Swaminiji’s exclusive devotees is sufficient to grant the highest deliverance.

sanskrit_text: (Raag Kaanharo)Tehi Chhinu Brishbhanu-Kisori, Giridhar Piy Ke Man Budhi Harati. Jihi Chhinu Naval Vipin-Veethini Mahn,Ujhakati Too Abhisarati. title: Pal Bichhurein Na Kal Parein - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Utsah Sukh (37)
sanskrit_text: Pal Bichhurein Na Kal Parein, Dhare Rahain Rasadhaari.Sahaj Sanwaree Gori Yah, Jori Param Udaari.- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Utsah Sukh (37)The most enchanting and rapturous pair, the dark-complexioned Shyam and the fair-complexioned Radha, are supremely generous. title: Kim Karomi Kka Gachhami - Shri Hita Krishn Chandra, Shri Radha Upsudha Nidhi (43)

title: Swamini Tor Suhag Manaun - Sri Shyama Sakhi
sanskrit_text: Swamini Tor Suhag Manaun.Shrivrishbhan Dulari Sewa Jab-Jab Yahi Jag Aaun. [1]Atar Phulel Argaja Sundar Piy Pyari Ubtaun.Viri Saras Lagay Pavaun Ras Ke Bain Sunau. [2]Preetam So Nit Lad Ladaun Tahlani Hoy Apanaun.‘Shyama Sakhi’ Darbar Rahungi Junthan Aas Dharaun. [3]- Sri Shyama SakhiO Swāmini (Śrī Rādhe)! May I forever celebrate Your divine conjugal bliss. In every birth, O daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, may I receive the blessing of your selfless service. Wherever I am born in this world, may I serve You alone. [1]May I lovingly prepare fragrant ointments and perfumes and apply them to You and Your beloved. I shall offer you delightful pān (betel leaf) and speak to you love-filled words. [2]Every day, may I fondly serve You both in many playful ways. Śrī Shyāmā Sakhī says, “O Śrī Rādhe, may I always dwell in Your palace, sustained by the sweet hope of receiving Your remnants.” [3]

title: Shri Haridas Ananya Jai Jinkai Prem Pradhan - Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (31)

sanskrit_text: (Raag Peelu Trital)Shyama Ab To Rahyau Na Jaay.Pal-Pal Yaad Sataaye Tihaari, Sewakunj Man Bhaay. [1]Vrindavipin Nikunjan Maanhi, Charanan Raj Mil Jaay.Shrigopalhit Pran Jeevani, Bhule Nahin Bhulaay. [2]- Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (50)O Shyama (Radha), now I can no longer remain without You. Each moment is filled with the agony of your remembrance, and your eternal abode, Sevakunj, appears most enchanting to my heart. [1]May I dwell in the ever-new bowers (Nikunjas) of Vrindavan and receive the dust of Your lotus feet. O the very life-breath of Shri Hit Gopaldas Ji — You cannot be forgotten, even if one tries to forget. [2]

title: Maharaja Vrishbhanu Ko Barsano Sukhsaar - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Maharaja Vrishbhanu Kau, Barsaanau Sukhsaar.Arab Kharb Vaikunth Chhavi, Taapari Daarau Vaar.- Braj Ke DoheKing Vrishabhanu’s Barsana, the birthplace of Shri Radha, is the very essence of divine bliss. Billions and trillions of Vaikuntha abodes pale in comparison and could gladly be sacrificed upon it.

title: Mohi Bharoso Swami Ji Ko - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (127)
sanskrit_text: Mohi Bharoso Swami Ji Ko,Kari Hain Apno Aap Barobari, Praan Adhaar Hai Peeko. [1]Vishe Vaasna Jaari Kheh Kari, Upjai Hain Hit Neeko.Shri Rasik-Vihari Biharini Tan Man, Aur Lage Sab Feeko. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (127)I place my faith in Lalita incarnation, Swami Shri Haridasji. His compassion is such that whoever he blesses, he elevates them to his own status. That is, just as he serves Shri Priya-Priyatam, he bestows exactly the same privilege of seva upon his chosen recipients. The foundation of his very life is the eternal divine love-play (nitya-vihār) of the Yugal Jori. [1]He completely burns away all worldly desires from the heart of the seeker, and fills it instead with exclusive, selfless love for Shri Shyama-Kunjbihari. Shri Lalit Kishori Dev says — “When Swami Ji’s grace is received, the body, mind, and soul of the rasika become entirely immersed in Biharī-Bihārinī alone, and the rest of the world appears utterly tasteless.” [2]

title: Soi Poot Sapoot Hai Jo Bhakti Kare Chit Laay - Shri Malook Das
sanskrit_text: Soi Poot Sapoot Hai, Jo Bhakti Kare Chit Laay.Jara Maran Ten Chhooti Parai, Ajar Amar Hoi Jaay.- Shri Malook DasOnly that son is truly blessed and virtuous who engages His mind fully in devotion. Through such devotion, he transcends old age and death, attaining an eternal, immortal state.

title: Sun Barsane Vari Gulam Tero Banvari - Braj Ke Lokgeet
sanskrit_text: Sun Barsane Vari, Gulam Tero Banvari.Teri Paayaliya Pai Baaje Muraliya, Chham Chham Naache Murari. [1]Bade Bade Dev Dvarpe Thaadhe, Baat Taakat Giridhari.Vrindavan Ke Raja Hokar, Chhaachhpai Naache Murari. [2]Vrindavan Ki Kunj Galin Mein, Raas Rachyo Giridhari.Kadamb Ki Daarpai Jhoola Parayo Hai, Jhota Deve Bihari. [3]Bade Bade Nainnon Mein Jheena Jheena Kajara, Ghayal Kunjbihari.Barsane Ki Khor Saankri, Mangat Daan Bihari. [4]- Braj Ke LokgeetO one who resides in Barsana, Shri Radha, listen! Banwari Shri Krishna is truly Your servant.To the jingling of Your anklets, He plays His flute and dances in rhythm. [1]O Radhe! At Your doorway, even the heavenly gods stand in line, longing for a glimpse of You.Shri Krishna Himself waits eagerly for Your darshan — though King of Vrindavan, He dances before the gopis for just a sip of buttermilk. [2]Giridhari Krishna performs Maharaas in the lanes of Vrindavan.Upon a kadamba branch hangs Your divine seat, and Krishna lovingly swings You there. [3]O Shri Radhe! Seeing the fine line of kohl in Your large eyes, Kunjbihari is pierced with love.In the narrow lanes of Barsana (Sankhari Khor), Krishna begs tax from the gopis — thus, they call Him Daan Bihari. [4]

title: Vrindavan Mahima Amit Varani Sakai Nahin Koy - Braj Ke Dohe
sanskrit_text: Vrindavan Mahima Amit, Varani Sakai Nahin Koy. Dar Paat Jahan Sabani Mah, Shriradhe Radhe Hoy.- Braj Ke DoheThe glory of Vrindavan is immeasurable, no one can truly describe it. On every branch and leaf there, the divine name Shri “Radhe Radhe” emanates.

title: Jug Beet Gaye Bichhure Se Mile – Shri Dhruv Ali Sharan Ji (Vrindavan)
sanskrit_text: (Savaiya)Jug Beet Gaye Bichhure Se Mile, Din Yon Hi Gaye Sab Thallav Ke. [1] Apanon–Apanon Sabahin Ne Kahyo, Sapanon So Bhayo Sab Gallabh Ke. [2]Abaki Bani Baanik Khoob Gayau, Sharnagat Shri Pad Pallabh Ke. [3]‘Dhruv’ Dhany Bhayo Brajvasin Ke, Mukh Te Sun Radhikavalabh Ke.[4]- Shri Dhruv Ali Sharan Ji (Vrindavan)O Lord (Śrī Rādhā Kṛṣṇa), countless ages have passed since separation from You—the days have slipped by in fruitless wandering. [1]All who claimed to be "mine" turned out to be false like fleeting dreams, their promises nothing but hollow words. [2]But this time, fortune favored me—I have come into the shelter of Your lotus feet. [3]Dhruv Alī Śaraṇ says he is truly blessed to have heard the glories of Śrī Rādhikā Vallabha from the mouths of the Brajavāsīs (residents of Braj). [4]

title: Shri Vrindavan Ke Daras Te - Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (71)
sanskrit_text: Shri Vrindavan Ke Daras Te, Bhaye Jeev Anukool.Bhavsagar Athaah Jal, Utaran Ko Yah Tool.- Goswami Shri Hariray Ji, Vallabh Saakhi (71)Through the darshan of Shri Vrindavan Dham, the soul becomes favorably inclined toward the divine path of God. The world is like an infinite ocean, and Shri Vrindavan is the supreme means of deliverance.

title: Yah Gati Nanchi-Nanchi Layi - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani
sanskrit_text: Yah Gati Nanchi-Nanchi Layi.Vrindavanmein Raas-Vilas, Sukh Baadhat Sayi. [1]Bhanti-Bhanti Raag Gavat, Sur Alaapat Kayi.Urap-Tirap Maan Let, Tata - Tat - Thayi. [2] Syam Sundar Karat Krida, Prem-Chhata Chhayi.Kumbhandas Prabhu Giradhar, Chhinu-Chhinu Preeti Nayi. [3]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki VaniI have attained this state of divine love through dancing. In Vrindavan’s rasa play, bliss is ever-increasing. [1]The sakhis sing sweetly in various ragas, gracefully performing musical notes (alap). The divine couple, Shri Shyama-Shyam, synchronize their dance movements to these melodies. The rhythmic syllables “tat-tat-thei”, uttered by the sakhis, add graceful momentum to the dance. [2]Shri Shyamsundar engages in playful pastimes, immersing the entire atmosphere in the colors of divine love. Shri Kumbhandas says, Lord Giridhar Lal showers fresh waves of love with every passing moment. [3]

title: Sakhi Sundar Syam Salauna - Shri Lalit Madhuri
sanskrit_text: Sakhi Sundar Syam Salauna.Koyan Chitai Bihansi Muskanyau, Chitvanmein Kachhu Kar Gayo Tona. [1]Jab Te Dekhi “Lalit Madhuri”, Sab Ras Lagat Alona.Man To Ab Chitachor Son Atakyo, Honi Hoy So Hona. [2]- Shri Lalit MadhuriO friend! Beautiful is that charming Shyamsundara. He glanced with a gentle smile — it felt as if His eyes cast a spell. [1]Shri Lalit Madhuri Ji says, "Since the moment I beheld the incomparable beauty of Shri Krishna, all worldly pleasures have lost their charm. My heart is forever bound to the heart-stealer, Shri Shyamsundar — whatever is meant to happen, let it be." [2]

title: Jog Jagya Jap Tap Barat - Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)
sanskrit_text: Jog Jagya Jap Tap Barat, Teerath Nem Achaar.Chaar Bed Shat Shaastra Prabhu, Tum Kirpa Ki Laar.- Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)One may perform yoga, sacrifices, japa, penance, vows, and pilgrimages, follow discipline and good conduct, and even master the four Vedas and six scriptures—yet, O Lord, without Your grace, nothing is truly fruitful.

title: Tiharo Mohi Bal Vrishbhanu Dulari - Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
sanskrit_text: (Raag Paraj)Tiharo Mohi Bal Vrishbhanu Dulari. Yadyapi Hoon Gunheen Deen Main, Tadyapi Sharan Tumhari. [1]Asharan Sharan Adham Uddhaaran, Virad Raavaro Bhaari.Yaahi Ke Vishvas Bharose, Jeevat Jakt Manjhaari. [2]Nissadhan Sharnagat Paalak, Ho Swamini Hamaari.‘Sarasmadhuri’ Si Bahu Sahachari, Bhavsagar Son Taari. [3]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Daughter of Vrishabhanu, O Shri Radha! You are my only strength. Though I am devoid of all virtues and utterly destitute, I still seek shelter at Your feet alone. [1]You are the refuge of the refuge-less, the deliverer of the downtrodden. title: Saadhan Dharm Na Bhatakna - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Ras Siddhant (6)
sanskrit_text: Saadhan Dharm Na Bhatakna, Ant Na Paave Koy.Shyama Ju Ki Kripa Saun, Jo Kachhu Hoy So Hoy.- Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri, Shri Radha Ras Siddhant (6)No matter how many rituals, righteous acts, or spiritual practices a soul may perform, its wandering never ends, nor can it attain the ultimate goal. title: Mam Vinay Karuna Dham Shyama Shyam - Shri Sanket Ali, Sanket Lata (888)
sanskrit_text: Mam Vinay Karuna Dham Shyama Shyam Yah Suni Leejiyai.Nit Baas Vrindavipin Me Dridh Sang Rasikan Deejiyai. title: Kripa-Kripa Sabahi Kahain Kripa Patra Nahin Koy - Shri Ladalidas
sanskrit_text: Kripa-Kripa Sabahi Kahain, Kripa Patra Nahin Koy.Kripa Patra So Jaaniye, Jo Agyavarti Hoy.- Shri LadalidasEveryone speaks of grace, but rarely is there a true disciple who is worthy of receiving it. The one truly worthy is he who sincerely follows the instructions of his Guru.

title: Jab Son Nihaarau Roop - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (4)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jab Son Nihaarau Roop Baarau Nand Kau Dularau,Tab Ten Hamaari Kul Kaan Baani Sataki. [1]Mand Mand Aavan Ki Pat Phaharavan Ki,Lalit Rasili Chhabi Madhuri Lakut Ki. [2]Lal Balbir Ju Ki Bansuri Bajaavan Ki, Drigan Milavan Ki Bhrikuti Bikat Ki. [3]Mand Musikyavan Ki Jheenain Sur Gaavan Ki,Basi Chhabi Aan Ur Mor Ke Mukat Ki. [4]- Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (4)From the moment I beheld the divine beauty of Nanda’s beloved son, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, worldly decorum, family pride, and social honor all slipped away from me. [1]With the gentle approach of Kṛṣṇa’s footsteps, the fluttering of His yellow garments, His incomparable beauty, and the tender charm of His stick, my heart was captured. [2]Śrī Lāl Balbir says — the sweet melody of His flute, the playful glance of His eyes, and the dancing play of His brows have utterly enchanted me. [3]His tender smile, His soft and sweet singing, and the sight of His peacock feather crown are forever etched into my heart. [4]

title: Uttam Kare So Ladili - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (107)
sanskrit_text: Uttam Karai So Ladili, Madhyam Ham Saun Hoi.Ihi Baat Nishchay Kari, Hari Ke Pyare Soi.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (107)Whatever Shri Radha does is perfect and for the highest welfare of the soul, while we, with our limited intellect, are capable only of average or selfish acts. The one who realizes this truth in every circumstance and makes Shri Radha’s wish his own in complete surrender becomes truly dear to Shri Hari.
