title: Eti Kripa Swamini Man Chahai - Shri Lalit Viharini Ji
sanskrit_text: Eti Kripa Swamini Man Chahai.Parninda Abhiman Eershya, Bhed Bhavana Rahe Na Jahai. [1]Mo Se Adham Udhare Lakhana, Jor Padyau Swamini! Kachhu Naahi.‘Lalitviharini’ Ju Karunanidhi, Puni Sankoch Karo Man Kahai. [2]- Shri Lalit Viharini JiO Swamini Ji (Shri Radha), please grant me such grace so that all material afflictions such as censuring, fault-finding, pride, envy, and discrimination—are completely eradicated from my heart. [1]You have uplifted countless souls more fallen than me. Please extend your mercy to me as well, for I lack the strength to overcome on my own. Shri Lalit Viharini Ji says, ‘O Radha, delighting in the beautiful bowers! You are an ocean of compassion, so why hesitate to show mercy to me?’ [2]

title: Shaak Paat Va Kand Phal - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (6)
sanskrit_text: Shaak Paat Va Kand Phal, Jo Kachu Mile Ahaar.Vrindavan Nahin Chhodiye, Surasthal Yugal Vihaar.- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Madhurya Ras Dohavali (6)Be content with whatever sustenance is available, be it vegetables, leaves, roots, or fruits. However, one should never abandon Shri Vrindavan Dham, the sacred realm of the eternal love plays of the divine couple, Sri Radha Krishna, for residing in Vrindavan holds unparalleled glory.

title: Prem Katari Hansi Hansi Maari - Shri Guru Chhauna Ji Maharaj
sanskrit_text: Prem Katari Hansi Hansi Maari, Mohan Meet Hamare. [1]Bheetar Baahar Tan Man Chedo, Niksi Paile Paare. [2]Ghayal Pari Kasak Jiya Maahin, Darshan Aushad Deeje. [3]‘Sakhichhona’ Vyakul Bhare Aansu, Tum Bin Nahin Pateejai. [4]- Shri Guruchauna Ji Maharaj, Virah Ki Maanjh (3)With a mischievous smile, my beloved Mohan (Krishna) has pierced me with the dagger of love. [1]Both inside and out, my body and mind are deeply wounded, as the dagger has pierced through to the other side. [2]Lying wounded, the pain in my heart can only be soothed by the medicine of Shri Krishna’s divine darshan. [3]Shri Guruchhona Ji says, ‘Now I shed tears in anguish, for without Mohan, my heart finds no peace anywhere.’ [4]

[3]Shri Guruchhona Ji says, ‘Now I shed tears in anguish, for without Mohan, my heart finds no peace anywhere.’ [4]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

sanskrit_text: Braja Ke Param Sanehi Log.Gaari Dain Hanshi Milat Ghahbare, Antar Prem Samyog. [1]Prem Roop Ras Dampati Leela, Yah Tinkau Nit Bhog.‘Nagaridas’ Sada Anandi, Supne Hoon Nahin Sok. [2]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Chootak Pad (2)The people of Braj are filled with boundless love. title: Preetam Ke Praan Pyari - Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (37)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Eman)Preetam Ke Praan Pyari, Pyari Ji Ke Praan Piy.Prem Rasi Ek Ras, Doo Chhavi Dekhihin. [1]Tripit Na Hot Kyon Hoon, Badhat Adhik Ruchi,Chhin-Chhin Chomp Nai Laagai Nain Na Nimeshin. [2]Reejhi-Reejhi Rang-Bhare Umagi Loin Dhare,Ank-Ank Rahe Bharivhas Visheshin. [3]‘Hit Dhruv’ Yah Gati Heri Kain Magan Bhain,Sakhi Sab Aisain Rahi Mano Chitra Rekh Hin. [4]- Shri Hita Dhruvdas, Bayalees Leela, Padyavali (37)Shri Radha is the very life of Shri Krishna, and Shri Krishna is the very life of Shri Radha. This treasure of love, the divine couple, gazes continuously at each other’s enchanting form, yet they never feel satisfied; their longing only deepens. [1]New waves of divine love arise every moment from each other’s beauty, keeping their eyelids from ever closing. Their joy-filled eyes, overwhelmed with love, overflow with tears of love. Completely enchanted by rasa, they lovingly embrace each other again and again. Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji says that seeing the couple in such a state of love-filled ecstasy, the sakhis, immersed in divine bliss, stand spellbound as if they were lines drawn in an eternal painting. [2]

sanskrit_text: mūrata naiṃnana meṃ ramai, hiya mathi guna rahai pūridaśā na koū samajhi hai, prema pahucanau dūri- Shri Neh Nagridas Ji, Shri Neh Nagridas Ji Ki Vani, Dohavali (23)The form of the beloved resides in the eyes, and the heart remains filled with their virtues. title: Uddhav Aadi Brahmaadik Durlabh - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Kavitt-Sewaiya (61)
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Uddhav Aadi Brahmaadik Durlabh, Paree Pramaan Juhee Suk Bhaakhee.Jaako Sujas Bakhaanat Shreemukh, Syaamaa Syaam Sahasmukh Saakhee. [1]Shree Bihareedaas Viswaas Tihiin Bal, Umandi MaiND Marjaadaa Naankhee.Rahyau Na Man Bhai Bhram Kram Shram Kachhu, Braj Raj Kaaj Kiyo Raj Raakhee. [2]- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Kavitt-Sewaiya (61)Describing the significance of Braj Rāj (the sacred sand of Braj), Śrī Śukadeva Paramhaṃsa Jī states that even great personalities like Uddhava and Lord Brahmā consider it a rare treasure. The divine couple, Śrī Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa, themselves have glorified this Braj Rāj through Their divine words, with Śrī Śeṣa Jī bearing witness to its greatness. [1]Śrī Bihārin Deva says that relying on its strength, we have cast aside all societal norms and broken every boundary with joy. Fear, doubt, labor, and rules have been eliminated from our hearts, and this divine sand has fulfilled our every desire. That is why we constantly place this sacred Braj Rāj upon our foreheads. [2]

sanskrit_text: Jaisi Ekta Priya Ki, Aisi Kare Na Koi.Tan Man Bachanani Chitt Mein, Rom Rom Rahi Bhoi.- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Vishistha Pada & Saakhi (108)No one shares the oneness (closeness) with me that my beloved Priyaji (Sri Radha) does. title: Swarg Mein Kahaan Hai Madhur Dhvani Radhe Radhe Ki - Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati, Vrindavan Shatak (12)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Swarg Mein Kahaan Hai Madhur Dhvani Radhe Radhe Ki,Swarg Mein Kahaan Kalit Kunj Abhiraam Hai. [1]Swarg Mein Kahaan Bheer Gopi Gaay Gwaal Waale Ki,Swarg Mein Kahaan Pulin Yamuna Lalaam Hai. [2]Swarg Mein Saras Braj Bhasha Ka Prachaar Kahaan,Swarg Mein Kahaan Makhhan Chor Ghanashyam Hai. [3]Swarg Mein Amit Sukh Itna Aapaar Kahaan,Swarg Se Bhi Shreshth Yah Vrindavan Dhaam Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (12)Where can one hear the sweet melody of ‘Rādhe Rādhe’ in heaven?Where in heaven are those enchanting bowers and forests? [1]Where can one see the crowds of gopīs, cows, and cowherds in heaven?Where in heaven are the beautiful banks of the Yamunā? [2]Where in heaven is such a sweet and nectar‑like Brajbhāṣā spoken?Where in heaven can one find the butter‑thief (Ghanshyām) Śrī Kṛṣṇa? [3]Where in heaven is such infinite and unparalleled bliss found?Ḍaṃḍī Swāmī Śrī Hare Krishṇānand Saraswatī Jī says that this Vṛndāvan Dham is far superior to heaven itself. [4]

sanskrit_text: mathurāṃ mathurā-nātho vāsudevo jagāma haantarhite nanda-sute śrīmad-vṛndāvane mune- Sanat Kumar Samhita (36.306)Lord Shiva says to Narada - O sage, it is the Lord who is the son of Vasudeva and the king of Mathura who goes to Mathura. title: Tere Tan Ki Upma Kaun Dekhyo - Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (168)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vilawal)Tere Tan Ki Upma Kaun DekhyoMain Vichar Ke Kaun Nahiin Bhamini. [1]Kaha Baparo Kanchan, Kadali, Kaha Keheri, Gaj,Kapot, Kumbh, Pik Kaha Chandrama Kaha Vapuri Damini? [2]Kaha Kurang, Suk, Bandhuk, Keki, Kamal Ya AageShri Dekhiye Sab Ki Nikhamini. [3]Mohan Rasik Giri-Dharan Kahat ‘Radhe’!Param Bhavanti Tu Hai ‘Kumbhandas’ Swamini. [4]- Shri Kumbhandas, Shri Kumbhandas Ji Ki Vani (168)Shri Krishna says to Shri Radha:O Bhāminī (beautiful lady), I ponder deeply, yet cannot find any suitable comparison for your divine form. [1]Neither gold, nor banana trees, the lion, the elephant, the dove, the pitcher, the cuckoo, the moon, nor lightning can match your radiance. [2]How can the deer, the parrot, the bandhuka flower, the peacock, or the lotus even compare to your divine splendor? They seem insignificant in comparison. [3]The enchanter of hearts, Rasika Manmohana, the lifter of Giriraj mountain, Shri Krishna, says: “O Kumbhandasa’s Swamini Radhe! You are supremely pleasing to me.” [4]

title: Soi Neh Nandlal Mein Prakati Na Pavein Jaan - Shri Dayaram Ji
sanskrit_text: Soi Neh Nandlal Mein, Prakati Na Pavein Jaan.Jas Asi Surachitra Kon, Anchyo Hoi Na Myan.- Shri Dayaram JiJust as the sword in the hands of a warrior depicted in a painting remains forever drawn and never returns to its sheath, similarly, one’s love for Nandalal (Shri Krishna) should be such that, once manifested, it should remain steadfast and never fade.

title: Biharini Binti Yah Sun Lijiye- Shri Saras Madhuri Ji
sanskrit_text: (Raag Bilawal)Biharini Binti Yah Sun Lijiye.Tuv Mukh Anandakand Chandr Ki, Mohi Chakori Kijiye. [1]Chhin-Chhin Chhata Lakhun Chabirashi, Nain Nirakh Nit Jeejiye.Saras Madhuri Suno Swamini, Darshan Ki Nidhi Dijiye. [2]- Shri Saras MadhuriO Nitya Biharini (Shri Radha)! Please listen to my humble plea. Grant me the fortune to forever remain as a chakori bird, captivated by the moon-like radiance of your blissful face. title: Munin Ke Vrindan Ke Vrinda Sada - Shri Lal Balbir Ji, Sri Radha Shatak (18)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Munin Ke Vrindan Ke Vrind Sada Vande Tumhe,Anand Ke Kande Nandanandai Sang Lijiye. [1]Teen Lok Jeevan Ke Sokan Ki Harn,Prasanna Mukh Pankaj Son Charan Saran Dijiye. [2]Nikunj Bhu Vilasini Prakashani Hau Gyan Ki,Vijendra Bhan Nandani Araj Suni Lijiye. [3]Kahat Bar Bar Main Tihare Darbar Mein,‘Sulal Balbir’ Pai Kripa Kataksh Kijiye. [3]Śrī Lāl Balbir says, “I repeatedly offer my plea to Your court — cast Your merciful glance upon me”. [4]

title: Kim Dharmena Mamasti Kryamiha - Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (42)
sanskrit_text: kiṃ dharmeṇa mamāsti kṛtyamiha kiṃ yogena kiṃ sadguṇaiḥkiṃ me brahmamukhena kiṃ murāripordhyānādhināpyadya caśrīvṛndāvipineśvarīsarasikāgarveṇa na kvāpi mecittaṃ kuṇḍarasāmṛtāmbuddhi bhṛtaṃ sajjītyatīvonmadama- Shri Govardhan Bhatt, Shri Radhakund Stava (42)What worth do rituals or religious practices hold for me now? Even yoga, disciplines, and virtues seem futile. My heart does not crave even the bliss of ‘Brahmanand’ (bliss of an impersonal form of God), nor can meditation on Murari (Shri Krishna) fulfill my yearning. My mind, absorbed in the pride and glory of the Queen of Vrindavan’s sacred lake (Shri Radha Kund), cannot stray elsewhere. It is so thoroughly intoxicated that it continually drinks nectar from the ocean of nectar that is Radha Kund.

title: Kari Ken Aas Ju Aur Ki - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (71)
sanskrit_text: (Doha)Kari Ken Aas Ju Aur Ki, Takata Na It Ut Hoy.Tuv Pad Parchhaahi Bina, Nahin Bhaavat Man Koy.(Pad)Shri Radhe! Toh Pad Pankaj Ki Parchhaahi Rihat Sadaa Man Mero.Kariken Aas Aur It Utki Takata Na Daahin Derou. [1]Sakal Lok Sukh-Sampatti Kau Sukh Nahin Suhaavat Nerou.Shri Hari Priya Nirantar Rasnaa Ratat Naam Nit Tero. [2]- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (71)Shri Lal Ji (Shri Krishna) is now restless, says -(Doha)O Beloved (Shri Radha), my mind does not wander here or there, leaving the hope of your lotus feet.  Beyond the shade of your lotus-feet, nothing else in this universe brings me peace.(Pad)My mind forever rests in the shadow of your lotus feet, abandoning all other hopes or desires. [1]Even the joys of all the fourteen worlds and the transcendental realms like Vaikuntha cannot match the bliss found beneath the shadow of your lotus feet. O Beloved Swamini (protectress) of Shri Hari, my tongue continuously chants your name, desiring nothing but the eternal shade of your lotus feet. [2]

title: Aisa Sumiran Keejiye Sahaj Rahai Lau Laay - Sri Sahjobai
sanskrit_text: Aisa Sumiran Keejiye, Sahaj Rahai Lau Laay.Binu Jibhya Binu Taaluai, Antar Surat Lagay.- Sri SahjobaiEngage in such remembrance (of the Lord) that your focus always remains effortlessly steady. title: Aaju Nikunj Mahal Mein Gavat - Shri Ichcha Sakhi Ji
sanskrit_text: Aaju Nikunj Mahal Mein Gavat, Priyalal Dou Rangbhine. [1]Baaje Sab Mil Bajat Madhur Gati, Mohan Alap Kahen Sur Jheene. [2]Raag-Ragini Moorti Dharikai, Chakit Bhaye Maanau Likhi Deene. [3]‘Ichchha Sakhi’ Nirikh Ya Chhavi Kaun, Pran Waari Nyauchhaavar Keene. [4]- Shri Ichcha Sakhi JiIn the enchanting bower palace today, Sri Radha and Krishna sing together, immersed in divine love. [1]Sahcharis are playing instruments in perfect harmony with the rhythm, as soft notes and refined alaps of Priya Priyatam captivate the heart. [2]The personified forms of ragas and raginis stand mesmerized as if destiny itself had created this magical moment. [3]Ichcha Sakhi ji, beholding this captivating vision, sacrifices her very life in complete devotion. [4]

title: Tuhi Ek Radha Kunwar Drig Darshat Nahin Aur - Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (6)
sanskrit_text: Tuhi Ek Radha Kunwar, Drig Darshat Nahin Aur.Yehai Jaan Hum Bhajti Hain, Aho Rasik Sirmour.- Shri Vanshi Ali, Sri Radhika Maharas, Doha (6)You alone are my life, O eternally youthful, Radha, and my eyes seek no other vision but yours. title: Kripa Karo Ab Naval Naveli - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (34)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Durga Tritaal)Kripa Karo Ab Naval Naveli.Sevakunj-Nikunj Bhavan Ki, Lata Phool Banun Veli.Chhaki Rahun Ras Mati Nit Hi, Chhado Nanhi Akeli.Shri Gopalhit Hari Swamini, Jaise Phool Chameli. - Shri Hita Gopal Das [Of Sewa Kunj], Nikunj Ras Vallari (34)O ever-youthful Shri Radha! Please bestow your grace upon me so that I may become a vine, a flower, or a creeper in the Sevakunj (Nikunj forest). [1]May I always remain immersed in your divine nectar. Please don't leave me alone; let me always stay in your close proximity. Shri Hit Gopal Das Ji says, ‘O protectress of Shri Hari (Shri Radha), you are as radiant and pure as a jasmine flower.’ [2]

title: Nirakh Nirakh Shobha Harsh - Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Maan Leela Dohavali (93)
sanskrit_text: Nirakh Nirakh Shobha Harsh, Piy Hiy Hot Apaar.Darad Darad Binti Karat, Jai Shri Rajkumar.- Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Maan Leela Dohavali (93)Shri Krishna’s heart overflows with joy at the sight of Shri Radha’s resplendent form. title: राधा राधा रटत ही मिट जाती सब बाधा
sanskrit_text:
"राधा राधा रटत ही मिट जाती सब बाधा"

केवल श्री राधा नाम लेने से ही समस्त बाधाएं मिट जाती हैं और अनंत कोटि जन्मों की आपदाएं श्री राधा नाम से चली जाती हैं।
english_text: "radha radha ratat hi mit jati sab badha" keval shri radha nam lene se hi samast badhaen mit jati hain aur annt koti janmon ki apadaen shri radha nam se chali jati hain.

author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Nachat Dou Rahas Mein Rang Bhine - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (11.1)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Kedarau)Nachat Dou Rahas Mein Rang-Bhinain.Haav-Bhaav Upajat Ang-Angan, Kok-Kala Man Deenain. [1]Bajat Madhur Mridang Kinkini, Noopur Taal Nabeenain.Hoda-Hodi Taan, Tirap-Gati Let, Nahi Kou Heenain. [2]Raka-Rati, Rajanikar-Anan Udit Madan Bas Keenain.Reejhi-Reejhi Bhagwat Ki Swamini, Laal Ank Bhari Leenain. [3]- Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik Ki Vani, Ananyarasikabharan Granth (11.1)Completely immersed in the ecstasy of divine love, the divine couple (Sri Radha Krishna) are dancing together in a secluded place. Engrossed in ever-new expressions of amorous pastimes, their every movement emits countless charming gestures and moods. [1]The enchanting mridang of ‘Nitya Vihara’ beats in perfect harmony, complemented by the soft jingles of their waistbands and anklets. The divine couple engage in a playful competition of melodic expressions and intricate dance rhythms, with neither falling short of the other. [2]At that moment, the full moon, glowing like the face of Rati (the goddess of love) in the night sky, rose to witness the scene and handed them over to the care of Kamadeva (the god of love). It was then that Bhagavata Rasik Ji’s Swamini Sri Radha was pleased, and embraced Lal Ji (Sri Krishn) lovingly within her tender arms. [3]

The divine couple engage in a playful competition of melodic expressions and intricate dance rhythms, with neither falling short of the other. [2]At that moment, the full mun, glowing like the face of Rati (the goddess of love) in the night sky, rose to witness the scene and handed them over to the care of Kamadeva (the god of love). It was then that Bhagavata Rasik Ji’s Swamini Sri Radha was pleased, and embraced Lal Ji (Sri Krishn) lovingly within her tender arms. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: Aarti Bhanu Dulari Ki - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj
sanskrit_text: āratī bhānu dulārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kīvirājeṃ siṃhāsana śyāmā, divya śrī vṛndāvana dhāmā,ḍhurāvaiṃ caṅvara sughara bāmā, paloṭaiṃ paga pūrana kāmālalī paga aṃka cāpi ni:śaṃka, śyāma janu raṃka,pāya nidhi pārasa pyārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (1)I perform the aarti of Barsane wari Radhey, the loving daughter of King Brishbhanu.She is seated on a golden throne adorned with jewels, in the divine abode of Vrindavan,Beautiful maidens are gently fanning Her with the chanwar (fly-whisk), and self-complacent absolute brahm, Shri Krishna, is pressing Her lotus feet.Holding Her feet in His lap, and pressing them with great care, He is doing this unhesitatingly with no fear of anyone's opinion, as if lost in the ecstasy of a pauper who has found a touchstone. [1]gaura sira kanaka mukuṭa rājaiṃ, candrikā cāru suchabi chājaiṃ,kuṭila kuntala ali bhala bhrājaiṃ, lakhata jehi śikhikalāpa lājaiṃmāṅga sindūra, motiyana pūra, sajīvani mūra,brahma govardhana dhārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (2)Her fair face is decorated with a gold crown and a beautiful chandrika,With the charming beauty of Kishoriji’s black and curly hair abashing the beauty of Shri Krishna’s peacock feather decorated on His head.The parting in Her hair is decorated with sindura and strings of pearls. Kishori Ji is the soul treasure of the Supreme Lord, Shri Krishna, the lifter of the Govardhana Mountain. [2]śravaṇa vica karaṇa phūla jhalakaiṃ, nāsikā vica besara halakaiṃ,nayana vica premasudhā chalakaiṃ, bandhu bala ke lakhi lakhi lalakaiṃcapala natha camaka, dasanaduti damaka, sumukhimukha ramaka,madhura musakina sukumārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (3)The lovely pendants of Her ears sparkle brightly, and the elegance of Her swaying nose pearl enchants all,Her eyes overflow with divine love, releasing such an intense nectar that ignites an ardent yearning in Sri Krishna, Balram’s brother.Her swaying nose-ring shimmers, the whiteness of Her teeth glistens and her radiant smile together make Her face indescribably beautiful and enchanting. [3]motiyana lara uramaṇimālā, cibuka jhalakata ika tila kālā,śambhu śuka daiṃ saṃga karatālā, lalī guṇa gāvati brajabālākabahuṅ mukha murani, kabahuṅ dṛga durani, kabahuṅ dṛga jurani,kabahuṅ sudhi bhurani vihārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (4)Her bosom is decorated with strands of pearls and jewelled necklaces, while a charming beauty spot adorns Her chin.Great paramahamsas like Lord Shankara and Shukadeva clap their hands joyfully as the maidens of Braja sing Her glories.Sometimes She turns Her face away from Shyamasundara, sometimes out of shyness, She averts Her eyes, and at other times, She casts a flirtatious glance in His direction, causing Shyamasundara to nearly lose consciousness with joy. [4]kinārina jarina nīla sārī, kaṃcukī kumakuma raṃga vārī,curī kara kaṃkana manahārī, chīna kaṭi kiṃkinī chavi nyārīpāyalani pagani, mahāvari lagani, bīchuvani nagani,'kṛpālu' sukīrti - kumārī kī, ki śrī barasāne vārī kī āratī (5)She is wearing a blue saree with a golden border, and the rosy pink blouse on Her body is charming.The elegance of fancy bracelets and bangles on Her hands is fascinating, and the beauty of the ornate waistband on Her thin waist is heart-captivating.She is wearing anklets, and Her lotus feet are decorated with mahavar (red color), while Her toes are adorned with delicate diamond toe rings.In this way, Kirti Kumari Radhey, beautifully dressed and adorned, sits on the golden throne as the maidens perform the aarti. [5]

title: Shri Guru Sandhi Subhav Na Paavat - Shri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (11)
sanskrit_text: Shri Guru Sandhi Subhav Na Paavat, Gaavat Jag Jas Dhuta.Bina Ananya Vihara Chahat, Kyon Paavhuge Puta.- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Saakhi (11)Without comprehending the principle and nature of Swami Sri Haridas, the bestower of supremely divine Nitya Vihara nectar, deceitful people merely sing praises of worldly fame. How can one attain this eternal rasa of the divine couple without firm and exclusive devotion?

title: Aj Bishnu, Mahesh, Brajesh, Shri - Shri Prem Ji
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Aj Bishnu, Mahesh, Brajesh, Shri, Nahin Paavat Paar Bade Adhikari. [1]Jag Jaal Jaadyau Jab Jeev Japai, Kare Sukkh Pradatt Shrikunjbihari. [2]Nity Bihar Bileen Chhabili Lai, Dhyavat Shri Haridas Dulari. [3]Tihaari Archana Prem Pujari Karen, Hiye Manhi Bithakar Bankebihari. [4]- Shri Prem JiEven the greatest personalities like Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, Brajeśvara Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and Goddess Lakṣmī remain unable to comprehend the infinite glory of Śrī Kuñjabihārī and Śrī Kuñjabihāriṇī, who are ever immersed in the eternal Nitya Vihāra rasa. [1]For the soul lost in the illusions of the material world, the mere remembrance of Their sacred names brings liberation from Māyā and bestows infinite bliss. [2]Śrī Kuñjabihārī eternally enjoys the divine Nitya Vihāra rasa with His beloved Śrī Kuñjabihāriṇī, who remains the constant focus of Śrī Haridāsa Jī’s meditation. [3]Śrī Prema Jī declares, "Only rasika devotees, filled with pure love, can truly keep Śrī Baṅke Bihārī enshrined in their hearts." [4]

title: Ardhon Milita Lochanasya - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.35)
sanskrit_text: ardhonmīlitalochanasya pibato rādeti nāmāmṛtam premāśrūṇi vimuñcataḥ pulakitāṁ sarvāṁ tanuṁ bibhṛtaḥ.kutrāpi skhalataḥ kvacicca patato vṛndāṭavīvīthiṣu svacchandaṁ vrajataḥ kadātisukhadā yāsyanti me vāsarāḥ.- Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Saptashati (5.35)With half-closed eyes, May I chant “Shri Radhe! Shri Radhe!” overflowing with nectar.With my eyes flowing with tears of love, may my entire body shiver in blissful ecstasy.Stumbling, falling, and losing all awareness, I may wander freely through the lanes of Shri Vrindavan.When will such days of divine bliss arrive for me?

title: Aao Pyare Hridaysadan Mein - Shri Yugal Priya
sanskrit_text: (Raag Peelu-Taal Kaharva)Aao Pyare Hridaysadan Mein,Pal Kapaat Dai Raakhungi. [1]Jaan Liye Chhal-Chhand-Phand SabAb Na Chalai Satya Bhaakhungi. [2]Karihai Jo Koi Vighan MilanmeinTaake Sab Kal-Bal Naakhungi. [3]Jugalpriya Manmohan Tumharau,Dragbhari Roopsudha Chaakhungi. [4]- Shri Yugal PriyaO Beloved,  step into the temple of my heart, where I shall forever keep you inside. [1]Having seen through all allure and false charms, I now declare that no deception of yours can distract me anymore. [2]If any obstacle dares to arise in our union, I shall overcome it with steadfast determination. [3]Sri Jugal Priya says, “O beloved Manmohan, I long to immerse myself in the nectar of your divine beauty.” [4]

title: Gaanthi Satt Kupeen Mein Sada Phire Nissank - Shri Malook Das
sanskrit_text: Gaanthi Satt Kupeen Mein, Sada Phire Nissank.Naam Amal Mata Rahai, Ginai Indra Ko Rank.- Shri Malook DasEven with a loincloth tied in seven knots, he roams fearlessly, perpetually immersed in the nectar of Shri Hari’s divine name. For such a great soul, even Indra, the ruler of heaven, seems no more than a beggar.

title: Paudhe Mai Laalan Girivardhari - Shri Chhit Swami, Shri Chhit Swami Ji Ki Vani (159)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Vihagaro)Paudhe Mai ? Laalan Girivardhari.Kunj-Mahal Mein Kusum-Sej Par Sohati Sang Radhika Piyari. [1]Kanth Laagi Bhuj Diyein Sirhanein Adbhut Chhabi Laagat Ati Bhaari.Maanon Mili Rahi Damini Ghan Son ‘Chhit-Swami' Bhari Laee Ankavaari. [2]- Shri Chhit Swami, Shri Chhit Swami Ji Ki Vani (159)O friend, within the enchanting bower-palace, on a bed adorned with fragrant flowers, rests the glorious Shri Krishna, while beside Him, the supremely captivating Shri Radha Pyari gracefully rests. [1]With His arm tenderly placed beneath Shri Radha’s head, Shri Krishna draws her close to His heart. The splendor of this divine moment defies all description. Shri Chhit Swami beautifully compares it to lightning embracing a dark cloud as Shri Radha rests in Shri Shyamsundar’s loving embrace. [2]

title: Pai Mithas Ya Maar Ke Rom-Rom Bharpoor - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (30)
sanskrit_text: Pai Mithas Ya Maar Ke, Rom-Rom Bharpoor.Marat Jiyai Jhukatau Thirai, Banai Su Chaknachoor.- Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (30)The wound of love is deep, yet sweet, filling the heart with boundless nectar. Only those who sacrifice themselves to love achieve immortality. Only by plunging into the depths of love can one rise to spiritual heights. True transformation begins when the ego is forsaken, and the soul advances toward love.

title: Bandaun Swamini Charan Tihaare - Shri Shyamdas
sanskrit_text: Bandaun Swamini Charan Tihaare.Arunkamal Mridu Amal Karun Ati, Ratipati Manahi Lubhavanvaare. [1]Sundar Saras Sucharu Sugandhit, Nakhmanichandr Amand Ujaare.Chandan Charchit Noopur - Naadit, Brahmanand Bhulavan Haare. [2]Sakhijan Sevit, Laalit-Paalit, Ashtayam Ghanshyamhin Pyare.Shyamdas Ke Isht Shiromani, Teen Lok Vedan Te Nyare. [3]- Shri ShyamdasO my Swamini Shri Radha, I bow to your lotus feet. Your feet, of a radiant red hue, are soft, pure, and filled with compassion, and enchant even the mind of Cupid, the deity of love. [1]These feet are supremely beautiful, filled with divine fragrance. The radiant gems of your toenails outshine the moon. Adorned with sandalwood paste and resonating with the melodious chime of anklets, they surpass even the bliss of ‘Brahmanand’ (the impersonal form of divine ecstasy). [2]These divine lotus feet are lovingly worshipped and served by the sakhis and are loved by Shri Krishna throughout all eight quarters of the day. Shri Shyamdas says, “The lotus feet of Shri Radha are my Ishta Deva (worshipful deity), transcending the realms of the three worlds and surpassing even the Vedas.” [3]

title: Dasan Khandit Viri Ruchir Daihain Nikat Bulaay - Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (149)
sanskrit_text: Dasan Khandit Viri Ruchir, Daihain Nikat Bulaay.Kunvari Aapne Kanth Ko, Haar Kanth Pahraay.- Shri Madhuri Das, Utkantha Madhuri (149)It is my heartfelt desire that ever-youthful Shri Radha calls me to her side, offers me the betel leaf she has chewed with her tender hands, and places the garland from her own neck around mine.

title: Hamarain Inake Vachan Praman - Shri Kishori Ali
sanskrit_text: Hamaarain Inake Vachan Praman.Shri Harivansh Gusain, Shri Haridas Kiye Je Gaan. [1]Vyas Saman Vyas Hain Mere, Dhruv Dhruvpad Ke Vakta.Vitthalvipul Biharinidasi, Rahasikeli Anurakta. [2]Yahi Tatv Hiy Dhar Chhod Ab Nana Mat Vyabhichaare.Gahi Anany Mat Sei 'Kishori', Nirkhau Jugal Vihaare. [3]- Shri Kishori AliThe Vanis (words) of these great Rasikas are my guiding authority. The divine rasa sung by Goswami Shri Hit Harivansh Ji and Swami Shri Haridas Ji forms the foundation of my life. [1]Shri Hariram Vyas Ji stands as my Ved Vyasa, while Shri Hit Dhruvdas Ji is the masterful orator of Dhruvapada.  Shri Vitthalvipul Dev Ji and Shri Biharindev Ji are perpetually immersed in the eternal Keli plays of the divine couple, Sri Radha and Krishna. [2]Shri Kishori Ali says, ‘O mind, accept the supreme essence glorified by these Rasikas, and abandon the contamination of various other beliefs. Embrace singular devotion, serve the lotus feet of Shri Radha, and behold the divine couple's Nitya Vihara (love-play).’ [3]

title: Pyari Pritam Ke Sada Ras Hi Mein Aasakt - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Rasik Pacchisi (21)
sanskrit_text: Pyaari Preetam Ke Sada, Ras Hi Mein Aasakt.Roop Madhuri Sam Ginai, Nindan Vandan Jakta.- Shri Roopmadhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Rasik Pacchisi (21)The true Rasika is one who remains perpetually absorbed in the nectar of the divine couple, Sri Shyama Shyam, and remains indifferent to both praise and criticism.

title: Re Man Kyon Chate Jag Dhur - Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (33)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Yogiya Kalingada)Re Man Kyon Chate Jag Dhur.Dhan Joban Yon Jay Hath Tein, Ja Vidhi Udat Kapoor. [1]Maat Taat Bhrata Sut Dara, Yah Nate Sab Koor.Lalit Ladaiti Bas Vrindavan, Brajaraj Mil Hvai Choor. [2]- Shri Lalit Ladaiti, Shri Kishori Kripa Kataksha, Vinay (33)Oh mind, why cling to the transient dust of this world? Wealth and youth vanish as swiftly as camphor in the air. [1]Relations like parents, siblings, sons, and spouses are all fleeting ties and filled with selfishness. Sri Lalit Ladaiti says, “Find refuge in Vrindavan and merge with the divine dust of Braj, for only then will your life attain true meaning.” [2]

title: Vrindavan Ki Rajani Mein Sovat Paun Pasari - Shri Ananya Ali
sanskrit_text: Vrindavan Ki Rajani Mein Sovat Pain Pasari.Aur Thaur Ke Bhajan Gan Lajat Hot Balihari.- Shri Ananya Ali, Shri Ananya Ali Ji Ki Vani, Shri Vrindavan Vaas Avastha (2.53)In the sacred realm of Vrindavan, even resting with outstretched legs under the refuge of Shri Radha Maharani embodies the highest devotion. The exalted practices of devotion elsewhere pale and bow in reverence to this.

title: Pahne Yah Kundal Yonhi Raho - Braj Ke Sawaiya
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Pahne Yah Kundal Yonhi Raho, Alkalvi Yonhi Sanware Raho. [1]Adharamrit Paan Karate Huye, Murli Kar-Kanj Mein Dhare Raho. [2]Nahin Aur Vishesh Karo Kuch To, Aniyare Drigon Se Nihare Raho. [3]Kahin Jao Na Mohan Chhod Humein, Bane Jeevanpraan Hamare Raho. [4]- Braj Ke SawaiyaO Manamohana, let Your beautiful earrings remain just as they are,And may Your lovely curls stay gracefully adorned. [1]As You offer the sweet nectar of Your lips,Keep the flute steady in Your lotus-like hands. [2]If You choose to do nothing more,Let Your playful sidelong glances rest lovingly upon me. [3]Please don't leave me, O Manamohana—Stay with me, like the soul of my life. [4]

title: Yah Agadh Nidhi Madhur Ras - Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri, Doha (1)
sanskrit_text: Yah Agadh Nidhi Madhur Ras, Chhavi Kachu Kahi Na Jai.Chatak Chehe Sab Hi Piyo, Pai Ik Boond Samai.- Shri Rasik Govind, Shri Yugal Ras Madhuri, Doha (1)The beauty of the boundless treasure of this sweetest nectar of the divine couple cannot be described in words. title: Aisen Aarati Karau - Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (240)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Gandhar)Aisen Aarati Karau.Suthir Thar Hiy Bisad Beech Lai Prem-Pradeep Dharau. [1]Ujjal Dasa Saneh-Sanjoi Joti Jagai Dharau.Bhav-Puhup Pratiti Son Sanjut Baarani Or Arau. [2]Mohan-Mukh Jagamagni Pani Pai Nirkhat Harash Bharau.Anandghan Umaah Aarati Kaun Harihi Badai Harau. [3]- Shri Anandghan Ji, Shri Ghanananda Granthavali, Padavali (240)If you wish to perform the Lord’s aarti, do it this way: let your heart be the vast plate, and place within it the lamp of love. [1]Light a pure flame of affection, and turn your mind and soul toward the Lord. Present the flowers of your innermost emotions at His feet with faith and reverence. [2]As the divine radiance of Shri Krishna’s face begins to illuminate your inner being, fill your heart with supreme bliss. Shri Anandghan says, “An aarti performed with true love and devotion will captivate even the heart of the Lord.” [3]

title: Barsane Vasinu Kain Shri Radha Aadhar - Shri Hita Parmanand Das
sanskrit_text: Barsane Vaasinu Kain, Shri Radha Aadhaar.Radha Ke Pyaare Sabai, Radha Hi Soun Pyaar.- Shri Hita Parmanand DasThe very source of life for the residents of Barsana is none other than Sri Radha. All the Barsana Wasis are deeply loved by Radha, and they are exclusively absorbed in loving her.

title: (Shri) Radhavallabhkau Hau Bhanvatau Cherau - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (133)
sanskrit_text: (Shri) Radhavallabhkau Hau Bhanvatau Cherau.Radhavallabh Kahat Sunathi, Man Na Naim Jam Kerau. [1]Radhavallabh Vastu Bhooli Hoon, Kiyau Anat Nahin Pherau.Radhavallabh Vyasdaskai Sunahun Shravan Dai Terau. [2]- Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardh (133)I am the beloved servant of the divine couple, Shri Radhavallabh Ji. The mere utterance or hearing of the name “Radhavallabh” elevates my heart beyond all restraints and observances. [1]I will never, even by mistake, turn elsewhere, leaving Shri Radhavallabh Ji. title: Bakhanat Prem Pratap Mahaatam - Shri Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (28)
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Bakhanat Prem Pratap Mahaatam Sanch Na Svang Kasai Kasi Kaanchi. [1]Sadhik Siddh Bhayo To Kaha Kunvari Kishori Kripa Nahin Jaanchi. [2]Shriguru Prem Prasann Biharanidasi Shrinagari Ke Rang Raachi. [3]Re Buddhi Bivek Bichari Ihai Ju Kahai Su Lahai To Karai Sab Saanchi. [4]- Shri Nagri Dev, Nagri Dev Ju Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Pad (28)Śrī Nāgarideva Jī advises—O brother, you speak of love, but you mix it with grandeur and splendor. This exposes your claim to being a true rasika (connoisseur of divine love) as false, exposing its immaturity upon closer examination. [1]Unless you sincerely seek the exclusive grace of Nitya Bihāriṇījū (Śrī Rādhā), any spiritual accomplishment you attain will still leave you devoid of Svāminī Jī's (Śrī Rādhā's) supremely divine nectar. [2]Our beloved Gurudeva, Śrī Bihārīdeva, is ever immersed in the bliss of His Guru's love, remaining deeply absorbed in the love of Kiśorī Śrī Rādhā. [3]Reflect deeply with wisdom and be determined to follow your Gurudeva's teachings to the very word. By doing so, you will achieve true spiritual realization. [4]

title: Tanak Hansi Chitvau Hamari Aor - Shri Krishnpriya Ji
sanskrit_text: Tanak Hansi Chitvau Hamari Aor.Mero To Mohan Ik Tumhi, Tumkoun Laakh Karor. [1]Kabki Main Thadi Araj Karat Houn, Suniyo Nandkishor.‘Krishnapriya’ Ke Praan Jivandhan, Karunanidhi Chitchor. [2]- Shri Krishnpriya JiO Shyamsundar!  Cast your glance upon me with a smile, even for a moment. You have countless devotees, but I have no one but you, O Manmohan! [1]I have been standing and pleading with you for so long, but now, O Nandkishor, kindly hear my prayers! Shri Krishnapriya Ji proclaims, “My life’s only treasure is the ocean of mercy, Shri Krishna, the one who steals all hearts.” [2]

title: Radhe Bhayi Aapu Ghansyam - Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu Granthawali
sanskrit_text: Radhe Bhayi Aapu Ghansyam.Aapun Kau Gobind Kahat Hai, Chhadi Radhika Naam. [1]Vaisei Jhuki Jhuki Kai Kunjan Mein, Kabahunk Benu Bajaavai.Kabahoon Apanau Naam Lei Kai, Radha Radha Gaavai. [2]Kabahaun Maun Gahi Rahat Dhyan Kari, Mundi Rahat Dou Nain.'Harichand' Mohan Binu Vyakul, Naiku Nahin Chit Chain. [3]- Shri Bhartendu Harishchandra, Bhartendu GranthawaliToday, Sri Radha transformed into Krishna, adorning herself in His attire and calling herself Govind, leaving Her name Radhika. [1]Like Krishna, she sometimes plays the flute, bending gracefully within the bowers. At other times, she chants her own name, “Radha Radha.” [2]Occasionally, she sits silently in meditation, her eyes closed. Shri Harichand says, “She is restless for Krishna and finds no respite without Him, even for a moment.” [3]

title: Kechidbhajanti Krritino Girijamathanye - Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (53)
sanskrit_text: kecidbhajanti kṛtino girijāmathānyesevanti bhargamapare divasādhināthaṃeke gaṇādhipa surādhipa śaṃkarādīnsevantvahaṃ girivaraṃ śaraṇaṃ brajāmi- Shri Keshavachary, Govardhan Shatak (53)Some find their devotion in worshiping Girija Devi (Parvati), others bow to Lord Shiva. sanskrit_text: Aisi Preeti Deu Kin Pyari.Chhin Chhin Pal Tum Pad Avalokau, Haun Kaun Rahau Tihari. [1]Umadol Dolat Man Mero, Jahan Jay Tahan Khwari.Premsakhi Ki Yahi Binti, Rakho Saran Na Kije Nyari. [2]- Shri Premdas Ji [Brother of Shri Lal Balbir Ji], Shri Premdas Ji Ki Vani (113)O Pyari Ju (Shri Radha)! sanskrit_text: Ladaiti Ju Teri Rang Bhari Musikyani.Tan Man Ati Anand Badhavati, Adbhut Sukh Ki Khani. [1]Param Praveen Kisori Radhe, Ati Jaananimani Jaani.Shrirasik Siromani Ki Niju Jeevani, Kunjbiharini Rani. [2]- Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Shringar Ras Ke Pad (10)O Ladaiti Ju (Shri Radha), your enchanting smile is filled with the hues of love, a treasure trove of bliss that fills the body and mind with boundless joy. [1]The supremely skillful and ever-youthful Shri Radha perfectly understands the innermost thoughts and feelings of every heart.  Shri Lalitkishori Dev Ji says, “My Kunjbiharini Rani (Shri Radha) is the life and soul of Shri Krishna, the supreme connoisseur of divine love.” [2]

sanskrit_text: Manmohan Baskarini, Nakhasikh Roop Rasaal.So Swamini Nit Gaaiye, Rasikani Radha Baal.- Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Utsah Sukh (23)Sing ceaselessly the glories of Swamini Shri Radha, who enchants even Sri Krishna Himself and whose form is filled with nectar from head to toe.

title: Kantedar Karil Ke Vriksh Jis Bhoomi Par - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (30)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Kantedar Karil Ke Vriksh Jis Bhoomi Par,Deta Dikhalayi Jahan Khara Jal Koop Hai. [1]Gari De Bolte Brajbasi Sab Aapas Mein,Anna Phal Heen Dhara Khaadar Kuroop Hai. [2]Paakar Ke Chhaak Chhachh Gauyen Charata Phire,Phir Bhi Banaya Use Svarg Se Anoop Hai. [3]Aisa Jo Manmauji Mast Thakur Triloki Ka,Rakshak Hamara Vahi Vrindavan Bhoop Hai. [4]- Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnanand Sarasvati ‘Hare Krishn’, Vrindavan Shatak (30)The land is filled with thorny Karīla trees, and its wells hold only salty water. [1]Where the Brajvāsīs converse with each other in abusive language, the land itself remains barren, devoid of crops and fruits, and steeped in desolation. [2]Yet, Śrī Kṛṣṇa roams through this land, drinking buttermilk and grazing cows, transforming Vṛndāvan into a place more beautiful than heaven itself. [3]That rapturous Lord, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the ruler of the three worlds, is the king of Vṛndāvan and our beloved protector. [4]

title: Pritam Hu Kain Pran Ihai - Shri Dhruvdas Ji, Bayalees Leela, Man Shiksha Leela (57)
sanskrit_text: Pritam Hu Kain Pran Ihai, Preeti Ke Bas Hwai Jaahin.Koti Dharma Kin Karau Kou, Tin Tan Chitavat Naahin.- Shri Dhruvdas Ji, Bayalees Leela, Mana Shiksha Leela (57)Our beloved Lalji (Sri Krishn) vows that He is forever captivated by pure love alone. However, He does not even glance at those who, despite performing millions of rituals or virtuous acts, are devoid of love.

title: Nisidin Barsat Nain Hamaare - Shri Surdas, Soor Sagar
sanskrit_text: Nisidin Barsat Nain Hamaare.Sada Rahat Paavas Ritu Ham Par, Jabate Syam Sidhare. [1]Anjan Thir Na Rahat Ankhiyan Mein, Kar Kapol Bhaye Kare.Kanchuki-Pat Sukhat Nahin Kabahun, Ur Bich Bahat Panaare. [2]Aansu Salil Bhaye Pag Thake, Bahe Jaat Sit Taare.Surdas Ab Doobat Hai Braj, Kaahe Na Let Ubare. [3]- Shri Surdas, Soor SagarTears flow endlessly from my eyes day and night, as if the monsoon season has permanently arrived since Shyamsundara departed. [1]Kohl does not stay in my eyes; it washes away with tears, smearing my cheeks and hands with black streaks. My bodice and garments never dry, soaked by the flood of tears flowing from my heart. [2]Because of these ever-flowing tears, this body has become a source of water, constantly seeping. Shri Surdas says, ‘The entire Braj has drowned in tears—O Shri Krishna, why do you not come to rescue it now?’ [3]

title: Syama-Syam Nikunj Nidhi - Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (37)
sanskrit_text: Syama-Syam Nikunj-Nidhi, Shri Swami Sirmaur.Roop Lalit Ura Main Base, Jaanat Naahin Aur.- Shri Roop Sakhi, Siddhant Ke Doha (37)The beloved deity of Swami Shri Haridas, the crest jewel among the Rasikas, is the divine couple Sri Shyama Kunjbihari, who is the treasure of the Nikunj. Their enchanting forms dwell forever within my heart, for I know no one else but them.

title: Arati Karat Shri Lalit Kunvari Ki - Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (115)
sanskrit_text: Arati Karat Shri Lalit Kunvari Ki.Koti Bhanu Duti Roop Sundari Ki. [1]Raajat Kanak Sinhasan Syama.Adbhut Roop Anoopabhirama. [2]Sarangi Been Prabeen Bajavain.Padgati Nupur Surani Milavain. [3]Prem Mudit Ali Chanvar Duravain.Jay Jay Shabd Puhup Barasavain. [4]Angani Duti Phaili Ban Joti.Patr Phool Manon Kundan Doti. [5]Nirakhi Nirakhi Ang Ang Nikayi.Albeli Ali Bali Bali Jayi. [6]- Shri Albeli Ali, Samay Prabandh (115)Shri Lalita and the other sakhis lovingly perform the aarti of the enchanting Queen, Shri Radha, whose beauty glows like countless radiant suns. [1]Gracefully seated on a golden throne, Shri Shyama Ju (Sri Radha) radiates an unparalleled beauty, transcending everything else. [2]The sakhis skillfully play the sarangi and veena, while others clap rhythmically and dance gracefully, their anklets producing a sweet melody in perfect harmony. [3]Some sakhis lovingly and joyfully wave the ‘Chanwar’ (fly-whisk), while others shower flowers on Shri Radha, singing her glories ecstatically. [4]The brilliance of Shri Radha’s divine form illuminates the entire forest, making the leaves and flowers shimmer like gold. [5]Shri Albeli Ali says, “As I behold the divine beauty of each of Shri Radha’s limbs, I find myself surrendering to her again and again.” [6]

title: Namastrailokyajanani Prasida - Devi Bhagwat  (9.50.47)
sanskrit_text: Namastrailokyajanani Prasida Karunarnave.Brahmavishnvadibhirdevairvandyamanapadambuje.- Devi Bhagwat (9.50.47) [Sri Radha Namaskar Stotram (2)]Lord Narayan speaks, “O Sri Radha, ocean of compassion and mother of the three worlds, I bow before you with utmost humility. Please be pleased with me, for Brahma, Vishnu, and countless other deities worship your divine lotus feet.”

title: Talahati Barsane Ki Rahiyer - Shri Nagridas Ji Ki Vani
sanskrit_text: Talahati Barsane Ki Rahiye.Gahar Van Ki Baith Latan Mein, Radha-Radha Gaiye. [1]Sada Sarvada Parvat Upar, Nit Prati Chadh Kar Jaiye.‘Nagaridas’ Vaas Barsane, Kunwari Diye Saun Paiye. [2]- Shri Nagridas Ji (Maharaj Sawant Singh), Shri Nagridas Ji Ki VaniMake your home at the foothills of Barsana, and dwell among the sacred vines of Gahvar Van, chanting the sweet name “Radha-Radha.” [1]Climb Barsana Hill regularly for the darshan of Shri Radharani. Shri Nagaridas Ji says that only by Shri Kishori Ji’s grace can one receive the blessing of living in Barsana. [2]

title: Bandon Pag Pankaj Sada Nandanandan Brajchand - Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (6)
sanskrit_text: Bandon Pag Pankaj Sada, Nandanandan Brajchand.Radhasat Baranat Karat, Phir Na Paron Bhav-Phand.- Shri Hati Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (6)I humbly bow to the lotus feet of Sri Krishna, the moon of Braj and beloved son of Nanda, whose grace has granted me the ability to compose “Radha Shat” (Radha Sudha Shatak). May I be forever liberated from the bondage of worldly existence.

title: Jag Uphasan Saun Raakhat Na Kaaj Kachhu - Shri Hit Kishori Lal, Radha Sudha Nidhi Stva (235)
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Jag Uphasan Saun Raakhat Na Kaaj Kachhu,Naradadi Bhaktan Ki Sudhi Samharai Na. [1]Subalaadi Sakhan Kaun Bhetat Na Dekhyau Kahun,Nand Au Jasoda Kau Saneh Man Dharai Na. [2]Jaanat Pai Prem Seem Madhur Ras Sudha Ki,Sagar Agadha Radha Nainan Saun Taarai Na. [3]Taahi Saun Viharai Nav Kunj Saghan Veethin Mein,Nagar Rasik Dooji Or Hu Nihaarai Na. [4]- Shri Hit Kishori Lal, Radha Sudha Nidhi Stva (235)What to say of creating and sustaining the material worlds when Nikunjeśwar Śrī Kṛṣṇa turns a deaf ear to devotees like Nārada? [1]He avoids the company of Śrīdāma and His dear friends and even sets aside His parents’ boundless love. [2]His heart and eyes are fixed solely on Śrī Rādhā, the epitome of divine love and an unfathomable ocean of nectar. [3]Immersed in Her contemplation, He passes days and nights adoring Vṛndāvan's kunj pathways, graced by Her sacred footsteps. [4]

title: Shreemukh Bani Kahi Vilamb Ab Naiku Na Lavhu - Sri Surdas, Soor Sagar
sanskrit_text: Shreemukh Bani Kahi, Vilamb Ab Naiku Na Laavhu.Vraj Parikrama Karhu, Deh Kau Paap Nasavhu.- Sri Surdas, Soor SagarWhen Lord Brahma sought forgiveness, Shri Krishna said, ‘Do not delay further. Circumambulate the sacred land of Braj and purify yourself from the sins of your deeds.’

title: Kou Vidya Vidhi Ved Bandhyau Bal - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Kavitt-Sewaiya (20)
sanskrit_text: (Sawaiya)Kou Vidya Vidhi Ved Bandhyau Bal, Kou Dhan Dharma Karm Krit Paas. [1]Kou Jam Naim Koou Brat Sanjam, Kou Jap Tap Kou Bhramat Udaas. [2]Kou Kartik Agahan Makar Seet, Sahi Kou Baisakhi Gyaas Upas. [3]Santat Sukhada Viharinidas Kain, Shriharidas Se Shriharidas. [4]- Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji Ki Vani, Siddhant Ke Kavitt-Sewaiya (20)Some remain entangled in the webs of knowledge, Vedas, and injunctions or prohibitions, while others are caught in the pursuit of wealth, religious rituals, and ceremonial practices. [1]Some strive through self-restraint, vows, austerities, japa, and penance, while others wander aimlessly in the path of udāsīna pantha (Renounced Worship). [2]Many endure harsh winters during Kārttika, Agrahāyaṇa, or Makara Saṅkrānti, or place their hopes in fasts like Baisākhī or Nirjalā Ekādaśī as acts of devotion. [3]But far away from all these arduous practices lies the ever-joyous, eternal path of rasa known as Nitya Vihāra, revealed by none other than Svāmī Śrī Haridāsa Jī Mahārāja, the crown jewel among the Rasikas. [4]

title: Mo Mana Kab Anurgaihai - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (120)
sanskrit_text: Mo Mana Kab Anurgaihai, Jugul Kamalpag Teer.Jyon Pyaase Ki Laalsa, Nirmal Seetal Neer.- Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Shatak (120)When will my mind become devoted to the lotus feet of the divine couple, Sri Radha Krishn, with the same intensity that a thirsty person longs for cool and pure water?

title: Dev Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha - Shri Sundar Ji
sanskrit_text: (Kavitt)Dev Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha, Indra Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha,Vidhi Hu Kai Lok Tai Bahuri Aaiyatu Hai. [1]Manush Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha, Bhupati Bhaye Tai Kaha,Dvij Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha Paar Jaaiyatu Hai. [2]Pashu Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha, Pakhi Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha,Pannag Hu Bhaye Tai Kaha Kyon Aghaaiyatu Hai. [3]Chhutibe Kaun ‘Sundar’ Upai Ek Sadhu Sang,Jinki Kripa Ati Sukh Paiyatu Hai. [4]- Shri Sundar JiWhat is so special about becoming a celestial god? Or attains the position of Indra, the king of heaven? For it is merely material and fleeting, and, by the law of creation, one must return to the mortal world again. [1]If one takes birth as a human and even becomes a king, what is the benefit? Even if one becomes a Brāhmaṇa, yet fails to cross the ocean of worldly existence, their life is ultimately wasted. [2]What is the worth in becoming an animal, a bird, or even a serpent, if one cannot satiate the soul’s eternal hunger — the longing to know the ultimate truth? [3]Śrī Sundardās Jī says, the only means of liberation from this ocean of existence lies in the association of a true saint. Through their grace alone, the soul attains the ultimate happiness of realizing God. [4]

title: Daya Prem Pragatyau Tinhai Tan Ki Tani Na Sanbhar - Shri Dayabai
sanskrit_text: Daya Prem Pragatyau Tinhai, Tan Ki Tani Na Sambhar.Hari Ras Mein Maate Phirain, Grih Ban Kaun Bichar.- Shri Dayabai (a disciple of Shri Charan Das Ji of the Shuk sect.)When love arises in one’s heart, one becomes unaware of bodily consciousness. Their journey turns inward, erasing the distinction between home and the forest.

title: Vrindavan Bansivat JamunaTat - Nanddas Granthwali, Padavali (122)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Jaijaivanti)Vrindavan Bansivat Jamuna-Tat Bansi Rat,Raas Mein Rasik Pyaro Khel Rachyo Van Mein. [1]Radha-Madhav Kar Jorain, Ravi-Sashi Hot Bhorein,Mandala Mein Niratat Doo Saras Saghan Mein. [2]Madhur Mridang Bajai, Murli Ki Dhuni Gajai,Sudhi Na Rahi Ree Kachhu, Sur, Muni, Jan Mein. [3]‘Nandadas’ Prabhu Pyaro, Roop-Ujiyaro Ati,Krishna-Kreeda Dekhi Bhaye Thakit Jan Man Mein. [4]- Shri Nanddas, Nanddas Granthwali, Padavali (122)On the serene banks of the Yamuna, beneath the Bansi Vat, the sweet melody of the flute resonates,The beloved rasika, Lord Krishna engages in the divine pastimes of Raas amidst the enchanting forest. [1]Hand in hand, the divine couple, Sri Radha Madhava stand, radiating brilliance. The sun and moon, like bumblebees, hover close, drawn to their divine nectar.Together in the raas mandala, they dance gracefully in the lush forest. [2]The mridang beats sweetly, merging with the flute’s tune,The celestial gods, sages, and devotees lose all sense of self-awareness. [3]Sri Nandadas says, “The beloved Lord glows with unparalleled splendor. Witnessing Krishna’s captivating divine play leaves every mind completely spellbound.” [4]

title: Pyari Tohi Vuri Vaan Jah Maan Ki - Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (36)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Dhanashri)Pyari Tohi Vuri Vaan Jah Maan Ki. [1]Naik Vank Bhruikuti Dekhat Mohi Sudhi Na Rehat Niju Praan Ki.Tan Man Waari Vihaarini Saanchi Aas Ek Musikyan Ki. [2]Mukh Rukhyo Ghoontan Chahan Vas Adhar Sudha Ke Paan Ki.Shri Ramray Swamini Hriday Mein Ati Udaar Kul Kaan Ki. [3]- Shri Ramray Ji, Aadivani (36)Shri Krishna says to Shri Radha - O Pyariju! Your habit of sulking brings me unbearable pain. [1]Even the slightest raise of your eyebrows leaves me devoid of all awareness of myself. I swear, I would gladly offer my body and mind at the mere hope of seeing your smile. [2]But now, your face is turned away in displeasure, hidden behind a veil. I yearn to receive your Adharamrit prasad (nectar of your lips). O Swamini of Shri Ramray, you are supremely generous and the crown jewel of your noble lineage. (Please, let go of your sulking.) [3]

title: Kishori Shyama Tum Ho Param Udaar - Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (108)
sanskrit_text: (Raag Patdeep or Sarang)Kishori Shyama! Tum Ho Param Udaar.Jo Kou Gaavat Naam Tumhaaro, Taake Sukhju Apaar. [1]Jan Ke Avgun Dekhat Naahi, Tanku Na Karo Vichar.Sharan Pade Jo Saanche Man Se, Tajo Na Taaki Laar. [2]Pal Pal Sahay Karo Tum Pyari, Devat Naahi Visaar.“Roop Madhuri” Aap Bharose, Sovat Paav Pasaaar. [3]- Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (108)O ever-youthful Shyamaju (Sri Radha)! You are supremely generous.Whoever chants your name, their bliss becomes boundless. [1]You never see the faults of your devotees, not even for a moment.Those who take refuge in you with a sincere heart, you never forsake them. [2]You offer your help every moment, O Pyariju, never forgetting your devotees.Sri Roop Madhuri places his faith in you, thus, sleeping fearlessly with His legs stretched out. [3]

[3]- Shri Rup Madhuri, Shri Rup Madhuri Ji Ki Vani, Padavali (108)O ever-youthful Shyamaju (Sri Radha)! You are supremely generous.Whoever chants your name, their bliss becomes boundless. title: मेरी टेर सुनो सुकुमारी - श्री लाल बलबीर, वृन्दावन शतक (53)
sanskrit_text:

अखिल लोक चूड़ामणि सुन्दर मनमोहन की प्यारी॥ [2]
परम उदार दयानिधि नागरि दीनन ओर निहारी। [3]
दासी जानि कीजिये स्वामिनि महल टहल अधिकारी॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, वृन्दावन शतक (53)
english_text: meri ter suno sukumari. [1] akhil lok chuड़amani sundar manamohan ki pyari.. [2] param udar dayanidhi nagari dinan or nihari. [3] dasi jani kijiye svamini mahal tahal adhikari.. [4] - shri lal balabir, vrindavan shatak (53)

title: रस भरे लाल रस भरी राधे - श्री हित ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, पद्यावली (61)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहागरौ)
रस भरे लाल रस भरी राधे, 
रस भरी सखी अवलोकत रंगहि। 
मदन हुलास बाढ़यौ प्रीतम मन, 
अतिहि चाव सौं भरत उछंगहि। [1] 
अद्भुत कोक-कलनि की उमगनि, 
लज्जित करत अनंगहि। 
‘हित ध्रुव’ चतुर सिरोमनि दोऊ, 
विलसत प्रेम-तरंगहि। [2]
- श्री हित ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, पद्यावली (61)

रस-पूरित लाल एवं रस-पूरित प्रिया की रंग-केलि का रस-पूरित सखियाँ अवलोकन कर रहीं हैं। प्रियतम के मन में मदनोल्लास की वृद्धि हो रही है, अतः वे उत्साहपूर्वक प्रिया को बारम्बार अपनी गोद में ले रहे हैं। [1]
युगल में कोक-कलाओं का यह अद्भुत उदगम कामदेव को भी लज्जित कर रहा है। श्री हित ध्रुवदास जी कहते हैं कि कोक-कलाओं में चतुर शिरोमणि-युगल इन प्रेम लहरियों में मग्न हुए विलास करते रहते हैं। [2]
english_text: (rag vihagarau) ras bhare lal ras bhari radhe, ras bhari sakhi avalokat rngahi. madan hulas badhayau pritam man, atihi chav saun bharat uchhngahi. [1] adbhut koka-kalani ki umagani, lajjit karat anngahi. ‘hit dhruva’ chatur siromani duo, vilasat prema-tarngahi. [2] - shri hit dhruvadas, bayalis lila, padyavali (61) rasa-purit lal evn rasa-purit priya ki rnga-keli ka rasa-purit sakhiyan avalokan kar rahin hain. priyatam ke man men madanollas ki vriddhi ho rahi hai, ath ve utsahapurvak priya ko barambar apani god men le rahe hain. [1] yugal men koka-kalaon ka yah adbhut udagam kamadev ko bhi lajjit kar raha hai. shri hit dhruvadas ji kahate hain ki koka-kalaon men chatur shiromani-yugal in prem lahariyon men magn hue vilas karate rahate hain. [2]

[1] adbhut koka-kalani ki umagani, lajjit karat anngahi. ‘hit dhruva’ chatur siromani duo, vilasat prema-tarngahi. [2] - shri hit dhruvadas, bayalis lila, padyavali (61) rasa-purit lal evn rasa-purit priya ki rnga-keli ka rasa-purit sakhiyan avalokan kar rahin hain. priyatam ke man men madanollas ki vriddhi ho rahi hai, ath ve utsahapurvak priya ko barambar apani god men le rahe hain. [1] yugal men koka-kalaon ka yah adbhut udagam kamadev ko bhi lajjit kar raha hai. shri hit dhruvadas ji kahate hain ki koka-kalaon men chatur shiromani-yugal in prem lahariyon men magn hue vilas karate rahate hain. [2]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कुंवरी लडैती लाडिली - श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (276)
sanskrit_text:
कुंवरी लडैती लाडिली, लाड लडी सुकुमार।
अँग सँग दैनी केली रस, महा प्रेम सुख सार॥
- श्री ललितकिशोरी देव, श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (276)
english_text: kunvari ladaiti ladili, lad ladi sukumar. ang sng daini keli ras, maha prem sukh sar.. - shri lalitakishori dev, shri lalitakishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (276)
english_translation: kunvari ladaiti ladili, lad ladi sukumar. ang sng daini keli ras, maha prem sukh sar.. - shri lalitakishori dev, shri lalitakishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (276)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: न मे भूयान्मोक्षो न पुनरमराधीश सदनं - श्री विट्ठलनाथ जी ( गुसाईं जी), श्री स्वामिनयाष्टकम् (8)
sanskrit_text:
न मे भूयान्मोक्षो न पुनरमराधीश सदनं न योगो न ज्ञानं न विषस सखं दुःखकदनम्॥
त्वदुच्छिष्टं भोज्यं तब पदजलं पेयमपि तद्रजोमूर्ध्नि स्वामिन्यनुभव नमस्तु प्रतिभवम्॥
- श्री विट्ठलनाथ जी (गुसाईं जी), श्री स्वामिनियाष्टकम् (8)
english_text: n me bhuyanmoksho n punaramaradhish sadann n yogo n jnyann n vishas sakhn duhkhakadanam.. tvaduchchhishtn bhojyn tab padajaln peyamapi tadrajomurdhni svaminyanubhav namastu pratibhavam.. - shri vitthalanath ji (gusain ji), shri svaminiyashtakam (8)
english_translation: n me bhuyanmoksho n punaramaradhish sadann n yogo n jnyann n vishas sakhn duhkhakadanam.. tvaduchchhishtn bhojyn tab padajaln peyamapi tadrajomurdhni svaminyanubhav namastu pratibhavam.. - shri vitthalanath ji (gusain ji), shri svaminiyashtakam (8)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दाबन साँचौ धन भैया - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (192)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दाबन साँचौ धन भैया।
कनक कूट कौटिक लगि तजिए, भजिये कुँवर कन्हैयाँ॥ [1]
जहाँ श्री राधा चरनरेनु की कमला लेत बलैय्या।
तिन को गोपी नाच नचावत, मोहन वेणु बजैया॥ [2]
कामधेनु के छीर सिन्धु तजि भजहु नन्द की गैय्या।
चार्यों मुक्ती कहा ले करिहों जहाँ यसौदा मैय्या॥ [3]
अद्भुत लीला, अद्भुत वैभव शत् शुकदेव कहईया।
'व्यास' दास पुकारत वनते थौरे लोग सुनइया॥ [4]
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (192)
english_text: vrindaban sanchau dhan bhaiya. kanak kut kautik lagi tajie, bhajiye kunvar kanhaiyan.. [1] jahan shri radha charanarenu ki kamala let balaiyya. tin ko gopi nach nachavat, mohan venu bajaiya.. [2] kamadhenu ke chhir sindhu taji bhajahu nand ki gaiyya. charyon mukti kaha le karihon jahan yasauda maiyya.. [3] adbhut lila, adbhut vaibhav shat shukadev kahaiya. 'vyas' das pukarat vanate thaure log sunaiya.. [4] - shri hariram vyas, vyas vani, purvardh (192)
english_translation: vrindaban sanchau dhan bhaiya. kanak kut kautik lagi tajie, bhajiye kunvar kanhaiyan.. [1] jahan shri radha charanarenu ki kamala let balaiyya. tin ko gopi nach nachavat, mohan venu bajaiya.. [2] kamadhenu ke chhir sindhu taji bhajahu nand ki gaiyya. charyon mukti kaha le karihon jahan yasauda maiyya.. [3] adbhut lila, adbhut vaibhav shat shukadev kahaiya. 'vyas' das pukarat vanate thaure log sunaiya.. [4] - shri hariram vyas, vyas vani, purvardh (192)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृज के रस कूँ जो चखै - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
वृज के रस कूँ जो चखै, चखै न दूजौ स्वाद।
एक बार राधै कहै, रहे न और कछु याद॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: vrij ke ras kun jo chakhai, chakhai n dujau svad. ek bar radhai kahai, rahe n aur kachhu yad.. - braj ke dohe
english_translation: vrij ke ras kun jo chakhai, chakhai n dujau svad. ek bar radhai kahai, rahe n aur kachhu yad.. - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अली किशोरी मनहि लगाये गरे लगावत प्यारी
sanskrit_text:
“अली किशोरी मनहि लगाये, गरे लगावत प्यारी॥”
- श्री किशोरी अलि
english_text: “ali kishori manahi lagaye, gare lagavat pyari..” - shri kishori ali
english_translation: “ali kishori manahi lagaye, gare lagavat pyari..” - shri kishori ali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: "वृन्दस्य अवनं रक्षणं यत्र तत वृन्दावनं
sanskrit_text: "वृन्दस्य अवनं रक्षणं यत्र तत वृन्दावनं"
english_text: "vrindasy avann rakshann yatr tat vrindavann"
english_translation: "vrindasy avann rakshann yatr tat vrindavann"
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ऐसैंई देखत रहौं जनम सुफल करि मानौं - श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (3)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरौ)
ऐसैंई देखत रहौं जनम सुफल करि मानौं। [1]
प्यारे की भाँवती भाँवती के प्यारे जुगल किशोर जानौं॥ [2]
छिनु न टरौ पल होहु न इत उत रहौ एक तानौं। [3]
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्यामा कुंजबिहारी मन रानौं॥ [4]
- श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (3)
english_text: (rag kanharau) aisaini dekhat rahaun janam sufal kari manaun. [1] pyare ki bhanvati bhanvati ke pyare jugal kishor janaun.. [2] chhinu n tarau pal hohu n it ut rahau ek tanaun. [3] shriharidas ke svami syama kunjabihari man ranaun.. [4] - shri svami haridas ji, kelimal (3)
english_translation: (rag kanharau) aisaini dekhat rahaun janam sufal kari manaun. [1] pyare ki bhanvati bhanvati ke pyare jugal kishor janaun.. [2] chhinu n tarau pal hohu n it ut rahau ek tanaun. [3] shriharidas ke svami syama kunjabihari man ranaun.. [4] - shri svami haridas ji, kelimal (3)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: खान पान तौ कीजिये - श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, मन शिक्षा लीला (27)
sanskrit_text:
खान पान तौ कीजिये, रसिक मंडली माहिं।
जिनकै और उपासना, तहाँ उचित ध्रुव नाहिं॥
- श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, मन शिक्षा लीला (27)
english_text: khan pan tau kijiye, rasik mndali mahin. jinakai aur upasana, tahan uchit dhruv nahin.. - shri dhruvadas ji, bayalis lila, man shiksha lila (27)
english_translation: khan pan tau kijiye, rasik mndali mahin. jinakai aur upasana, tahan uchit dhruv nahin.. - shri dhruvadas ji, bayalis lila, man shiksha lila (27)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सब साधन सम्पन्न कहँ - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (39)
sanskrit_text:
सब साधन सम्पन्न कहँ, पुछत सब संसार।
साधनहीन प्रपन्न कहँ, पुछत नंदकुमार॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (39)
english_text: sab sadhan sampann kahn, puchhat sab snsar. sadhanahin prapann kahn, puchhat nndakumar.. - jagadguru shri kripalu ji maharaj, bhakti shatak (39)
english_translation: sab sadhan sampann kahn, puchhat sab snsar. sadhanahin prapann kahn, puchhat nndakumar.. - jagadguru shri kripalu ji maharaj, bhakti shatak (39)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री राधे मेरी स्वामिनी, मैं राधे जू को दास
sanskrit_text:
श्री राधे मेरी स्वामिनी, मैं राधे जू को दास,
जनम जनम मोहि दीजियो, श्री वृन्दावन को वास। 
- श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार)

श्री हरिराम व्यास जी कहते है,"श्री राधा जी मेरी 'स्वामिनी' हैं और मैं उनकी सेवादार हूँ। आप (श्रीराधा जी) से विनती है की आप मुझे हर जन्म में अपने दिव्य निवास श्री वृंदावन का वास दे कर मुझ पर अनुग्रह करें।"
english_text: shri radhe meri svamini, main radhe ju ko das, janam janam mohi dijiyo, shri vrindavan ko vas. - shri hariram vyas (vishakha avatara) shri hariram vyas ji kahate hai,"shri radha ji meri 'svamini' hain aur main unaki sevadar hun. ap (shriradha ji) se vinati hai ki ap mujhe har janm men apane divy nivas shri vrindavan ka vas de kar mujh par anugrah karen."
english_translation: shri radhe meri svamini, main radhe ju ko das, janam janam mohi dijiyo, shri vrindavan ko vas. - shri hariram vyas (vishakha avatara) shri hariram vyas ji kahate hai,"shri radha ji meri 'svamini' hain aur main unaki sevadar hun. ap (shriradha ji) se vinati hai ki ap mujhe har janm men apane divy nivas shri vrindavan ka vas de kar mujh par anugrah karen."
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्रिया चरन बल जानि के, बाढ्यौ हिये हुलास
sanskrit_text:
प्रिया चरन बल जानि के, बाढ्यौ हिये हुलास । 
तेइ उर में आनि हैं, श्री वृन्दावन विपिन प्रकाश॥
 - श्री ध्रुवदास - वृन्दावन शत लीला (09)
english_text: priya charan bal jani ke, badhyau hiye hulas . tei ur men ani hain, shri vrindavan vipin prakash.. - shri dhruvadas - vrindavan shat lila (09)
english_translation: priya charan bal jani ke, badhyau hiye hulas . tei ur men ani hain, shri vrindavan vipin prakash.. - shri dhruvadas - vrindavan shat lila (09)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारी तेरी महिमा वरनी न जाय - श्री स्वामी हरिदास, केलिमल (26)
sanskrit_text:
प्यारी तेरी महिमा वरनी न जाय
-  श्री स्वामी हरिदास

श्री कृष्ण श्री राधा से कहते हैं: प्यारी आपकी महिमा वर्णन करना असंभव है।
english_text: pyari teri mahima varani n jay - shri svami haridas shri krishn shri radha se kahate hain: pyari apaki mahima varnan karana asnbhav hai.
english_translation: pyari teri mahima varani n jay - shri svami haridas shri krishn shri radha se kahate hain: pyari apaki mahima varnan karana asnbhav hai.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरा बल तेरा नाम राधे
sanskrit_text:
मेरा बल तेरा नाम राधे 
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज 

हे राधे, मेरा एकमात्र बल आपका नाम "राधे" है।
english_text: mera bal tera nam radhe - jagadguru shri kripalu ji maharaj he radhe, mera ekamatr bal apaka nam "radhe" hai.
english_translation: mera bal tera nam radhe - jagadguru shri kripalu ji maharaj he radhe, mera ekamatr bal apaka nam "radhe" hai.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सेवै नित्य बिहार कों - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (303)
sanskrit_text:
सेवै नित्य बिहार कों, और न जानै कोइ।
कुंजबिहारिनि बाल ने, तन मन लये समोइ॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (303)
english_text: sevai nity bihar kon, aur n janai koi. kunjabiharini bal ne, tan man laye samoi.. - shri lalit kishori dev, shri lalit kishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (303)
english_translation: sevai nity bihar kon, aur n janai koi. kunjabiharini bal ne, tan man laye samoi.. - shri lalit kishori dev, shri lalit kishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (303)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन कौ नाम रट - श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, वृन्दावन शत लीला (79)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन कौ नाम रट, वृन्दावन कौं देखि।
वृन्दावन सौं प्रीत कर, वृन्दावन उर लेखी॥
- श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, वृन्दावन शत लीला (79)
english_text: vrindavan kau nam rat, vrindavan kaun dekhi. vrindavan saun prit kar, vrindavan ur lekhi.. - shri dhruvadas ji, bayalis lila, vrindavan shat lila (79)
english_translation: vrindavan kau nam rat, vrindavan kaun dekhi. vrindavan saun prit kar, vrindavan ur lekhi.. - shri dhruvadas ji, bayalis lila, vrindavan shat lila (79)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अतिसाहसमाचरितं विरुध्य - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.14)
sanskrit_text:
अतिसाहसमाचरितं विरुध्य गुरुशास्त्राविद्वद्वर्यैः।
त्वयि वृन्दावन! आप वासायेन्द्रियवशमप्यतो न हि त्यज माम्॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.14)
english_text: atisahasamacharitn virudhy gurushastravidvadvaryaih. tvayi vrindavan! ap vasayendriyavashamapyato n hi tyaj mam.. - shri prabodhanand sarasvati, vrindavan mahimamrit (9.14)
english_translation: atisahasamacharitn virudhy gurushastravidvadvaryaih. tvayi vrindavan! ap vasayendriyavashamapyato n hi tyaj mam.. - shri prabodhanand sarasvati, vrindavan mahimamrit (9.14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भूमिलोक सुरलोक सब - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, नख सिख दर्शन (4)
sanskrit_text:
भूमिलोक सुरलोक सब, रहे पताल लजाय।
कुमरि माधुरी अंग की, समता दीजे काय॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, नख सिख दर्शन (4)
english_text: bhumilok suralok sab, rahe patal lajay. kumari madhuri ang ki, samata dije kay.. - shri lal balabir, braj binod, nakh sikh darshan (4)

title: अनन्यनि कौन की परवाहि
sanskrit_text:
अनन्यनि कौन की परवाहि
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (176)

श्री राधा के अनन्य भक्त को किसकी परवाह?
english_text: ananyani kaun ki paravahi - shri hariram vyas, vyas vani, purvardh (176) shri radha ke anany bhakt ko kisaki paravah?

title: जाके बल मैं सब सों तोरी, लोक वेद कुल कानि
sanskrit_text:
जाके बल मैं सब सों तोरी, लोक वेद कुल कानि,
मेरी महारानी श्री राधारानी।
- श्री भगवत रसिक

वृन्दावन निकुंज की अधीश्वरी श्री राधारानी ही मेरी एक मात्र स्वामिनी हैं। इन्ही के बल पर मैंने लोक, वेद, और कुल की सभी मर्यादाओं को तोड़ दिया है।
english_text: jake bal main sab son tori, lok ved kul kani, meri maharani shri radharani. - shri bhagavat rasik vrindavan nikunj ki adhishvari shri radharani hi meri ek matr svamini hain. inhi ke bal par mainne lok, ved, aur kul ki sabhi maryadaon ko toda diya hai.
english_translation: jake bal main sab son tori, lok ved kul kani, meri maharani shri radharani. - shri bhagavat rasik vrindavan nikunj ki adhishvari shri radharani hi meri ek matr svamini hain. inhi ke bal par mainne lok, ved, aur kul ki sabhi maryadaon ko toda diya hai.

title: परसाद विहारिनि रानी कौ - श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (63)
sanskrit_text:
(राग गौरी)
परसाद विहारिनि रानी कौ।
अति आनंद बढै छिन ही छिन महा प्रेम सुखदानी कौ॥ [1]
जाकी सोभा कहत न आवै अद्भुत रूप निमानी कौ।
श्रीललितकिसोरी लाडलडावति अति जाननि मन जानी कौ॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (63)
english_text: (rag gauri) parasad viharini rani kau. ati annd badhai chhin hi chhin maha prem sukhadani kau.. [1] jaki sobha kahat n avai adbhut rup nimani kau. shrilalitakisori ladaladavati ati janani man jani kau.. [2] - shri lalit kishori dev, shri lalit kishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ke pad (63)
english_translation: (rag gauri) parasad viharini rani kau. ati annd badhai chhin hi chhin maha prem sukhadani kau.. title: मेरे मन दृग रीझि की - श्री आनन्दघन जी, घनानंद ग्रंथावली, प्रिया प्रसाद (70)
sanskrit_text:
मेरे मन दृग रीझि की, राधा ही कों बूझि।
राधा के मन रीझि की, मोहि बूझि अरु सूझि॥
- श्री आनन्दघन जी, घनानंद ग्रंथावली, प्रिया प्रसाद (70)
english_text: mere man drig rijhi ki, radha hi kon bujhi. radha ke man rijhi ki, mohi bujhi aru sujhi.. - shri anandaghan ji, ghanannd grnthavali, priya prasad (70)
english_translation: mere man drig rijhi ki, radha hi kon bujhi. radha ke man rijhi ki, mohi bujhi aru sujhi.. - shri anandaghan ji, ghanannd grnthavali, priya prasad (70)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भोः श्रीदामन्सुबल वृषभस्तोक कृष्णार्जुनाद्याः - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (227)
sanskrit_text:
भोः श्रीदामन्सुबल वृषभस्तोक कृष्णार्जुनाद्याः, किंवो दृष्टं मम नु चकिता दृग्गता नैव कुञ्जे।
काचिद्देवी सकल भुवनाप्लाविलावण्यपूरादूरादेवाखिलमहरत प्रेयसो वस्तु सख्युः॥
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (227)
english_text: bhoh shridamansubal vrishabhastok krishnarjunadyah, kinvo drishtn mam nu chakita driggata naiv kunyje. kachiddevi sakal bhuvanaplavilavanyapuraduradevakhilamaharat preyaso vastu sakhyuh.. - shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu, shri radha sudha nidhi (227)
english_translation: bhoh shridamansubal vrishabhastok krishnarjunadyah, kinvo drishtn mam nu chakita driggata naiv kunyje. kachiddevi sakal bhuvanaplavilavanyapuraduradevakhilamaharat preyaso vastu sakhyuh.. - shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu, shri radha sudha nidhi (227)

title: रुचि के प्रकास परस्पर खेलन लागे - श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (2)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरौ)
रुचि के प्रकास परस्पर खेलन लागे। [1]
राग रागिनी अलौकिक उपजत नृत्य संगीत अलग लाग लागे॥ [2]
राग ही में रंग रह्यौ रंग के समुद्र में दोऊ झागे। [3]
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्यामा कुंजबिहारी
पै रंग रह्यौ रस ही में पागे॥ [4]
- श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (2)
english_text: (rag kanharau) ruchi ke prakas paraspar khelan lage. [1] rag ragini alaukik upajat nrity sngit alag lag lage.. [2] rag hi men rng rahyau rng ke samudr men duo jhage. [3] shriharidas ke svami syama kunjabihari pai rng rahyau ras hi men page.. [4] - shri svami haridas ji, kelimal (2)
english_translation: (rag kanharau) ruchi ke prakas paraspar khelan lage. [1] rag ragini alaukik upajat nrity sngit alag lag lage.. [2] rag hi men rng rahyau rng ke samudr men duo jhage. [3] shriharidas ke svami syama kunjabihari pai rng rahyau ras hi men page.. [4] - shri svami haridas ji, kelimal (2)

title: वृन्दावन श्रवनन सुनहि - श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, वृन्दावन शत लीला (78)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन श्रवनन सुनहि, वृन्दावन को गान।
मन वच कै अति हेत सौं, वृन्दावन उर आन॥
- श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, वृन्दावन शत लीला (78)
english_text: vrindavan shravanan sunahi, vrindavan ko gan. man vach kai ati het saun, vrindavan ur an.. - shri dhruvadas ji, bayalis lila, vrindavan shat lila (78)
english_translation: vrindavan shravanan sunahi, vrindavan ko gan. man vach kai ati het saun, vrindavan ur an.. - shri dhruvadas ji, bayalis lila, vrindavan shat lila (78)

title: मन चेतु नहीं पछितावैगो - श्री नारायण स्वामी, ब्रज विहार, पद सिद्धान्त (5)
sanskrit_text:
(राग काफी)
मन चेतु नहीं पछितावैगो।
भजिलै रे श्रीनंदनँदनको, जो तोहि पार लगावैगो॥ [1]
झूठ साँच को ब्योहारन सों, कहँ लगि द्रव्य कमावैगो।
निशि बासर याही चिंता में, रो रोके मरि जावैगो॥ [2]
जिनके काज अनीति करत तू, काउ काम नहिं आवैगो।
जब यमदूत तोहि पकरेंगे, तब न कछू बस्यावैगो॥ [3]
नारायण तेरी-मेरी में, योंहीं उमरि गमावैगो।
अन्त समय ढिंग आय गयो अब, फिर कब हरिगुण गावैगो॥ [4]
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, ब्रज विहार, पद सिद्धान्त (5)
english_text: (rag kafi) man chetu nahin pachhitavaigo. bhajilai re shrinndanndanako, jo tohi par lagavaigo.. [1] jhuth sanch ko byoharan son, kahn lagi dravy kamavaigo. nishi basar yahi chinta men, ro roke mari javaigo.. [2] jinake kaj aniti karat tu, kau kam nahin avaigo. jab yamadut tohi pakarenge, tab n kachhu basyavaigo.. [3] narayan teri-meri men, yonhin umari gamavaigo. ant samay dhing ay gayo ab, fir kab harigun gavaigo.. [4] - shri narayan svami, braj vihar, pad siddhant (5)
english_translation: (rag kafi) man chetu nahin pachhitavaigo. bhajilai re shrinndanndanako, jo tohi par lagavaigo.. title: प्यारी तेरौ बदन अमृत की पंक तामें बींधे नैंन द्वै  - श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (7)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरौ)
प्यारी तेरौ बदन अमृत की पंक तामें बींधे नैंन द्वै। [1]
चित चल्यौ काढ़नि कौं बिकच संधि संपुट में रह्यौ भ्वै॥ [2]
बहुत उपाइ आहि री प्यारी पै न करत स्वे। [3]
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्यामा कुंजबिहारी ऐसैंई रहौ ह्वै॥ [4]
-ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (7)
english_text: (rag kanharau) pyari terau badan amrit ki pnk tamen bindhe nainn dvai. [1] chit chalyau kadhani kaun bikach sndhi snput men rahyau bhvai.. [2] bahut upai ahi ri pyari pai n karat sve. [3] shriharidas ke svami syama kunjabihari aisaini rahau hvai.. [4] -lalita avatar shri svami haridas ji, kelimal (7)
english_translation: (rag kanharau) pyari terau badan amrit ki pnk tamen bindhe nainn dvai. [1] chit chalyau kadhani kaun bikach sndhi snput men rahyau bhvai.. [2] bahut upai ahi ri pyari pai n karat sve. [3] shriharidas ke svami syama kunjabihari aisaini rahau hvai.. [4] -lalita avatar shri svami haridas ji, kelimal (7)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सदा हमारे पास है - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (274)
sanskrit_text:
सदा हमारे पास है, कुंजबिहारिनी बाल।
लियें सुभाव रहै सदा, छिन छिन करत निहाल॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (274)
english_text: sada hamare pas hai, kunjabiharini bal. liyen subhav rahai sada, chhin chhin karat nihal.. - shri lalit kishori dev, shri lalit kishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (274)
english_translation: sada hamare pas hai, kunjabiharini bal. liyen subhav rahai sada, chhin chhin karat nihal.. - shri lalit kishori dev, shri lalit kishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (274)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अवगुण करे समुद्र सम, गिनत न अपनों जान
sanskrit_text:
“अवगुण करे समुद्र सम, गिनत न अपनों जान । 
राई सम भजन को, मानत मेरु समान॥ ”
- श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला
english_text: “avagun kare samudr sam, ginat n apanon jan . rai sam bhajan ko, manat meru saman.. ” - shri dhruvadas, bayalis lila
english_translation: “avagun kare samudr sam, ginat n apanon jan . rai sam bhajan ko, manat meru saman.. ” - shri dhruvadas, bayalis lila

title: नित्य केली आनंद रस - श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह जी), श्री जुगल रस माधुरी (12)
sanskrit_text:
नित्य केली आनंद रस, बिच वृंदावन बाग।
“नागरिया” हिय में बसो, श्यामा श्याम सुहाग॥
- श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह जी), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, श्री जुगल रस माधुरी (12)
english_text: nity keli annd ras, bich vrindavan bag. “nagariya” hiy men baso, shyama shyam suhag.. - shri nagaridas (maharaj savnt sinh ji), shri nagaridas ji ki vani, shri jugal ras madhuri (12)
english_translation: nity keli annd ras, bich vrindavan bag. “nagariya” hiy men baso, shyama shyam suhag.. - shri nagaridas (maharaj savnt sinh ji), shri nagaridas ji ki vani, shri jugal ras madhuri (12)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यह वृन्दावन यह समैं - श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, निकुंज विलास (102)
sanskrit_text:
यह वृन्दावन यह समैं, यह दम्पति की प्रीति।
नागरिया कैं हिय बसो, निति विहार रस- रीति॥
- श्री नागरी दास (महाराज सावंत सिंह जी), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, निकुंज विलास (102)
english_text: yah vrindavan yah samain, yah dampati ki priti. nagariya kain hiy baso, niti vihar rasa- riti.. - shri nagari das (maharaj savnt sinh ji), shri nagaridas ji ki vani, nikunj vilas (102)
english_translation: yah vrindavan yah samain, yah dampati ki priti. nagariya kain hiy baso, niti vihar rasa- riti.. - shri nagari das (maharaj savnt sinh ji), shri nagaridas ji ki vani, nikunj vilas (102)

title: मोहन लाल के रंग राँची - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्रीहित स्फुट वाणी (12)
sanskrit_text:
(राग बिलावल एवं धनाश्री)
मोहन लाल के रंग राँची।
मेरे ख्याल परौ जिनि कोऊ, बात दसौं दिसि माँची॥ [1]
कंत अनंत करौ जो कोऊ, बात कहौं सुनि साँची।
यह जिय जाहु भलैं सिर ऊपर, हौंऽव प्रगट ह्वै नाँची॥ [2]
जागत शयन रहत उर ऊपर, मनि कंचन ज्यौं पाँची।
(जै श्री) हित हरिवंश डरौं काके डर, हौं नाहिन मति काँची॥ [3]
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्रीहित स्फुट वाणी (12)
english_text: (rag bilaval evn dhanashri) mohan lal ke rng ranchi. mere khyal parau jini kuo, bat dasaun disi manchi.. [1] knt annt karau jo kuo, bat kahaun suni sanchi. yah jiy jahu bhalain sir upar, haunऽv pragat hvai nanchi.. [2] jagat shayan rahat ur upar, mani knchan jyaun panchi. (jai shri) hit harivnsh daraun kake dar, haun nahin mati kanchi.. [3] - shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu, shrihit sfut vani (12)
english_translation: (rag bilaval evn dhanashri) mohan lal ke rng ranchi. mere khyal parau jini kuo, bat dasaun disi manchi.. [1] knt annt karau jo kuo, bat kahaun suni sanchi. yah jiy jahu bhalain sir upar, haunऽv pragat hvai nanchi.. [2] jagat shayan rahat ur upar, mani knchan jyaun panchi. (jai shri) hit harivnsh daraun kake dar, haun nahin mati kanchi.. [3] - shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu, shrihit sfut vani (12)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरे प्राणनाथ श्रीश्यामा, सपथ करौं तिन छियें - श्री हित स्फुट वाणी (20)
sanskrit_text:
मेरे प्राणनाथ श्रीश्यामा, सपथ करौं तिन छियें । "
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री स्फुट वाणी 


मैं शपथ खा कर कहता हूँ कि मेरी प्राणनाथ, स्वामिनी श्री लाड़ली जू महाराज, श्री राधा ही हैं।
english_text: mere prananath shrishyama, sapath karaun tin chhiyen . " - shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu, shri sfut vani main shapath kha kar kahata hun ki meri prananath, svamini shri ladali ju maharaj, shri radha hi hain.
english_translation: mere prananath shrishyama, sapath karaun tin chhiyen . " - shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu, shri sfut vani main shapath kha kar kahata hun ki meri prananath, svamini shri ladali ju maharaj, shri radha hi hain.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अपि सर्वधर्महीनः सर्वकुकर्मावलेश्च निर्माता - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.13)
sanskrit_text:
अपि सर्वधर्महीनः सर्वकुकर्मावलेश्च निर्माता।
राधेति सिद्धमन्त्रं द्व्यक्षरमुच्चार्य किं न सिध्येयम्?॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.13)
english_text: api sarvadharmahinh sarvakukarmavaleshch nirmata. radheti siddhamantrn dvyaksharamuchchary kin n sidhyeyam?.. - shri prabodhanand sarasvati, vrindavan mahimamrit (9.13)

title: धनि यह वृन्दावन की रेनु - श्री सूरदास जी, सूरसागर, वृन्दावन लीला (14)
sanskrit_text:
धनि यह वृन्दावन की रेनु। [1]
नंद-किसोर चरावत गैयाँ, मुखहिं बजावत बेनु॥ [2]
मन-मोहन को ध्यान धरै जिय, अति सुख पावत चैनु। [3]
चलत कहाँ मन और पुरी तन, जहँ कछु लैन न दैनु॥ [4]
इहाँ रहहु जहँ जूठनि पावहु, बृजवासिनि कै ऐनु। [5]
सूरदास ह्याँ की सरवरि नहि, कल्पवृच्छ सुर-धैनु॥ [6]
- श्री सूरदास जी, सूरसागर, वृन्दावन लीला (14)
english_text: dhani yah vrindavan ki renu. [1] nnda-kisor charavat gaiyan, mukhahin bajavat benu.. [2] mana-mohan ko dhyan dharai jiy, ati sukh pavat chainu. [3] chalat kahan man aur puri tan, jahn kachhu lain n dainu.. [4] ihan rahahu jahn juthani pavahu, brijavasini kai ainu. [5] suradas hyan ki saravari nahi, kalpavrichchh sura-dhainu.. [6] - shri suradas ji, surasagar, vrindavan lila (14)

title: प्रिया कहा करें मन बस नाँही - श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (59)
sanskrit_text:
प्रिया कहा करें मन बस नाँही। [1]
करनी कछू बनै नहिं मोपै मन बच क्रम सब अवगांही॥ [2]
एक उपाय एही है स्वामिनि अपनी जानि गहो बांही। [3]
श्रीहरिदास रसिक अनन्य बिन और ठौर हमकों नाँही॥ [4]
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (59)
english_text: priya kaha karen man bas nanhi. [1] karani kachhu banai nahin mopai man bach kram sab avaganhi.. [2] ek upay ehi hai svamini apani jani gaho banhi. [3] shriharidas rasik anany bin aur thaur hamakon nanhi.. [4] - shri lalit kishori dev, shri lalit kishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ke pad (59)
english_translation: priya kaha karen man bas nanhi. [1] karani kachhu banai nahin mopai man bach kram sab avaganhi.. [2] ek upay ehi hai svamini apani jani gaho banhi. [3] shriharidas rasik anany bin aur thaur hamakon nanhi.. [4] - shri lalit kishori dev, shri lalit kishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ke pad (59)

title: सारद नारद सेस - श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (3)
sanskrit_text:
सारद नारद सेस, सुरपति पसुपति प्रजापति।
बंदत रहैं हमेस, श्रीवृषभानु कुमारि पद॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर जी, ब्रज बिनोद, श्रीराधा शतक (3)
english_text: sarad narad ses, surapati pasupati prajapati. bndat rahain hames, shrivrishabhanu kumari pad.. - shri lal balabir ji, braj binod, shriradha shatak (3)
english_translation: sarad narad ses, surapati pasupati prajapati. bndat rahain hames, shrivrishabhanu kumari pad.. - shri lal balabir ji, braj binod, shriradha shatak (3)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जयति जय राधा रसिक मनि मुकुट मनि - श्री हरिव्यास देवाचार्य, महावाणी, सेवा सुख (52)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
पराभक्ति रति वर्ध्दिनी, स्यामा सब सुख दैनि।
रसिक मुकुटमनि राधिके, जय नव नीरज नैनि॥
english_text: (doha) parabhakti rati vardhdini, syama sab sukh daini. rasik mukutamani radhike, jay nav niraj naini..
english_translation: (doha) parabhakti rati vardhdini, syama sab sukh daini. rasik mukutamani radhike, jay nav niraj naini..
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ललित किशोरी इत-उत राधे जित देखौं मैं तित तित राधे
sanskrit_text:
ललित किशोरी इत-उत राधे जित देखौं मैं तित तित राधे॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी
english_text: lalit kishori ita-ut radhe jit dekhaun main tit tit radhe.. - shri lalit kishori
