ki ayu men sinhasan par viraje. parntu 1776 men prithisinh ji devalok gami ho gae. tab unake chhote bhai pratapasinhaji vaishakh badi 3 budhavar 1778 ko gaddi par viraje. ye gaddi par baithane ke samay anumanath pndrah varsh ke the. vivah : maharaja savai pratapasinh ji ka vivah bhatyani ji se hua jinase unhen ek putr hua. putr ka nam jagatasinh rakha gaya. shasan prabndh : gaddi par baithate hi maharaj pratapasinhaji shasan prabndh karane lage. dusht firoj mahavat ko, jo vritha hi rajadhani men shahajor ho raha tha, fauj dekar maharaj pratapasinhaji ne manchaidai ke rav par bheja aur vahin usako ( firoj ko ) bohara khushaliram ne jahar dekar marava dala. mata chundavataji ki bhi paramagati ho gai. manchaiड़i ke rav ne fir sir uthaya tab unhone faujakashi karake use thik kiya. parntu bohara khushaliram, manchaiड़ivale se mila hua tha, is lie usane us rav ko kuchh ilaka dila diya. isase desh ki kuchh hani bhi ho gai. udhar marathon ka utpat badhata ja raha tha. marathe apani chauth rajasthanon se vasul karane ka purn udyog karate the. maharaj pratapasinhaji ke pita maharaj madhavasinhaji to malhararav ko fauj sahit lakar jayapur lene men safal hue hi the. us samay ka kuchh fauj - kharch bhi baki tha. isi se sendhiya jayapur par chadhai karana chahata tha. nitiman maharaja pratapasinhaji ne yah upay socha tha ki any rajavadaon ko milakar marathon ko sada ke liye rajaputane se nikal diya jay. isi liye unhonne 1786 men jodhapur ke maharaj vijayasinhaji ke pas daulataram haladiya ko bhejakar kahalaya ki yadi ap sath hon to marathon ko marakar nikal sakate hain. vijayasinh ji to is bat ko chahate hi the. unhonne turnt sena bhej di.1786 hi men donon rajyon ki sammilit sena ne lunga (dyausa ke pas ek kasba) ki badai ladai men sendhiya ki sena ko aisa parast kiya ki sab marathon par rajaputon ki shuravirata ka atnk chha gaya. parntu char hi varsh pichhe sendhiya ne jayapur par fir chadhai ki aur fir jayapur ne rathodaon ki fauj bulavai. patan ( toravati ) ke mukam par 1791 men bhari sngram hua jisamen pahale to jayapur ki jit hui parntu pichhe jodhapur ki fauj ke chanpavaton ne, jayapur valon ke tane marane se rusht hokar, sahayata nahin di aur is vishvasaghat se har khani padai. patan ki har ke pichhe mauka pakar holkar ne bhi fir chadhai ki aur us samay paristhiti thik n rahane se marathon se mel karana pada. tathapi kabhi sendhiya aur kabhi holkar se ladai-jhagada hota hi raha jisase rajy ko bahut hani pahunchi. jorj tamas ke safaraname ke havale se kaviraj shyamaladanaji ne marathon aur rajaputon ki ek bhari ladai ka, fatahapur ( shekhavati ) men, 1799 men, hona likha hai, jisamen marathon ki taraf se ukt sahab aur baman rav the tatha kavayad jananevali ek sena aur topen bhi sath men thin. jayapur ki fauj ne unako bhari shikast di aur unaka bahut dur tak pichha karake badai hani pahunchai. is ladai men bikaner aur kishanagadha ki faujen bhi madad ke liye ai thin. tunge ki vijay ke snbndh men karnal tod sahab ne maharaj pratapasinhaji ki bahut badha-chadhakar prashnsa likhi hai -- "maharaj pratapasinh ne svayn ranakshetr men sena ka parichalan kiya tha. is karan unake paksh men yah vijay vishesh prashasit mani gai. tunga ke is yuddh men vijay pakar maharaj pratapasinhaji ne ek baड़a utsav karake 24 lakh rupaya banta tha. is samar men vijay pane se ameradhish pratapasinh ji ke yash ka gaurav samast rajavadaon men fail gaya. pratapasihaji ek mahavir aur buddhiman raja the." parntu apas ki fut aur dasyu marathon ki luta-pat, pindariyon ki dakaiti aur akraman adi se us samay jo jo apattiyan upasthit hoti rahati thin unake nivaran karane men in maharaj ne jitana udyog kiya utana kadachit dhundhahada ke kisi bhi raja ko n karana pada hoga. jayapur ki vnshavali ( khyat ) men likha hai ki sendhiya patel ki fatah ke pichhe revadai ke dere men badashah aya tha. vahan maharaj usase milane gae. us samay inaki buddhimani aur virata se badashah bahut prasann hua aur inase mntri ka kam karane ke liye kaha. maharaj ne shishtachar ki baten karake use tal diya. maharaj pratapasinhaji ko marathon adi ke daman karane aur anek yuddh adi karane men apane jivan me badai badai kathinaiyan bhogani padai hain. laड़aiyon ka kharch aur apattiyan tatha klesh kitane uthane paड़te hain, yah bat anubhavi purushon se chhipi nahin hai. jayapur ka khajana, jo kuber ka bhandar samajha jata tha, bahut kuchh in yuddhon me khali ho gaya tha. maharaj savai jayasinhaji ke samay men yah bhara-pura tha. ashvamedh yajny, jayapura- nirman aur jodhapur ki chadhai tatha any ladaiyon men unake samay men bhi isaka ek ansh vyay ho gaya tha. fir ishvarisinhaji aur madhavasinhaji donon bhaiyon ki ladai men ek badai rakam nikal chuki thi. avastha men bhi maharaj pratapasinhaji ne apani buddhimani aur niti-parayanata se sab ladaiyon ka kharch chalaya aur bahut virata, sahas aur yogyata se us kathin kal men rajy ki raksha ki jab bharatavarsh gahare viplavon men duba hua tha aur yah rajy shatruon se samaya-samay par akrant aur trast hota tha. bharatavarsh men yah yugantar ya yug parivartan ka samay tha, jisaka hal itihas padhanevalon ko bhali bhanti vidit hain. prasiddh nirman kary [hava mahal jayapur ityadi] : maharaj pratapasinhaji ke samay men imaraten bhi bahut bani thin; udaharanarth chndramahal men kai vishal bhavan, ridhasidhapal, badha divanakhana, shri govindaji ke pichhadai ka hauj, havamahal, shri govardhananathaji ka mndir, shri brajarajavihariji ka mndir, thakur shri brajanidhiji ka mndir, shri pratapeshvaraji mahadev ka mndir, khas mahalon se havamahal tak surng, shri madanamohanaji ka mndir ityadi. jayapur ke yntralay ki marammat bhi hui. kilon ki marammat karai gai aur nai topen ityadi banavai gai. 'havamahal' ki karigari snsar men prasiddh hai. havamahal par inaka prem tha. isake nirman men inaki bhagavadbhakti bhi karanibhut thi, jaisa ki maharaj ne “ shribrajanidhi-muktavali" men likha hai- havamahal yaten kiyo, sab samajho yah bhav. radhe krishn sidharasi, daras paras ko hav.. guru diksha : akhil bharatiy jagadguru shrinimbarkacharyapith par jab shri 'shriji' shrisarveshvarasharanadevacharyaji maharaj abhishikt hue, tab kuchh samay bad ve jayapur padhare, jahan maharaja pratapasinhaji ne unase vaishnavi diksha lekar unaka vishesh mana-samman kiya aur unaki ajnyanusar anyany vaishnav sampradayon ke mahant santon ka bhi samuchit satkar kiya, is sambandh men jayapur ke prakhyat kavi shrimndanabhattaji ne shri sarveshvarasharanadevacharyaji ke prasng men likha hai - madhav mahindr sut shripratap, bulavay kiye guru kari milap. nij mahal bich mandir banay, tamen padharaye shir navay. radhanandanandan bhaktibhav, sikhe pratap nrip rachi subhav. kar diye raghukul ke guru ganesh, sanche sevak huv pratapesh. tin guru charanan ko yog pay, diye sampraday charon jamay.. maharaj brajanidhi ji ko bhagavadbhakti ka chasaka laganevalon men pradhan 'jagannath bhatt' (kishori ali) the jinaki stuti men maharaj ne likha hai - main kahaun kaha ab kripa tumhari. yahi kripa kari gur mai pae jagannath upakari.. jaten meri lagan lagi hai takau det mila ri. "brajanidhi" raj sanvaro dhota takau die bata ri.. - haripad - sngrah 191 bhattaji ke siva 'bnsiali', adi bhakti ras piyush ko badhanevale aur vidvan bhi the. apane isht se prem evn pratyaksh darshan : jis tarah bahy shatruon ko vijay karane ka maharaj brajanidhi ji ko vah yug prapt tha vaise hi abhyntar shatruon ( krodh adi) ko jitane, bhagavan ki bhakti karane aur uttam purushon aur guniyon ke satsng ka shubh avasar bhi unhe prapt tha, jisake liye unake hriday me sada umng raha karati thi. shri radha-govindaji maharaj ke charanaravindon men maharaj ki atal anany bhakti thi. unhin ki kripa se inako bhakti ka labh hua aur us bhakti ke udgar men anek grnthon ki rachana hui. maharaj brajanidhi ji radha-govindaji ko dndavat karate aur darshanon ke pichhe nity stuti ya pad sunate, jinaki nity nai rachana svayn karate the. vishesh avasar aur utsavon par bahut samaroh se annd ka samaj karate. ras lilaen karate. kahate hain ki shri govindadevaji inako bal rup aur kishor rup se pratyaksh darshan dete the. inake padon se bhi yah bat vidit hoti hai, jinamen is pratyaksh darshan ka ullekh hai. yatha- rekhata guladavadi bahar bich yar khush khada tha. gulajar gul sanam ki gul se bhi gul pada tha.. poshak rng havasi saj ke dhaj ka taड़taड़a tha . pukharaj ka bhi jevar nakha-sikh ajab jada tha.. vah nur ka jahur ada par ladajhada tha. dekhate hi maine jisako ain aड़baड़a tha.. dil ka dalel dilabar dil chorane aड़a tha. 'brajanidhi' hai vohi dadhi par chhala-bal se chhuk lada tha.. - rekhata-sngrah 168 thakur shri brajanidhi ji ki sthapana : kisi aise aparadh ke karan kuchh varshon pichhe shri thakuraji ke pratyaksh darshan bnd ho gae jinhen keval maharaja savai pratapasinh ji hi janate the. us samay maharaj bahut vyakul hue. tab svapn men inako yah ajnya hui ki " tu apane prem ke anusar meri prithak pratima bana aur mahalon ke samip mndir banakar usamen virajaman kara, vahan tujhe darshan hua karenge." ath maharaj ne shri brajanidhiji ki shyamamurtti apane purn prem se banavai. koi koi kahate hain ki murti ka mukharavind maharaj ne apane hath se kora. fir mndir men patotsav ki jo pratishtha hui usaka bada utsav hua aur 'daulataramaji' haladiya ke yahan priya-priyatam ( radha - krishn ) ka vivah hua. arthat unake yahan jakar thakur shri brajanidhiji ka vivah hone par priyaji mndir men padharin. beti ke vivah men jitani baten avashyak hoti hain ve sab daulataramaji ne badae kharch aur utsah se kin. aur fir sada sab tyoharon par beti ko jo vastr, abhushan, chhappan bhog, chhattis vynjan adi bheja karate hain ve bhi bhejate rahe. adyapi unake vnshaj tijon ka sijara adi mndir men bhejate hain. shri govindadevaji ko brajanidhiji maharaj ne svayn apana ishtadev bataya hai, jaisa ki in chhndon se spasht vidit hai. (bihaga) hamare isht hai gobind . radhika sukha-sadhika sng ramat ban svachchhnd.. hiye nita- prati basau 'vrajanidhi' bhavati nndalal.. - hari-pada-sngrah 163 shri thakur ji ka pratapasinh ji ko "brajanidhi" nam pradan karana : "brajanidhi" upanam bhi maharaja savai pratapasinh ji ko shri thakuraji ne pradan kiya tha. maharaj ne isi bat ko is prakar kaha hai. yatha- rekhata dil tadapata hai husn tere ko. kab milega mujhe salona syam.. ab to jaldi se a daras dijai. jo inayat kiya hai 'brajanidhi' nam.. - hari-pada-sngrah 165 sorath (dev gndhar dhima chhit ) sanchi priti son bas syam. dharyau 'brajanidhi' nam tau ab lijie chit chori.. - hari-pada-sngrah 166 rachana : maharaja savai pratapasinh ji achchhe kavi the, apane padon men brajanidhi ki chhap lagate the, ath bahut se unhen brajanidhi bhi kahate the, mishrabandhuon ne inaki rachanaon men - 1. shringgara-manyjari, 2. niti-mnjari, 3. vairagy mnjari adi ka ullekh kiya hai, aur rachanakal 1778 mana hai. sneh sngram, snchasagar, rekhata aur bhartrihari shatak ki tika inaka rachana-kal 1795 mana hai. inaki rachanaon ka sngrah "brajanidhi grnthavali" ke nam se nagari pracharini sabha, kashi ne prakashit karavaya hai. maharaja savai pratapasinh ji ke kavy ke antargat vidyaman varnyavimayon men niti, vairagy, upadesh, shrringar, snyog, virah, prem evn upasana ke satha-sath rasaliladi ka bhi chitran atyant utkrisht rup men ankit kiya gaya hai. shri radhamadhav ke prati ananyata, dinata evn priti ko prakat karate hue, brajanidhi ji ne rasalilantargat vnshivadan se lekar nrity, abhinay evn rati-ramanotsav ka bhi sangopang nirupan kiya hai. inaki rachanaon ke antargat brajabhasha ke prayog men rajasthani, pnjabi, snskrit, urdu, farasi tatha khadai boli ke shabdon ka bhi samavesh drishtigochar hota hai. rachanaon men in bhashaon ke shabdon ke prayog se, jahan ek or, brajabhasha men prasada-gun jhalakata hai, vahin dusari or brajabhasha ka madhury bhi barabar sthir rahata hai. is prakar, brajanidhi ji rasalila ke anukaran sambandhi utsavon ko to sahayata evn protsahan dete hi the, sath hi rasalila vishayak pad ityadi ki bhi rachanayen atynt manoyog evn bhakti purvak karate the. shri radhakrishn yugal anany bhakti hone se, inaki rasalilabhivynjana mi paramparik evn ahlad karak hai. ham to chakar nandakishor ke. rahen sada sanamukh rakh lie gauri garab garur ke.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pada-19 apane rasalila-nirupan men bhi, shri brajanidhi ji men prathamath vnshivadan ki hi pratishtha a jati hai. yahan bhi shrikrishn ki vnshi aise madhur prem ke svaron ka prasaran karati hai, ki shrikrishn milan ki utkantha se brajadeviyan adhir ban jati hain aur ve chal hi deti hai. mohan madan mantr padhai daryo. ghar men rahyo jat nahi sajani vnsi men lai nam ucharyo.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pad 71 sachamuch shrikrishn ki is vnshi dhvani ne aisi mohini dali thi ki sabhi brajadeviyan thakit, chakit tatha vashibhut ho gai thin. parinamath vnshi ke madhur svar ke sath unake dvara vadit vividh vadyon ki dhvaniyan tatha nupuradi ki jhnkritiyon ne bhi, vrindavan ke rasotsav men, ek abhut purv sngit vad ki srishti ki thi. rajat bnsi madhur dhuni man mohan ki an. sunat thakit chakrit rahi adbhut ati hi tan.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, premaprakas, snkhya-36 'ras ka rekhata' - namak apani rachana men to shri brajanidhi ji ne rasalila ka nirupan kiya hi hai, sath hi any kai rachanaon men bhi rasalila ko varny vishay banaya hai. mandalakar ras ke madhy lalita dvara tathaii-thaii ka madhur uchcharan, shriyugal ka rasasikt avalokan, netra-snket, svarupaiky, vady vadan, muralidhvani, nrity evn bhagavan shiv ka sakhi rup se rasalila men pravesh tatha nrity adi sharadchandrika men ek abhutapurv ras ki srishti kar dete hain. lalita diyo ughatati tarthai thie thei. ras - mandal bich jhehen piy pyari.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, ras ka rekhata is divy rasalila men natanagar shri krishn to apana nity nutan kaushal pradarshit karate hi hain, sath hi vahan ka vatavaran, brajanganayen, cheshtaen, saja-sajjaen, gita-gayan, lila- vilas, vadya-dhvaniyan, vinod, premavartaen tatha hava-bhav kataksh adi bhi nity navin rup men drishtigochar hote hain. fulavan son jhuki rahi lata mahin thadhae jahan kunvar natanagar. naval lal nav bal bhal gal basan naye bhushanahi ujagar.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pada- 61 sakhiyon sahit shriyugal ke kunja- rasalila nrity ka bhi jo varnan shri brajanidhi ji ne kiya hai, vah bhi sngit evn ras ke utkarsh ka dyotak hai. viharat radhe sng vihari. kunj bhavan sital druma-chhaiyan chnda-jyoti ujiyari.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pada-31 is ras lila nrity men paraspar git gayan, nrity, vady vadan evn shripriya ji ka kaushal itane asadharan rup men pradarshit hota hai ki raseshvar krishn besudh tak ho jate hain. naval vihari naval tiy jori param pravin. gan duo kari paras par, bhae adhik adhin.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajashrringar, doha-36, 37, 38, 39 is prakar priya ji shri krishn ko apane kaushal se besudh bhi kar deti hain aur vihval bhi. prem men chhake hain duo ras ki chuhal badhai, gan kiyo ani piy pyari ati an son. - brajanidhi grnthavali, braj shrringar, kavitt - 40 rasalila ke paramotkarsh rup rati-ramanotsav ka bhi chitran, shri brajanidhi ji ne atyant madhuryapurn dhng se kiya hai. inake is nirupan men rasalila-nrity ke sath rati-ramanotsav rupi rasalila ke do hi rup atyant sangopang rup men pari lakshit hain. lila snvaran : is prakar rajy ki raksha karate hue tatha apane param isht shri govindevaji ke charanon men atal bhakti rakhate hue maharaj savai pratapasinh ji ab us samay ke nikat a pahunche jab aganit chintaon se unaka man khinn ho gaya aur unake sharir men rudhir vikar aur fir atisar rog ki prabalata ho gai. is avastha men ye prayh thakur shri brajanidhiji ke charanon ke tale tahakhane men aram kiya karate. inake samay men badae badae nami vaidy the, jinhonne aushadhi-prayog ke dvara jal se bhare hauj tak ko jama diya tha. parntu unaki ve aushadhiyan bhi is atisar ko rokane men asamarth rahin. antatogatva inaki pavitr atma ne, golok - vas karane ke liye, inake nashvar sharir ko miti savan sudi 13 1803 ko tyag diya. dhundhahada ke ek nami, parakrami, jnyani-dhyani, vidvan aur vidya- kala rasik, guniyon aur kaviyon ke grahak raja is snsar se uth gae! parntu apani atal kirtti ko jo unake alaukik karyon, sahitya-seva, guna-grahakata aur bhagavat-prem ke karan pratishthit thi - is jagat men chhoda gae. maharaj ka dahakarm 'getor' men hua, jahan inake purvajon ( pita aur pitamah ) ki samadhiyan hain. vahin safed patthar ki sundar chhatari inaki smriti raksha ke nimitt bani hui hai. inake pichhe inake maharajakumar jagatasinhaji gaddi par virajaman hue.

parntu bohara khushaliram, manchaiड़ivale se mila hua tha, is lie usane us rav ko kuchh ilaka dila diya. isase desh ki kuchh hani bhi ho gai. udhar marathon ka utpat badhata ja raha tha. marathe apani chauth rajasthanon se vasul karane ka purn udyog karate the. maharaj pratapasinhaji ke pita maharaj madhavasinhaji to malhararav ko fauj sahit lakar jayapur lene men safal hue hi the. us samay ka kuchh fauj - kharch bhi baki tha. isi se sendhiya jayapur par chadhai karana chahata tha. nitiman maharaja pratapasinhaji ne yah upay socha tha ki any rajavadaon ko milakar marathon ko sada ke liye rajaputane se nikal diya jay. isi liye unhonne 1786 men jodhapur ke maharaj vijayasinhaji ke pas daulataram haladiya ko bhejakar kahalaya ki yadi ap sath hon to marathon ko marakar nikal sakate hain. vijayasinh ji to is bat ko chahate hi the. unhonne turnt sena bhej di.1786 hi men donon rajyon ki sammilit sena ne lunga (dyausa ke pas ek kasba) ki badai ladai men sendhiya ki sena ko aisa parast kiya ki sab marathon par rajaputon ki shuravirata ka atnk chha gaya. parntu char hi varsh pichhe sendhiya ne jayapur par fir chadhai ki aur fir jayapur ne rathodaon ki fauj bulavai. patan ( toravati ) ke mukam par 1791 men bhari sngram hua jisamen pahale to jayapur ki jit hui parntu pichhe jodhapur ki fauj ke chanpavaton ne, jayapur valon ke tane marane se rusht hokar, sahayata nahin di aur is vishvasaghat se har khani padai. patan ki har ke pichhe mauka pakar holkar ne bhi fir chadhai ki aur us samay paristhiti thik n rahane se marathon se mel karana pada. tathapi kabhi sendhiya aur kabhi holkar se ladai-jhagada hota hi raha jisase rajy ko bahut hani pahunchi. jorj tamas ke safaraname ke havale se kaviraj shyamaladanaji ne marathon aur rajaputon ki ek bhari ladai ka, fatahapur ( shekhavati ) men, 1799 men, hona likha hai, jisamen marathon ki taraf se ukt sahab aur baman rav the tatha kavayad jananevali ek sena aur topen bhi sath men thin. jayapur ki fauj ne unako bhari shikast di aur unaka bahut dur tak pichha karake badai hani pahunchai. is ladai men bikaner aur kishanagadha ki faujen bhi madad ke liye ai thin. tunge ki vijay ke snbndh men karnal tod sahab ne maharaj pratapasinhaji ki bahut badha-chadhakar prashnsa likhi hai -- "maharaj pratapasinh ne svayn ranakshetr men sena ka parichalan kiya tha. is karan unake paksh men yah vijay vishesh prashasit mani gai. tunga ke is yuddh men vijay pakar maharaj pratapasinhaji ne ek baड़a utsav karake 24 lakh rupaya banta tha. is samar men vijay pane se ameradhish pratapasinh ji ke yash ka gaurav samast rajavadaon men fail gaya. pratapasihaji ek mahavir aur buddhiman raja the." parntu apas ki fut aur dasyu marathon ki luta-pat, pindariyon ki dakaiti aur akraman adi se us samay jo jo apattiyan upasthit hoti rahati thin unake nivaran karane men in maharaj ne jitana udyog kiya utana kadachit dhundhahada ke kisi bhi raja ko n karana pada hoga. jayapur ki vnshavali ( khyat ) men likha hai ki sendhiya patel ki fatah ke pichhe revadai ke dere men badashah aya tha. vahan maharaj usase milane gae. us samay inaki buddhimani aur virata se badashah bahut prasann hua aur inase mntri ka kam karane ke liye kaha. maharaj ne shishtachar ki baten karake use tal diya. maharaj pratapasinhaji ko marathon adi ke daman karane aur anek yuddh adi karane men apane jivan me badai badai kathinaiyan bhogani padai hain. laड़aiyon ka kharch aur apattiyan tatha klesh kitane uthane paड़te hain, yah bat anubhavi purushon se chhipi nahin hai. jayapur ka khajana, jo kuber ka bhandar samajha jata tha, bahut kuchh in yuddhon me khali ho gaya tha. maharaj savai jayasinhaji ke samay men yah bhara-pura tha. ashvamedh yajny, jayapura- nirman aur jodhapur ki chadhai tatha any ladaiyon men unake samay men bhi isaka ek ansh vyay ho gaya tha. fir ishvarisinhaji aur madhavasinhaji donon bhaiyon ki ladai men ek badai rakam nikal chuki thi. avastha men bhi maharaj pratapasinhaji ne apani buddhimani aur niti-parayanata se sab ladaiyon ka kharch chalaya aur bahut virata, sahas aur yogyata se us kathin kal men rajy ki raksha ki jab bharatavarsh gahare viplavon men duba hua tha aur yah rajy shatruon se samaya-samay par akrant aur trast hota tha. bharatavarsh men yah yugantar ya yug parivartan ka samay tha, jisaka hal itihas padhanevalon ko bhali bhanti vidit hain. prasiddh nirman kary [hava mahal jayapur ityadi] : maharaj pratapasinhaji ke samay men imaraten bhi bahut bani thin; udaharanarth chndramahal men kai vishal bhavan, ridhasidhapal, badha divanakhana, shri govindaji ke pichhadai ka hauj, havamahal, shri govardhananathaji ka mndir, shri brajarajavihariji ka mndir, thakur shri brajanidhiji ka mndir, shri pratapeshvaraji mahadev ka mndir, khas mahalon se havamahal tak surng, shri madanamohanaji ka mndir ityadi. jayapur ke yntralay ki marammat bhi hui. kilon ki marammat karai gai aur nai topen ityadi banavai gai. 'havamahal' ki karigari snsar men prasiddh hai. havamahal par inaka prem tha. isake nirman men inaki bhagavadbhakti bhi karanibhut thi, jaisa ki maharaj ne “ shribrajanidhi-muktavali" men likha hai- havamahal yaten kiyo, sab samajho yah bhav. radhe krishn sidharasi, daras paras ko hav.. guru diksha : akhil bharatiy jagadguru shrinimbarkacharyapith par jab shri 'shriji' shrisarveshvarasharanadevacharyaji maharaj abhishikt hue, tab kuchh samay bad ve jayapur padhare, jahan maharaja pratapasinhaji ne unase vaishnavi diksha lekar unaka vishesh mana-samman kiya aur unaki ajnyanusar anyany vaishnav sampradayon ke mahant santon ka bhi samuchit satkar kiya, is sambandh men jayapur ke prakhyat kavi shrimndanabhattaji ne shri sarveshvarasharanadevacharyaji ke prasng men likha hai - madhav mahindr sut shripratap, bulavay kiye guru kari milap. nij mahal bich mandir banay, tamen padharaye shir navay. radhanandanandan bhaktibhav, sikhe pratap nrip rachi subhav. kar diye raghukul ke guru ganesh, sanche sevak huv pratapesh. tin guru charanan ko yog pay, diye sampraday charon jamay.. maharaj brajanidhi ji ko bhagavadbhakti ka chasaka laganevalon men pradhan 'jagannath bhatt' (kishori ali) the jinaki stuti men maharaj ne likha hai - main kahaun kaha ab kripa tumhari. yahi kripa kari gur mai pae jagannath upakari.. jaten meri lagan lagi hai takau det mila ri. "brajanidhi" raj sanvaro dhota takau die bata ri.. - haripad - sngrah 191 bhattaji ke siva 'bnsiali', adi bhakti ras piyush ko badhanevale aur vidvan bhi the. apane isht se prem evn pratyaksh darshan : jis tarah bahy shatruon ko vijay karane ka maharaj brajanidhi ji ko vah yug prapt tha vaise hi abhyntar shatruon ( krodh adi) ko jitane, bhagavan ki bhakti karane aur uttam purushon aur guniyon ke satsng ka shubh avasar bhi unhe prapt tha, jisake liye unake hriday me sada umng raha karati thi. shri radha-govindaji maharaj ke charanaravindon men maharaj ki atal anany bhakti thi. unhin ki kripa se inako bhakti ka labh hua aur us bhakti ke udgar men anek grnthon ki rachana hui. maharaj brajanidhi ji radha-govindaji ko dndavat karate aur darshanon ke pichhe nity stuti ya pad sunate, jinaki nity nai rachana svayn karate the. vishesh avasar aur utsavon par bahut samaroh se annd ka samaj karate. ras lilaen karate. kahate hain ki shri govindadevaji inako bal rup aur kishor rup se pratyaksh darshan dete the. inake padon se bhi yah bat vidit hoti hai, jinamen is pratyaksh darshan ka ullekh hai. yatha- rekhata guladavadi bahar bich yar khush khada tha. gulajar gul sanam ki gul se bhi gul pada tha.. poshak rng havasi saj ke dhaj ka taड़taड़a tha . pukharaj ka bhi jevar nakha-sikh ajab jada tha.. vah nur ka jahur ada par ladajhada tha. dekhate hi maine jisako ain aड़baड़a tha.. dil ka dalel dilabar dil chorane aड़a tha. 'brajanidhi' hai vohi dadhi par chhala-bal se chhuk lada tha.. - rekhata-sngrah 168 thakur shri brajanidhi ji ki sthapana : kisi aise aparadh ke karan kuchh varshon pichhe shri thakuraji ke pratyaksh darshan bnd ho gae jinhen keval maharaja savai pratapasinh ji hi janate the. us samay maharaj bahut vyakul hue. tab svapn men inako yah ajnya hui ki " tu apane prem ke anusar meri prithak pratima bana aur mahalon ke samip mndir banakar usamen virajaman kara, vahan tujhe darshan hua karenge." ath maharaj ne shri brajanidhiji ki shyamamurtti apane purn prem se banavai. koi koi kahate hain ki murti ka mukharavind maharaj ne apane hath se kora. fir mndir men patotsav ki jo pratishtha hui usaka bada utsav hua aur 'daulataramaji' haladiya ke yahan priya-priyatam ( radha - krishn ) ka vivah hua. arthat unake yahan jakar thakur shri brajanidhiji ka vivah hone par priyaji mndir men padharin. beti ke vivah men jitani baten avashyak hoti hain ve sab daulataramaji ne badae kharch aur utsah se kin. aur fir sada sab tyoharon par beti ko jo vastr, abhushan, chhappan bhog, chhattis vynjan adi bheja karate hain ve bhi bhejate rahe. adyapi unake vnshaj tijon ka sijara adi mndir men bhejate hain. shri govindadevaji ko brajanidhiji maharaj ne svayn apana ishtadev bataya hai, jaisa ki in chhndon se spasht vidit hai. (bihaga) hamare isht hai gobind . radhika sukha-sadhika sng ramat ban svachchhnd.. hiye nita- prati basau 'vrajanidhi' bhavati nndalal.. - hari-pada-sngrah 163 shri thakur ji ka pratapasinh ji ko "brajanidhi" nam pradan karana : "brajanidhi" upanam bhi maharaja savai pratapasinh ji ko shri thakuraji ne pradan kiya tha. maharaj ne isi bat ko is prakar kaha hai. yatha- rekhata dil tadapata hai husn tere ko. kab milega mujhe salona syam.. ab to jaldi se a daras dijai. jo inayat kiya hai 'brajanidhi' nam.. - hari-pada-sngrah 165 sorath (dev gndhar dhima chhit ) sanchi priti son bas syam. dharyau 'brajanidhi' nam tau ab lijie chit chori.. - hari-pada-sngrah 166 rachana : maharaja savai pratapasinh ji achchhe kavi the, apane padon men brajanidhi ki chhap lagate the, ath bahut se unhen brajanidhi bhi kahate the, mishrabandhuon ne inaki rachanaon men - 1. shringgara-manyjari, 2. niti-mnjari, 3. vairagy mnjari adi ka ullekh kiya hai, aur rachanakal 1778 mana hai. sneh sngram, snchasagar, rekhata aur bhartrihari shatak ki tika inaka rachana-kal 1795 mana hai. inaki rachanaon ka sngrah "brajanidhi grnthavali" ke nam se nagari pracharini sabha, kashi ne prakashit karavaya hai. maharaja savai pratapasinh ji ke kavy ke antargat vidyaman varnyavimayon men niti, vairagy, upadesh, shrringar, snyog, virah, prem evn upasana ke satha-sath rasaliladi ka bhi chitran atyant utkrisht rup men ankit kiya gaya hai. shri radhamadhav ke prati ananyata, dinata evn priti ko prakat karate hue, brajanidhi ji ne rasalilantargat vnshivadan se lekar nrity, abhinay evn rati-ramanotsav ka bhi sangopang nirupan kiya hai. inaki rachanaon ke antargat brajabhasha ke prayog men rajasthani, pnjabi, snskrit, urdu, farasi tatha khadai boli ke shabdon ka bhi samavesh drishtigochar hota hai. rachanaon men in bhashaon ke shabdon ke prayog se, jahan ek or, brajabhasha men prasada-gun jhalakata hai, vahin dusari or brajabhasha ka madhury bhi barabar sthir rahata hai. is prakar, brajanidhi ji rasalila ke anukaran sambandhi utsavon ko to sahayata evn protsahan dete hi the, sath hi rasalila vishayak pad ityadi ki bhi rachanayen atynt manoyog evn bhakti purvak karate the. shri radhakrishn yugal anany bhakti hone se, inaki rasalilabhivynjana mi paramparik evn ahlad karak hai. ham to chakar nandakishor ke. rahen sada sanamukh rakh lie gauri garab garur ke.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pada-19 apane rasalila-nirupan men bhi, shri brajanidhi ji men prathamath vnshivadan ki hi pratishtha a jati hai. yahan bhi shrikrishn ki vnshi aise madhur prem ke svaron ka prasaran karati hai, ki shrikrishn milan ki utkantha se brajadeviyan adhir ban jati hain aur ve chal hi deti hai. mohan madan mantr padhai daryo. ghar men rahyo jat nahi sajani vnsi men lai nam ucharyo.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pad 71 sachamuch shrikrishn ki is vnshi dhvani ne aisi mohini dali thi ki sabhi brajadeviyan thakit, chakit tatha vashibhut ho gai thin. parinamath vnshi ke madhur svar ke sath unake dvara vadit vividh vadyon ki dhvaniyan tatha nupuradi ki jhnkritiyon ne bhi, vrindavan ke rasotsav men, ek abhut purv sngit vad ki srishti ki thi. rajat bnsi madhur dhuni man mohan ki an. sunat thakit chakrit rahi adbhut ati hi tan.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, premaprakas, snkhya-36 'ras ka rekhata' - namak apani rachana men to shri brajanidhi ji ne rasalila ka nirupan kiya hi hai, sath hi any kai rachanaon men bhi rasalila ko varny vishay banaya hai. mandalakar ras ke madhy lalita dvara tathaii-thaii ka madhur uchcharan, shriyugal ka rasasikt avalokan, netra-snket, svarupaiky, vady vadan, muralidhvani, nrity evn bhagavan shiv ka sakhi rup se rasalila men pravesh tatha nrity adi sharadchandrika men ek abhutapurv ras ki srishti kar dete hain. lalita diyo ughatati tarthai thie thei. ras - mandal bich jhehen piy pyari.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, ras ka rekhata is divy rasalila men natanagar shri krishn to apana nity nutan kaushal pradarshit karate hi hain, sath hi vahan ka vatavaran, brajanganayen, cheshtaen, saja-sajjaen, gita-gayan, lila- vilas, vadya-dhvaniyan, vinod, premavartaen tatha hava-bhav kataksh adi bhi nity navin rup men drishtigochar hote hain. fulavan son jhuki rahi lata mahin thadhae jahan kunvar natanagar. naval lal nav bal bhal gal basan naye bhushanahi ujagar.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pada- 61 sakhiyon sahit shriyugal ke kunja- rasalila nrity ka bhi jo varnan shri brajanidhi ji ne kiya hai, vah bhi sngit evn ras ke utkarsh ka dyotak hai. viharat radhe sng vihari. kunj bhavan sital druma-chhaiyan chnda-jyoti ujiyari.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajanidhi muktavali, pada-31 is ras lila nrity men paraspar git gayan, nrity, vady vadan evn shripriya ji ka kaushal itane asadharan rup men pradarshit hota hai ki raseshvar krishn besudh tak ho jate hain. naval vihari naval tiy jori param pravin. gan duo kari paras par, bhae adhik adhin.. - brajanidhi grnthavali, brajashrringar, doha-36, 37, 38, 39 is prakar priya ji shri krishn ko apane kaushal se besudh bhi kar deti hain aur vihval bhi. prem men chhake hain duo ras ki chuhal badhai, gan kiyo ani piy pyari ati an son. - brajanidhi grnthavali, braj shrringar, kavitt - 40 rasalila ke paramotkarsh rup rati-ramanotsav ka bhi chitran, shri brajanidhi ji ne atyant madhuryapurn dhng se kiya hai. inake is nirupan men rasalila-nrity ke sath rati-ramanotsav rupi rasalila ke do hi rup atyant sangopang rup men pari lakshit hain. lila snvaran : is prakar rajy ki raksha karate hue tatha apane param isht shri govindevaji ke charanon men atal bhakti rakhate hue maharaj savai pratapasinh ji ab us samay ke nikat a pahunche jab aganit chintaon se unaka man khinn ho gaya aur unake sharir men rudhir vikar aur fir atisar rog ki prabalata ho gai. is avastha men ye prayh thakur shri brajanidhiji ke charanon ke tale tahakhane men aram kiya karate. inake samay men badae badae nami vaidy the, jinhonne aushadhi-prayog ke dvara jal se bhare hauj tak ko jama diya tha. parntu unaki ve aushadhiyan bhi is atisar ko rokane men asamarth rahin. antatogatva inaki pavitr atma ne, golok - vas karane ke liye, inake nashvar sharir ko miti savan sudi 13 1803 ko tyag diya. dhundhahada ke ek nami, parakrami, jnyani-dhyani, vidvan aur vidya- kala rasik, guniyon aur kaviyon ke grahak raja is snsar se uth gae! parntu apani atal kirtti ko jo unake alaukik karyon, sahitya-seva, guna-grahakata aur bhagavat-prem ke karan pratishthit thi - is jagat men chhoda gae. maharaj ka dahakarm 'getor' men hua, jahan inake purvajon ( pita aur pitamah ) ki samadhiyan hain. vahin safed patthar ki sundar chhatari inaki smriti raksha ke nimitt bani hui hai. inake pichhe inake maharajakumar jagatasinhaji gaddi par virajaman hue.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अन्यदेशागतो दूरात्परिभ्रमति यो नरः - वराहपुराण, मथुरा महात्म (160.83)
sanskrit_text:
अन्यदेशागतो दूरात्परिभ्रमति यो नरः। तस्य सन्दर्शनादन्ये पूताः स्युर्विगतामयाः॥
श्रुतं यैश्च विदूरस्थैः कृतयात्रं नरं नरैः। सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते यान्ति परमं पदम्॥
- वराहपुराण, मथुरा महात्म (160.83)
 
अन्य दूर देशों से आकर जो मनुष्य ब्रज की परिक्रमा करते हैं उनके दर्शन से ही अन्य मनुष्य भी पाप रहित हो जाते हैं।
english_text: anyadeshagato duratparibhramati yo narh. tasy sandarshanadanye putah syurvigatamayah.. shrutn yaishch vidurasthaih kritayatrn narn naraih. sarvapapavinirmuktaste yanti paramn padam.. - varahapuran, mathura mahatm (160.83) any dur deshon se akar jo manushy braj ki parikrama karate hain unake darshan se hi any manushy bhi pap rahit ho jate hain.
english_translation: anyadeshagato duratparibhramati yo narh. tasy sandarshanadanye putah syurvigatamayah.. shrutn yaishch vidurasthaih kritayatrn narn naraih. sarvapapavinirmuktaste yanti paramn padam.. - varahapuran, mathura mahatm (160.83) any dur deshon se akar jo manushy braj ki parikrama karate hain unake darshan se hi any manushy bhi pap rahit ho jate hain.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: व्यास विवेकी भगत सौं - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, साखी (67)
sanskrit_text:
व्यास विवेकी भगत सौं दृढ़ करि कीजै प्रीति। 
अविवेकी कौ संग तजि, इहै भक्ति की रीति॥ 
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, साखी (67)
english_text: vyas viveki bhagat saun driढ़ kari kijai priti. aviveki kau sng taji, ihai bhakti ki riti.. - shri hariram vyas, vyas vani, sakhi (67)
english_translation: vyas viveki bhagat saun driढ़ kari kijai priti. aviveki kau sng taji, ihai bhakti ki riti.. - shri hariram vyas, vyas vani, sakhi (67)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तस्मात् सर्वात्मनारुद्र मत् प्रियांशरणं व्रजेत् - सनत्कुमार संहिता (36.172)
sanskrit_text:
तस्मात् सर्वात्मनारुद्र मत् प्रियांशरणं व्रजेत्। 
य आशु मत् प्रिया भूत्वा मां वशीकर्तु मिच्छति। 
इदं रहस्यं परमं मया ते परिकीर्त्तितम्॥
- सनत्कुमार संहिता (36.172)
english_text: tasmat sarvatmanarudr mat priyansharann vrajet. y ashu mat priya bhutva man vashikartu michchhati. idn rahasyn paramn maya te parikirttitam.. - sanatkumar snhita (36.172)
english_translation: tasmat sarvatmanarudr mat priyansharann vrajet. y ashu mat priya bhutva man vashikartu michchhati. idn rahasyn paramn maya te parikirttitam.. - sanatkumar snhita (36.172)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्वान कहूं कि शृगाल कहूं कि - श्री सुंदरदास जी
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
श्वान कहूं कि शृगाल कहूं कि,
विडाल कहूं मन की मत्ति तैसी। [1]
ढेढ कहूं किधौ डूम कहूं किधौ,
भाड कहूं कि भडाइ दे जैसी॥ [2]
चौर कहूं, वट मार कहूं,
ठग जाइ कहूं, उपमा कहूं कैसी। [3]
सुन्दर और कहा कहिये अब,
या मन की गति दीसत ऐसी॥ [4]
- श्री सुंदरदास जी
english_text: (savaiya) shvan kahun ki shrigal kahun ki, vidal kahun man ki matti taisi. [1] dhedh kahun kidhau dum kahun kidhau, bhad kahun ki bhadai de jaisi.. [2] chaur kahun, vat mar kahun, thag jai kahun, upama kahun kaisi. [3] sundar aur kaha kahiye ab, ya man ki gati disat aisi.. [4] - shri sundaradas ji
english_translation: (savaiya) shvan kahun ki shrigal kahun ki, vidal kahun man ki matti taisi. [1] dhedh kahun kidhau dum kahun kidhau, bhad kahun ki bhadai de jaisi.. [2] chaur kahun, vat mar kahun, thag jai kahun, upama kahun kaisi. [3] sundar aur kaha kahiye ab, ya man ki gati disat aisi.. [4] - shri sundaradas ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जै जै रसिक रवनी रवन। रूप गुन लवन्य प्रभुता प्रेम पूरन भवन - श्री भगवत रसिक, भगवत रसिक की वानी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [पूर्वार्ध] (35)
sanskrit_text:
जै जै रसिक रवनी रवन। रूप गुन लवन्य प्रभुता प्रेम पूरन भवन॥
विपति जन की भानबे कौं तुम बिना कहु कवन।
- श्री भगवत रसिक, भगवत रसिक की वानी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [पूर्वार्ध] (35)
english_text: jai jai rasik ravani ravan. rup gun lavany prabhuta prem puran bhavan.. vipati jan ki bhanabe kaun tum bina kahu kavan. - shri bhagavat rasik, bhagavat rasik ki vani, anany nishchayatmak grnth [purvardha] (35)
english_translation: jai jai rasik ravani ravan. rup gun lavany prabhuta prem puran bhavan.. vipati jan ki bhanabe kaun tum bina kahu kavan. - shri bhagavat rasik, bhagavat rasik ki vani, anany nishchayatmak grnth [purvardha] (35)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नारायण तौ का भयो - श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (72)
sanskrit_text:
नारायण तौ का भयो, पाये नैन विशाल।
नैन वही जिन में बसें, श्रीराधा गोपाल॥
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (72)
english_text: narayan tau ka bhayo, paye nain vishal. nain vahi jin men basen, shriradha gopal.. - shri narayan svami, anurag ras (72)
english_translation: narayan tau ka bhayo, paye nain vishal. nain vahi jin men basen, shriradha gopal.. - shri narayan svami, anurag ras (72)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भक्ति भाव विस्वास न उपजे - श्री नागरी देव, श्री नागरी देव जी की वाणी (10)
sanskrit_text:
भक्ति भाव विस्वास न उपजे, घर घर रसिक कहाई।
बिन अनन्य संसार सिंधु में, फिर फिर गोता खाईं॥
- श्री नागरी देव, श्री नागरी देव जी की वाणी (10)
english_text: bhakti bhav visvas n upaje, ghar ghar rasik kahai. bin anany snsar sindhu men, fir fir gota khain.. - shri nagari dev, shri nagari dev ji ki vani (10)
english_translation: bhakti bhav visvas n upaje, ghar ghar rasik kahai. bin anany snsar sindhu men, fir fir gota khain.. - shri nagari dev, shri nagari dev ji ki vani (10)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: लखि औगुन तन आपनै भूल सबै सुधि जाइ- श्री रसनिधि
sanskrit_text:
लखि औगुन तन आपनै, भूल सबै सुधि जाइ। 
अधम-उधारन-विरद तुव, ‘रसनिधि’ सुमिर सुहाइ॥
- श्री रसनिधि
english_text: lakhi augun tan apanai, bhul sabai sudhi jai. adhama-udharana-virad tuv, ‘rasanidhi’ sumir suhai.. - shri rasanidhi
english_translation: lakhi augun tan apanai, bhul sabai sudhi jai. adhama-udharana-virad tuv, ‘rasanidhi’ sumir suhai.. - shri rasanidhi
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जात रूप तखत पै बैठी रूप रासि राधे - श्री हठी जी, श्री राधा सुधा शतक (25)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
जात रूप तखत पै बैठी रूप रासि राधे, 
अंगन की प्रभा प्रभाकर को लजावतीं। [1]
चीर चारु हीर हार हीय पहिराय कर, 
भूषन बनाय बाल साजन सजावतीं॥ [2]
अतर गुलाब लै सुगन्धन लगावै सबै, 
चन्दन चढ़ाय भाल भौरन भगावतीं। [3]
जोरि जोरि पानि देवतान हूँ की रानी ‘हठी’, 
कोटि कोटि कोरनिस झुकि कै बजावतीं॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, श्री राधा सुधा शतक (25)
english_text: (kavitta) jat rup takhat pai baithi rup rasi radhe, angan ki prabha prabhakar ko lajavatin. [1] chir charu hir har hiy pahiray kar, bhushan banay bal sajan sajavatin.. [2] atar gulab lai sugandhan lagavai sabai, chandan chadhay bhal bhauran bhagavatin. [3] jori jori pani devatan hun ki rani ‘hathi’, koti koti koranis jhuki kai bajavatin.. [4] - shri hathi ji, shri radha sudha shatak (25)
english_translation: (kavitta) jat rup takhat pai baithi rup rasi radhe, angan ki prabha prabhakar ko lajavatin. [1] chir charu hir har hiy pahiray kar, bhushan banay bal sajan sajavatin.. [2] atar gulab lai sugandhan lagavai sabai, chandan chadhay bhal bhauran bhagavatin. [3] jori jori pani devatan hun ki rani ‘hathi’, koti koti koranis jhuki kai bajavatin.. [4] - shri hathi ji, shri radha sudha shatak (25)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वंशीवट यमुना-निकट जहाँ सघन घन छाँह - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
वंशीवट यमुना-निकट, जहाँ सघन घन छाँह।
प्यारी मुख बिहसत भई, डारि गले पिय बाँह॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: vnshivat yamuna-nikat, jahan saghan ghan chhanh. pyari mukh bihasat bhai, dari gale piy banh.. - braj ke dohe
english_translation: vnshivat yamuna-nikat, jahan saghan ghan chhanh. pyari mukh bihasat bhai, dari gale piy banh.. - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मन रे श्याम सों कर हेत - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहाग)
मन रे श्याम सों कर हेत।
कृष्ण नाम की वार करले तो वचे तेरो खेत॥ [1]
मन सुआ तन पींजरा हो तासु बाँध्यों तेरौ हेत।
काल रूपी मझार डोले अब घड़ी तोहै लेत॥ [2]
विषय विष रस छाँड़ दे रे उतर सागर सेत।
‘सूर’ श्री गोपाल भजले गुरु बताये देत॥ [3]
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
english_text: (rag vihaga) man re shyam son kar het. krishn nam ki var karale to vache tero khet.. [1] man sua tan pinjara ho tasu bandhyon terau het. kal rupi majhar dole ab ghadai tohai let.. [2] vishay vish ras chhanda de re utar sagar set. ‘sura’ shri gopal bhajale guru bataye det.. [3] - shri suradas, sur sagara
english_translation: (rag vihaga) man re shyam son kar het. krishn nam ki var karale to vache tero khet.. [1] man sua tan pinjara ho tasu bandhyon terau het. kal rupi majhar dole ab ghadai tohai let.. [2] vishay vish ras chhanda de re utar sagar set. ‘sura’ shri gopal bhajale guru bataye det.. [3] - shri suradas, sur sagara
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जेहि बिनु जाने कछुहि नहिं जात्यौ जात बिसेष - श्री रसखान, प्रेम वाटिका (18)
sanskrit_text:
जेहि बिनु जाने कछुहि नहिं, जात्यौ जात बिसेष। 
सोइ प्रेम जेहि जानिकै, रहि न जात कछु सेष॥
- श्री रसखान, प्रेम वाटिका (18)
english_text: jehi binu jane kachhuhi nahin, jatyau jat bisesh. soi prem jehi janikai, rahi n jat kachhu sesh.. - shri rasakhan, prem vatika (18)
english_translation: jehi binu jane kachhuhi nahin, jatyau jat bisesh. soi prem jehi janikai, rahi n jat kachhu sesh.. - shri rasakhan, prem vatika (18)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारीजू कौन तिहारी खोट - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (68)
sanskrit_text:
(राग भैरवी)
प्यारीजू कौन तिहारी खोट। 
मोसों वनी न कछु वै स्वामिनि, हों औगुनकी मोट॥ [1]
श्रीवन दरस दिखायके राधे, मेटो जियकी चोट। 
ललितकिशोरी को अपनावहु, गही तिहारी ओट॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (68)
english_text: (rag bhairavi) pyariju kaun tihari khot. moson vani n kachhu vai svamini, hon augunaki mot.. [1] shrivan daras dikhayake radhe, meto jiyaki chot. lalitakishori ko apanavahu, gahi tihari ot.. [2] - shri lalit kishori, abhilash madhuri, vinay (68)
english_translation: (rag bhairavi) pyariju kaun tihari khot. moson vani n kachhu vai svamini, hon augunaki mot.. [1] shrivan daras dikhayake radhe, meto jiyaki chot. lalitakishori ko apanavahu, gahi tihari ot.. [2] - shri lalit kishori, abhilash madhuri, vinay (68)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आयु जल बुलबुला गोविंद राधे - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविन्द गीत (5955)
sanskrit_text:
आयु जल बुलबुला गोविंद राधे।
जाने कब फूट जाये सबको बता दे॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविन्द गीत (956)
english_text: ayu jal bulabula govind radhe. jane kab fut jaye sabako bata de.. - jagadguru shri kripalu ji maharaj, radha govind git (956)
english_translation: ayu jal bulabula govind radhe. jane kab fut jaye sabako bata de.. - jagadguru shri kripalu ji maharaj, radha govind git (956)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बरसानो वृषभानु को लखी साँकरी खोर -  श्री प्रियादास जी, रसिक मोहिनी (22)
sanskrit_text:
बरसानो वृषभानु को, लखी साँकरी खोर।
सखिन सहित श्री लाड़िली, निकसत याही ओर॥
- श्री प्रियादास जी, रसिक मोहिनी (22)
english_text: barasano vrishabhanu ko, lakhi sankari khor. sakhin sahit shri ladaili, nikasat yahi or.. - shri priyadas ji, rasik mohini (22)
english_translation: barasano vrishabhanu ko, lakhi sankari khor. sakhin sahit shri ladaili, nikasat yahi or.. - shri priyadas ji, rasik mohini (22)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बाँकी रसिक विहारिनि राधे - श्री सरस माधुरी जी
sanskrit_text:
बाँकी रसिक विहारिनि राधे, बाँके रसिक बिहारी। [1]
बाँकी मुकुट चन्द्रिका बाँकी, बाँकी चितवन प्यारी॥ [2]
बाँकी चलन चारु गति चंचल, पग नूपुर झुनकारी। [3]
सरस माधुरी बाँकी झाँकी, जीवन प्राण हमारी॥ [4]
- श्री सरस माधुरी
english_text: banki rasik viharini radhe, banke rasik bihari. [1] banki mukut chandrika banki, banki chitavan pyari.. [2] banki chalan charu gati chnchal, pag nupur jhunakari. [3] saras madhuri banki jhanki, jivan pran hamari.. [4] - shri saras madhuri
english_translation: banki rasik viharini radhe, banke rasik bihari. [1] banki mukut chandrika banki, banki chitavan pyari.. [2] banki chalan charu gati chnchal, pag nupur jhunakari. [3] saras madhuri banki jhanki, jivan pran hamari.. [4] - shri saras madhuri
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन सबसौं बड़ो यथा दूध में घीव - श्री चरणदास
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन सबसौं बड़ो, यथा दूध में घीव। 
सब धर्मन हरि भक्त ज्यौं, यथा पिंड में जीव॥
- श्री चरणदास
english_text: vrindavan sabasaun badao, yatha dudh men ghiv. sab dharman hari bhakt jyaun, yatha pind men jiv.. - shri charanadasa
english_translation: vrindavan sabasaun badao, yatha dudh men ghiv. sab dharman hari bhakt jyaun, yatha pind men jiv.. - shri charanadasa
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ज्यौं ज्यौं इत देखियत - श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, तीर्थानंद (01)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
ज्यौं ज्यौं इत देखियत मूरख विमुख लोग, 
त्यौं त्यों सुखराशी व्रजवासी जिय भावैं हैं। [1]
खारे जल छीलर दुखारे अन्ध कूप चितै, 
कालिन्दी के काज महा मन ललचावैं हैं॥ [2]
जैसी अब बीतत सु कहत न आवैं बैंन, 
नागर न चैन परैं प्रान अकुलावैं हैं। [3]
थोहर फरास देखि देखि कैं बंबूर बुरे, 
हाय हरे हरे वे तमाल सुधि आवैं हैं॥ [4]
- श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, तीर्थानंद (01)
english_text: (kavitta) jyaun jyaun it dekhiyat murakh vimukh log, tyaun tyon sukharashi vrajavasi jiy bhavain hain. [1] khare jal chhilar dukhare andh kup chitai, kalindi ke kaj maha man lalachavain hain.. [2] jaisi ab bitat su kahat n avain bainn, nagar n chain parain pran akulavain hain. [3] thohar faras dekhi dekhi kain bnbur bure, hay hare hare ve tamal sudhi avain hain.. [4] - shri nagaridas (maharaj savnt sinha), shri nagaridas ji ki vani, tirthannd (01)
english_translation: (kavitta) jyaun jyaun it dekhiyat murakh vimukh log, tyaun tyon sukharashi vrajavasi jiy bhavain hain. [1] khare jal chhilar dukhare andh kup chitai, kalindi ke kaj maha man lalachavain hain.. [2] jaisi ab bitat su kahat n avain bainn, nagar n chain parain pran akulavain hain. [3] thohar faras dekhi dekhi kain bnbur bure, hay hare hare ve tamal sudhi avain hain.. [4] - shri nagaridas (maharaj savnt sinha), shri nagaridas ji ki vani, tirthannd (01)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भला कहा रीझे नहीं बुरा कहा न खिजन्त- श्री रूपरसिक देवाचार्य, विशिष्ट दोहा (54)
sanskrit_text:
भला कहा रीझे नहीं, बुरा कहा न खिजन्त।
‘रूप रसिक’ सोइ जानिये, आनन्द-रूपी सन्त॥  
- श्री रूपरसिक देवाचार्य, विशिष्ट दोहा (54)
english_text: bhala kaha rijhe nahin, bura kaha n khijant. ‘rup rasika’ soi janiye, ananda-rupi sant.. - shri ruparasik devachary, vishisht doha (54)
english_translation: bhala kaha rijhe nahin, bura kaha n khijant. ‘rup rasika’ soi janiye, ananda-rupi sant.. - shri ruparasik devachary, vishisht doha (54)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कौंन भाग्य भरि नैंन निहारौ - श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (267)
sanskrit_text:
कौंन भाग्य भरि नैंन निहारौ।
बिनु नख चन्द्र चन्दिका देखे, त्रिभुवन सब अँधियारौ॥ [1]
सहज छबीली छबि के ऊपर, त्रिभुवन सोभा वारौ।
'भोरी' छिन इक दरसन कारण, कोटि प्राण तजि डारौ॥ [2]
- श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (267)
english_text: kaunn bhagy bhari nainn niharau. binu nakh chandr chandika dekhe, tribhuvan sab andhiyarau.. [1] sahaj chhabili chhabi ke upar, tribhuvan sobha varau. 'bhori' chhin ik darasan karan, koti pran taji darau.. [2] - shri bhori sakhi, prem ki pir (267)
english_translation: kaunn bhagy bhari nainn niharau. binu nakh chandr chandika dekhe, tribhuvan sab andhiyarau.. [1] sahaj chhabili chhabi ke upar, tribhuvan sobha varau. 'bhori' chhin ik darasan karan, koti pran taji darau.. [2] - shri bhori sakhi, prem ki pir (267)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आगे की आगे गई अब न रुखाई देहु - श्री वृंदावन दास चाचा जी, विवेक लक्षण बेली (106)
sanskrit_text:
आगे की आगे गई, अब न रुखाई देहु। 
‘वृन्दावन हित’ दास की, लाज हियैं धरि लेहु॥
- श्री वृंदावन दास चाचा जी, विवेक लक्षण बेली (106)
english_text: age ki age gai, ab n rukhai dehu. ‘vrindavan hita’ das ki, laj hiyain dhari lehu.. - shri vrindavan das chacha ji, vivek lakshan beli (106)
english_translation: age ki age gai, ab n rukhai dehu. ‘vrindavan hita’ das ki, laj hiyain dhari lehu.. - shri vrindavan das chacha ji, vivek lakshan beli (106)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वसिये श्री वृन्दावन धाम - रसिक वाणी
sanskrit_text:
वसिये श्री वृन्दावन धाम। 
अंग पुलकि निशि दिवस बोलिये, श्री राधे-राधे नाम। [1]
ललित-प्रिया जेहि त्यागि परमपद, पायहुँ नहीं विश्राम। 
भाग बड़ो तब यह व्रज-रज में, पावत मन अभिराम॥ [2]
- रसिक वाणी
english_text: vasiye shri vrindavan dham. ang pulaki nishi divas boliye, shri radhe-radhe nam. [1] lalita-priya jehi tyagi paramapad, payahun nahin vishram. bhag badao tab yah vraja-raj men, pavat man abhiram.. [2] - rasik vani
english_translation: vasiye shri vrindavan dham. ang pulaki nishi divas boliye, shri radhe-radhe nam. [1] lalita-priya jehi tyagi paramapad, payahun nahin vishram. bhag badao tab yah vraja-raj men, pavat man abhiram.. [2] - rasik vani
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: निरखत नित्य विहार, पुलकित तन रोमावली - श्री सेवक जी, श्री सेवक वाणी
sanskrit_text:
निरखत नित्य विहार, पुलकित तन रोमावली।
आनंद नैन सुढार, यह जू कृपा हरिवंश की।
- श्री सेवक जी (दामोदर दास) - श्री सेवक वाणी

नित्य विहार का दर्शन हो रहा हो, सम्पूर्ण शरीर आनंद से पुलकित हो रहा हो, रोमांचित हो, नेत्रों से आनंद के आंसू बह रहे हो, यह ही श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु की वास्तविक कृपा है।
english_text: nirakhat nity vihar, pulakit tan romavali. annd nain sudhar, yah ju kripa harivnsh ki. - shri sevak ji (damodar dasa) - shri sevak vani nity vihar ka darshan ho raha ho, sampurn sharir annd se pulakit ho raha ho, romanchit ho, netron se annd ke ansu bah rahe ho, yah hi shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu ki vastavik kripa hai.
english_translation: nirakhat nity vihar, pulakit tan romavali. annd nain sudhar, yah ju kripa harivnsh ki. - shri sevak ji (damodar dasa) - shri sevak vani nity vihar ka darshan ho raha ho, sampurn sharir annd se pulakit ho raha ho, romanchit ho, netron se annd ke ansu bah rahe ho, yah hi shri hit harivnsh mahaprabhu ki vastavik kripa hai.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: पाँडे माटी में सनैं - श्री बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (320)
sanskrit_text:
पाँडे माटी में सनैं, करमठ निपट निकोर।
प्रेम पदारथ क्यौं गहैं, अरुझे लहै न छोर॥
- श्री बिहारिन देव जी, श्री बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (320)
english_text: pande mati men sanain, karamath nipat nikor. prem padarath kyaun gahain, arujhe lahai n chhor.. - shri biharin dev ji, shri biharin dev ji ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (320)
english_translation: pande mati men sanain, karamath nipat nikor. prem padarath kyaun gahain, arujhe lahai n chhor.. - shri biharin dev ji, shri biharin dev ji ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (320)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: माया कौं सब जग भजै - श्री भगवत रसिक की वाणी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [उतरार्द्ध] (28)
sanskrit_text:
(कुण्डलियाँ)
माया कौं सब जग भजै, माधौ भजै न कोइ। 
जो कदापि माधौ भजै, माया चेरी होइ॥ [1]
माया चेरी होइ, रहै चरनन लपटानी। 
ज्यों मलयज के संग, सहज सौरभ सुखदानी॥ [2] 
भगवत रसिक अनन्य, होय सतगुरु की दाया। 
माधौ सौं मन लगै, मोह मद छूटै माया॥ [3]
- श्री भगवत रसिक, श्री भगवत रसिक की वाणी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [उतरार्द्ध] (28)
english_text: (kundaliyan) maya kaun sab jag bhajai, madhau bhajai n koi. jo kadapi madhau bhajai, maya cheri hoi.. [1] maya cheri hoi, rahai charanan lapatani. jyon malayaj ke sng, sahaj saurabh sukhadani.. [2] bhagavat rasik anany, hoy sataguru ki daya. madhau saun man lagai, moh mad chhutai maya.. [3] - shri bhagavat rasik, shri bhagavat rasik ki vani, anany nishchayatmak grnth [utararddha] (28)
english_translation: (kundaliyan) maya kaun sab jag bhajai, madhau bhajai n koi. jo kadapi madhau bhajai, maya cheri hoi.. [1] maya cheri hoi, rahai charanan lapatani. jyon malayaj ke sng, sahaj saurabh sukhadani.. [2] bhagavat rasik anany, hoy sataguru ki daya. madhau saun man lagai, moh mad chhutai maya.. [3] - shri bhagavat rasik, shri bhagavat rasik ki vani, anany nishchayatmak grnth [utararddha] (28)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दारण्यलतागृहेषु वसतां गोविन्दलीलासुधा - श्री वागीश शास्त्री जी, श्री राधासप्तशती (5.65)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दारण्यलतागृहेषु वसतां गोविन्दलीलासुधा-
मापीयाश्रु विमुञ्चतां सुमधुरं राधेति संगायताम्। 
अर्धोन्मीलितलोचनैर्विचरतां वृन्दाटवीवीथिसु 
कुत्रापि स्खलतां क्वचिच्च पततां यज्जीवनं जीवनम्॥
- श्री वागीश शास्त्री जी, श्रीराधासप्तशती (5.65)
english_text: vrindaranyalatagriheshu vasatan govindalilasudha- mapiyashru vimunychatan sumadhurn radheti sngayatam. ardhonmilitalochanairvicharatan vrindatavivithisu kutrapi skhalatan kvachichch patatan yajjivann jivanam.. - shri vagish shastri ji, shriradhasaptashati (5.65)
english_translation: vrindaranyalatagriheshu vasatan govindalilasudha- mapiyashru vimunychatan sumadhurn radheti sngayatam. ardhonmilitalochanairvicharatan vrindatavivithisu kutrapi skhalatan kvachichch patatan yajjivann jivanam.. - shri vagish shastri ji, shriradhasaptashati (5.65)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: लोक लाज कुल कान की - श्री ललित लड़ैती, श्री किशोरी कृपा कटाक्ष, माधुर्य रस दोहावली (77)
sanskrit_text:
लोक लाज कुल कान की, लगी हिये में आग।
ललित लड़ैती युगल सों, कब होवै अनुराग॥
- श्री ललित लड़ैती, श्री किशोरी कृपा कटाक्ष, माधुर्य रस दोहावली (77)
english_text: lok laj kul kan ki, lagi hiye men ag. lalit ladaiti yugal son, kab hovai anurag.. - shri lalit ladaiti, shri kishori kripa kataksh, madhury ras dohavali (77)
english_translation: lok laj kul kan ki, lagi hiye men ag. lalit ladaiti yugal son, kab hovai anurag.. - shri lalit ladaiti, shri kishori kripa kataksh, madhury ras dohavali (77)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सुनिये नाथ गरीब निवाज - श्री युगल प्रिया
sanskrit_text:
(राग झंझौटी-ताल चर्चरी)
सुनिये नाथ गरीब निवाज। आई सरन तुम्हें सब लाज॥ [1]
अधम-उधारन बिरद-सम्हारन, त्रिभुवन के सिरताज। 
कुंजद्वार हौं खड़ी कबैकी, त्राहि त्राहि महराज॥ [2]
करुनाकर अब बोलि लीजिये, करिये बिलम न आज। 
जुगलप्रियाको अभय कीजिये, यह नहिं कछु बड़ काज॥ [3]
- श्री युगल प्रिया
english_text: (rag jhnjhauti-tal charchari) suniye nath garib nivaj. ai saran tumhen sab laj.. [1] adhama-udharan birada-samharan, tribhuvan ke sirataj. kunjadvar haun khadai kabaiki, trahi trahi maharaj.. [2] karunakar ab boli lijiye, kariye bilam n aj. jugalapriyako abhay kijiye, yah nahin kachhu bada kaj.. [3] - shri yugal priya
english_translation: (rag jhnjhauti-tal charchari) suniye nath garib nivaj. ai saran tumhen sab laj.. [1] adhama-udharan birada-samharan, tribhuvan ke sirataj. kunjadvar haun khadai kabaiki, trahi trahi maharaj.. [2] karunakar ab boli lijiye, kariye bilam n aj. jugalapriyako abhay kijiye, yah nahin kachhu bada kaj.. [3] - shri yugal priya
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अग्रदेव आग्या दई भक्तन को जस गाऊ - श्री नाभादास जी
sanskrit_text:
अग्रदेव आग्या दई, भक्तन को जस गाऊ।
भवसागर के तरन को, नाहिंन और उपाउ॥
- श्री नाभादास जी
english_text: agradev agya dai, bhaktan ko jas gau. bhavasagar ke taran ko, nahinn aur upau.. - shri nabhadas ji
english_translation: agradev agya dai, bhaktan ko jas gau. bhavasagar ke taran ko, nahinn aur upau.. - shri nabhadas ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: चंद की कलासी, नवलासी सखी संगबारी - श्री हठी जी, श्री राधा सुधा शतक (48)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
चंद की कलासी, नवलासी सखी संगबारी,
रंभा, रमा, उमा, 'हठी' उपमा कों को रही? [1]
कीरति किसोरी बृषभान की दुलारी राधा,
आली, वनमाली कौ सहज चित्त चोरही॥ [2]
भौंन ते निकसि प्यारी पाय धारे बाहिर लौं,
लाली तरवान की उमड़ि इक और ही। [3]
बगर-बगर अरु डगर-डगर बर,
जगर-मगर चारों ओर दुति हो रही॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, श्री राधा सुधा शतक (48)
english_text: (kavitta) chnd ki kalasi, navalasi sakhi sngabari, rnbha, rama, uma, 'hathi' upama kon ko rahi? [1] kirati kisori brishabhan ki dulari radha, ali, vanamali kau sahaj chitt chorahi.. [2] bhaunn te nikasi pyari pay dhare bahir laun, lali taravan ki umadai ik aur hi. [3] bagara-bagar aru dagara-dagar bar, jagara-magar charon or duti ho rahi.. [4] - shri hathi ji, shri radha sudha shatak (48)
english_translation: (kavitta) chnd ki kalasi, navalasi sakhi sngabari, rnbha, rama, uma, 'hathi' upama kon ko rahi? [1] kirati kisori brishabhan ki dulari radha, ali, vanamali kau sahaj chitt chorahi.. [2] bhaunn te nikasi pyari pay dhare bahir laun, lali taravan ki umadai ik aur hi. [3] bagara-bagar aru dagara-dagar bar, jagara-magar charon or duti ho rahi.. [4] - shri hathi ji, shri radha sudha shatak (48)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अँखियाँ दुखिया नित ही तरसें - श्री रशीद जी
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
अँखियाँ दुखिया नित ही तरसें, तुम आनसे नेह लगाते रहो।
बिसराते रहो मोहि जान अयोग, वियोगकी ज्वाल जलाते रहो॥ [1]
यहु न्याव कहाँका गोपाल भला, कल पाके मुझे कलपाते रहो।
विनती है विनीत 'रशीद' यही, ब्रजमें घनश्याम बुलाते रहो॥ [2]
- श्री रशीद जी
english_text: (savaiya) ankhiyan dukhiya nit hi tarasen, tum anase neh lagate raho. bisarate raho mohi jan ayog, viyogaki jval jalate raho.. [1] yahu nyav kahanka gopal bhala, kal pake mujhe kalapate raho. vinati hai vinit 'rashid' yahi, brajamen ghanashyam bulate raho.. [2] - shri rashid ji
english_translation: (savaiya) ankhiyan dukhiya nit hi tarasen, tum anase neh lagate raho. bisarate raho mohi jan ayog, viyogaki jval jalate raho.. [1] yahu nyav kahanka gopal bhala, kal pake mujhe kalapate raho. vinati hai vinit 'rashid' yahi, brajamen ghanashyam bulate raho.. [2] - shri rashid ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ज्यों दिन जात अषाढ  के त्यों त्यों घटै मेरी भूख - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
ज्यों दिन जात अषाढ  के, त्यों त्यों घटै मेरी भूख।
बिधिना कब दर्साइहौ, बरसाने के रूख॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: jyon din jat ashadh ke, tyon tyon ghatai meri bhukh. bidhina kab darsaihau, barasane ke rukh.. - braj ke dohe
english_translation: jyon din jat ashadh ke, tyon tyon ghatai meri bhukh. bidhina kab darsaihau, barasane ke rukh.. - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अरे मन श्री वल्लभ गुन गाय - गोस्वामी श्री हरिराय जी
sanskrit_text:
अरे मन श्री वल्लभ गुन गाय।
वृथा काल काहे को खोंवत, बेद पुराण पढ़ाय॥ [1]
श्री गिरिराजधरण पेवै कों, नाहिन और उपाय।
"रसिक" सदा अनन्य होय के, चित्त इत उत न डुलाय॥ [2]
- गोस्वामी श्री हरिराय जी
english_text: are man shri vallabh gun gay. vritha kal kahe ko khonvat, bed puran padhay.. [1] shri girirajadharan pevai kon, nahin aur upay. "rasik" sada anany hoy ke, chitt it ut n dulay.. [2] - gosvami shri hariray ji
english_translation: are man shri vallabh gun gay. vritha kal kahe ko khonvat, bed puran padhay.. [1] shri girirajadharan pevai kon, nahin aur upay. "rasik" sada anany hoy ke, chitt it ut n dulay.. [2] - gosvami shri hariray ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हम वासी बरसाने के - श्री ललित माधुरी
sanskrit_text:
(राह लावनी ईमन)
हम वासी बरसाने के।
श्री चैतन्य उपासी खासी, राधागोविंद वानेके॥ [1]
ललितकिशोरी गर्वभरे हम, अन्यसों क्यों चित लानेके। 
‘ललितमाधुरी’ नित अवलोकैं, अन तन मन भटकाने के॥ [2]
- श्री ललित माधुरी
english_text: (rah lavani imana) ham vasi barasane ke. shri chaitany upasi khasi, radhagovind vaneke.. [1] lalitakishori garvabhare ham, anyason kyon chit laneke. ‘lalitamadhuri’ nit avalokain, an tan man bhatakane ke.. [2] - shri lalit madhuri
english_translation: (rah lavani imana) ham vasi barasane ke. shri chaitany upasi khasi, radhagovind vaneke.. [1] lalitakishori garvabhare ham, anyason kyon chit laneke. ‘lalitamadhuri’ nit avalokain, an tan man bhatakane ke.. [2] - shri lalit madhuri
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन की चूहरी चली मुक्ति ठुकराय - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन की चूहरी, चली मुक्ति ठुकराय।
व्यास कहै अचरज कहाँ, यह राधा महल ख्वाय॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: vrindavan ki chuhari, chali mukti thukaray. vyas kahai acharaj kahan, yah radha mahal khvay.. - braj ke dohe
english_translation: vrindavan ki chuhari, chali mukti thukaray. vyas kahai acharaj kahan, yah radha mahal khvay.. - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी रसिक महा हरिव्यास  - श्री चरण दास
sanskrit_text:
श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, रसिक महा हरिव्यास। 
कृष्णदास अरु हित अली, इन मारग सुखरास॥ [1]
सोई मेरौ मार्ग है, महा मोद की खान। 
उन्नत परम निकुंज रस, तिन बानिन परमान॥ [2]
- श्री चरणदास
english_text: shri svami haridas ji, rasik maha harivyas. krishnadas aru hit ali, in marag sukharas.. [1] soi merau marg hai, maha mod ki khan. unnat param nikunj ras, tin banin paraman.. [2] - shri charanadasa
english_translation: shri svami haridas ji, rasik maha harivyas. krishnadas aru hit ali, in marag sukharas.. [1] soi merau marg hai, maha mod ki khan. unnat param nikunj ras, tin banin paraman.. [2] - shri charanadasa
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जग में मिलन अनूप है भगवदियन को संग - गोस्वामी श्री हरिराय जी, वल्लभ साखी (26)
sanskrit_text:
जग में मिलन अनूप है, भगवदियन को संग। 
तिनके संग प्रताप तें, होत श्याम सो रंग॥
- गोस्वामी श्री हरिराय जी, वल्लभ साखी (26)
english_text: jag men milan anup hai, bhagavadiyan ko sng. tinake sng pratap ten, hot shyam so rng.. - gosvami shri hariray ji, vallabh sakhi (26)
english_translation: jag men milan anup hai, bhagavadiyan ko sng. tinake sng pratap ten, hot shyam so rng.. - gosvami shri hariray ji, vallabh sakhi (26)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: चलु मन श्री वृन्दावन ओर - श्री संकेत अली, संकेत लता
sanskrit_text:
चलु मन श्री वृन्दावन ओर।
अनुपम धाम कामना पूरण, विहरत युगल किशोर॥ [1]
षट् ऋतु रहत प्रत्यक्ष स्वच्छ जल, यमुना लेत हिलोर।
प्रफुलित लता पता मृदु फल युत, खग ध्वनि नाचत मोर॥ [2]
- श्री संकेत अली, संकेत लता
english_text: chalu man shri vrindavan or. anupam dham kamana puran, viharat yugal kishor.. [1] shat ritu rahat pratyaksh svachchh jal, yamuna let hilor. prafulit lata pata mridu fal yut, khag dhvani nachat mor.. [2] - shri snket ali, snket lata

title: पशु पक्षी पाषाण हों - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय श्रृंगार शतक (91)
sanskrit_text:
पशु पक्षी पाषाण हों, तृण अणु रज ब्रज गैल।
कूप बावरी कीजिए, ललित किशोरी छैल॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय श्रृंगार शतक (91)
english_text: pashu pakshi pashan hon, trin anu raj braj gail. kup bavari kijie, lalit kishori chhail.. - shri lalit kishori, abhilash madhuri, vinay shrringar shatak (91)
english_translation: pashu pakshi pashan hon, trin anu raj braj gail. kup bavari kijie, lalit kishori chhail.. - shri lalit kishori, abhilash madhuri, vinay shrringar shatak (91)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राखि दृढ़ भरोसो तोको पोषैगी जय श्रीराधा - श्री अली माधुरी जी, श्री निकुञ्ज केली माधुरी, विनयावली (161)
sanskrit_text:
(राग धनाश्री)
राखि दृढ़ भरोसो तोको पोषैगी जय श्रीराधा॥ टेक॥ [1]
श्यामविहारी आज्ञाकारी, तन मन की सब मैटे बाधा। 
सुन्दर श्यामा श्याम मनोहर, प्रणतन के पोषण सुख साधा॥ [2]
दया उदधि करुणा के सागर, कृपासिन्धु सदगुणन अगाधा। 
अली माधुरी के सर्वस धन, दम्पति सर्वोपरि आराधा॥ [3]
- श्री अली माधुरी जी, श्री निकुञ्ज केली माधुरी, विनयावली (161)
english_text: (rag dhanashri) rakhi dridha bharoso toko poshaigi jay shriradha.. tek.. [1] shyamavihari ajnyakari, tan man ki sab maite badha. sundar shyama shyam manohar, pranatan ke poshan sukh sadha.. [2] daya udadhi karuna ke sagar, kripasindhu sadagunan agadha. ali madhuri ke sarvas dhan, dampati sarvopari aradha.. [3] - shri ali madhuri ji, shri nikunyj keli madhuri, vinayavali (161)
english_translation: (rag dhanashri) rakhi dridha bharoso toko poshaigi jay shriradha.. tek.. [1] shyamavihari ajnyakari, tan man ki sab maite badha. sundar shyama shyam manohar, pranatan ke poshan sukh sadha.. [2] daya udadhi karuna ke sagar, kripasindhu sadagunan agadha. ali madhuri ke sarvas dhan, dampati sarvopari aradha.. [3] - shri ali madhuri ji, shri nikunyj keli madhuri, vinayavali (161)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ध्यान धरो सुमिरण करो श्रीमत राधे श्याम- श्री सरस माधुरी
sanskrit_text:
ध्यान धरो सुमिरण करो, श्रीमत राधे श्याम। 
गावो गुण गण प्रेम सों, पल छिन आठों याम॥
- श्री सरस माधुरी
english_text: dhyan dharo sumiran karo, shrimat radhe shyam. gavo gun gan prem son, pal chhin athon yam.. - shri saras madhuri
english_translation: dhyan dharo sumiran karo, shrimat radhe shyam. gavo gun gan prem son, pal chhin athon yam.. - shri saras madhuri
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कहूँ लकुट कहुँ मुरलिका पीताम्बर सुधि नाहिं - श्री ब्रजनिधि ग्रंथावली, प्रीति लता (63)
sanskrit_text:
कहूँ लकुट कहुँ मुरलिका, पीताम्बर सुधि नाहिं।
मोर-चंद्रिका झुकि रही, प्रिया ध्यान मन माहिं॥
- श्री ब्रजनिधि जी, ब्रजनिधि ग्रंथावली, प्रीति लता (63)
english_text: kahun lakut kahun muralika, pitambar sudhi nahin. mora-chndrika jhuki rahi, priya dhyan man mahin.. - shri brajanidhi ji, brajanidhi grnthavali, priti lata (63)
english_translation: kahun lakut kahun muralika, pitambar sudhi nahin. mora-chndrika jhuki rahi, priya dhyan man mahin.. - shri brajanidhi ji, brajanidhi grnthavali, priti lata (63)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री ललिता सिखवत रस परिकर की - श्री वंशी अलि, सिद्धांत के पद (26)
sanskrit_text:
श्री ललिता सिखवत रस परिकर की ॥
वृषभान पुरा को बास सखीरी, पूजी आसा मो मन की॥ [1] 
तुब पद पकंज सेऊं प्रेम सों, सुध न रहे कछु तन की। 
ब्रज रज लिपट रहों श्री बंसी अलि, मोह नाहिं धन गुन की॥ [2]
- श्री वंशी अलि, सिद्धांत के पद (26)
english_text: shri lalita sikhavat ras parikar ki .. vrishabhan pura ko bas sakhiri, puji asa mo man ki.. [1] tub pad paknj seun prem son, sudh n rahe kachhu tan ki. braj raj lipat rahon shri bnsi ali, moh nahin dhan gun ki.. [2] - shri vnshi ali, siddhant ke pad (26)
english_translation: shri lalita sikhavat ras parikar ki .. vrishabhan pura ko bas sakhiri, puji asa mo man ki.. [1] tub pad paknj seun prem son, sudh n rahe kachhu tan ki. braj raj lipat rahon shri bnsi ali, moh nahin dhan gun ki.. [2] - shri vnshi ali, siddhant ke pad (26)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आजु बधाई वृंदावन सुख-सिंधु हिलोर -  श्री ललितमोहिनी देव जू की वाणी, रस के पद (62)
sanskrit_text:
आजु बधाई वृंदावन, सुख-सिंधु हिलोर।
प्रियालाल तन-मन हुलसाने, मनसिज-मेघनि घोर॥ [1]
सब सखि उमँगि-उमँगि गुन गावैं, नाचत मोर-चकोर। 
श्रीललितमोहिनी के उर बिहरत, नैंन-कमल चित-चोर॥ [2]
- श्री ललितमोहिनी देव, श्री ललितमोहिनी देव जू की वाणी, रस के पद (62)
english_text: aju badhai vrindavan, sukha-sindhu hilor. priyalal tana-man hulasane, manasija-meghani ghor.. [1] sab sakhi umngi-umngi gun gavain, nachat mora-chakor. shrilalitamohini ke ur biharat, nainna-kamal chita-chor.. [2] - shri lalitamohini dev, shri lalitamohini dev ju ki vani, ras ke pad (62)
english_translation: aju badhai vrindavan, sukha-sindhu hilor. priyalal tana-man hulasane, manasija-meghani ghor.. [1] sab sakhi umngi-umngi gun gavain, nachat mora-chakor. shrilalitamohini ke ur biharat, nainna-kamal chita-chor.. [2] - shri lalitamohini dev, shri lalitamohini dev ju ki vani, ras ke pad (62)

title: वासी की आसा करौ वासी हाथ विकाऊं  - श्री हित दामोदर दास, नेम बत्तीसी (6)
sanskrit_text:
वासी की आसा करौ, वासी हाथ विकाऊं। 
श्री वृन्दावन छाड़ि कै, अनत न कित हूँ जाऊँ॥
- श्री हित दामोदर दास, नेम बत्तीसी (6)
english_text: vasi ki asa karau, vasi hath vikaun. shri vrindavan chhadai kai, anat n kit hun jaun.. - shri hit damodar das, nem battisi (6)
english_translation: vasi ki asa karau, vasi hath vikaun. shri vrindavan chhadai kai, anat n kit hun jaun.. - shri hit damodar das, nem battisi (6)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ब्रजवासी नहीं सब देवता हैं - डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
ब्रजवासी नहीं सब देवता हैं, यह भावना चित्त में ला रहे हैं।
चिरकाल प्रतीक्षा के बाद अहा! मम स्वामी समीप में आ रहे हैं॥[1]
हरेकृष्ण ! चलो मत देर करो, दृग दर्शन को ललचा रहे हैं।
जिन्हें देखो वही कुछ भेंट लिये, बस नन्द के द्वार को जा रहे हैं॥ [2]
- डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’
english_text: (savaiya) brajavasi nahin sab devata hain, yah bhavana chitt men la rahe hain. chirakal pratiksha ke bad aha! mam svami samip men a rahe hain..[1] harekrishn ! chalo mat der karo, drig darshan ko lalacha rahe hain. jinhen dekho vahi kuchh bhent liye, bas nand ke dvar ko ja rahe hain.. [2] - dndi svami shri hare krishnanand sarasvati ‘hare krishna’
english_translation: (savaiya) brajavasi nahin sab devata hain, yah bhavana chitt men la rahe hain. chirakal pratiksha ke bad aha! mam svami samip men a rahe hain..[1] harekrishn ! chalo mat der karo, drig darshan ko lalacha rahe hain. jinhen dekho vahi kuchh bhent liye, bas nand ke dvar ko ja rahe hain.. [2] - dndi svami shri hare krishnanand sarasvati ‘hare krishna’
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रसशेखर रसराजवर रस अनन्य हरिदास - श्री प्रह्लाद जी
sanskrit_text:
रसशेखर रसराजवर, रस अनन्य हरिदास।
सुमिरत दर्शत मन हरत, रंग महल नित वास॥
- श्री प्रह्लाद जी
english_text: rasashekhar rasarajavar, ras anany haridas. sumirat darshat man harat, rng mahal nit vas.. - shri prahlad ji
english_translation: rasashekhar rasarajavar, ras anany haridas. sumirat darshat man harat, rng mahal nit vas.. - shri prahlad ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बैन वही उनको गुन गाइ - श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
बैन वही उनको गुन गाइ, औ कान वही उन बैन सों सानी।
हाथ वही उन गात सरै, अरु पाइ वही जु वही अनुजानी॥ [1]
ज्ञान वही उन आन के संग, औ मान वही जु करै मनमानी।
त्यौं रसखानि वही रसखानि जु, है रसखानि सों है रसखानी॥ [2]
- श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
english_text: (savaiya) bain vahi unako gun gai, au kan vahi un bain son sani. hath vahi un gat sarai, aru pai vahi ju vahi anujani.. [1] jnyan vahi un an ke sng, au man vahi ju karai manamani. tyaun rasakhani vahi rasakhani ju, hai rasakhani son hai rasakhani.. [2] - shri rasakhan, rasakhan ratnavali
english_translation: (savaiya) bain vahi unako gun gai, au kan vahi un bain son sani. hath vahi un gat sarai, aru pai vahi ju vahi anujani.. [1] jnyan vahi un an ke sng, au man vahi ju karai manamani. tyaun rasakhani vahi rasakhani ju, hai rasakhani son hai rasakhani.. [2] - shri rasakhan, rasakhan ratnavali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मक्का मदीना द्वारिका बदरी और केदार - श्री मलूक दास
sanskrit_text:
मक्का मदीना द्वारिका, बदरी और केदार।
बिना दया सब झूठ हैं, कहै मलूक बिचार॥
- श्री मलूक दास
english_text: makka madina dvarika, badari aur kedar. bina daya sab jhuth hain, kahai maluk bichar.. - shri maluk dasa
english_translation: makka madina dvarika, badari aur kedar. bina daya sab jhuth hain, kahai maluk bichar.. - shri maluk dasa
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नैन लख्यो जब कुंजन तैं - श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
नैन लख्यो जब कुंजन तैं, बनि कै निकस्यो मटक्यो री। [1]
सोहत कैसे हरा टटकौ, सिर तैसो किरीट लसै लटक्यो री॥ [2]
को 'रसखान’ कहै अटक्यो, हटक्यो ब्रजलोग फिरैं भटक्यो री। [3]
रूप अनूपम वा नट को, हियरे अटक्यो, अटक्यो, अटक्यो री॥ [4]
- श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
english_text: (savaiya) nain lakhyo jab kunjan tain, bani kai nikasyo matakyo ri. [1] sohat kaise hara tatakau, sir taiso kirit lasai latakyo ri.. [2] ko 'rasakhana’ kahai atakyo, hatakyo brajalog firain bhatakyo ri. [3] rup anupam va nat ko, hiyare atakyo, atakyo, atakyo ri.. [4] - shri rasakhan, rasakhan ratnavali
english_translation: (savaiya) nain lakhyo jab kunjan tain, bani kai nikasyo matakyo ri. [1] sohat kaise hara tatakau, sir taiso kirit lasai latakyo ri.. [2] ko 'rasakhana’ kahai atakyo, hatakyo brajalog firain bhatakyo ri. [3] rup anupam va nat ko, hiyare atakyo, atakyo, atakyo ri.. [4] - shri rasakhan, rasakhan ratnavali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नन्दलाल मो तन दुख हेरो - श्री ललित लड़ैती, श्री किशोरी कृपा कटाक्ष, विनय (16)
sanskrit_text:
(राग ईमन)
नन्दलाल मो तन दुख हेरो। 
श्री व्रज-रज पावन दरसाबहु, जासौं सहजें होय निवेरो॥ [1]
उक-चूक सब क्षमो साँवरे, हा-हा, अब न करो अवसेरो।
ललित लड़ैती देहु कृपा करि, श्रीवृन्दावन कुंज बसेरो॥ [2]
- श्री ललित लड़ैती, श्री किशोरी कृपा कटाक्ष, विनय (16)
english_text: (rag imana) nandalal mo tan dukh hero. shri vraja-raj pavan darasabahu, jasaun sahajen hoy nivero.. [1] uka-chuk sab kshamo sanvare, ha-ha, ab n karo avasero. lalit ladaiti dehu kripa kari, shrivrindavan kunj basero.. [2] - shri lalit ladaiti, shri kishori kripa kataksh, vinay (16)
english_translation: (rag imana) nandalal mo tan dukh hero. shri vraja-raj pavan darasabahu, jasaun sahajen hoy nivero.. [1] uka-chuk sab kshamo sanvare, ha-ha, ab n karo avasero. lalit ladaiti dehu kripa kari, shrivrindavan kunj basero.. [2] - shri lalit ladaiti, shri kishori kripa kataksh, vinay (16)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन व्रज को महत कापे बरनी जाई - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर, दशम सकंध
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन व्रज को महत्, कापे बरनी जाई।
चतुरानन पग परसिकै, लोक गयो सुख पाई॥
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर, दशम सकंध
english_text: vrindavan vraj ko mahat, kape barani jai. chaturanan pag parasikai, lok gayo sukh pai.. - shri suradas, sur sagar, dasham sakndha
english_translation: vrindavan vraj ko mahat, kape barani jai. chaturanan pag parasikai, lok gayo sukh pai.. - shri suradas, sur sagar, dasham sakndha
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: करि मन रसिकनी सौं सत्संग - श्री रूप सखी जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (72)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहागरो)
करि मन रसिकनी सौं सत्संग।
सुकृत सुहृदय भजन मैं भीजै उपजावैं निजु रंग॥ [1]
महा माधुरी ललित सलोचन निरखत वदन दुरंग।
रूप बसंत इनके उर नित्य ही जुगल सरूप अभंग॥ [2]
- श्री रूप सखी, श्री रूप सखी जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (72)
english_text: (rag vihagaro) kari man rasikani saun satsng. sukrit suhriday bhajan main bhijai upajavain niju rng.. [1] maha madhuri lalit salochan nirakhat vadan durng. rup basnt inake ur nity hi jugal sarup abhng.. [2] - shri rup sakhi, shri rup sakhi ji ki vani, siddhant ke pad (72)
english_translation: (rag vihagaro) kari man rasikani saun satsng. sukrit suhriday bhajan main bhijai upajavain niju rng.. [1] maha madhuri lalit salochan nirakhat vadan durng. rup basnt inake ur nity hi jugal sarup abhng.. [2] - shri rup sakhi, shri rup sakhi ji ki vani, siddhant ke pad (72)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मैं तो तेरे दर्शन की हूँ भिखारी  - श्री रूपमाधुरी जी की वाणी, पदावली (125)
sanskrit_text:
(राग - देश व सोरठ)
मैं तो तेरे दर्शन की हूँ भिखारी।
अरजी सुनिये भान दुलारी॥ टेक॥ [1]
जीवन धन सर्वेश्वरी श्यामा, सब गुन आगर अति अभिरामा,
ध्यान धरूँ तुमको अठयामा, कीरत राज कुमारी॥ [2]
नाम रटूँ नित तुमरो मुख से, जीवन बीते यासुं सुख से,
जगमें खोये बहुत दिन दुःख से, आई शरण तुम्हारी॥ [3]
करुणानिधि जै जै श्रीराधा, शोभा सिन्धु रूप अगाधा,
हरो विरह की बेगहि बाधा, "रूपमाधरी" वारी॥ [4]
- श्री रूपमाधुरी जी, श्री रूपमाधुरी जी की वाणी, पदावली (125)
english_text: (rag - desh v soratha) main to tere darshan ki hun bhikhari. araji suniye bhan dulari.. tek.. [1] jivan dhan sarveshvari shyama, sab gun agar ati abhirama, dhyan dharun tumako athayama, kirat raj kumari.. title: तो को का पतो नाँय गोविन्द राधे, वृन्दावन राधारानी का है बतादे - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी
sanskrit_text:
तो को का पतो नाँय गोविन्द राधे, वृन्दावन राधारानी का है बतादे।
वृन्दावन की हैं गोविन्द राधे, रानी एकमात्र राधा बतादे॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविंद गीत (9415, 9416)
english_text: to ko ka pato nany govind radhe, vrindavan radharani ka hai batade. vrindavan ki hain govind radhe, rani ekamatr radha batade.. - jagadguru shri kripalu ji maharaj, radha govind git (9415, 9416)

title: राधानन्तापराधात्‌ पततां - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (14.100)
sanskrit_text:
राधानन्तापराधात्‌ पततां वाधाम्बुधावनुद्धार:।
वृन्दावनमपि मन्दायत इह करुणार्द्रदृक्‌ प्रसारे॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (14.100)

title: धन धन वृन्दावन में वसैं कुम्हार - श्री अभयराम, वृंदावन रहस्य विनोद (98)
sanskrit_text:
धन धन वृन्दावन में वसैं कुम्हार।
भावैं चाक बनावैं बासन, करुये कुलरा करैं अपार॥ [1]
साधु सन्त कौ पानी प्यावैं, इनके कुल को यही विचार।
अभयराम एहूँ बड़भागी, सब कौऊ आवैं इनके द्वार॥ [2]
- श्री अभयराम, वृंदावन रहस्य विनोद (98)
english_text: dhan dhan vrindavan men vasain kumhar. bhavain chak banavain basan, karuye kulara karain apar.. [1] sadhu sant kau pani pyavain, inake kul ko yahi vichar. abhayaram ehun badabhagi, sab kauu avain inake dvar.. [2] - shri abhayaram, vrindavan rahasy vinod (98)
english_translation: dhan dhan vrindavan men vasain kumhar. bhavain chak banavain basan, karuye kulara karain apar.. [1] sadhu sant kau pani pyavain, inake kul ko yahi vichar. abhayaram ehun badabhagi, sab kauu avain inake dvar.. [2] - shri abhayaram, vrindavan rahasy vinod (98)

title: कबहूँ हकधक हो रहै, उठै प्रेम हित गाय  - श्री सहजो बाई
sanskrit_text:
कबहूँ हकधक हो रहै, उठै प्रेम हित गाय।
सहजो आँख मुँदी रहै, कबहूँ सुधि हो जाय॥
- श्री सहजो बाई
english_text: kabahun hakadhak ho rahai, uthai prem hit gay. sahajo ankh mundi rahai, kabahun sudhi ho jay.. - shri sahajo bai
english_translation: kabahun hakadhak ho rahai, uthai prem hit gay. sahajo ankh mundi rahai, kabahun sudhi ho jay.. - shri sahajo bai
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधे आन पड़ो तेरे द्वार - श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (33)
sanskrit_text:
(राग दुर्गा त्रिताल)
राधे आन पड़ो तेरे द्वार।
तुम्हें छोड़ वृषभान दुलारी, कासौं करूँ पुकार॥ [1]
भवसागर में डूब रही हूँ, वेग लगाबो पार।
शरण तिहारी आन पड़ी हूँ, अब ना मानो भार॥ [2]
जीवन प्राण अधार तुम्हीं हो, ये मन लीनो धार।
श्रीगोपाल हित हरि स्वामिनि, तुम बिन हों बेकार॥ [3]
- श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (33)
english_text: (rag durga tritala) radhe an padao tere dvar. tumhen chhoda vrishabhan dulari, kasaun karun pukar.. [1] bhavasagar men dub rahi hun, veg lagabo par. sharan tihari an padai hun, ab na mano bhar.. [2] jivan pran adhar tumhin ho, ye man lino dhar. shrigopal hit hari svamini, tum bin hon bekar.. [3] - shri hit gopal das [seva kunyj vale], nikunj ras vallari (33)

title: कृष्ण-गुरु द्युति परा बहु गायमाना - श्री किशोरी अलि, राधाष्टक (1)
sanskrit_text:
कृष्ण-गुरु द्युति परा बहु गायमाना कृष्णातटे विहरतान्वित कृष्णसारा। 
कृष्णेन कंठमनुषंजित दीर्घबाहुः कृष्णप्रिया वसतु मे हृदये सदैव॥
- श्री किशोरी अलि, राधाष्टक (1)
english_text: krishna-guru dyuti para bahu gayamana krishnatate viharatanvit krishnasara. krishnen knthamanushnjit dirghabahuh krishnapriya vasatu me hridaye sadaiv.. - shri kishori ali, radhashtak (1)
english_translation: krishna-guru dyuti para bahu gayamana krishnatate viharatanvit krishnasara. krishnen knthamanushnjit dirghabahuh krishnapriya vasatu me hridaye sadaiv.. - shri kishori ali, radhashtak (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तेरे चरनन में बलि जाऊँ - श्री भोली गोपी
sanskrit_text:
तेरे चरनन में बलि जाऊँ।
हे मनमोहन श्री बनवारी, दरशन से सुख पाऊँ॥ [1]
माखन मिश्री मोदक मेवा, प्रेम से तोहे खिलाऊँ।
रोम रोम में तेरी सूरत, इक पल भूल न पाऊँ॥ [2]
नन्द गांव गोकुल गोवरधन, ब्रिज तज अनत न जाऊँ। 
'भोली-गोपी' चरनन दासी, जग में तेरी कहाऊँ॥ [3]
- श्री भोली गोपी
english_text: tere charanan men bali jaun. he manamohan shri banavari, darashan se sukh paun.. [1] makhan mishri modak meva, prem se tohe khilaun. rom rom men teri surat, ik pal bhul n paun.. [2] nand ganv gokul govaradhan, brij taj anat n jaun. 'bholi-gopi' charanan dasi, jag men teri kahaun.. [3] - shri bholi gopi

title: गुण गावै गोपाल के भरि लावै दृग नीर - श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (171)
sanskrit_text:
गुण गावै गोपाल के, भरि लावै दृग नीर।
नारायण नहीं कल परै, बिन देखे बलबीर॥
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (171)
english_text: gun gavai gopal ke, bhari lavai drig nir. narayan nahin kal parai, bin dekhe balabir.. - shri narayan svami, anurag ras (171)

title: कोई कहै बैकुंठ, कोई कहै ब्रह्म है - श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (346)
sanskrit_text:
कोई कहै बैकुंठ, कोई कहै ब्रह्म है। 
कोई कहै इह राम, कोई कहै कृष्ण है॥ [1]
कोई कहै यह कुंजनि-कुंजनि, रास कियौ निरधार है। 
हरि हाँ, सबै तजौ जंजाल, भजौ हरिदास कह्यौ सुखसार है॥ [2]
- श्री ललितकिशोरी देव, श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (346)
english_text: koi kahai baikunth, koi kahai brahm hai. koi kahai ih ram, koi kahai krishn hai.. [1] koi kahai yah kunjani-kunjani, ras kiyau niradhar hai. hari han, sabai tajau jnjal, bhajau haridas kahyau sukhasar hai.. [2] - shri lalitakishori dev, shri lalitakishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (346)
english_translation: koi kahai baikunth, koi kahai brahm hai. koi kahai ih ram, koi kahai krishn hai.. [1] koi kahai yah kunjani-kunjani, ras kiyau niradhar hai. hari han, sabai tajau jnjal, bhajau haridas kahyau sukhasar hai.. [2] - shri lalitakishori dev, shri lalitakishori dev ju ki vani, siddhant ki sakhi (346)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यह सुख समुझन कौं कछू - श्री हित ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, प्रेमावली (49)
sanskrit_text:
यह सुख समुझन कौं कछू, नाहिंन आन उपाइ।
प्रेम दरीची जौ कबहुँ, सहज कृपा खुलि जाइ॥
- श्री हित ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, प्रेमावली (49)
english_text: yah sukh samujhan kaun kachhu, nahinn an upai. prem darichi jau kabahun, sahaj kripa khuli jai.. - shri hit dhruvadas, bayalis lila, premavali (49)
english_translation: yah sukh samujhan kaun kachhu, nahinn an upai. prem darichi jau kabahun, sahaj kripa khuli jai.. - shri hit dhruvadas, bayalis lila, premavali (49)
